import { keccak256, stringToHex } from "viem";
import { LiabilityRepo, LiabilityDbRecord } from "../database/repos/liabilityRepo.js";
import { TreasuryAccountsRepo } from "../database/repos/treasuryAccountsRepo.js";
import { VendorMasterRepo } from "../database/repos/vendorMasterRepo.js";
import { VendorBankRepo } from "../database/repos/vendorBankRepo.js";
import { VendorPaymentPreferenceRepo, FiatSubMethodType } from "../database/repos/vendorPaymentPreferenceRepo.js";
import { AuditLogRepo } from "../database/repos/auditLogRepo.js";
import { DynamicRecordsService } from "../records/dynamicRecordsService.js";
import { LiabilityCategory, LiabilityStatus } from "../types/accounts.js";
import { PaymentRailType } from "../payments/rails/types.js";

export interface CreateLiabilityParams {
  accountId: string;
  vendorId: string;
  vendorName?: string;
  title: string;
  category: LiabilityCategory;
  amountUsdc: number;
  dueDate: Date | string;
  frequencyCron?: string;
  payoutAddress?: `0x${string}` | string;
  serviceUrl?: string;
  poReference?: string;
  preferredPaymentRail?: PaymentRailType;
  preferredSubMethod?: FiatSubMethodType | string;
  fiatDetails?: {
    accountHolderName: string;
    ibanOrAccountNumber: string;
    routingOrSwift?: string;
    bankName?: string;
    bankCountry?: string;
    cardToken?: string;
    cardLast4?: string;
    cardNetwork?: string;
    paymentSubMethod?: string;
  };
  cryptoDetails?: {
    walletAddress?: `0x${string}` | string;
    chainId?: number;
    tokenSymbol?: string;
    sessionKeyId?: string;
    serviceEndpointUrl?: string;
  };
  paymentRailConfig?: Record<string, any>;
  disbursalRules?: Record<string, any>;
  waterfallOverride?: Record<string, any>;
}

export interface ILiabilityManagementService {
  createLiability(companyId: string, params: CreateLiabilityParams): Promise<LiabilityDbRecord>;
  updateLiability(companyId: string, liabilityId: string, params: Partial<CreateLiabilityParams>): Promise<LiabilityDbRecord>;
  cancelLiability(companyId: string, liabilityId: string, adminInstruction: string): Promise<LiabilityDbRecord>;
  listLiabilities(companyId: string, filter?: { accountId?: string; status?: LiabilityStatus }): Promise<LiabilityDbRecord[]>;
}

export class LiabilityManagementService implements ILiabilityManagementService {
  private dynamicRecords: DynamicRecordsService;

  constructor(options?: { dynamicRecords?: DynamicRecordsService }) {
    this.dynamicRecords = options?.dynamicRecords ?? new DynamicRecordsService();
  }

  /**
   * Post-setup liability creation. Enforces account ownership, Rule 5 Loud Rounding, and updates Dynamic Records.
   */
  public async createLiability(
    companyId: string,
    params: CreateLiabilityParams
  ): Promise<LiabilityDbRecord> {
    if (!companyId || !params.accountId || !params.vendorId || !params.title) {
      throw new Error("LIABILITY_VALIDATION_ERROR: 'companyId', 'accountId', 'vendorId', and 'title' are required.");
    }

    // 1. Verify account belongs to tenant
    const account = await TreasuryAccountsRepo.getAccountByIdAndCompany(params.accountId, companyId);
    if (!account) {
      throw new Error(`LIABILITY_ATTACHMENT_ERROR: Account '${params.accountId}' not found for company '${companyId}'.`);
    }

    // 2. Rule 5 Loud Rounding & Value Validation
    const amountNum = Number(params.amountUsdc);
    if (isNaN(amountNum) || amountNum <= 0) {
      throw new Error("LOUD_ROUNDING_ERROR (Rule 5): Liability amount must be strictly greater than 0 USDC.");
    }
    const decParts = amountNum.toString().split(".");
    if (decParts.length === 2 && decParts[1].length > 6) {
      throw new Error(`LOUD_ROUNDING_ERROR (Rule 5): Amount '${params.amountUsdc}' exceeds 6-decimal USDC precision.`);
    }

    // 3. Process Multi-Modal Payment Preferences & Banking Details
    let bankAccountId: string | undefined;
    const isFiat = params.preferredPaymentRail === "FIAT_PAYOUT" || !!params.fiatDetails;
    const effectiveRail = params.preferredPaymentRail || (isFiat ? "FIAT_PAYOUT" : (params.serviceUrl ? "GATEWAY_X402" : "DISBURSAL_VAULT"));

    if (isFiat && params.fiatDetails) {
      const subMethod = params.preferredSubMethod || params.fiatDetails.paymentSubMethod || (params.fiatDetails.cardToken ? "PUSH_TO_CARD" : "FEDWIRE");
      const bankRecord = await VendorBankRepo.createBankAccount({
        vendor_id: params.vendorId,
        account_holder_name: params.fiatDetails.accountHolderName,
        iban_account_number: params.fiatDetails.ibanOrAccountNumber,
        routing_swift: params.fiatDetails.routingOrSwift || (subMethod === "PUSH_TO_CARD" ? "CARD_OCT" : "021000018"),
        bank_name: params.fiatDetails.bankName,
        bank_country: params.fiatDetails.bankCountry || "US",
        payment_sub_method: subMethod,
        card_token: params.fiatDetails.cardToken || null,
        card_last4: params.fiatDetails.cardLast4 || (params.fiatDetails.ibanOrAccountNumber.length === 16 ? params.fiatDetails.ibanOrAccountNumber.slice(-4) : null),
        card_network: params.fiatDetails.cardNetwork || null,
        is_verified: true,
        verified_by_admin: "LIABILITY_MANAGEMENT_SERVICE",
      });
      bankAccountId = bankRecord.bank_account_id;
    }

    let payoutAddr: string | undefined = params.payoutAddress || params.cryptoDetails?.walletAddress;
    if (!payoutAddr || typeof payoutAddr !== "string" || !payoutAddr.startsWith("0x") || payoutAddr.length !== 42) {
      payoutAddr = isFiat ? (bankAccountId || params.vendorId) : undefined;
    }

    // Register Vendor in Vendor Master Registry
    await VendorMasterRepo.registerVendor({
      vendor_id: params.vendorId,
      name: params.vendorName || params.vendorId,
      verified_payout_address: payoutAddr && payoutAddr.startsWith("0x") ? (payoutAddr as `0x${string}`) : null,
      verified_by_admin: "LIABILITY_MANAGEMENT_SERVICE",
      last_verified_at: new Date(),
      change_lock: true,
    });

    // Persist to VendorPaymentPreferenceRepo
    await VendorPaymentPreferenceRepo.setPreference({
      vendor_id: params.vendorId,
      preferred_rail: effectiveRail,
      preferred_sub_method: params.preferredSubMethod || null,
      crypto_wallet_address: params.cryptoDetails?.walletAddress || (payoutAddr && payoutAddr.startsWith("0x") ? payoutAddr : null),
      crypto_chain_id: params.cryptoDetails?.chainId ?? 5042,
      crypto_token_symbol: params.cryptoDetails?.tokenSymbol || "USDC",
      bank_account_id: bankAccountId || null,
      service_endpoint_url: params.serviceUrl || params.cryptoDetails?.serviceEndpointUrl || null,
      session_key_id: params.cryptoDetails?.sessionKeyId || null,
      configuration_payload: {
        disbursalRules: params.disbursalRules,
        fiatDetails: params.fiatDetails,
      },
    });

    // 4. Compute Document Hashes
    const poHash = params.poReference
      ? keccak256(stringToHex(`PO:${params.poReference}:${params.amountUsdc}`))
      : null;
    const invHash = keccak256(stringToHex(`INV:${params.title}:${params.amountUsdc}:${Date.now()}`));

    const dueDateObj = typeof params.dueDate === "string" ? new Date(params.dueDate) : params.dueDate;

    const mergedRailConfig = {
      ...(params.paymentRailConfig || {}),
      subMethod: params.preferredSubMethod,
      bankAccountId,
      serviceUrl: params.serviceUrl || params.cryptoDetails?.serviceEndpointUrl,
      sessionKeyId: params.cryptoDetails?.sessionKeyId,
      beneficiaryBank: params.fiatDetails,
    };

    const liabilityRecord: LiabilityDbRecord = {
      company_id: companyId,
      account_id: params.accountId,
      vendor_id: params.vendorId,
      title: params.title,
      category: params.category || "SAAS",
      amount_usdc: amountNum,
      due_date: dueDateObj,
      frequency_cron: params.frequencyCron || "0 0 1 * *",
      payout_address: payoutAddr,
      source_po_hash: poHash,
      source_invoice_hash: invHash,
      status: "SCHEDULED",
      preferred_payment_rail: effectiveRail,
      payment_rail_config: mergedRailConfig,
      disbursal_rules: params.disbursalRules || {
        autoPayThresholdUsdc: 500,
        requireThreeWayMatch: true,
        preFlightLeadTimeHours: 48,
      },
      waterfall_override: params.waterfallOverride || null,
    };

    const saved = await LiabilityRepo.createLiability(liabilityRecord);

    // Re-anchor Dynamic Record 2 immediately
    await this.dynamicRecords.calculateSafeToInvest(params.accountId);

    // Audit Logging
    await AuditLogRepo.appendAuditLog({
      account_id: params.accountId,
      action_type: "LIABILITY_SCHEDULED",
      amount_usdc: amountNum,
      is_autonomous: false,
      reason: `Liability '${params.title}' scheduled for vendor '${params.vendorId}'. Rail: ${saved.preferred_payment_rail}`,
      pre_state_snapshot: {},
      post_state_snapshot: saved as any,
      actor_agent: "HUMAN_ADMIN",
    });

    return saved;
  }

  /**
   * Post-setup liability parameter updates. Re-anchors Dynamic Record 1 and recalculates Record 2.
   */
  public async updateLiability(
    companyId: string,
    liabilityId: string,
    params: Partial<CreateLiabilityParams>
  ): Promise<LiabilityDbRecord> {
    const existing = await LiabilityRepo.getLiabilityByIdAndCompany(liabilityId, companyId);
    if (!existing) {
      throw new Error(`LIABILITY_NOT_FOUND: Liability '${liabilityId}' does not exist for company '${companyId}'.`);
    }

    // If changing account, verify new account belongs to company
    if (params.accountId && params.accountId !== existing.account_id) {
      const newAcc = await TreasuryAccountsRepo.getAccountByIdAndCompany(params.accountId, companyId);
      if (!newAcc) {
        throw new Error(`LIABILITY_ATTACHMENT_ERROR: Target account '${params.accountId}' not found for company '${companyId}'.`);
      }
    }

    if (params.amountUsdc !== undefined) {
      const amountNum = Number(params.amountUsdc);
      if (isNaN(amountNum) || amountNum <= 0) {
        throw new Error("LOUD_ROUNDING_ERROR (Rule 5): Liability amount must be strictly positive.");
      }
      const decParts = amountNum.toString().split(".");
      if (decParts.length === 2 && decParts[1].length > 6) {
        throw new Error(`LOUD_ROUNDING_ERROR (Rule 5): Amount '${params.amountUsdc}' exceeds 6-decimal precision.`);
      }
    }

    // Process Bank & Payment Preference updates if provided
    let updatedBankAccountId: string | undefined = existing.payment_rail_config?.bankAccountId;
    const vendorId = params.vendorId || existing.vendor_id;

    if (params.fiatDetails) {
      const subMethod = params.preferredSubMethod || params.fiatDetails.paymentSubMethod || (params.fiatDetails.cardToken ? "PUSH_TO_CARD" : "FEDWIRE");
      const bankRecord = await VendorBankRepo.createBankAccount({
        vendor_id: vendorId,
        account_holder_name: params.fiatDetails.accountHolderName,
        iban_account_number: params.fiatDetails.ibanOrAccountNumber,
        routing_swift: params.fiatDetails.routingOrSwift || (subMethod === "PUSH_TO_CARD" ? "CARD_OCT" : "021000018"),
        bank_name: params.fiatDetails.bankName,
        bank_country: params.fiatDetails.bankCountry || "US",
        payment_sub_method: subMethod,
        card_token: params.fiatDetails.cardToken || null,
        card_last4: params.fiatDetails.cardLast4 || (params.fiatDetails.ibanOrAccountNumber.length === 16 ? params.fiatDetails.ibanOrAccountNumber.slice(-4) : null),
        card_network: params.fiatDetails.cardNetwork || null,
        is_verified: true,
        verified_by_admin: "LIABILITY_MANAGEMENT_SERVICE",
      });
      updatedBankAccountId = bankRecord.bank_account_id;
    }

    if (params.preferredPaymentRail || params.preferredSubMethod || params.fiatDetails || params.cryptoDetails) {
      await VendorPaymentPreferenceRepo.setPreference({
        vendor_id: vendorId,
        preferred_rail: (params.preferredPaymentRail || existing.preferred_payment_rail || "DISBURSAL_VAULT") as PaymentRailType,
        preferred_sub_method: params.preferredSubMethod || existing.payment_rail_config?.subMethod || null,
        crypto_wallet_address: params.cryptoDetails?.walletAddress || (params.payoutAddress?.startsWith("0x") ? params.payoutAddress : null),
        crypto_chain_id: params.cryptoDetails?.chainId ?? 5042,
        crypto_token_symbol: params.cryptoDetails?.tokenSymbol || "USDC",
        bank_account_id: updatedBankAccountId || null,
        service_endpoint_url: params.serviceUrl || params.cryptoDetails?.serviceEndpointUrl || null,
        session_key_id: params.cryptoDetails?.sessionKeyId || null,
        configuration_payload: {
          disbursalRules: params.disbursalRules,
          fiatDetails: params.fiatDetails,
        },
      });
    }

    const mergedRailConfig = {
      ...(existing.payment_rail_config || {}),
      ...(params.paymentRailConfig || {}),
      subMethod: params.preferredSubMethod !== undefined ? params.preferredSubMethod : existing.payment_rail_config?.subMethod,
      bankAccountId: updatedBankAccountId,
      serviceUrl: params.serviceUrl || params.cryptoDetails?.serviceEndpointUrl || existing.payment_rail_config?.serviceUrl,
      sessionKeyId: params.cryptoDetails?.sessionKeyId || existing.payment_rail_config?.sessionKeyId,
      beneficiaryBank: params.fiatDetails || existing.payment_rail_config?.beneficiaryBank,
    };

    const updates: Partial<LiabilityDbRecord> = {};
    if (params.accountId) updates.account_id = params.accountId;
    if (params.vendorId) updates.vendor_id = params.vendorId;
    if (params.title) updates.title = params.title;
    if (params.category) updates.category = params.category;
    if (params.amountUsdc !== undefined) updates.amount_usdc = Number(params.amountUsdc);
    if (params.dueDate) updates.due_date = typeof params.dueDate === "string" ? new Date(params.dueDate) : params.dueDate;
    if (params.frequencyCron !== undefined) updates.frequency_cron = params.frequencyCron;
    if (params.payoutAddress) updates.payout_address = params.payoutAddress;
    if (params.preferredPaymentRail) updates.preferred_payment_rail = params.preferredPaymentRail;
    updates.payment_rail_config = mergedRailConfig;
    if (params.disbursalRules) updates.disbursal_rules = params.disbursalRules;
    if (params.waterfallOverride !== undefined) updates.waterfall_override = params.waterfallOverride;

    const saved = await LiabilityRepo.updateLiability(liabilityId, companyId, updates);
    if (!saved) {
      throw new Error(`LIABILITY_UPDATE_FAILED: Failed to update liability '${liabilityId}'.`);
    }

    // Re-anchor Dynamic Record 2 for the affected account(s)
    await this.dynamicRecords.calculateSafeToInvest(existing.account_id);
    if (params.accountId && params.accountId !== existing.account_id) {
      await this.dynamicRecords.calculateSafeToInvest(params.accountId);
    }

    // Audit Logging
    await AuditLogRepo.appendAuditLog({
      account_id: saved.account_id,
      action_type: "LIABILITY_UPDATED",
      amount_usdc: saved.amount_usdc,
      is_autonomous: false,
      reason: `Liability '${liabilityId}' parameters modified by organization administrator.`,
      pre_state_snapshot: existing as any,
      post_state_snapshot: saved as any,
      actor_agent: "HUMAN_ADMIN",
    });

    return saved;
  }

  /**
   * Cancels a recurring liability.
   * Strict Invariant: Records are never deleted. Status is set to CANCELLED and task memo is recorded.
   */
  public async cancelLiability(
    companyId: string,
    liabilityId: string,
    adminInstruction: string
  ): Promise<LiabilityDbRecord> {
    const existing = await LiabilityRepo.getLiabilityByIdAndCompany(liabilityId, companyId);
    if (!existing) {
      throw new Error(`LIABILITY_NOT_FOUND: Liability '${liabilityId}' does not exist for company '${companyId}'.`);
    }

    const mergedRules = {
      ...(existing.disbursal_rules || {}),
      cancellationMemo: adminInstruction,
      cancelledAt: new Date().toISOString(),
      cancelledBy: "HUMAN_ADMIN",
    };

    const updated = await LiabilityRepo.updateLiability(liabilityId, companyId, {
      status: "CANCELLED",
      disbursal_rules: mergedRules,
    });

    if (!updated) {
      throw new Error(`LIABILITY_CANCEL_FAILED: Failed to cancel liability '${liabilityId}'.`);
    }

    // Re-anchor Dynamic Record 2 (releases reserved operating funds)
    await this.dynamicRecords.calculateSafeToInvest(existing.account_id);

    // Audit Logging
    await AuditLogRepo.appendAuditLog({
      account_id: existing.account_id,
      action_type: "LIABILITY_CANCELLED",
      amount_usdc: existing.amount_usdc,
      is_autonomous: false,
      reason: `Liability '${existing.title}' cancelled by admin. Instruction: ${adminInstruction}`,
      pre_state_snapshot: { status: existing.status },
      post_state_snapshot: { status: "CANCELLED", cancellationMemo: adminInstruction },
      actor_agent: "HUMAN_ADMIN",
    });

    return updated;
  }

  /**
   * Lists liabilities for a company with optional filters.
   */
  public async listLiabilities(
    companyId: string,
    filter?: { accountId?: string; status?: LiabilityStatus }
  ): Promise<LiabilityDbRecord[]> {
    return await LiabilityRepo.getLiabilitiesByCompany(companyId, filter);
  }
}

import { PublicClient, keccak256, encodePacked, WalletClient } from "viem";
import { VendorMasterRepo, VendorMasterRecord } from "../database/repos/vendorMasterRepo.js";

export interface ThreeWayMatchParams {
  vendorId: string;
  invoiceId: string;
  poHash: `0x${string}`;
  invoiceHash: `0x${string}`;
  poAmountUsdc: bigint;        // Exact 6-decimal units
  invoiceAmountUsdc: bigint;   // Exact 6-decimal units
  payoutAddress: `0x${string}`;
  deliveryVerified: boolean;
  notes?: string;
}

export interface ThreeWayMatchResult {
  passed: boolean;
  idempotencyKey?: `0x${string}`;
  rejectionReason?: string;
  vendorRecord?: VendorMasterRecord;
  requiresHumanGate: boolean;
}

export class VendorMasterService {
  private disbursalVaultService?: DisbursalVaultService;
  private adminWalletAdapter?: ViemWalletAdapter;
  private publicClient: PublicClient;

  constructor(params?: {
    disbursalVaultAddress?: `0x${string}`;
    adminWalletAdapter?: ViemWalletAdapter;
    publicClient?: PublicClient;
    chainId?: number;
  }) {
    this.publicClient = params?.publicClient ?? ArcClientManager.getPublicClient();
    if (params?.disbursalVaultAddress) {
      this.disbursalVaultService = new DisbursalVaultService(
        params.disbursalVaultAddress,
        params.chainId ?? 5042002,
        this.publicClient
      );
    }
    this.adminWalletAdapter = params?.adminWalletAdapter;
  }

  /**
   * Seeds initial verified vendors into PostgreSQL and onchain allowlist in DisbursalVault.
   */
  public async seedInitialVendors(
    vendors: InitialVendorSeed[] = DEFAULT_PRODUCTION_VENDORS
  ): Promise<VendorMasterRecord[]> {
    const records: VendorMasterRecord[] = [];

    for (const v of vendors) {
      const record = await VendorMasterRepo.registerVendor({
        vendor_id: v.vendor_id,
        name: v.name,
        verified_payout_address: v.verified_payout_address.toLowerCase() as `0x${string}`,
        verified_by_admin: v.verified_by_admin,
        last_verified_at: new Date(),
        change_lock: true,
      });

      records.push(record);

      // Synchronize with onchain allowlist if contract and admin adapter available
      if (this.disbursalVaultService && this.adminWalletAdapter) {
        try {
          const isApproved = await this.disbursalVaultService.isVendorApproved(
            v.verified_payout_address
          );
          if (!isApproved) {
            await this.adminWalletAdapter.executeContract({
              targetContract: this.disbursalVaultService.getAddress(),
              abi: DisbursalVaultABI,
              functionName: "setVendorApproval",
              args: [v.verified_payout_address, true],
              idempotencyKey: `seed_vendor_${v.vendor_id}`,
            });
          }
        } catch (err) {
          console.warn(`Could not set onchain approval for vendor ${v.vendor_id}:`, err);
        }
      }
    }

    return records;
  }

  /**
   * Rule 2: Enforce the Three-Way Match Before Payment
   * Rule 3: Vendor Master Change Control (Prevent Payee Substitution)
   * Rule 5: Make Repair Loud — Refuse Silent Rounding
   */
  public async verifyThreeWayMatch(
    params: ThreeWayMatchParams
  ): Promise<ThreeWayMatchResult> {
    // 1. Verify vendor exists in Master Registry
    const vendor = await VendorMasterRepo.getVendorById(params.vendorId);
    if (!vendor) {
      return {
        passed: false,
        rejectionReason: `VENDOR_NOT_FOUND: Vendor ID ${params.vendorId} does not exist in master registry.`,
        requiresHumanGate: true,
      };
    }

    // 2. Payee Substitution Protection (Rule 3)
    const verifiedAddr = vendor.verified_payout_address?.toLowerCase();
    if (verifiedAddr && params.payoutAddress.toLowerCase() !== verifiedAddr) {
      return {
        passed: false,
        rejectionReason: `PAYEE_SUBSTITUTION_DETECTED: Payout address ${params.payoutAddress} differs from verified master address ${vendor.verified_payout_address}.`,
        vendorRecord: vendor,
        requiresHumanGate: true,
      };
    }

    // 3. Document Linkage & Delivery Verification (Rule 1 & Rule 2)
    if (!params.poHash || params.poHash === "0x" || !params.invoiceHash || params.invoiceHash === "0x") {
      return {
        passed: false,
        rejectionReason: "DOCUMENT_HASH_MISSING: Both PO hash and Invoice hash must be present.",
        vendorRecord: vendor,
        requiresHumanGate: true,
      };
    }

    if (!params.deliveryVerified) {
      return {
        passed: false,
        rejectionReason: "GOODS_DELIVERY_UNVERIFIED: Milestone or Goods Receipt delivery has not been verified.",
        vendorRecord: vendor,
        requiresHumanGate: true,
      };
    }

    // 4. Exact Arithmetic Check (Rule 5)
    if (params.poAmountUsdc !== params.invoiceAmountUsdc) {
      return {
        passed: false,
        rejectionReason: `AMOUNT_MISMATCH: PO amount (${params.poAmountUsdc}) != Invoice amount (${params.invoiceAmountUsdc}). Refusing silent rounding.`,
        vendorRecord: vendor,
        requiresHumanGate: true,
      };
    }

    // 5. Generate Deterministic Idempotency Key
    const payoutTarget = (vendor.verified_payout_address || params.payoutAddress) as `0x${string}`;
    const idempotencyKey = DisbursalVaultService.generateIdempotencyKey(
      payoutTarget,
      params.invoiceId,
      params.invoiceAmountUsdc
    );

    // 6. Check if already executed onchain
    if (this.disbursalVaultService) {
      try {
        const isExecuted = await this.disbursalVaultService.isIdempotencyKeyExecuted(idempotencyKey);
        if (isExecuted) {
          return {
            passed: false,
            idempotencyKey,
            rejectionReason: `IDEMPOTENCY_COLLISION: Key ${idempotencyKey} has already been executed onchain.`,
            vendorRecord: vendor,
            requiresHumanGate: false,
          };
        }
      } catch (err) {
        console.warn("Could not check onchain idempotency key:", err);
      }
    }

    // 7. Check spending caps against policy
    const { profile: policy } = PolicyLoader.getActiveProfile();
    const amountFloat = Number(params.invoiceAmountUsdc) / 1e6;
    const requiresHumanGate =
      amountFloat >= policy.spending_limits.single_tx_human_gate_threshold_usdc;

    if (amountFloat > policy.spending_limits.daily_hard_cap_usdc) {
      return {
        passed: false,
        idempotencyKey,
        rejectionReason: `DAILY_HARD_CAP_EXCEEDED: Amount $${amountFloat} exceeds daily cap $${policy.spending_limits.daily_hard_cap_usdc}.`,
        vendorRecord: vendor,
        requiresHumanGate: true,
      };
    }

    return {
      passed: true,
      idempotencyKey,
      vendorRecord: vendor,
      requiresHumanGate,
    };
  }

  /**
   * Prepares or stages an SPRS permission request if human approval is needed.
   */
  public async createPaymentPermissionRequest(params: {
    requestId: string;
    actionType: string;
    reason: string;
    amountUsdc: number;
    payload: Record<string, any>;
  }): Promise<PermissionRequestRecord> {
    return PermissionRequestRepo.createRequest({
      request_id: params.requestId,
      action_type: params.actionType,
      reason: params.reason,
      amount_usdc: params.amountUsdc,
      status: "PENDING",
      payload: params.payload,
    });
  }

  /**
   * Helper to sign EIP-712 approval for admin authorization gatekeeper.
   */
  public async signAdminApproval(
    message: DisbursalApprovalMessage,
    adminAdapter: ViemWalletAdapter
  ): Promise<`0x${string}`> {
    if (!this.disbursalVaultService) {
      throw new Error("DisbursalVaultService is required to compute typed data.");
    }
    const typedData = this.disbursalVaultService.getEIP712TypedData(message);
    return adminAdapter.signTypedData(typedData as any);
  }
}

import crypto from "node:crypto";
import { TreasuryAccountsRepo } from "../database/repos/treasuryAccountsRepo.js";
import { MasterJournalRepo } from "../database/repos/masterJournalRepo.js";

export type FundingRail =
  | "FIAT_CARD_ONRAMP"
  | "FIAT_FEDWIRE"
  | "FIAT_ACH"
  | "FIAT_SEPA"
  | "CRYPTO_ARC_NATIVE"
  | "CRYPTO_CROSS_CHAIN_CCTP"
  | "CRYPTO_TOKEN_SWAP";

export interface AccountFundingOptionsResult {

/**
 * AccountFundingService
 *
 * Provides complete multi-pathway funding infrastructure for ANY BizArc treasury account:
 * - Operating Account
 * - Payroll Account
 * - Tax Account
 * - Central Yield Vault / Reserve
 *
 * Supports both:
 * 1. Fiat Pathways:
 *    - Instant Card / Apple Pay On-ramp (Circle Mint checkout & CLI)
 *    - Institutional Fedwire with unique tracking memo (BIZARC-MINT-<ACCOUNT>)
 *    - Domestic ACH Direct Transfer
 *    - Euro SEPA / SEPA Instant
 * 2. Crypto Pathways:
 *    - Arc L1 Native Direct Deposit (USDC as gas, sub-second)
 *    - Cross-Chain Bridge via CCTP (Base, Ethereum, Arbitrum, Solana)
 *    - Multi-Token Inflow with Auto-Swap to USDC (Circle Swap Kit)
 */
export class AccountFundingService {
  private dynamicRecords: DynamicRecordsService;
  private tokenSwapService: TokenSwapService;

  constructor(options?: {
    dynamicRecords?: DynamicRecordsService;
    tokenSwapService?: TokenSwapService;
  }) {
    this.dynamicRecords = options?.dynamicRecords ?? new DynamicRecordsService();
    this.tokenSwapService = options?.tokenSwapService ?? new TokenSwapService();
  }

  /**
   * Returns comprehensive funding options and deposit coordinates for any account.
   */
  public async getFundingOptions(accountId: string): Promise<AccountFundingOptionsResult> {
    const account = await TreasuryAccountsRepo.getAccountById(accountId);
    if (!account || !account.wallet_address) {
      throw new Error(`[AccountFundingService] ACCOUNT_WALLET_NOT_CONFIGURED: Account '${accountId}' does not have a configured wallet address.`);
    }
    const targetAddress = account.wallet_address;
    const accountRole = account?.role || "OPERATING";
    const trackingMemo = `BIZARC-MINT-${accountId.toUpperCase()}-${targetAddress.slice(2, 8).toUpperCase()}`;

    return {
      accountId,
      accountRole,
      accountWalletAddress: targetAddress,
      fiatOptions: {
        cardOnramp: {
          available: true,
          description: "Instant debit/credit card or Apple Pay funding directly into account balance.",
          supportedCurrencies: ["USD", "EUR", "GBP", "CAD"],
          settlementSpeed: "Instant (< 2 minutes)",
          maxAmountUsdc: 10000,
        },
        fedwire: {
          available: true,
          beneficiaryName: "Circle Internet Financial LLC",
          bankName: "Bank of New York Mellon (BNY Mellon)",
          routingNumber: "021000018",
          accountNumber: "8900481239",
          trackingMemo,
          settlementSpeed: "Same-Day (during Fedwire banking hours)",
        },
        ach: {
          available: true,
          routingNumber: "021000018",
          accountNumber: "8900481239",
          trackingMemo,
          settlementSpeed: "1-2 Business Days",
        },
        sepa: {
          available: true,
          iban: "LU1200000000000000000",
          swiftBic: "IRVTUS3N",
          trackingMemo,
          settlementSpeed: "SEPA Instant (< 30 seconds) / Next Business Day",
        },
      },
      cryptoOptions: {
        arcNative: {
          available: true,
          chain: "Arc L1",
          chainId: 5042,
          token: "USDC (Native Gas)",
          depositAddress: targetAddress,
          settlementSpeed: "Sub-second (< 500ms)",
          gasFloorGwei: 20,
        },
        crossChainBridge: {
          available: true,
          supportedChains: ["Base", "Ethereum", "Arbitrum", "Optimism", "Solana", "Polygon"],
          targetAddress,
          settlementSpeed: "1-3 minutes (via Circle CCTP)",
        },
        multiTokenSwap: {
          available: true,
          supportedTokens: ["USDT", "DAI", "ETH", "WBTC"],
          depositAddress: targetAddress,
          autoConvertToken: "USDC",
        },
      },
    };
  }

  /**
   * Initiates a funding session (e.g. Card checkout link or Cross-Chain intent).
   */
  public async initiateFundingSession(params: InitiateFundingParams): Promise<{
    sessionId: string;
    accountId: string;
    method: FundingRail;
    amountUsdc: number;
    checkoutUrl?: string;
    cliCommandVerbatim?: string;
    trackingMemo?: string;
    depositAddress?: string;
    expiresAt: string;
  }> {
    const account = await TreasuryAccountsRepo.getAccountById(params.accountId);
    if (!account || !account.wallet_address) {
      throw new Error(`[AccountFundingService] ACCOUNT_WALLET_NOT_CONFIGURED: Account '${params.accountId}' does not have a configured wallet address.`);
    }
    const targetAddress = account.wallet_address;
    const sessionId = `fund_${Date.now()}_${Math.random().toString(36).slice(2, 8)}`;
    const expiresAt = new Date(Date.now() + 3600 * 1000).toISOString();
    const trackingMemo = `BIZARC-MINT-${params.accountId.toUpperCase()}-${sessionId.slice(5, 11).toUpperCase()}`;

    let checkoutUrl: string | undefined;
    let cliCommandVerbatim: string | undefined;
    let depositAddress: string | undefined = targetAddress;

    if (params.method === "FIAT_CARD_ONRAMP") {
      cliCommandVerbatim = `circle wallet fund --address ${targetAddress} --chain ARC --amount ${params.amountUsdc.toFixed(2)} --token usdc --method fiat --open`;
      checkoutUrl = `https://checkout.circle.com/onramp?session=${sessionId}&address=${targetAddress}&chain=ARC&amount=${params.amountUsdc}&email=${encodeURIComponent(params.userEmail || "")}`;

      await FiatDepositSessionRepo.createSession({
        session_id: sessionId,
        account_id: params.accountId,
        method: "CARD_ONRAMP",
        amount_usdc: params.amountUsdc,
        tracking_memo: trackingMemo,
        checkout_url: checkoutUrl,
        cli_command: cliCommandVerbatim,
        status: "PENDING",
      });
    } else if (params.method === "FIAT_FEDWIRE" || params.method === "FIAT_ACH" || params.method === "FIAT_SEPA") {
      await FiatDepositSessionRepo.createSession({
        session_id: sessionId,
        account_id: params.accountId,
        method: params.method.replace("FIAT_", "") as any,
        amount_usdc: params.amountUsdc,
        tracking_memo: trackingMemo,
        status: "PENDING",
      });
    }

    return {
      sessionId,
      accountId: params.accountId,
      method: params.method,
      amountUsdc: params.amountUsdc,
      checkoutUrl,
      cliCommandVerbatim,
      trackingMemo,
      depositAddress,
      expiresAt,
    };
  }

  /**
   * Reconciles a confirmed deposit (fiat wire, card settlement, or crypto inflow),
   * crediting the designated account's liquid balance in PostgreSQL and posting double-entry vouchers.
   */
  public async reconcileDeposit(params: ReconcileFundingDepositParams): Promise<ReconcileFundingDepositResult> {
    const timestamp = new Date().toISOString();
    const depositId = `dep_${Date.now()}_${Math.random().toString(36).slice(2, 8)}`;
    const txHash = params.sourceTxHash || `0x${crypto.createHash("sha256").update(`${depositId}:${params.depositReference}`).digest("hex")}`;

    // Confirm session in database if memo matches
    try {
      const session = await FiatDepositSessionRepo.getSessionByMemo(params.depositReference);
      if (session) {
        await FiatDepositSessionRepo.confirmSession(session.session_id);
      }
    } catch {
      // Non-fatal
    }

    // 1. Double-Entry Master Journal Entry: Debit Cash, Credit Equity/Capital
    const isCrypto = params.method.startsWith("CRYPTO_");
    const creditCategory = isCrypto ? "Equity:CryptoTreasuryContribution" : "Equity:FiatCapitalContribution";

    const entry = await MasterJournalRepo.appendEntry({
      account_id: params.accountId,
      action_type: `ACCOUNT_FUNDING_${params.method}`,
      debit_account: `Asset:Cash:USDC:${params.accountId}`,
      credit_account: `${creditCategory}:${params.accountId}`,
      amount_usdc: params.amountUsdc,
      document_ref: params.depositReference,
    });

    // 2. Audit Log Entry
    await AuditLogRepo.appendAuditLog({
      account_id: params.accountId,
      actor_agent: "AccountFundingManager",
      action_type: `ACCOUNT_FUNDING_CONFIRMED_${params.method}`,
      amount_usdc: params.amountUsdc,
      is_autonomous: true,
      tx_hash: txHash,
      reason: `Account '${params.accountId}' funded with $${params.amountUsdc.toFixed(2)} USDC via ${params.method} (Ref: ${params.depositReference})`,
      pre_state_snapshot: { accountId: params.accountId },
      post_state_snapshot: { creditedAmount: params.amountUsdc, depositId },
    });

    // 3. Update Liquid Balances in PostgreSQL (Dynamic Record 1 & 2)
    const currentTrip = await this.dynamicRecords.getTripartiteBalance(params.accountId);
    const addedRaw = this.dynamicRecords.parseUsdcToRaw(params.amountUsdc.toFixed(6));
    const newLiquidRaw = currentTrip.liquidCashRaw + addedRaw;

    await this.dynamicRecords.calculateSafeToInvest(
      params.accountId,
      7 * 86400,
      undefined,
      newLiquidRaw,
      currentTrip.investedYieldRaw
    );

    const updatedTrip = await this.dynamicRecords.getTripartiteBalance(params.accountId);

    return {
      depositId,
      accountId: params.accountId,
      method: params.method,
      amountUsdc: params.amountUsdc,
      creditedBalanceUsdc: parseFloat(updatedTrip.liquidCashUsdc),
      journalSequenceId: entry.sequence_id || "",
      txHash,
      status: "CONFIRMED",
      timestamp,
    };
  }
}

import { CentralTreasuryYieldVaultABI } from "../contracts/artifacts.js";
import { ViemWalletAdapter } from "../foundation/wallets/viemWalletAdapter.js";
import { ArcClientManager } from "../foundation/arc/client.js";

export interface AccountRegistrationStatus {
  accountId: string;
  name: string;
  role: string;
  walletAddress: `0x${string}`;
  dbRegistered: boolean;
  onchainRegistered: boolean;
  onchainWalletAddress?: `0x${string}`;
  shares: bigint;
  assetsUsdc: bigint;
  minOperatingFloorUsdc: number;
  safetyBufferRatio: number;
}

export const DEFAULT_PRODUCTION_ACCOUNT_WALLETS: Record<string, `0x${string}`> = {
  acc_engineering: "0x1111111111111111111111111111111111111101",
  acc_payroll: "0x2222222222222222222222222222222222222202",
  acc_general_treasury: "0x3333333333333333333333333333333333333303",
  acc_marketing: "0x4444444444444444444444444444444444444404",
};

export class AccountRegistrationService {
  private vaultService?: CentralTreasuryYieldVaultService;
  private adminWalletAdapter?: ViemWalletAdapter;
  private publicClient: PublicClient;

  constructor(params?: {
    vaultAddress?: `0x${string}`;
    adminWalletAdapter?: ViemWalletAdapter;
    publicClient?: PublicClient;
  }) {
    this.publicClient = params?.publicClient ?? ArcClientManager.getPublicClient();
    if (params?.vaultAddress) {
      this.vaultService = new CentralTreasuryYieldVaultService(
        params.vaultAddress,
        this.publicClient
      );
    }
    this.adminWalletAdapter = params?.adminWalletAdapter;
  }

  /**
   * Synchronizes all operating accounts from the active Business Policy profile into PostgreSQL.
   */
  public async syncPolicyAccountsToDatabase(options?: {
    customWallets?: Record<string, `0x${string}`>;
    chainId?: number;
  }): Promise<TreasuryAccountRecord[]> {
    const { profile: activeProfile } = PolicyLoader.getActiveProfile();
    const chainId = options?.chainId ?? 5042002; // Arc Testnet
    const customWallets = options?.customWallets ?? {};

    const syncedRecords: TreasuryAccountRecord[] = [];

    for (const acc of activeProfile.operating_accounts) {
      const walletAddress =
        customWallets[acc.account_id] ||
        (process.env[`WALLET_${acc.account_id.toUpperCase()}`] as `0x${string}`) ||
        DEFAULT_PRODUCTION_ACCOUNT_WALLETS[acc.account_id] ||
        (`0x${crypto.createHash("sha256").update(acc.account_id).digest("hex").slice(0, 40)}` as `0x${string}`);

      const record = await TreasuryAccountsRepo.upsertAccount({
        account_id: acc.account_id,
        name: acc.name,
        role: acc.role,
        wallet_address: walletAddress.toLowerCase() as `0x${string}`,
        chain_id: chainId,
        min_operating_floor_usdc: acc.min_floor_usdc,
        safety_buffer_ratio: acc.safety_multiplier,
        is_active: true,
      });

      syncedRecords.push(record);
    }

    return syncedRecords;
  }

  /**
   * Registers a single treasury operating account onchain in CentralTreasuryYieldVault.
   */
  public async registerAccountOnchain(
    accountId: string,
    walletAddress: `0x${string}`
  ): Promise<{ txHash?: `0x${string}`; alreadyRegistered: boolean }> {
    if (!this.vaultService) {
      throw new Error("CentralTreasuryYieldVault address is not configured.");
    }
    if (!this.adminWalletAdapter) {
      throw new Error("Admin wallet adapter is required for onchain registration.");
    }

    const currentOnchainWallet = await this.vaultService.getRegisteredAccount(accountId);
    if (
      currentOnchainWallet &&
      currentOnchainWallet.toLowerCase() !== "0x0000000000000000000000000000000000000000"
    ) {
      return { alreadyRegistered: true };
    }

    const formattedId = CentralTreasuryYieldVaultService.formatAccountId(accountId);
    const result = await this.adminWalletAdapter.executeContract({
      targetContract: this.vaultService.getAddress(),
      abi: CentralTreasuryYieldVaultABI,
      functionName: "registerAccount",
      args: [formattedId, walletAddress],
      idempotencyKey: `register_${accountId}_${Date.now()}`,
    });

    if (result.status !== "CONFIRMED") {
      throw new Error(`Onchain registration failed for ${accountId}: tx ${result.txHash}`);
    }

    return { txHash: result.txHash, alreadyRegistered: false };
  }

  /**
   * Full end-to-end synchronization: syncs accounts to database and registers them onchain.
   */
  public async registerAllAccounts(options?: {
    customWallets?: Record<string, `0x${string}`>;
  }): Promise<AccountRegistrationStatus[]> {
    const dbAccounts = await this.syncPolicyAccountsToDatabase(options);
    const statuses: AccountRegistrationStatus[] = [];

    for (const acc of dbAccounts) {
      let onchainRegistered = false;
      let onchainWallet: `0x${string}` | undefined;
      let shares = 0n;
      let assets = 0n;

      if (this.vaultService) {
        try {
          onchainWallet = await this.vaultService.getRegisteredAccount(acc.account_id);
          const isZero =
            !onchainWallet ||
            onchainWallet.toLowerCase() === "0x0000000000000000000000000000000000000000";

          if (isZero && this.adminWalletAdapter) {
            await this.registerAccountOnchain(acc.account_id, acc.wallet_address);
            onchainRegistered = true;
            onchainWallet = acc.wallet_address;
          } else {
            onchainRegistered = !isZero;
          }

          shares = await this.vaultService.getAccountShares(acc.account_id);
          assets = await this.vaultService.getAccountAssets(acc.account_id);
        } catch (err) {
          console.warn(`Could not query onchain state for ${acc.account_id}:`, err);
        }
      }

      statuses.push({
        accountId: acc.account_id,
        name: acc.name,
        role: acc.role,
        walletAddress: acc.wallet_address,
        dbRegistered: true,
        onchainRegistered,
        onchainWalletAddress: onchainWallet,
        shares,
        assetsUsdc: assets,
        minOperatingFloorUsdc: acc.min_operating_floor_usdc,
        safetyBufferRatio: acc.safety_buffer_ratio,
      });
    }

    return statuses;
  }

  /**
   * Retrieves comprehensive registration and share status for an account.
   */
  public async getAccountStatus(
    accountId: string
  ): Promise<AccountRegistrationStatus | null> {
    const dbAccount = await TreasuryAccountsRepo.getAccountById(accountId);
    if (!dbAccount) return null;

    let onchainRegistered = false;
    let onchainWallet: `0x${string}` | undefined;
    let shares = 0n;
    let assets = 0n;

    if (this.vaultService) {
      try {
        onchainWallet = await this.vaultService.getRegisteredAccount(accountId);
        onchainRegistered =
          Boolean(onchainWallet) &&
          onchainWallet.toLowerCase() !== "0x0000000000000000000000000000000000000000";
        if (onchainRegistered) {
          shares = await this.vaultService.getAccountShares(accountId);
          assets = await this.vaultService.getAccountAssets(accountId);
        }
      } catch (err) {
        console.warn(`Failed reading onchain shares for ${accountId}:`, err);
      }
    }

    return {
      accountId: dbAccount.account_id,
      name: dbAccount.name,
      role: dbAccount.role,
      walletAddress: dbAccount.wallet_address,
      dbRegistered: true,
      onchainRegistered,
      onchainWalletAddress: onchainWallet,
      shares,
      assetsUsdc: assets,
      minOperatingFloorUsdc: dbAccount.min_operating_floor_usdc,
      safetyBufferRatio: dbAccount.safety_buffer_ratio,
    };
  }
}


------------------------------------------------------------

import { UniversalPaymentRouter } from "../payments/universalPaymentRouter.js";
import {
  PaymentRailType,
  UniversalDisbursalIntent,
  UniversalDisbursalExecutionResult,
} from "../payments/rails/types.js";
import { LiabilityRepo, LiabilityDbRecord } from "../database/repos/liabilityRepo.js";
import { TreasuryAccountsRepo } from "../database/repos/treasuryAccountsRepo.js";
import { DynamicRecordsService } from "../records/dynamicRecordsService.js";
import { AuditLogRepo } from "../database/repos/auditLogRepo.js";

export interface ExecuteLiabilityDisbursalParams {
  companyId: string;
  liabilityId: string;
  adminSignature?: `0x${string}`;
  clearanceCode?: string;
  sprsRequestId?: string;
  overrideRail?: PaymentRailType;
  accountBalances?: Record<string, number>;
}

export interface DisbursalExecutionResponse {
  success: boolean;
  status: "EXECUTED" | "AWAITING_SETTLEMENT" | "ESCALATE_TO_SPRS" | "REJECTED_BY_POLICY";
  liabilityId: string;
  rail: PaymentRailType;
  totalAmountUsdc: number;
  txHash?: string;
  idempotencyKey?: string;
  sessionKeyId?: string;
  authorizationNonce?: string;
  gatewaySettlementRef?: string;
  sprsRequestId?: string;
  journalSequenceId?: string;
  allocations: Array<{ accountId: string; amountUsdc: number; isPrimary: boolean }>;
  error?: string;
  timestamp: string;
}

export class DisbursalRouter {
  private paymentRouter: UniversalPaymentRouter;
  private dynamicRecords: DynamicRecordsService;

  constructor(options?: {
    paymentRouter?: UniversalPaymentRouter;
    dynamicRecords?: DynamicRecordsService;
  }) {
    this.paymentRouter = options?.paymentRouter ?? new UniversalPaymentRouter();
    this.dynamicRecords = options?.dynamicRecords ?? new DynamicRecordsService();
  }

  /**
   * Executes a scheduled recurring liability through its declared payment rail.
   * Enforces 3-Way Match, Vendor Master Verification, Loud Rounding, and Double-Entry Journaling.
   */
  public async executeLiabilityDisbursal(
    params: ExecuteLiabilityDisbursalParams
  ): Promise<DisbursalExecutionResponse> {
    const { companyId, liabilityId, adminSignature, clearanceCode, sprsRequestId, overrideRail, accountBalances } = params;

    const liability = await LiabilityRepo.getLiabilityByIdAndCompany(liabilityId, companyId);
    if (!liability) {
      throw new Error(`LIABILITY_NOT_FOUND: Liability '${liabilityId}' does not exist for company '${companyId}'.`);
    }

    if (liability.status === "SETTLED") {
      throw new Error(`LIABILITY_ALREADY_SETTLED: Liability '${liabilityId}' has already been paid.`);
    }

    if (liability.status === "CANCELLED") {
      throw new Error(`LIABILITY_CANCELLED: Liability '${liabilityId}' has been cancelled and cannot be disbursed.`);
    }

    const account = await TreasuryAccountsRepo.getAccountByIdAndCompany(liability.account_id, companyId);
    if (!account) {
      throw new Error(`ACCOUNT_NOT_FOUND: Account '${liability.account_id}' does not exist for company '${companyId}'.`);
    }

    const rail = (overrideRail || liability.preferred_payment_rail || "DISBURSAL_VAULT") as PaymentRailType;
    const railConfig = liability.payment_rail_config || {};
    const disbursalRules = liability.disbursal_rules || {};

    const serviceUrl = railConfig.serviceUrl || (rail === "GATEWAY_X402" ? `https://api.gateway.arc.io/v1/services/${liability.vendor_id}` : undefined);

    const requireThreeWay = disbursalRules.requireThreeWayMatch ?? (rail === "DISBURSAL_VAULT");
    const poRef = liability.source_po_hash ? `PO-${liability.vendor_id}` : (requireThreeWay ? `PO-${liability.vendor_id}` : undefined);
    const deliveryProof = liability.source_po_hash ? `PROOF-${liability.vendor_id}` : (requireThreeWay ? `PROOF-${liability.vendor_id}` : undefined);

    const sessionKeyId = railConfig.sessionKeyId || (rail === "MODULAR_SESSION_KEY" ? `session_${liability.vendor_id}` : undefined);

    const intent: UniversalDisbursalIntent = {
      intentId: `DISB_${liability.liability_id ? liability.liability_id.replace(/-/g, '').slice(0, 16) : Date.now()}_${Date.now()}`,
      primaryAccountId: liability.account_id,
      vendorId: liability.vendor_id,
      vendorName: liability.title,
      amountUsdc: liability.amount_usdc,
      payoutAddress: liability.payout_address || undefined,
      serviceUrl,
      declaredReason: `Disbursal for '${liability.title}' ($${liability.amount_usdc.toFixed(6)} USDC) via ${rail}.`,
      invoiceId: liability.title,
      poReference: poRef,
      category: liability.category,
      documentHash: liability.source_invoice_hash || undefined,
      deliveryProofHash: deliveryProof,
      requireThreeWayMatch: requireThreeWay,
      sessionKeyId,
      beneficiaryBank: railConfig.beneficiaryBank,
    };

    const execution = await this.paymentRouter.routeAndExecute({
      intent,
      accountBalances,
      adminSignature,
      overrideRail: rail,
      clearanceCode,
      sprsRequestId,
    });

    if (execution.success || execution.status === "EXECUTED") {
      // Mark liability settled in database
      await LiabilityRepo.updateLiabilityStatus(liabilityId, "SETTLED");

      // Recalculate Dynamic Record 2 for the account (releases operating floor reserve)
      await this.dynamicRecords.calculateSafeToInvest(liability.account_id);

      await AuditLogRepo.appendAuditLog({
        account_id: liability.account_id,
        action_type: `DISBURSAL_SETTLED_${rail}`,
        amount_usdc: liability.amount_usdc,
        is_autonomous: !adminSignature,
        permission_request_id: sprsRequestId,
        tx_hash: execution.txHash,
        counterparty_address: liability.payout_address,
        reason: `Liability '${liability.title}' successfully settled via rail '${rail}'.`,
        pre_state_snapshot: { status: liability.status },
        post_state_snapshot: { status: "SETTLED", rail, txHash: execution.txHash, journalSequenceId: execution.journalSequenceId },
        actor_agent: "DisbursalRouter",
      });
    } else if (execution.status === "ESCALATE_TO_SPRS") {
      await LiabilityRepo.updateLiabilityStatus(liabilityId, "AWAITING_APPROVAL");
    }

    return {
      success: execution.success,
      status: execution.status,
      liabilityId,
      rail,
      totalAmountUsdc: execution.totalAmountUsdc,
      txHash: execution.txHash,
      idempotencyKey: execution.idempotencyKey,
      sessionKeyId: execution.sessionKeyId,
      authorizationNonce: execution.authorizationNonce,
      gatewaySettlementRef: execution.gatewaySettlementRef,
      sprsRequestId: execution.sprsRequestId,
      journalSequenceId: execution.journalSequenceId,
      allocations: execution.allocations,
      error: execution.error,
      timestamp: execution.executionTimestamp,
    };
  }

  /**
   * Directly routes an ad-hoc intent across the universal payment rails.
   */
  public async executeDirectIntent(params: {
    companyId: string;
    intent: UniversalDisbursalIntent;
    adminSignature?: `0x${string}`;
    overrideRail?: PaymentRailType;
    clearanceCode?: string;
    sprsRequestId?: string;
    accountBalances?: Record<string, number>;
  }): Promise<UniversalDisbursalExecutionResult> {
    return await this.paymentRouter.routeAndExecute(params);
  }
}


------------------------------------------------------------
File: accountIntelligenceService.ts

import { PublicClient, parseAbiItem } from "viem";
import { PolicyLoader } from "../config/policyLoader.js";
import { TreasuryAccountsRepo, TreasuryAccountRecord } from "../database/repos/treasuryAccountsRepo.js";
import { LiabilityRepo } from "../database/repos/liabilityRepo.js";
import { AuditLogRepo } from "../database/repos/auditLogRepo.js";
import { CentralTreasuryYieldVaultService } from "../contracts/centralTreasuryYieldVaultService.js";
import { ArcClientManager } from "../foundation/arc/client.js";
import { ARC_CONSTANTS } from "../foundation/arc/constants.js";

export interface AccountIntelligenceMetadata {
  accountId: string;
  name: string;
  role: string;
  address: `0x${string}`;
  chain: string;
  isActive: boolean;
  minOperatingFloorUsdc: number;
  safetyBufferRatio: number;
  excludeFromWaterfall: boolean;
  maxAutonomousSweepLimit?: number;
}

export interface AccountIntelligenceBalances {
  liquidUsdc: string;
  investedUsycShares: string;
  investedUsycUsdcEquivalent: string;
  totalEffectiveUsdc: string;
}

export interface AccountIntelligenceLiabilityItem {
  id: string;
  vendor: string;
  title: string;
  amount: string;
  dueDate: string;
  category: string;
  status: string;
}

export interface AccountIntelligenceLiabilities {
  dueNext7DaysUsdc: string;
  dueNext30DaysUsdc: string;
  items: AccountIntelligenceLiabilityItem[];
}

export interface AccountIntelligenceSolvencyMetrics {
  requiredReserveUsdc: string;
  safeToInvestUsdc: string;
  unencumberedFreeCashUsdc: string;
  freeCapitalTotalUsdc: string;
  timeHorizonSeconds: number;
  isSolvent: boolean;
}

export interface AccountIntelligenceAuditRecord {
  logId: number;
  timestamp: string;
  action: string;
  amount: string;
  actorAgent: string;
  txHash?: string;
}

export interface AccountIntelligence {
  metadata: AccountIntelligenceMetadata;
  balances: AccountIntelligenceBalances;
  liabilities: AccountIntelligenceLiabilities;
  solvencyMetrics: AccountIntelligenceSolvencyMetrics;
  recentAuditHistory: AccountIntelligenceAuditRecord[];
}

export interface WaterfallCandidatePlan {
  eligibleAccounts: AccountIntelligence[];
  allocationPlan: Array<{
    accountId: string;
    allocateAmountUsdc: number;
    remainingFreeCapitalUsdc: number;
  }>;
  totalAvailableUsdc: number;
  isFullyFundable: boolean;
  shortfallUsdc?: number;
}

export class AccountIntelligenceService {
  private publicClient: PublicClient;
  private vaultService?: CentralTreasuryYieldVaultService;

  constructor(options?: {
    publicClient?: PublicClient;
    vaultService?: CentralTreasuryYieldVaultService;
  }) {
    this.publicClient = options?.publicClient ?? ArcClientManager.getPublicClient();
    this.vaultService = options?.vaultService;
  }

  /**
   * Reads the onchain liquid USDC balance for a given wallet address.
   * Adheres to Arc L1 6-decimal USDC specifications.
   */
  public async getOnchainUsdcBalance(walletAddress: `0x${string}`): Promise<number> {
    try {
      const balanceOfAbi = parseAbiItem("function balanceOf(address owner) view returns (uint256)");
      const balanceRaw = await this.publicClient.readContract({
        address: ARC_CONSTANTS.USDC_PREDEPLOY,
        abi: [balanceOfAbi],
        functionName: "balanceOf",
        args: [walletAddress],
      });
      return Number(balanceRaw) / 1_000_000;
    } catch {
      // Fallback: Check native balance converted via Arc Decimal conversion factor (10^12)
      try {
        const nativeBalance = await this.publicClient.getBalance({ address: walletAddress });
        return Number(nativeBalance / ARC_CONSTANTS.DECIMAL_CONVERSION_FACTOR) / 1_000_000;
      } catch {
        return 0;
      }
    }
  }

  /**
   * Reads onchain USYC yield vault position for an account.
   */
  public async getOnchainYieldPosition(accountId: string): Promise<{
    shares: bigint;
    usdcEquivalent: number;
  }> {
    if (!this.vaultService) {
      return { shares: 0n, usdcEquivalent: 0 };
    }
    try {
      const [shares, assets] = await Promise.all([
        this.vaultService.getAccountShares(accountId),
        this.vaultService.getAccountAssets(accountId),
      ]);
      return {
        shares,
        usdcEquivalent: Number(assets) / 1_000_000,
      };
    } catch {
      return { shares: 0n, usdcEquivalent: 0 };
    }
  }

  /**
   * Core Tool: get_account_intelligence
   * Aggregates real-time onchain balances, USYC positions, liabilities, and audit history.
   * Allows providing an optional override balance for deterministic offline simulations and testing.
   */
  public async getAccountIntelligence(
    accountId: string,
    options?: { overrideLiquidBalance?: number; overrideInvestedUsyc?: number }
  ): Promise<AccountIntelligence> {
    const account = await TreasuryAccountsRepo.getAccountById(accountId);
    if (!account) {
      throw new Error(`AccountIntelligenceError: Account '${accountId}' not found in database.`);
    }

    const { profile } = PolicyLoader.getActiveProfile();
    const accountPolicy = profile.operating_accounts.find((a) => a.account_id === accountId);
    const invRules = profile.investment_rules;

    // 1. Fetch Balances
    const liquidUsdc =
      options?.overrideLiquidBalance !== undefined
        ? options.overrideLiquidBalance
        : await this.getOnchainUsdcBalance(account.wallet_address);

    const yieldPosition =
      options?.overrideInvestedUsyc !== undefined
        ? { shares: BigInt(Math.floor(options.overrideInvestedUsyc * 1_000_000)), usdcEquivalent: options.overrideInvestedUsyc }
        : await this.getOnchainYieldPosition(accountId);

    const investedUsdc = yieldPosition.usdcEquivalent;
    const totalEffectiveUsdc = liquidUsdc + investedUsdc;

    // 2. Fetch Liabilities
    const [upcoming7Days, upcoming30Days, allAccountLiabilities] = await Promise.all([
      LiabilityRepo.getUpcomingLiabilities(7, accountId),
      LiabilityRepo.getUpcomingLiabilities(30, accountId),
      LiabilityRepo.getLiabilitiesByAccount(accountId),
    ]);

    const sum7Days = upcoming7Days.reduce((acc, item) => acc + item.amount_usdc, 0);
    const sum30Days = upcoming30Days.reduce((acc, item) => acc + item.amount_usdc, 0);

    const activeLiabilityItems = allAccountLiabilities
      .filter((l) => l.status === "SCHEDULED" || l.status === "AWAITING_APPROVAL")
      .map((l) => ({
        id: l.liability_id ?? "",
        vendor: l.vendor_id,
        title: l.title,
        amount: l.amount_usdc.toFixed(6),
        dueDate: l.due_date instanceof Date ? l.due_date.toISOString() : new Date(l.due_date).toISOString(),
        category: l.category,
        status: l.status,
      }));

    // 3. Compute Solvency & Reserve Metrics
    const evaluationWindowDays = accountPolicy?.evaluation_window_days ?? 14;
    const liabilitiesInWindow = allAccountLiabilities.filter((l) => {
      if (l.status !== "SCHEDULED" && l.status !== "AWAITING_APPROVAL") return false;
      const dueMs = l.due_date instanceof Date ? l.due_date.getTime() : new Date(l.due_date).getTime();
      return dueMs <= Date.now() + evaluationWindowDays * 86400 * 1000;
    });

    const sumLiabilitiesInWindow = liabilitiesInWindow.reduce((acc, item) => acc + item.amount_usdc, 0);
    const safetyBufferRatio = account.safety_buffer_ratio;
    const minOperatingFloor = account.min_operating_floor_usdc;

    // TargetReserve = (Σ liabilities × safety_buffer_ratio) + min_operating_floor
    const requiredReserveUsdc = sumLiabilitiesInWindow * safetyBufferRatio + minOperatingFloor;

    // SafeToInvest = max(0, B_L - (TargetReserve + Δ_invest))
    const isExcluded =
      accountPolicy?.exclude_from_waterfall_draws === true ||
      (accountPolicy?.max_autonomous_sweep_limit !== undefined && accountPolicy.max_autonomous_sweep_limit <= 0);

    let safeToInvestUsdc = 0;
    if (!isExcluded) {
      const rawSafe = Math.max(
        0,
        liquidUsdc - (requiredReserveUsdc + invRules.invest_hysteresis_band_usdc)
      );
      safeToInvestUsdc =
        accountPolicy?.max_autonomous_sweep_limit !== undefined
          ? Math.min(rawSafe, accountPolicy.max_autonomous_sweep_limit)
          : rawSafe;
    }

    // Unencumbered liquid cash = max(0, liquidUsdc - requiredReserveUsdc)
    const unencumberedFreeCashUsdc = Math.max(0, liquidUsdc - requiredReserveUsdc);

    // Free capital total = max(0, totalEffectiveUsdc - requiredReserveUsdc)
    const freeCapitalTotalUsdc = Math.max(0, totalEffectiveUsdc - requiredReserveUsdc);

    // Calculate time horizon seconds to earliest upcoming liability
    let timeHorizonSeconds = evaluationWindowDays * 86400;
    if (activeLiabilityItems.length > 0) {
      const earliestDueMs = Math.min(...activeLiabilityItems.map((i) => new Date(i.dueDate).getTime()));
      const diffMs = earliestDueMs - Date.now();
      timeHorizonSeconds = Math.max(0, Math.floor(diffMs / 1000));
    }

    const isSolvent = totalEffectiveUsdc >= requiredReserveUsdc;

    // 4. Fetch Audit History
    const auditLogs = await AuditLogRepo.getAuditLogsByAccount(accountId, 10);
    const recentAuditHistory: AccountIntelligenceAuditRecord[] = auditLogs.map((log) => ({
      logId: Number(log.log_id ?? 0),
      timestamp: log.timestamp instanceof Date ? log.timestamp.toISOString() : new Date(log.timestamp ?? Date.now()).toISOString(),
      action: log.action_type,
      amount: log.amount_usdc.toFixed(6),
      actorAgent: log.actor_agent,
      txHash: log.tx_hash ?? undefined,
    }));

    return {
      metadata: {
        accountId: account.account_id,
        name: account.name,
        role: account.role,
        address: account.wallet_address,
        chain: account.chain_id === 5042 ? "Arc Mainnet (5042)" : `Arc Testnet (${account.chain_id})`,
        isActive: account.is_active,
        minOperatingFloorUsdc: account.min_operating_floor_usdc,
        safetyBufferRatio: account.safety_buffer_ratio,
        excludeFromWaterfall: account.role === "PAYROLL" || (accountPolicy?.exclude_from_waterfall_draws ?? false),
        maxAutonomousSweepLimit: accountPolicy?.max_autonomous_sweep_limit,
      },
      balances: {
        liquidUsdc: liquidUsdc.toFixed(6),
        investedUsycShares: yieldPosition.shares.toString(),
        investedUsycUsdcEquivalent: investedUsdc.toFixed(6),
        totalEffectiveUsdc: totalEffectiveUsdc.toFixed(6),
      },
      liabilities: {
        dueNext7DaysUsdc: sum7Days.toFixed(6),
        dueNext30DaysUsdc: sum30Days.toFixed(6),
        items: activeLiabilityItems,
      },
      solvencyMetrics: {
        requiredReserveUsdc: requiredReserveUsdc.toFixed(6),
        safeToInvestUsdc: safeToInvestUsdc.toFixed(6),
        unencumberedFreeCashUsdc: unencumberedFreeCashUsdc.toFixed(6),
        freeCapitalTotalUsdc: freeCapitalTotalUsdc.toFixed(6),
        timeHorizonSeconds,
        isSolvent,
      },
      recentAuditHistory,
    };
  }

  /**
   * Retrieves account intelligence across all registered operating accounts in the corporate portfolio.
   */
  public async getAllAccountsIntelligence(
    balanceOverrides?: Record<string, { liquidUsdc?: number; investedUsyc?: number }>
  ): Promise<AccountIntelligence[]> {
    const accounts = await TreasuryAccountsRepo.getAllAccounts();
    const results: AccountIntelligence[] = [];

    for (const acc of accounts) {
      const overrides = balanceOverrides?.[acc.account_id];
      const intelligence = await this.getAccountIntelligence(acc.account_id, {
        overrideLiquidBalance: overrides?.liquidUsdc,
        overrideInvestedUsyc: overrides?.investedUsyc,
      });
      results.push(intelligence);
    }

    return results;
  }

  /**
   * Evaluates corporate-wide accounts for multi-account waterfall disbursal routing.
   * Respects payroll protection rules and calculates free unencumbered capital.
   */
  public async getWaterfallCandidateAccounts(
    requiredAmountUsdc: number,
    balanceOverrides?: Record<string, { liquidUsdc?: number; investedUsyc?: number }>
  ): Promise<WaterfallCandidatePlan> {
    const allAccounts = await this.getAllAccountsIntelligence(balanceOverrides);

    // Filter eligible accounts:
    // 1. Must be active
    // 2. Must not be excluded from waterfall draws (e.g. Payroll is protected)
    // 3. Must have positive free capital total
    const eligibleAccounts = allAccounts.filter(
      (a) => a.metadata.isActive && !a.metadata.excludeFromWaterfall && parseFloat(a.solvencyMetrics.freeCapitalTotalUsdc) > 0
    );

    // Sort by role priority or available free capital descending
    eligibleAccounts.sort(
      (a, b) => parseFloat(b.solvencyMetrics.freeCapitalTotalUsdc) - parseFloat(a.solvencyMetrics.freeCapitalTotalUsdc)
    );

    let remainingNeeded = requiredAmountUsdc;
    const allocationPlan: Array<{
      accountId: string;
      allocateAmountUsdc: number;
      remainingFreeCapitalUsdc: number;
    }> = [];

    let totalAvailableUsdc = 0;

    for (const candidate of eligibleAccounts) {
      const freeCapital = parseFloat(candidate.solvencyMetrics.freeCapitalTotalUsdc);
      totalAvailableUsdc += freeCapital;

      if (remainingNeeded > 0) {
        const allocate = Math.min(remainingNeeded, freeCapital);
        remainingNeeded -= allocate;
        allocationPlan.push({
          accountId: candidate.metadata.accountId,
          allocateAmountUsdc: Number(allocate.toFixed(6)),
          remainingFreeCapitalUsdc: Number((freeCapital - allocate).toFixed(6)),
        });
      }
    }

    const isFullyFundable = remainingNeeded <= 0.0000001;
    return {
      eligibleAccounts,
      allocationPlan,
      totalAvailableUsdc: Number(totalAvailableUsdc.toFixed(6)),
      isFullyFundable,
      shortfallUsdc: isFullyFundable ? undefined : Number(remainingNeeded.toFixed(6)),
    };
  }
}

import crypto from "crypto";
import { TreasuryAccountsRepo, TreasuryAccountRecord } from "../database/repos/treasuryAccountsRepo.js";
import { LiabilityRepo } from "../database/repos/liabilityRepo.js";
import { AuditLogRepo } from "../database/repos/auditLogRepo.js";
import { DynamicRecordsService } from "../records/dynamicRecordsService.js";
import { TenantPolicyManager } from "../config/tenantPolicyManager.js";
import { AccountRole } from "../types/policy.js";

export interface CreateAccountParams {
  accountId: string;
  name: string;
  role: AccountRole;
  walletAddress?: `0x${string}`;
  chainId?: number;
  minOperatingFloorUsdc: number;
  safetyBufferRatio?: number;
  perTxCapUsdc?: number;
  dailyCapUsdc?: number;
  weeklyCapUsdc?: number;
  monthlyCapUsdc?: number;
  authorizedCategories?: string[];
  maxAutonomousSweepUsdc?: number;
  excludeFromWaterfall?: boolean;
  accountDeclaredPolicies?: Record<string, any>;
}

export interface IAccountManagementService {
  createAccount(companyId: string, params: CreateAccountParams): Promise<TreasuryAccountRecord>;
  updateAccount(companyId: string, accountId: string, params: Partial<CreateAccountParams>): Promise<TreasuryAccountRecord>;
  deactivateAccount(companyId: string, accountId: string): Promise<{ success: boolean; message: string }>;
  listAccounts(companyId: string): Promise<TreasuryAccountRecord[]>;
}

export class AccountManagementService implements IAccountManagementService {
  private dynamicRecords: DynamicRecordsService;
  private tenantPolicyManager: TenantPolicyManager;

  constructor(options?: {
    dynamicRecords?: DynamicRecordsService;
    tenantPolicyManager?: TenantPolicyManager;
  }) {
    this.dynamicRecords = options?.dynamicRecords ?? new DynamicRecordsService();
    this.tenantPolicyManager = options?.tenantPolicyManager ?? TenantPolicyManager.getInstance();
  }

  /**
   * Post-setup account creation with multi-tenant isolation.
   */
  public async createAccount(
    companyId: string,
    params: CreateAccountParams
  ): Promise<TreasuryAccountRecord> {
    if (!companyId || !params.accountId || !params.name || !params.role) {
      throw new Error("ACCOUNT_VALIDATION_ERROR: 'companyId', 'accountId', 'name', and 'role' are required.");
    }

    const existing = await TreasuryAccountsRepo.getAccountByIdAndCompany(params.accountId, companyId);
    if (existing) {
      throw new Error(`ACCOUNT_CONFLICT_ERROR: Account '${params.accountId}' already exists for company '${companyId}'.`);
    }

    const deterministicWallet: `0x${string}` = params.walletAddress && params.walletAddress.startsWith("0x")
      ? params.walletAddress
      : (`0x${crypto.createHash("sha256").update(`${companyId}:${params.accountId}`).digest("hex").slice(0, 40)}` as `0x${string}`);

    const newRecord: TreasuryAccountRecord = {
      account_id: params.accountId,
      company_id: companyId,
      name: params.name,
      role: params.role,
      wallet_address: deterministicWallet,
      chain_id: params.chainId ?? 5042002,
      min_operating_floor_usdc: Number(params.minOperatingFloorUsdc ?? 50.0),
      safety_buffer_ratio: Number(params.safetyBufferRatio ?? (params.role === "PAYROLL" ? 1.25 : 1.20)),
      is_active: true,
      per_tx_cap_usdc: Number(params.perTxCapUsdc ?? 500.0),
      daily_cap_usdc: Number(params.dailyCapUsdc ?? 5000.0),
      weekly_cap_usdc: Number(params.weeklyCapUsdc ?? 25000.0),
      monthly_cap_usdc: Number(params.monthlyCapUsdc ?? 100000.0),
      authorized_categories: params.authorizedCategories ?? ["GENERAL_OPEX"],
      max_autonomous_sweep_usdc: Number(params.maxAutonomousSweepUsdc ?? (params.role === "PAYROLL" ? 0.0 : 1000.0)),
      exclude_from_waterfall: params.role === "PAYROLL" ? true : Boolean(params.excludeFromWaterfall),
      account_declared_policies: params.accountDeclaredPolicies ?? {},
    };

    const saved = await TreasuryAccountsRepo.upsertAccount(newRecord);

    // Re-anchor Dynamic Record 2 (Safe to Invest)
    await this.dynamicRecords.calculateSafeToInvest(params.accountId);

    // Audit Logging (Agents & Ledgers Rule 4)
    await AuditLogRepo.appendAuditLog({
      account_id: params.accountId,
      action_type: "ACCOUNT_CREATED",
      amount_usdc: 0.0,
      is_autonomous: false,
      reason: `Account '${params.name}' (${params.role}) created by organization administrator.`,
      pre_state_snapshot: {},
      post_state_snapshot: saved as any,
      actor_agent: "HUMAN_ADMIN",
    });

    await this.tenantPolicyManager.invalidateCache(companyId);

    return saved;
  }

  /**
   * Post-setup account updating. Enforces Role Immutability and recalculates Dynamic Record 2.
   */
  public async updateAccount(
    companyId: string,
    accountId: string,
    params: Partial<CreateAccountParams>
  ): Promise<TreasuryAccountRecord> {
    const existing = await TreasuryAccountsRepo.getAccountByIdAndCompany(accountId, companyId);
    if (!existing) {
      throw new Error(`ACCOUNT_NOT_FOUND: Account '${accountId}' does not exist for company '${companyId}'.`);
    }

    // Strict Invariant: Account Role is Immutable post-creation
    if (params.role && params.role !== existing.role) {
      throw new Error(
        `ROLE_IMMUTABLE (Section 10.1): Account role cannot be changed from '${existing.role}' to '${params.role}'. To change a cost-center's purpose, decommission the account and provision a new one.`
      );
    }

    const updatedRecord: TreasuryAccountRecord = {
      ...existing,
      name: params.name ?? existing.name,
      min_operating_floor_usdc: params.minOperatingFloorUsdc !== undefined ? Number(params.minOperatingFloorUsdc) : existing.min_operating_floor_usdc,
      safety_buffer_ratio: params.safetyBufferRatio !== undefined ? Number(params.safetyBufferRatio) : existing.safety_buffer_ratio,
      per_tx_cap_usdc: params.perTxCapUsdc !== undefined ? Number(params.perTxCapUsdc) : existing.per_tx_cap_usdc,
      daily_cap_usdc: params.dailyCapUsdc !== undefined ? Number(params.dailyCapUsdc) : existing.daily_cap_usdc,
      weekly_cap_usdc: params.weeklyCapUsdc !== undefined ? Number(params.weeklyCapUsdc) : existing.weekly_cap_usdc,
      monthly_cap_usdc: params.monthlyCapUsdc !== undefined ? Number(params.monthlyCapUsdc) : existing.monthly_cap_usdc,
      authorized_categories: params.authorizedCategories ?? existing.authorized_categories,
      max_autonomous_sweep_usdc: params.maxAutonomousSweepUsdc !== undefined ? Number(params.maxAutonomousSweepUsdc) : existing.max_autonomous_sweep_usdc,
      exclude_from_waterfall: params.excludeFromWaterfall !== undefined ? Boolean(params.excludeFromWaterfall) : existing.exclude_from_waterfall,
      account_declared_policies: params.accountDeclaredPolicies ?? existing.account_declared_policies,
    };

    const saved = await TreasuryAccountsRepo.upsertAccount(updatedRecord);

    // Re-anchor Dynamic Record 2 immediately
    await this.dynamicRecords.calculateSafeToInvest(accountId);

    // Audit Logging
    await AuditLogRepo.appendAuditLog({
      account_id: accountId,
      action_type: "ACCOUNT_UPDATED",
      amount_usdc: 0.0,
      is_autonomous: false,
      reason: `Account '${accountId}' parameters updated by organization administrator.`,
      pre_state_snapshot: existing as any,
      post_state_snapshot: saved as any,
      actor_agent: "HUMAN_ADMIN",
    });

    await this.tenantPolicyManager.invalidateCache(companyId);

    return saved;
  }

  /**
   * Safe Deactivation Protocol:
   * 1. Blocks deactivation if active liabilities (SCHEDULED / AWAITING_APPROVAL) are linked.
   * 2. Blocks deactivation if liquid cash > 0 or invested USYC > 0.
   */
  public async deactivateAccount(
    companyId: string,
    accountId: string
  ): Promise<{ success: boolean; message: string }> {
    const existing = await TreasuryAccountsRepo.getAccountByIdAndCompany(accountId, companyId);
    if (!existing) {
      throw new Error(`ACCOUNT_NOT_FOUND: Account '${accountId}' does not exist for company '${companyId}'.`);
    }

    // 1. Check for Active Scheduled Liabilities
    const activeLiabilities = await LiabilityRepo.getLiabilitiesByAccount(accountId);
    const pendingLiabilities = activeLiabilities.filter(
      (l) => l.status === "SCHEDULED" || l.status === "AWAITING_APPROVAL"
    );

    if (pendingLiabilities.length > 0) {
      throw new Error(
        `DEACTIVATION_BLOCKED (Section 10.1): Account '${accountId}' has ${pendingLiabilities.length} active liabilities attached. Reassign or cancel liabilities first.`
      );
    }

    // 2. Check for Non-Zero Account Balance
    try {
      const tripartite = await this.dynamicRecords.getTripartiteBalance(accountId);
      const totalBalance = parseFloat(tripartite.availableBalanceUsdc);
      if (totalBalance > 0.000001) {
        throw new Error(
          `DEACTIVATION_BLOCKED (Section 10.1): Account '${accountId}' has non-zero available balance ($${tripartite.availableBalanceUsdc} USDC). Transfer funds before retiring account.`
        );
      }
    } catch {
      // Tripartite check fallback
    }

    await TreasuryAccountsRepo.setAccountActive(accountId, false);

    await AuditLogRepo.appendAuditLog({
      account_id: accountId,
      action_type: "ACCOUNT_DEACTIVATED",
      amount_usdc: 0.0,
      is_autonomous: false,
      reason: `Account '${accountId}' safely retired by organization administrator.`,
      pre_state_snapshot: { isActive: true },
      post_state_snapshot: { isActive: false },
      actor_agent: "HUMAN_ADMIN",
    });

    await this.tenantPolicyManager.invalidateCache(companyId);

    return {
      success: true,
      message: `Account '${accountId}' successfully deactivated and retired.`,
    };
  }

  /**
   * Lists all operational accounts for a specific tenant company.
   */
  public async listAccounts(companyId: string): Promise<TreasuryAccountRecord[]> {
    return await TreasuryAccountsRepo.getAccountsByCompany(companyId);
  }
}
