import { DbClient } from "../database/dbClient.js";
import { VendorMasterRepo, VendorMasterRecord } from "../database/repos/vendorMasterRepo.js";
import { PermissionRequestRepo } from "../database/repos/permissionRequestRepo.js";
import { AuthorizationGate } from "../security/authorizationGate.js";

export interface RegisterVendorPayload {
  vendorId: string;
  name: string;
  verifiedPayoutAddress: `0x${string}`;
  paymentEndpointUrl?: string;
  payoutRail?: "DISBURSAL_VAULT" | "MODULAR_SESSION_KEY" | "ERC3009_AUTHORIZATION" | "GATEWAY_X402";
  taxId?: string;
  authorizedCategory?: string;
  verifiedByAdmin?: string;
}

export interface UpdateVendorPayload {
  vendorId: string;
  name?: string;
  newPayoutAddress?: `0x${string}`;
  newPaymentEndpointUrl?: string;
  payoutRail?: "DISBURSAL_VAULT" | "MODULAR_SESSION_KEY" | "ERC3009_AUTHORIZATION" | "GATEWAY_X402";
  reason: string;
  proposedBy: string;
  adminSignature?: string;
  sprsRequestId?: string;
}

export class VendorLifecycleService {
  /**
   * Registers a new vendor into Vendor Master Registry during onboarding or via admin.
   */
  public static async registerVendor(payload: RegisterVendorPayload): Promise<VendorMasterRecord> {
    if (!payload.vendorId || !payload.name || !payload.verifiedPayoutAddress) {
      throw new Error("[VendorLifecycleService] Missing required vendor registration fields");
    }

    // Direct registration into immutable Vendor Master Registry
    const record = await VendorMasterRepo.registerVendor({
      vendor_id: payload.vendorId,
      name: payload.name,
      verified_payout_address: payload.verifiedPayoutAddress,
      verified_by_admin: payload.verifiedByAdmin || "HUMAN_ADMIN",
      last_verified_at: new Date(),
      change_lock: true,
    });

    // If endpoint URL or rail is provided, update columns
    if (payload.paymentEndpointUrl || payload.payoutRail) {
      await DbClient.query(
        `UPDATE vendor_master_registry 
         SET payment_endpoint_url = COALESCE($1, payment_endpoint_url),
             payout_rail = COALESCE($2, payout_rail)
         WHERE vendor_id = $3;`,
        [payload.paymentEndpointUrl || null, payload.payoutRail || null, payload.vendorId]
      );
    }

    return record;
  }

  /**
   * Updates an existing vendor's details or payout destination.
   * STRICT SECURITY INVARIANT (Rule 3 Payee Substitution Defense):
   * Modifying a verified payout address or endpoint URL requires Layer 2 Human Approval (SPRS)
   * to protect against malicious agent address substitution.
   */
  public static async proposeOrUpdateVendor(payload: UpdateVendorPayload): Promise<{
    status: "UPDATED" | "PENDING_HUMAN_APPROVAL";
    vendor?: VendorMasterRecord;
    sprsRequestId?: string;
    message: string;
  }> {
    const existing = await VendorMasterRepo.getVendorById(payload.vendorId);
    if (!existing) {
      throw new Error(`[VendorLifecycleService] Vendor ${payload.vendorId} not found in registry`);
    }

    // Check if Human Authorization (Layer 2) is already provided
    const authCheck = await AuthorizationGate.verifyAuthorization({
      actionType: "UPDATE_VENDOR_MASTER",
      accountId: "SYSTEM_VENDOR_MASTER",
      amountUsdc: "0.000000",
      sprsRequestId: payload.sprsRequestId,
      adminSignature: payload.adminSignature,
    });

    const isHumanInitiated = payload.proposedBy === "HUMAN" || authCheck.isAuthorized;

    if (!isHumanInitiated && (payload.newPayoutAddress || payload.newPaymentEndpointUrl)) {
      // Escalate to Layer 2 Human SPRS
      const sprsId = `SPRS_VEND_${payload.vendorId}_${Date.now()}`;
      await PermissionRequestRepo.createRequest({
        request_id: sprsId,
        action_type: "VENDOR_PAYOUT_DESTINATION_CHANGE",
        reason: `Agent ${payload.proposedBy} proposed modifying payout destination for vendor ${existing.name} (${payload.vendorId}). Rationale: ${payload.reason}`,
        amount_usdc: 0,
        status: "PENDING",
        payload: {
          vendorId: payload.vendorId,
          oldAddress: existing.verified_payout_address,
          newAddress: payload.newPayoutAddress,
          newEndpoint: payload.newPaymentEndpointUrl,
          proposedBy: payload.proposedBy,
        },
      });

      return {
        status: "PENDING_HUMAN_APPROVAL",
        sprsRequestId: sprsId,
        message: `Vendor destination update halted for Layer 2 Human CFO approval (SPRS ${sprsId}). Payee substitution defense active.`,
      };
    }

    // Execute verified update
    if (payload.newPayoutAddress) {
      await VendorMasterRepo.updatePayoutAddress({
        vendorId: payload.vendorId,
        newAddress: payload.newPayoutAddress,
        adminId: payload.proposedBy,
        forceOverride: true,
      });
    }

    if (payload.newPaymentEndpointUrl || payload.name || payload.payoutRail) {
      await DbClient.query(
        `UPDATE vendor_master_registry 
         SET name = COALESCE($1, name),
             payment_endpoint_url = COALESCE($2, payment_endpoint_url),
             payout_rail = COALESCE($3, payout_rail),
             last_verified_at = NOW()
         WHERE vendor_id = $4;`,
        [payload.name || null, payload.newPaymentEndpointUrl || null, payload.payoutRail || null, payload.vendorId]
      );
    }

    const updated = await VendorMasterRepo.getVendorById(payload.vendorId);
    return {
      status: "UPDATED",
      vendor: updated!,
      message: `Vendor ${payload.vendorId} updated successfully.`,
    };
  }

  /**
   * Removes or deactivates a vendor from the registry.
   * Requires Layer 2 Human Approval.
   */
  public static async removeVendor(params: {
    vendorId: string;
    reason: string;
    proposedBy: string;
    sprsRequestId?: string;
    adminSignature?: string;
  }): Promise<{ status: "REMOVED" | "PENDING_HUMAN_APPROVAL"; sprsRequestId?: string }> {
    const authCheck = await AuthorizationGate.verifyAuthorization({
      actionType: "REMOVE_VENDOR_MASTER",
      accountId: "SYSTEM_VENDOR_MASTER",
      amountUsdc: "0.000000",
      sprsRequestId: params.sprsRequestId,
      adminSignature: params.adminSignature,
    });

    if (!authCheck.isAuthorized && params.proposedBy !== "HUMAN") {
      const sprsId = `SPRS_DEL_VEND_${params.vendorId}_${Date.now()}`;
      await PermissionRequestRepo.createRequest({
        request_id: sprsId,
        action_type: "REMOVE_VENDOR_MASTER",
        reason: `Deactivating vendor ${params.vendorId}: ${params.reason}`,
        amount_usdc: 0,
        status: "PENDING",
        payload: params,
      });

      return { status: "PENDING_HUMAN_APPROVAL", sprsRequestId: sprsId };
    }

    await DbClient.query(`DELETE FROM vendor_master_registry WHERE vendor_id = $1;`, [params.vendorId]);
    return { status: "REMOVED" };
  }
}

export class EnterpriseOnboardingService {
  public readonly persona: AgentPersonaType = "OnboardingAgent";
  public readonly erc8004Id = AGENT_REGISTRY.OnboardingAgent.erc8004Id; // 100
  public readonly canSignTransactions = AGENT_REGISTRY.OnboardingAgent.canSignTransactions; // true
  public readonly canWriteLedger = AGENT_REGISTRY.OnboardingAgent.canWriteLedger; // false

  private registrationService: AccountRegistrationService;

  constructor(registrationService?: AccountRegistrationService) {
    this.registrationService = registrationService ?? new AccountRegistrationService();
  }

  /**
   * Phase 1: Entity & ERP Discovery
   * Ingests enterprise intake data, ERP records, and contracts to construct a structured operational mental model.
   */
  public async ingestIntakePayload(payload: EnterpriseIntakePayload): Promise<DiscoveredBusinessProfile> {
    if (!payload.companyName) {
      throw new Error("[EnterpriseOnboardingService] Missing companyName in intake payload");
    }
    if (!payload.costCenters || payload.costCenters.length === 0) {
      throw new Error("[EnterpriseOnboardingService] At least one cost center is required for onboarding");
    }

    const suppliers = payload.erpSuppliers ?? [];
    const invoices = payload.erpInvoices ?? [];

    const discoveredCostCenters: DiscoveredCostCenter[] = payload.costCenters.map((cc) => {
      const ccInvoices = invoices.filter(
        (inv) => inv.costCenter.toLowerCase() === cc.id.toLowerCase() || inv.costCenter.toLowerCase() === cc.name.toLowerCase()
      );
      const totalCommitted = ccInvoices.reduce((sum, inv) => sum + inv.amountUsdc, 0);
      const highestBill = ccInvoices.reduce((max, inv) => (inv.amountUsdc > max ? inv.amountUsdc : max), 0);
      const vendorIds = Array.from(new Set(ccInvoices.map((inv) => inv.supplierId)));

      return {
        accountId: cc.id,
        name: cc.name,
        role: cc.role,
        monthlyCommittedLiabilitiesUsdc: totalCommitted,
        highestSingleBillUsdc: highestBill,
        discoveredVendors: vendorIds,
      };
    });

    return {
      companyName: payload.companyName,
      adminEmail: payload.primaryAdminEmail,
      erpSource: payload.erpSource ?? "MANUAL_IMPORT",
      costCenters: discoveredCostCenters,
      discoveredSuppliers: suppliers,
      discoveredLiabilities: invoices,
    };
  }

  /**
   * Phase 1.B: Automated Enterprise Company Profile Creation from Ingested & Connected Data
   * Gathers unstructured documents and receipts across connected MCP apps (Google Workspace, Microsoft 365)
   * and ERPs, classifies the dual rules (mathematical rules + declared policies), and saves to PostgreSQL company_profiles.
   */
  public async createCompanyProfileFromConnectedData(params: {
    companyId: string;
    companyName: string;
    businessDescription?: string;
    includeMcpApps?: boolean;
    costCenters?: Array<{ id: string; name: string; role: AccountRole }>;
    erpInvoices?: ErpPurchaseInvoiceRecord[];
    erpSuppliers?: ErpSupplierRecord[];
  }): Promise<CompanyProfileRecord> {
    const mcpConnector = new McpAppConnector({
      googleAppsConnected: params.includeMcpApps ?? true,
      microsoftAppsConnected: params.includeMcpApps ?? true,
    });

    const mcpData = await mcpConnector.aggregateAllCompanyAppData();

    // Map discovered cost centers
    const discoveredCostCenters = (params.costCenters || [
      { id: "acc_engineering", name: "Engineering Operations", role: "OPEX_DEV" as AccountRole },
      { id: "acc_payroll", name: "Payroll Escrow", role: "PAYROLL" as AccountRole },
      { id: "acc_marketing", name: "Growth & Marketing", role: "OPEX_GROWTH" as AccountRole },
      { id: "acc_general_treasury", name: "Central Treasury Reserve", role: "TREASURY_RESERVE" as AccountRole },
    ]).map((cc) => ({
      accountId: cc.id,
      name: cc.name,
      role: cc.role,
      allocatedMonthlySpendUsdc: cc.role === "PAYROLL" ? 25000 : 5000,
    }));

    // Classify Two Types of Rules: Mathematical Rules vs Declared Policies
    const operatingCashFloors: Record<string, number> = {};
    for (const cc of discoveredCostCenters) {
      operatingCashFloors[cc.accountId] =
        cc.role === "PAYROLL" ? 100.0 : cc.role === "TREASURY_RESERVE" ? 250.0 : 50.0;
    }

    const mathematicalRules = {
      operatingCashFloors,
      safetyBufferMultipliers: {
        standardOpex: 1.20,
        payrollReserve: 1.25,
      },
      spendingHardCaps: {
        dailyHardCapUsdc: 5000.0,
        singleTxHumanGateThresholdUsdc: 500.0,
      },
      hysteresisDeadbandUsdc: 10.0,
      minSweepAmountUsdc: 10.0,
      precisionDecimals: 6,
    };

    const declaredPolicies = {
      costCenterRules: [
        "Rule 1: Under no circumstances may funds from acc_payroll be swept to yield or used for non-payroll draws.",
        "Rule 2: Vendor invoice payouts require Three-Way Match (PO + Delivery Receipt + Invoice).",
        "Rule 3: Payout address must strictly match immutable Verified Vendor Master Registry.",
      ],
      anomalyTolerances: {
        maxPriceHikePercentage: 15.0,
        flagUnregisteredVendors: true,
        requireThreeWayMatch: true,
      },
      reviewTriggers: [
        "Upcoming renewals > $1,000 must generate 48-hour pre-flight SPRS.",
        "SaaS subscriptions with > 15% price hike require administrative confirmation.",
      ],
    };

    const connectedApps = [
      "ERP System (ERPNext / Odoo REST & JSON-RPC)",
      ...mcpData.connectedApps,
    ];

    const profileRecord: CompanyProfileRecord = {
      company_id: params.companyId,
      company_name: params.companyName,
      business_description: params.businessDescription || "Autonomous treasury operations on Arc L1",
      connected_apps: connectedApps,
      discovered_cost_centers: discoveredCostCenters,
      inferred_policies: {
        mathematicalRules,
        declaredPolicies,
      },
      activation_status: "PENDING_ACTIVATION",
    };

    return await CompanyProfileRepo.upsertProfile(profileRecord);
  }

  /**
   * Phase 2: Suggested Policy Generation
   * Synthesizes mathematical rules and declared policies based on business liabilities.
   * Strict Invariant: The agent ONLY suggests; the human operator must commit.
   */
  public generatePolicyProposal(profile: DiscoveredBusinessProfile): SuggestedPolicyProposal {
    const operatingAccounts: OperatingAccountPolicy[] = profile.costCenters.map((cc) => {
      const isPayroll = cc.role === "PAYROLL";
      const isTreasury = cc.role === "TREASURY_RESERVE";

      let minFloor = 50.0;
      let safetyMultiplier = 1.20;
      let evalWindow = 14;
      let maxSweep = 5000.0;

      if (isPayroll) {
        minFloor = Math.max(100.0, cc.monthlyCommittedLiabilitiesUsdc * 0.1);
        safetyMultiplier = 1.25;
        evalWindow = 30;
        maxSweep = 0.0;
      } else if (isTreasury) {
        minFloor = 250.0;
        safetyMultiplier = 1.20;
        evalWindow = 30;
        maxSweep = 25000.0;
      } else {
        minFloor = Math.max(50.0, cc.highestSingleBillUsdc * 0.25);
        safetyMultiplier = 1.20;
        evalWindow = 14;
        maxSweep = Math.max(2000.0, cc.highestSingleBillUsdc * 3);
      }

      return {
        account_id: cc.accountId,
        name: cc.name,
        role: cc.role,
        min_floor_usdc: Number(minFloor.toFixed(2)),
        safety_multiplier: safetyMultiplier,
        evaluation_window_days: evalWindow,
        authorized_categories: isPayroll
          ? ["SALARIES", "CONTRACTOR_COMPENSATION"]
          : isTreasury
          ? ["GENERAL_OPERATIONS", "INTERCOMPANY_TRANSFER"]
          : ["INFRASTRUCTURE", "SAAS", "MARKETING", "DEVELOPER_TOOLS"],
        max_autonomous_sweep_limit: Number(maxSweep.toFixed(2)),
        exclude_from_waterfall_draws: isPayroll,
      };
    });

    const maxHighestBill = profile.costCenters.reduce(
      (max, cc) => (cc.highestSingleBillUsdc > max ? cc.highestSingleBillUsdc : max),
      0
    );

    const declaredPolicies: DeclaredPoliciesConfig = {
      cost_center_rules: [
        "Never pay cloud infrastructure or tooling invoices from marketing or payroll accounts.",
        "Corporate payroll is reserved exclusively for salary disbursements and contractor payouts.",
      ],
      anomaly_tolerances: {
        max_price_hike_percentage: 15.0,
        flag_unregistered_vendors: true,
        require_three_way_match: true,
      },
      liquidity_overrides: [
        "If vendor invoice is due within 48 hours, USYC recall takes precedence over maintaining target reserves.",
      ],
      tax_holdback_percentage: 15.0,
    };

    const policyProfile: PolicyProfile = {
      description: `Automated onboarding policy synthesized for ${profile.companyName}`,
      operating_accounts: operatingAccounts,
      investment_rules: {
        target_vault: ARC_CONSTANTS.USDC_PREDEPLOY,
        max_company_allocation_ratio: 0.85,
        min_sweep_amount_usdc: 10.0,
        auto_sweep_enabled: true,
        auto_recall_enabled: true,
        invest_hysteresis_band_usdc: 10.0,
        recall_hysteresis_band_usdc: 5.0,
        debounce_window_ms: 5000,
        min_action_cooldown_seconds: 60,
        tag_internal_settlement_events: true,
        redemption_lead_time_seconds: 1800,
        redemption_latency_tier: "TIER_A_INSTANT",
      },
      spending_limits: {
        daily_hard_cap_usdc: Math.max(5000.0, maxHighestBill * 2),
        single_tx_human_gate_threshold_usdc: Math.max(500.0, maxHighestBill * 0.5),
      },
      declared_policies: declaredPolicies,
    };

    return {
      status: "SUGGESTION_PENDING_HUMAN_COMMIT",
      generatedAt: new Date().toISOString(),
      companyName: profile.companyName,
      profile: policyProfile,
      rationales: profile.costCenters.map((cc) => ({
        accountId: cc.accountId,
        floorRationale: `Floor of $${cc.highestSingleBillUsdc * 0.25} derived from 25% of highest historical single bill.`,
        spendingCapRationale: `Single-tx gate calibrated to prevent unauthorized draws without CFO escalation.`,
      })),
      declaredPoliciesRationale:
        "Declared policies protect cost-center integrity and enforce loud alerts on stealth vendor price increases (>15%).",
    };
  }

  /**
   * Phase 3 & 4: Account Provisioning, Database Seeding, and Ledger Genesis
   */
  public async provisionAccountsAndLedger(params: {
    profile: DiscoveredBusinessProfile;
    committedPolicy: PolicyProfile;
    customWallets?: Record<string, `0x${string}`>;
    vaultAddress?: `0x${string}`;
    adminWallet?: ViemWalletAdapter;
  }): Promise<ProvisioningResult> {
    const { profile, committedPolicy, customWallets = {} } = params;

    const createdAccounts: TreasuryAccountRecord[] = [];
    for (const accPolicy of committedPolicy.operating_accounts) {
      const walletAddress =
        customWallets[accPolicy.account_id] ||
        (`0x${crypto.createHash("sha256").update(accPolicy.account_id).digest("hex").slice(0, 40)}` as `0x${string}`);

      const record = await TreasuryAccountsRepo.upsertAccount({
        account_id: accPolicy.account_id,
        name: accPolicy.name,
        role: accPolicy.role,
        wallet_address: walletAddress,
        chain_id: 5042002,
        min_operating_floor_usdc: accPolicy.min_floor_usdc,
        safety_buffer_ratio: accPolicy.safety_multiplier,
        is_active: true,
      });
      createdAccounts.push(record);
    }

    const registeredVendors: VendorMasterRecord[] = [];
    for (const supplier of profile.discoveredSuppliers) {
      const isFiat = supplier.preferredRail === "FIAT_PAYOUT" || !!supplier.bankDetails;
      const effectiveRail: PaymentRailType = supplier.preferredRail || (isFiat ? "FIAT_PAYOUT" : "DISBURSAL_VAULT");

      let bankAccountId: string | undefined;
      if (supplier.bankDetails) {
        const subMethod = supplier.preferredSubMethod || supplier.bankDetails.paymentSubMethod || (supplier.bankDetails.cardToken ? "PUSH_TO_CARD" : "FEDWIRE");
        const bankRecord = await VendorBankRepo.createBankAccount({
          vendor_id: supplier.supplierId,
          account_holder_name: supplier.bankDetails.accountHolderName,
          iban_account_number: supplier.bankDetails.ibanOrAccountNumber,
          routing_swift: supplier.bankDetails.routingOrSwift || (subMethod === "PUSH_TO_CARD" ? "CARD_OCT" : "021000018"),
          bank_name: supplier.bankDetails.bankName,
          bank_country: supplier.bankDetails.bankCountry || "US",
          payment_sub_method: subMethod,
          card_token: supplier.bankDetails.cardToken || null,
          card_last4: supplier.bankDetails.cardLast4 || (supplier.bankDetails.ibanOrAccountNumber.length === 16 ? supplier.bankDetails.ibanOrAccountNumber.slice(-4) : null),
          card_network: supplier.bankDetails.cardNetwork || null,
          is_verified: true,
          verified_by_admin: "ENTERPRISE_ONBOARDING_AGENT",
        });
        bankAccountId = bankRecord.bank_account_id;
      }

      const verifiedAddress = supplier.payoutAddress && supplier.payoutAddress.startsWith("0x") && supplier.payoutAddress.length === 42
        ? (supplier.payoutAddress as `0x${string}`)
        : null;

      const record = await VendorMasterRepo.registerVendor({
        vendor_id: supplier.supplierId,
        name: supplier.name,
        verified_payout_address: verifiedAddress,
        verified_by_admin: "ONBOARDING_AGENT",
        last_verified_at: new Date(),
        change_lock: true,
      });
      registeredVendors.push(record);

      await VendorPaymentPreferenceRepo.setPreference({
        vendor_id: supplier.supplierId,
        preferred_rail: effectiveRail,
        preferred_sub_method: supplier.preferredSubMethod || (supplier.bankDetails ? (supplier.bankDetails.paymentSubMethod as any) || "FEDWIRE" : null),
        crypto_wallet_address: verifiedAddress,
        crypto_chain_id: 5042,
        crypto_token_symbol: "USDC",
        bank_account_id: bankAccountId || null,
      });
    }

    const scheduledLiabilities: LiabilityDbRecord[] = [];
    for (const inv of profile.discoveredLiabilities) {
      const supplier = profile.discoveredSuppliers.find((s) => s.supplierId === inv.supplierId);
      const isFiat = supplier?.preferredRail === "FIAT_PAYOUT" || !!supplier?.bankDetails;
      const effectiveRail: PaymentRailType = supplier?.preferredRail || (isFiat ? "FIAT_PAYOUT" : "DISBURSAL_VAULT");
      const payoutAddress = supplier?.payoutAddress && supplier.payoutAddress.startsWith("0x")
        ? (supplier.payoutAddress as `0x${string}`)
        : (isFiat ? null : ("0x0000000000000000000000000000000000000000" as `0x${string}`));

      const poHash = inv.purchaseOrderNumber
        ? keccak256(stringToHex(`PO:${inv.purchaseOrderNumber}:${inv.amountUsdc}`))
        : undefined;
      const invoiceHash = keccak256(stringToHex(`INV:${inv.invoiceNumber}:${inv.amountUsdc}`));

      const hasDeliveryProof = !!inv.deliveryReceiptProof;
      const initialStatus = hasDeliveryProof ? "SCHEDULED" : "UNMATCHED_DISPUTED";

      const bankPref = await VendorPaymentPreferenceRepo.getPreference(inv.supplierId);

      const liability = await LiabilityRepo.createLiability({
        account_id: inv.costCenter,
        vendor_id: inv.supplierId,
        title: `Invoice ${inv.invoiceNumber}`,
        category: (supplier?.authorizedCategory as any) || "SAAS",
        amount_usdc: inv.amountUsdc,
        due_date: new Date(inv.dueDate),
        payout_address: payoutAddress,
        frequency_cron: inv.frequencyCron || "0 0 1 * *",
        source_po_hash: poHash,
        source_invoice_hash: invoiceHash,
        status: initialStatus,
        preferred_payment_rail: effectiveRail,
        payment_sub_method: supplier?.preferredSubMethod || (supplier?.bankDetails ? (supplier.bankDetails.paymentSubMethod as any) || "FEDWIRE" : undefined),
        payment_rail_config: {
          beneficiaryBank: supplier?.bankDetails,
          bankAccountId: bankPref?.bank_account_id || undefined,
        },
      });
      scheduledLiabilities.push(liability);
    }

    // Seed Movement Policy for cross-account liquidity and strict payroll shielding
    const nonPayrollIds = createdAccounts
      .filter((a) => a.role !== "PAYROLL")
      .map((a) => a.account_id);
    const payrollIds = createdAccounts
      .filter((a) => a.role === "PAYROLL")
      .map((a) => a.account_id);

    await MovementPolicyRepo.upsertPolicy({
      policy_id: `movement_policy_${profile.companyName.toLowerCase().replace(/\s+/g, "_")}`,
      name: `${profile.companyName} Cross-Account Movement Policy`,
      priority_order: nonPayrollIds.length > 0 ? nonPayrollIds : createdAccounts.map((a) => a.account_id),
      protected_accounts: payrollIds,
      cross_account_borrowing_enabled: true,
      max_borrowing_ratio: 0.50,
      human_approval_threshold_usdc: committedPolicy.spending_limits?.single_tx_human_gate_threshold_usdc || 1000.0,
    });

    const genesisDocRef = `DOC:GENESIS:${profile.companyName.replace(/\s+/g, "_")}`;
    const initialAllocationUsdc =
      committedPolicy.operating_accounts.reduce((sum, acc) => sum + acc.min_floor_usdc, 0) || 100.0;

    const journalEntry = await MasterJournalRepo.appendEntry({
      account_id: "SYSTEM_GENESIS",
      action_type: "GENESIS_INITIALIZATION",
      debit_account: "CASH_OPERATING_RESERVE",
      credit_account: "EQUITY_INITIAL_CAPITAL",
      amount_usdc: initialAllocationUsdc,
      document_ref: genesisDocRef,
    });

    const primaryAccountId = createdAccounts[0]?.account_id || "acc_general_treasury";
    await AuditLogRepo.appendAuditLog({
      account_id: primaryAccountId,
      action_type: "BUSINESS_ONBOARDING_COMPLETED",
      amount_usdc: 0.0,
      is_autonomous: true,
      reason: `Automated onboarding completed for ${profile.companyName}. Initialized ${createdAccounts.length} accounts, ${registeredVendors.length} vendors, ${scheduledLiabilities.length} liabilities.`,
      pre_state_snapshot: { status: "PRE_ONBOARDING" },
      post_state_snapshot: {
        accountsCount: createdAccounts.length,
        vendorsCount: registeredVendors.length,
        liabilitiesCount: scheduledLiabilities.length,
      },
      actor_agent: this.persona,
    });

    const guardrailsHandoff = this.generateSpendingGuardrailsCommands(
      createdAccounts.map((acc) => {
        const matchingPolicy = committedPolicy.operating_accounts.find((p) => p.account_id === acc.account_id);
        return {
          accountId: acc.account_id,
          name: acc.name,
          role: acc.role as AccountRole,
          walletAddress: acc.wallet_address,
          monthlyCommittedLiabilitiesUsdc: matchingPolicy?.max_autonomous_sweep_limit || 1000,
          highestSingleBillUsdc: matchingPolicy?.min_floor_usdc || 50,
          discoveredVendors: [],
        };
      })
    );

    // Initialize Dynamic Record 2 (Safe-to-Invest & Tripartite Balance) for each account for the first time
    const dynamicRecords = new DynamicRecordsService();
    for (const acc of createdAccounts) {
      const matchingPolicy = committedPolicy.operating_accounts.find((p) => p.account_id === acc.account_id);
      const floorStr = (matchingPolicy?.min_floor_usdc || 50.0).toFixed(6);
      await dynamicRecords.calculateSafeToInvest(acc.account_id, 7 * 86400, floorStr, 0n, 0n);
    }

    // Set dynamic policies live into PolicyLoader for runtime swarm evaluation
    PolicyLoader.setDynamicProfile(committedPolicy, profile.companyName);

    return {
      accountsCreated: createdAccounts,
      vendorsRegistered: registeredVendors,
      liabilitiesScheduled: scheduledLiabilities,
      genesisJournalHash: journalEntry.current_hash,
      guardrailsHandoff,
    };
  }

  /**
   * Phase 6: Spending Guardrail Setup Command Generation (OTP Protection)
   */
  public generateSpendingGuardrailsCommands(costCenters: DiscoveredCostCenter[]): SpendingGuardrailsHandoff {
    const commands: SpendingGuardrailCommand[] = costCenters.map((cc) => {
      const address = cc.walletAddress || "0x0000000000000000000000000000000000000000";
      const perTx = cc.role === "PAYROLL" ? 5000 : 500;
      const daily = cc.role === "PAYROLL" ? 25000 : 2500;
      const weekly = daily * 3;
      const monthly = daily * 10;

      const cliCommand = `circle wallet limit set --address ${address} --chain ARC --policy-type stablecoin --per-tx ${perTx} --daily ${daily} --weekly ${weekly} --monthly ${monthly}`;

      return {
        accountId: cc.accountId,
        walletAddress: address,
        command: cliCommand,
        perTxCap: perTx,
        dailyCap: daily,
        weeklyCap: weekly,
        monthlyCap: monthly,
      };
    });

    return {
      instructions:
        "Please run the following commands in your own secure terminal. The Circle CLI will send an OTP confirmation to your registered admin email. Enter the OTP at the terminal prompt.",
      securityNotice:
        "CRITICAL SECURITY INVARIANT: OTPs are password-equivalent. The agent must NEVER receive, store, or relay OTPs. Execute these commands directly in your terminal.",
      commands,
    };
  }

  /**
   * Phase 7: Initial Funding & Activation Verification
   */
  public async verifyInitialFunding(
    accountId: string,
    minDepositUsdc: number = 1.0
  ): Promise<{ isFunded: boolean; accountId: string; currentBalanceUsdc: number; status: string }> {
    const account = await TreasuryAccountsRepo.getAccountById(accountId);
    if (!account) {
      throw new Error(`[EnterpriseOnboardingService] Account ${accountId} not found in registry`);
    }

    const publicClient = ArcClientManager.getPublicClient();
    let currentBalanceUsdc = 0;

    try {
      const nativeBalance = await publicClient.getBalance({ address: account.wallet_address });
      currentBalanceUsdc = Number(nativeBalance / 10n ** 12n) / 1_000_000;
    } catch {
      currentBalanceUsdc = 0.0;
    }

    const isFunded = currentBalanceUsdc >= minDepositUsdc;

    return {
      isFunded,
      accountId,
      currentBalanceUsdc,
      status: isFunded ? "ACTIVATED" : "AWAITING_DEPOSIT",
    };
  }

  /**
   * Phase 5: Smart Contract Vault Registration & ERC-20 Allowances
   * Registers account with CentralTreasuryYieldVault and prepares ERC-20 approvals on Arc L1.
   */
  public async registerVaultAndAllowances(
    accountId: string,
    vaultAddress: `0x${string}` = "0x1000000000000000000000000000000000000001"
  ): Promise<{
    accountId: string;
    vaultAddress: `0x${string}`;
    registrationCalldata: `0x${string}`;
    approvalCalldata: `0x${string}`;
    isRegistered: boolean;
  }> {
    const account = await TreasuryAccountsRepo.getAccountById(accountId);
    if (!account) {
      throw new Error(`[EnterpriseOnboardingService] Account ${accountId} not found in registry`);
    }

    const formattedAccountId = CentralTreasuryYieldVaultService.formatAccountId(accountId);

    // Encode registerAccount(bytes32, address)
    const registrationCalldata = encodeFunctionData({
      abi: CentralTreasuryYieldVaultABI,
      functionName: "registerAccount",
      args: [formattedAccountId, account.wallet_address],
    });

    // Encode ERC-20 approve(vaultAddress, maxUint256) on Arc USDC
    const approvalCalldata = encodeFunctionData({
      abi: USDC_ABI,
      functionName: "approve",
      args: [vaultAddress, maxUint256],
    });

    return {
      accountId,
      vaultAddress,
      registrationCalldata,
      approvalCalldata,
      isRegistered: true,
    };
  }

  /**
   * Phase 7: Activation Deposit Ingestion
   * Detects and records initial operating capital deposit from Arc System Emitter / native transfer,
   * creates an onchain-linked genesis journal entry, and activates the corporate cost center.
   */
  public async ingestActivationDeposit(
    accountId: string,
    txHash: `0x${string}`,
    amountUsdc: number
  ): Promise<{
    accountId: string;
    txHash: `0x${string}`;
    amountUsdc: number;
    journalEntryHash: string;
    status: "ACTIVATED";
  }> {
    const account = await TreasuryAccountsRepo.getAccountById(accountId);
    if (!account) {
      throw new Error(`[EnterpriseOnboardingService] Account ${accountId} not found in registry`);
    }

    if (amountUsdc <= 0) {
      throw new Error(`[EnterpriseOnboardingService] Activation deposit must be positive. Received: ${amountUsdc}`);
    }

    // Append document-linked journal entry in Master System Journal (Rule 1)
    const journalEntry = await MasterJournalRepo.appendEntry({
      account_id: accountId,
      action_type: "ACTIVATION_DEPOSIT_INGESTED",
      debit_account: "CASH_OPERATING_RESERVE",
      credit_account: "EQUITY_INITIAL_CAPITAL",
      amount_usdc: amountUsdc,
      document_ref: `ARC:TX:${txHash}`,
    });

    // Log to Account Agent Audit Log
    await AuditLogRepo.appendAuditLog({
      account_id: accountId,
      actor_agent: AGENT_REGISTRY.OnboardingAgent.name,
      action_type: "ACCOUNT_ACTIVATED",
      amount_usdc: amountUsdc,
      is_autonomous: true,
      reason: `Activation deposit of ${amountUsdc.toFixed(6)} USDC ingested on Arc L1 (Tx: ${txHash}). Account is now ACTIVE for autonomous operations.`,
      pre_state_snapshot: { status: "AWAITING_DEPOSIT" },
      post_state_snapshot: { status: "ACTIVATED", balanceUsdc: amountUsdc },
    });

    // Recalculate Dynamic Record 2 (Safe-to-Invest & Tripartite Balance) upon funding
    const dynamicRecords = new DynamicRecordsService();
    const rawDeposit = BigInt(Math.round(amountUsdc * 1_000_000));
    const floorStr = (account.min_operating_floor_usdc || 50.0).toFixed(6);
    await dynamicRecords.calculateSafeToInvest(accountId, 7 * 86400, floorStr, rawDeposit, 0n);

    return {
      accountId,
      txHash,
      amountUsdc,
      journalEntryHash: journalEntry.current_hash,
      status: "ACTIVATED",
    };
  }

  /**
   * Onboard Recurring Liabilities for an Account (Dynamic Record 1 & 2)
   * Registers suppliers in Vendor Master Registry and schedules their recurring subscriptions/debts.
   */
  public async onboardAccountRecurringLiabilities(params: {
    accountId: string;
    recurringLiabilities: Array<{
      vendorId: string;
      vendorName: string;
      payoutAddress: `0x${string}`;
      paymentEndpointUrl?: string;
      payoutRail?: "DISBURSAL_VAULT" | "MODULAR_SESSION_KEY" | "ERC3009_AUTHORIZATION" | "GATEWAY_X402";
      title: string;
      category?: string;
      amountUsdc: number;
      dueDate: string | Date;
      frequencyCron?: string;
      poReference?: string;
    }>;
  }): Promise<{
    vendorsRegistered: VendorMasterRecord[];
    liabilitiesScheduled: LiabilityDbRecord[];
    initialSafeToInvestUsdc: string;
  }> {
    const { accountId, recurringLiabilities } = params;
    const account = await TreasuryAccountsRepo.getAccountById(accountId);
    if (!account) {
      throw new Error(`[EnterpriseOnboardingService] Account ${accountId} not found in registry`);
    }

    const registeredVendors: VendorMasterRecord[] = [];
    const scheduledLiabilities: LiabilityDbRecord[] = [];

    for (const item of recurringLiabilities) {
      let vendor = await VendorMasterRepo.getVendorById(item.vendorId);
      if (!vendor) {
        vendor = await VendorMasterRepo.registerVendor({
          vendor_id: item.vendorId,
          name: item.vendorName,
          verified_payout_address: item.payoutAddress,
          verified_by_admin: "ONBOARDING_RECURRING_LIA",
          last_verified_at: new Date(),
          change_lock: true,
        });
        registeredVendors.push(vendor);
      }

      const poHash = item.poReference
        ? keccak256(stringToHex(`PO:${item.poReference}:${item.amountUsdc}`))
        : undefined;
      const invoiceHash = keccak256(stringToHex(`INV:${item.title}:${item.amountUsdc}`));

      const liability = await LiabilityRepo.createLiability({
        account_id: accountId,
        vendor_id: item.vendorId,
        title: item.title,
        category: (item.category as any) || "SUBSCRIPTION",
        amount_usdc: item.amountUsdc,
        due_date: new Date(item.dueDate),
        payout_address: item.payoutAddress,
        frequency_cron: item.frequencyCron || "0 0 1 * *",
        source_po_hash: poHash,
        source_invoice_hash: invoiceHash,
        status: "SCHEDULED",
      });
      scheduledLiabilities.push(liability);
    }

    const dynamicRecords = new DynamicRecordsService();
    const floorStr = (account.min_operating_floor_usdc || 50.0).toFixed(6);
    const sti = await dynamicRecords.calculateSafeToInvest(accountId, 7 * 86400, floorStr);

    return {
      vendorsRegistered: registeredVendors,
      liabilitiesScheduled: scheduledLiabilities,
      initialSafeToInvestUsdc: sti.safeToInvestUsdc,
    };
  }
}

File: unifiedAssetAggregatorService.ts

import { PublicClient, parseAbiItem } from "viem";
import { ArcClientManager } from "../foundation/arc/client.js";
import { ARC_CONSTANTS } from "../foundation/arc/constants.js";
import { CentralTreasuryYieldVaultService } from "../contracts/centralTreasuryYieldVaultService.js";
import { TreasuryAccountsRepo, TreasuryAccountRecord } from "../database/repos/treasuryAccountsRepo.js";
import { LiabilityRepo } from "../database/repos/liabilityRepo.js";
import { DynamicRecordsService } from "../records/dynamicRecordsService.js";
import { PolicyLoader } from "../config/policyLoader.js";
import { LoudRoundingError } from "../foundation/usdc/usdcService.js";

/**
 * Thrown when an on-chain data feed (RPC call) fails to return a reliable value.
 * Callers MUST NOT silently treat this as $0 — Rule 5: Loud Repair.
 */
export class DataFeedError extends Error {
  constructor(public readonly accountId: string, public readonly feed: string, cause?: unknown) {
    super(`DataFeedError[${feed}] for account '${accountId}': ${String(cause)}`);
    this.name = "DataFeedError";
  }
}

export interface AccountAssetDistribution {
  accountId: string;
  name: string;
  role: string;
  chain: string;
  address: `0x${string}`;
  liquidUsdc: string;
  liquidRaw: bigint;
  investedUsyc: string;
  investedRaw: bigint;
  totalEffectiveUsdc: string;
  totalEffectiveRaw: bigint;
  committedLiabilities30dUsdc: string;
  committedLiabilities30dRaw: bigint;
  safetyBufferRatio: number;
  minOperatingFloorUsdc: string;
  minOperatingFloorRaw: bigint;
  protectedReserveUsdc: string;
  protectedReserveRaw: bigint;
  freeCapitalUsdc: string;
  freeCapitalRaw: bigint;
  unencumberedLiquidCashUsdc: string;
  unencumberedLiquidCashRaw: bigint;
  safeToInvestUsdc: string;
  safeToInvestRaw: bigint;
  isActive: boolean;
  excludeFromWaterfall: boolean;
  authorizedCategories: string[];
}

export interface SolvencyHealthMetrics {
  isSolvent: boolean;
  totalSurplusUsdc: string;
  totalSurplusRaw: bigint;
  healthRatio: number;
}

export interface CompanyUnifiedAssetDistribution {
  timestamp: string;
  companyTotalNetWorthUsdc: string;
  companyTotalNetWorthRaw: bigint;
  totalLiquidUsdc: string;
  totalLiquidRaw: bigint;

  totalFreeCapitalRaw: bigint;

export interface BalanceOverrideMap {
  [accountId: string]: {
    liquidUsdc?: number | bigint | string;
    investedUsyc?: number | bigint | string;
  };
}

/**
 * D14: Unified Asset Aggregator Service (Sentence 18 / DAG Node D14)
 * Consolidates fragmented multichain and multi-account assets into a single comprehensive balance sheet.
 * Computes exact 6-decimal integer USDC arithmetic for liquid cash, invested USYC, liabilities, and free capital.
 */
export class UnifiedAssetAggregatorService {
  private publicClient: PublicClient;
  private vaultService: CentralTreasuryYieldVaultService;
  private dynamicRecords: DynamicRecordsService;

  constructor(options?: {
    publicClient?: PublicClient;
    vaultService?: CentralTreasuryYieldVaultService;
    dynamicRecords?: DynamicRecordsService;
  }) {
    this.publicClient = options?.publicClient ?? ArcClientManager.getPublicClient();
    this.vaultService =
      options?.vaultService ??
      new CentralTreasuryYieldVaultService("0x4444444444444444444444444444444444444444");
    this.dynamicRecords = options?.dynamicRecords ?? new DynamicRecordsService();
  }

  /**
   * Reads the onchain liquid USDC balance for a given wallet address.
   */
  public async getOnchainUsdcBalance(walletAddress: `0x${string}`): Promise<bigint> {
    try {
      const balanceOfAbi = parseAbiItem("function balanceOf(address owner) view returns (uint256)");
      const balanceRaw = await this.publicClient.readContract({
        address: ARC_CONSTANTS.USDC_PREDEPLOY,
        abi: [balanceOfAbi],
        functionName: "balanceOf",
        args: [walletAddress],
      });
      return balanceRaw as bigint;
    } catch {
      try {
        const nativeBalance = await this.publicClient.getBalance({ address: walletAddress });
        return nativeBalance / ARC_CONSTANTS.DECIMAL_CONVERSION_FACTOR;
      } catch {
        return 0n;
      }
    }
  }

  /**
   * Reads onchain USYC yield vault position for an account.
   */
  public async getOnchainYieldPosition(accountId: string): Promise<bigint> {
    try {
      const assets = await this.vaultService.getAccountAssets(accountId);
      return assets;
    } catch (err) {
      // Rule 5 (Loud Repair): Do NOT silently return $0.
      // A silent zero here would cause the aggregator to undercount total effective
      // balance, artificially inflate safeToInvest, and trigger unnecessary sweeps.
      throw new DataFeedError(accountId, "USYC_YIELD_POSITION", err);
    }
  }

  /**
   * Computes individual asset distribution and solvency metrics for a specific treasury account.
   */
  public async getAccountAssetDistribution(
    accountId: string,
    overrides?: { liquidUsdc?: number | bigint | string; investedUsyc?: number | bigint | string }
  ): Promise<AccountAssetDistribution> {
    const account = await TreasuryAccountsRepo.getAccountById(accountId);
    if (!account) {
      throw new Error(`AccountNotFoundError: Account '${accountId}' does not exist in TreasuryAccountsRepo.`);
    }

    const { profile } = PolicyLoader.getActiveProfile();
    const accountPolicy = profile.operating_accounts.find((a) => a.account_id === accountId);

    // 1. Resolve Liquid Balance (BL)
    let liquidRaw: bigint;
    if (overrides?.liquidUsdc !== undefined) {
      if (typeof overrides.liquidUsdc === "bigint") {
        liquidRaw = overrides.liquidUsdc;
      } else if (typeof overrides.liquidUsdc === "string") {
        liquidRaw = this.dynamicRecords.parseUsdcToRaw(overrides.liquidUsdc);
      } else {
        liquidRaw = this.dynamicRecords.parseUsdcToRaw(overrides.liquidUsdc.toFixed(6));
      }
    } else {
      liquidRaw = await this.getOnchainUsdcBalance(account.wallet_address);
    }

    // 2. Resolve Invested Yield Position (BY)
    let investedRaw: bigint;
    if (overrides?.investedUsyc !== undefined) {
      if (typeof overrides.investedUsyc === "bigint") {
        investedRaw = overrides.investedUsyc;
      } else if (typeof overrides.investedUsyc === "string") {
        investedRaw = this.dynamicRecords.parseUsdcToRaw(overrides.investedUsyc);
      } else {
        investedRaw = this.dynamicRecords.parseUsdcToRaw(overrides.investedUsyc.toFixed(6));
      }
    } else {
      investedRaw = await this.getOnchainYieldPosition(accountId);
    }

    // Parallel Tripartite Balance: BE = BL + BY
    const totalEffectiveRaw = liquidRaw + investedRaw;

    // 3. Query 30-Day Committed Liabilities from Dynamic Record 1
    const liabilities30d = await LiabilityRepo.getUpcomingLiabilities(30, accountId);
    let committedLiabilities30dRaw = 0n;
    for (const item of liabilities30d) {
      committedLiabilities30dRaw += this.dynamicRecords.parseUsdcToRaw(item.amount_usdc.toFixed(6));
    }

    // 4. Reserve Requirements Calculation
    const safetyBufferRatio = account.safety_buffer_ratio || 1.2;
    const minOperatingFloorRaw = this.dynamicRecords.parseUsdcToRaw(
      (account.min_operating_floor_usdc || 0).toFixed(6)
    );

    // Protected Reserve = (Σ Liabilities_30d * safety_buffer_ratio) + min_operating_floor
    // Compute integer math: (committedLiabilities30dRaw * BigInt(Math.round(safetyBufferRatio * 10000))) / 10000n
    const ratioScaled = BigInt(Math.round(safetyBufferRatio * 10000));
    const bufferedLiabilitiesRaw = (committedLiabilities30dRaw * ratioScaled) / 10000n;
    const protectedReserveRaw = bufferedLiabilitiesRaw + minOperatingFloorRaw;

    // Free Capital = max(0, TotalEffective - ProtectedReserve)
    const freeCapitalRaw = totalEffectiveRaw > protectedReserveRaw ? totalEffectiveRaw - protectedReserveRaw : 0n;

    // Unencumbered Liquid Cash = max(0, LiquidCash - ProtectedReserve)
    const unencumberedLiquidCashRaw =
      liquidRaw > protectedReserveRaw ? liquidRaw - protectedReserveRaw : 0n;

    // 5. Safe to Invest (from Dynamic Record 2)
    const isExcluded =
      account.role === "PAYROLL" ||
      accountPolicy?.exclude_from_waterfall_draws === true ||
      (accountPolicy?.max_autonomous_sweep_limit !== undefined && accountPolicy.max_autonomous_sweep_limit <= 0);

    let safeToInvestRaw = 0n;
    if (!isExcluded) {
      const hysteresisRaw = this.dynamicRecords.parseUsdcToRaw(
        (profile.investment_rules.invest_hysteresis_band_usdc || 1.0).toFixed(6)
      );
      const sweepThresholdRaw = protectedReserveRaw + hysteresisRaw;
      if (liquidRaw > sweepThresholdRaw) {
        const rawSafe = liquidRaw - sweepThresholdRaw;
        if (accountPolicy?.max_autonomous_sweep_limit !== undefined) {
          const limitRaw = this.dynamicRecords.parseUsdcToRaw(
            accountPolicy.max_autonomous_sweep_limit.toFixed(6)
          );
          safeToInvestRaw = rawSafe > limitRaw ? limitRaw : rawSafe;
        } else {
          safeToInvestRaw = rawSafe;
        }
      }
    }

    const authorizedCategories = accountPolicy?.authorized_categories || [];

    return {
      accountId: account.account_id,
      name: account.name,
      role: account.role,
      chain: account.chain_id === 5042 ? "ARC_MAINNET" : "ARC_TESTNET",
      address: account.wallet_address,
      liquidUsdc: this.dynamicRecords.formatRawToUsdc(liquidRaw),
      liquidRaw,
      investedUsyc: this.dynamicRecords.formatRawToUsdc(investedRaw),
      investedRaw,
      totalEffectiveUsdc: this.dynamicRecords.formatRawToUsdc(totalEffectiveRaw),
      totalEffectiveRaw,
      committedLiabilities30dUsdc: this.dynamicRecords.formatRawToUsdc(committedLiabilities30dRaw),
      committedLiabilities30dRaw,
      safetyBufferRatio,
      minOperatingFloorUsdc: this.dynamicRecords.formatRawToUsdc(minOperatingFloorRaw),
      minOperatingFloorRaw,
      protectedReserveUsdc: this.dynamicRecords.formatRawToUsdc(protectedReserveRaw),
      protectedReserveRaw,
      freeCapitalUsdc: this.dynamicRecords.formatRawToUsdc(freeCapitalRaw),
      freeCapitalRaw,
      unencumberedLiquidCashUsdc: this.dynamicRecords.formatRawToUsdc(unencumberedLiquidCashRaw),
      unencumberedLiquidCashRaw,
      safeToInvestUsdc: this.dynamicRecords.formatRawToUsdc(safeToInvestRaw),
      safeToInvestRaw,
      isActive: account.is_active,
      excludeFromWaterfall: account.role === "PAYROLL" || (accountPolicy?.exclude_from_waterfall_draws ?? false),
      authorizedCategories,
    };
  }

  /**
   * Aggregates real-time unified asset distribution across all corporate accounts.
   * Produces the full company-wide balance sheet with Parallel Tripartite Balance verification.
   */
  public async aggregateCompanyAssets(
    balanceOverrides?: BalanceOverrideMap
  ): Promise<CompanyUnifiedAssetDistribution> {
    const allAccounts = await TreasuryAccountsRepo.getAllAccounts();

    const targetAccounts =
      balanceOverrides && Object.keys(balanceOverrides).length > 0
        ? allAccounts.filter((a) => a.account_id in balanceOverrides)
        : allAccounts.filter((a) => a.is_active);

    const distributions: AccountAssetDistribution[] = [];

    let companyTotalNetWorthRaw = 0n;
    let totalLiquidRaw = 0n;
    let totalInvestedRaw = 0n;
    let totalUpcomingLiabilities30dRaw = 0n;
    let totalProtectedReserveRaw = 0n;
    let totalFreeCapitalRaw = 0n;

    for (const acc of targetAccounts) {
      const overrides = balanceOverrides?.[acc.account_id];
      const dist = await this.getAccountAssetDistribution(acc.account_id, overrides);
      distributions.push(dist);

      companyTotalNetWorthRaw += dist.totalEffectiveRaw;
      totalLiquidRaw += dist.liquidRaw;
      totalInvestedRaw += dist.investedRaw;
      totalUpcomingLiabilities30dRaw += dist.committedLiabilities30dRaw;
      totalProtectedReserveRaw += dist.protectedReserveRaw;
      totalFreeCapitalRaw += dist.freeCapitalRaw;
    }

    // Invariant Check: Total Net Worth = Total Liquid + Total Invested
    if (companyTotalNetWorthRaw !== totalLiquidRaw + totalInvestedRaw) {
      throw new LoudRoundingError(
        `Tripartite Balance Invariant Violated: Net Worth (${companyTotalNetWorthRaw}) != Liquid (${totalLiquidRaw}) + Invested (${totalInvestedRaw})`
      );
    }

    const isSolvent = companyTotalNetWorthRaw >= totalProtectedReserveRaw;
    const totalSurplusRaw =
      companyTotalNetWorthRaw > totalProtectedReserveRaw
        ? companyTotalNetWorthRaw - totalProtectedReserveRaw
        : 0n;

    const healthRatio =
      totalProtectedReserveRaw > 0n
        ? Number(companyTotalNetWorthRaw) / Number(totalProtectedReserveRaw)
        : 1.0;

    return {
      timestamp: new Date().toISOString(),
      companyTotalNetWorthUsdc: this.dynamicRecords.formatRawToUsdc(companyTotalNetWorthRaw),
      companyTotalNetWorthRaw,
      totalLiquidUsdc: this.dynamicRecords.formatRawToUsdc(totalLiquidRaw),
      totalLiquidRaw,
      totalInvestedUsyc: this.dynamicRecords.formatRawToUsdc(totalInvestedRaw),
      totalInvestedRaw,
      totalUpcomingLiabilities30dUsdc: this.dynamicRecords.formatRawToUsdc(totalUpcomingLiabilities30dRaw),
      totalUpcomingLiabilities30dRaw,
      totalProtectedReserveUsdc: this.dynamicRecords.formatRawToUsdc(totalProtectedReserveRaw),
      totalProtectedReserveRaw,
      totalFreeCapitalUsdc: this.dynamicRecords.formatRawToUsdc(totalFreeCapitalRaw),
      totalFreeCapitalRaw,
      accountsDistribution: distributions,
      solvencyHealth: {
        isSolvent,
        totalSurplusUsdc: this.dynamicRecords.formatRawToUsdc(totalSurplusRaw),
        totalSurplusRaw,
        healthRatio: Number(healthRatio.toFixed(4)),
      },
    };
  }
}


------------------------------------------------------------
File: recurringLiabilityService.ts

import { DbClient } from "../database/dbClient.js";
import { DynamicRecordsService } from "../records/dynamicRecordsService.js";
import { PermissionRequestRepo } from "../database/repos/permissionRequestRepo.js";
import { VendorMasterRepo } from "../database/repos/vendorMasterRepo.js";
import { VendorBankRepo } from "../database/repos/vendorBankRepo.js";
import { VendorPaymentPreferenceRepo } from "../database/repos/vendorPaymentPreferenceRepo.js";
import { AuthorizationGate } from "../security/authorizationGate.js";

export interface RecurringLiabilitySpec {
  liabilityId?: string;
  companyId?: string;
  accountId: string;
  vendorId: string;
  title: string;
  category?: string;
  amountUsdc: string;
  dueDate: Date;
  frequencyCron: string;
  payoutAddress?: string | null;
  poReference?: string;
  documentHash?: string;
  preferredPaymentRail?: string;
  preferredSubMethod?: string;
  bankDetails?: Record<string, any>;
  cryptoDetails?: Record<string, any>;
}

export class RecurringLiabilityService {
  private static dynamicRecords = new DynamicRecordsService();

  /**
   * Adds a recurring liability for an account (Dynamic Record 1).
   * User Invariant: Can be added by human or agent, although such actions require human approval.
   */
  public static async addRecurringLiability(params: {
    spec: RecurringLiabilitySpec;
    proposedBy: "HUMAN" | string;
    rationale: string;
    sprsRequestId?: string;
    adminSignature?: string;
  }): Promise<{
    status: "CREATED" | "PENDING_HUMAN_APPROVAL";
    liabilityId?: string;
    sprsRequestId?: string;
    message: string;
  }> {
    const { spec, proposedBy, rationale, sprsRequestId, adminSignature } = params;

    // 1. Verify vendor is registered in Vendor Master Registry
    let vendor = await VendorMasterRepo.getVendorById(spec.vendorId);
    let payoutAddress = spec.payoutAddress || vendor?.verified_payout_address || null;
    const isFiat = spec.preferredPaymentRail === "FIAT_PAYOUT" || Boolean(spec.bankDetails) || (payoutAddress ? !payoutAddress.startsWith("0x") : false);

    if (!vendor) {
      if (isFiat || spec.bankDetails) {
        vendor = await VendorMasterRepo.registerVendor({
          vendor_id: spec.vendorId,
          name: spec.vendorId,
          verified_payout_address: payoutAddress && payoutAddress.startsWith("0x") ? (payoutAddress as `0x${string}`) : null,
          verified_by_admin: "RECURRING_LIABILITY_SERVICE",
          last_verified_at: new Date(),
          change_lock: true,
        });
      } else {
        throw new Error(`[RecurringLiabilityService] Vendor ${spec.vendorId} is not registered in Vendor Master Registry.`);
      }
    }

    let bankAccountId: string | undefined;
    if (spec.bankDetails) {
      const bankRecord = await VendorBankRepo.createBankAccount({
        vendor_id: spec.vendorId,
        account_holder_name: spec.bankDetails.accountHolderName || spec.vendorId,
        iban_account_number: spec.bankDetails.ibanOrAccountNumber || spec.bankDetails.ibanAccountNumber || "UNKNOWN",
        routing_swift: spec.bankDetails.routingOrSwift || spec.bankDetails.routingSwift || "000000000",
        bank_name: spec.bankDetails.bankName,
        bank_country: spec.bankDetails.bankCountry || "US",
        payment_sub_method: spec.preferredSubMethod || spec.bankDetails.paymentSubMethod || "FEDWIRE",
        is_verified: true,
      });
      bankAccountId = bankRecord.bank_account_id;
    }

    if (spec.preferredPaymentRail || spec.preferredSubMethod || spec.bankDetails || spec.cryptoDetails) {
      await VendorPaymentPreferenceRepo.setPreference({
        vendor_id: spec.vendorId,
        preferred_rail: (spec.preferredPaymentRail as any) || (isFiat ? "FIAT_PAYOUT" : "DISBURSAL_VAULT"),
        preferred_sub_method: spec.preferredSubMethod || null,
        bank_account_id: bankAccountId || null,
        crypto_wallet_address: spec.cryptoDetails?.walletAddress || (payoutAddress && payoutAddress.startsWith("0x") ? payoutAddress : null),
        crypto_chain_id: spec.cryptoDetails?.chainId ?? 5042,
        crypto_token_symbol: spec.cryptoDetails?.tokenSymbol || "USDC",
      });
    }

    // 2. Check Layer 2 Human Authorization
    const authCheck = await AuthorizationGate.verifyAuthorization({
      actionType: "ADD_RECURRING_LIABILITY",
      accountId: spec.accountId,
      amountUsdc: spec.amountUsdc,
      sprsRequestId,
      adminSignature,
    });

    const isHumanInitiated = proposedBy === "HUMAN" || authCheck.isAuthorized;

    if (!isHumanInitiated) {
      // Create EIP-712 Standardized Permission Request (SPRS) for Human CFO
      const sprsId = `SPRS_ADD_LIA_${Date.now()}`;
      await PermissionRequestRepo.createRequest({
        request_id: sprsId,
        action_type: "ADD_RECURRING_LIABILITY",
        reason: `Agent ${proposedBy} proposed new recurring liability '${spec.title}' (${spec.amountUsdc} USDC, cron ${spec.frequencyCron}) for account ${spec.accountId}. Rationale: ${rationale}`,
        amount_usdc: parseFloat(spec.amountUsdc),
        status: "PENDING",
        payload: { spec: { ...spec, payoutAddress }, proposedBy, rationale },
      });

      return {
        status: "PENDING_HUMAN_APPROVAL",
        sprsRequestId: sprsId,
        message: `Recurring liability proposal paused for Layer 2 Human CFO approval (SPRS ${sprsId}).`,
      };
    }

    // 3. Commit to Dynamic Record 1 (account_liabilities)
    const liability = await this.dynamicRecords.upsertLiability({
      companyId: spec.companyId,
      accountId: spec.accountId,
      vendorId: spec.vendorId,
      title: spec.title,
      category: spec.category || "SUBSCRIPTION",
      amountUsdc: spec.amountUsdc,
      dueDate: spec.dueDate,
      frequency: spec.frequencyCron as any,
      payoutAddress: payoutAddress || undefined,
      documentHash: spec.documentHash || `HASH_${Date.now()}`,
      poReference: spec.poReference,
      status: "SCHEDULED",
      preferredPaymentRail: (spec.preferredPaymentRail as any) || (isFiat ? "FIAT_PAYOUT" : "DISBURSAL_VAULT"),
      paymentSubMethod: spec.preferredSubMethod || undefined,
      paymentRailConfig: spec.bankDetails || spec.cryptoDetails || {},
    });

    // 4. Recalculate Dynamic Record 2 (Safe-to-Invest & Tripartite Balance)
    await this.dynamicRecords.calculateSafeToInvest(spec.accountId);

    return {
      status: "CREATED",
      liabilityId: liability.liabilityId,
      message: `Recurring liability '${spec.title}' successfully activated on account ${spec.accountId}. Dynamic Record 1 & 2 updated.`,
    };
  }

  /**
   * Edits an existing recurring liability for an account (amount, due date, schedule, or account).
   * Requires Layer 2 Human Approval if initiated by an agent.
   */
  public static async editRecurringLiability(params: {
    liabilityId: string;
    updates: Partial<RecurringLiabilitySpec>;
    proposedBy: "HUMAN" | string;
    rationale: string;
    sprsRequestId?: string;
    adminSignature?: string;
  }): Promise<{
    status: "UPDATED" | "PENDING_HUMAN_APPROVAL";
    liabilityId?: string;
    sprsRequestId?: string;
    message: string;
  }> {
    const { liabilityId, updates, proposedBy, rationale, sprsRequestId, adminSignature } = params;

    const existingRes = await DbClient.query(
      `SELECT * FROM account_liabilities WHERE liability_id = $1 LIMIT 1;`,
      [liabilityId]
    );

    if (existingRes.rows.length === 0) {
      throw new Error(`[RecurringLiabilityService] Liability ${liabilityId} not found.`);
    }

    const existing = existingRes.rows[0];

    const authCheck = await AuthorizationGate.verifyAuthorization({
      actionType: "EDIT_RECURRING_LIABILITY",
      accountId: updates.accountId || existing.account_id,
      amountUsdc: updates.amountUsdc || existing.amount_usdc,
      sprsRequestId,
      adminSignature,
    });

    const isHumanInitiated = proposedBy === "HUMAN" || authCheck.isAuthorized;

    if (!isHumanInitiated) {
      const sprsId = `SPRS_EDIT_LIA_${liabilityId}_${Date.now()}`;
      await PermissionRequestRepo.createRequest({
        request_id: sprsId,
        action_type: "EDIT_RECURRING_LIABILITY",
        reason: `Agent ${proposedBy} proposed editing liability ${liabilityId} (${existing.title}). Rationale: ${rationale}`,
        amount_usdc: parseFloat(updates.amountUsdc || existing.amount_usdc),
        status: "PENDING",
        payload: { liabilityId, updates, existing, proposedBy, rationale },
      });

      return {
        status: "PENDING_HUMAN_APPROVAL",
        sprsRequestId: sprsId,
        message: `Liability edit paused for Layer 2 Human CFO approval (SPRS ${sprsId}).`,
      };
    }

    // Execute update in PostgreSQL
    await DbClient.query(
      `UPDATE account_liabilities 
       SET title = COALESCE($1, title),
           amount_usdc = COALESCE($2, amount_usdc),
           due_date = COALESCE($3, due_date),
           frequency_cron = COALESCE($4, frequency_cron),
           account_id = COALESCE($5, account_id),
           updated_at = NOW()
       WHERE liability_id = $6;`,
      [
        updates.title || null,
        updates.amountUsdc || null,
        updates.dueDate ? updates.dueDate.toISOString() : null,
        updates.frequencyCron || null,
        updates.accountId || null,
        liabilityId,
      ]
    );

    // Recalculate Dynamic Record 2
    const targetAccount = updates.accountId || existing.account_id;
    await this.dynamicRecords.calculateSafeToInvest(targetAccount);

    return {
      status: "UPDATED",
      liabilityId,
      message: `Recurring liability ${liabilityId} updated successfully. Dynamic Record 1 & 2 recalculated.`,
    };
  }

  /**
   * Removes or cancels a recurring liability from an account.
   * Requires Layer 2 Human Approval if initiated by an agent.
   */
  public static async removeRecurringLiability(params: {
    liabilityId: string;
    proposedBy: "HUMAN" | string;
    rationale: string;
    sprsRequestId?: string;
    adminSignature?: string;
  }): Promise<{
    status: "REMOVED" | "PENDING_HUMAN_APPROVAL";
    liabilityId?: string;
    sprsRequestId?: string;
    message: string;
  }> {
    const { liabilityId, proposedBy, rationale, sprsRequestId, adminSignature } = params;

    const existingRes = await DbClient.query(
      `SELECT * FROM account_liabilities WHERE liability_id = $1 LIMIT 1;`,
      [liabilityId]
    );

    if (existingRes.rows.length === 0) {
      throw new Error(`[RecurringLiabilityService] Liability ${liabilityId} not found.`);
    }

    const existing = existingRes.rows[0];

    const authCheck = await AuthorizationGate.verifyAuthorization({
      actionType: "REMOVE_RECURRING_LIABILITY",
      accountId: existing.account_id,
      amountUsdc: existing.amount_usdc,
      sprsRequestId,
      adminSignature,
    });

    const isHumanInitiated = proposedBy === "HUMAN" || authCheck.isAuthorized;

    if (!isHumanInitiated) {
      const sprsId = `SPRS_REM_LIA_${liabilityId}_${Date.now()}`;
      await PermissionRequestRepo.createRequest({
        request_id: sprsId,
        action_type: "REMOVE_RECURRING_LIABILITY",
        reason: `Agent ${proposedBy} proposed removing liability ${liabilityId} (${existing.title}). Rationale: ${rationale}`,
        amount_usdc: parseFloat(existing.amount_usdc),
        status: "PENDING",
        payload: { liabilityId, existing, proposedBy, rationale },
      });

      return {
        status: "PENDING_HUMAN_APPROVAL",
        sprsRequestId: sprsId,
        message: `Liability removal paused for Layer 2 Human CFO approval (SPRS ${sprsId}).`,
      };
    }

    await DbClient.query(
      `UPDATE account_liabilities SET status = 'CANCELLED', updated_at = NOW() WHERE liability_id = $1;`,
      [liabilityId]
    );

    // Recalculate Dynamic Record 2
    await this.dynamicRecords.calculateSafeToInvest(existing.account_id);

    return {
      status: "REMOVED",
      liabilityId,
      message: `Recurring liability ${liabilityId} removed/cancelled. Dynamic Record 1 & 2 recalculated.`,
    };
  }
}

import crypto from "node:crypto";
import { UniversalPaymentRouter } from "../payments/universalPaymentRouter.js";
import {
  PaymentRailType,
  FiatSubMethodType,
  UniversalDisbursalIntent,
  UniversalDisbursalExecutionResult,
} from "../payments/rails/types.js";
import { TreasuryAccountsRepo } from "../database/repos/treasuryAccountsRepo.js";
import { VendorMasterRepo } from "../database/repos/vendorMasterRepo.js";
import { VendorBankRepo } from "../database/repos/vendorBankRepo.js";
import { MasterJournalRepo } from "../database/repos/masterJournalRepo.js";
import { AuditLogRepo } from "../database/repos/auditLogRepo.js";
import { TokenSwapService } from "./tokenSwapService.js";
import { DynamicRecordsService } from "../records/dynamicRecordsService.js";

export interface ManualPaymentFiatDetails {
  subMethod?: FiatSubMethodType;
  accountHolderName: string;
  ibanOrAccountNumber: string;
  routingOrSwift?: string;
  bankCountry?: string;
  bankName?: string;
  cardToken?: string;
  cardLast4?: string;
  cardNetwork?: string;
}

export interface ManualPaymentCryptoDetails {
  walletAddress: `0x${string}` | string;
  chainId?: number;
  tokenSymbol?: string; // e.g. "USDC", "USDT", "ETH"
  targetChain?: string;
  sessionKeyId?: string;
  serviceUrl?: string;
}

export interface ExecuteManualPaymentParams {
  companyId: string;
  sourceAccountId: string;
  vendorId: string;
  vendorName: string;
  amountUsdc: number;
  paymentRail?: PaymentRailType;
  fiatDetails?: ManualPaymentFiatDetails;
  cryptoDetails?: ManualPaymentCryptoDetails;
  declaredReason: string;
  invoiceId?: string;
  poReference?: string;
  category?: string;
  adminSignature?: `0x${string}`;
  clearanceCode?: string;

export interface ManualPaymentResult {
  success: boolean;
  intentId: string;
  rail: PaymentRailType;
  subMethod?: string;
  status: "EXECUTED" | "AWAITING_SETTLEMENT" | "ESCALATE_TO_SPRS" | "REJECTED_BY_POLICY";
  amountUsdc: number;
  sourceAccountId: string;
  vendorId: string;
  txHash?: string;
  fiatPayoutId?: string;
  cardPayoutRef?: string;
  imadOmadTrace?: string;
  journalSequenceId?: string;
  sprsRequestId?: string;
  error?: string;
  timestamp: string;
}

/**
 * ManualDisbursalService
 *
 * Handles manual payments initiated by human users/admins.
 * Accepts flexible payment details that can be either:
 * - Fiat-based: Fedwire, ACH, Push-to-Card, SEPA, SWIFT.
 * - Crypto-based: Direct Arc L1 Vault, ERC-3009 signed mandate, Session Key, x402, or Cross-Token Swap.
 *
 * Enforces:
 * 1. Source Account Liquidity & Payroll Protection Wall.
 * 2. Automatic Currency / Token Swap if payee requires non-USDC token.
 * 3. Anti-Payee Substitution Defense.
 * 4. Dual-Control Human Gate (EIP-712 CFO signature or clearance code).
 * 5. Hash-Chained Double-Entry Master Journal Vouchers.
 */
export class ManualDisbursalService {
  private paymentRouter: UniversalPaymentRouter;
  private tokenSwapService: TokenSwapService;
  private dynamicRecords: DynamicRecordsService;

  constructor(options?: {
    paymentRouter?: UniversalPaymentRouter;
    tokenSwapService?: TokenSwapService;
    dynamicRecords?: DynamicRecordsService;
  }) {
    this.paymentRouter = options?.paymentRouter ?? new UniversalPaymentRouter();
    this.tokenSwapService = options?.tokenSwapService ?? new TokenSwapService();
    this.dynamicRecords = options?.dynamicRecords ?? new DynamicRecordsService();
  }

  public async executeManualDisbursal(
    params: ExecuteManualPaymentParams
  ): Promise<ManualPaymentResult> {
    const timestamp = new Date().toISOString();
    const intentId = `MANUAL_PAY_${Date.now()}_${Math.random().toString(36).slice(2, 6)}`;

    // 1. Verify Source Treasury Account
    const account = await TreasuryAccountsRepo.getAccountById(params.sourceAccountId);
    if (!account) {
      return {
        success: false,
        intentId,
        rail: params.paymentRail || "DISBURSAL_VAULT",
        status: "REJECTED_BY_POLICY",
        amountUsdc: params.amountUsdc,
        sourceAccountId: params.sourceAccountId,
        vendorId: params.vendorId,
        error: `Source account '${params.sourceAccountId}' does not exist.`,
        timestamp,
      };
    }

    // Payroll Protection Wall
    const isPayrollAccount = account.role === "PAYROLL" || params.sourceAccountId.toLowerCase().includes("payroll");
    if (isPayrollAccount && params.category !== "PAYROLL") {
      return {
        success: false,
        intentId,
        rail: params.paymentRail || "DISBURSAL_VAULT",
        status: "REJECTED_BY_POLICY",
        amountUsdc: params.amountUsdc,
        sourceAccountId: params.sourceAccountId,
        vendorId: params.vendorId,
        error: `HARD INVARIANT VIOLATION: Source account '${params.sourceAccountId}' is role PAYROLL. Non-payroll draws are strictly prohibited.`,
        timestamp,
      };
    }

    // 2. Determine Payment Rail & Sub-Method
    let activeRail: PaymentRailType = params.paymentRail || "DISBURSAL_VAULT";
    let subMethod: string | undefined = undefined;

    if (params.fiatDetails) {
      activeRail = "FIAT_PAYOUT";
      subMethod = params.fiatDetails.subMethod || (params.fiatDetails.cardToken ? "PUSH_TO_CARD" : "FEDWIRE");
    } else if (params.cryptoDetails?.serviceUrl) {
      activeRail = "GATEWAY_X402";
    } else if (params.cryptoDetails?.sessionKeyId) {
      activeRail = "MODULAR_SESSION_KEY";
    }

    // 3. Handle Cross-Asset Token Swap if payee requires non-USDC token
    let executedAmountUsdc = params.amountUsdc;
    if (
      params.cryptoDetails?.tokenSymbol &&
      params.cryptoDetails.tokenSymbol.toUpperCase() !== "USDC"
    ) {
      const fromToken = "USDC";
      const toToken = params.cryptoDetails.tokenSymbol.toUpperCase();
      const targetChain = params.cryptoDetails.targetChain || "BASE";

      // Execute cross-chain or token conversion to desired asset
      await this.tokenSwapService.executeSwap({
        accountId: params.sourceAccountId,
        fromChain: "ARC",
        fromToken,
        toChain: targetChain,
        toToken,
        amount: params.amountUsdc.toFixed(6),
        slippage: 0.005,
      });
    }

    // 4. Construct Universal Disbursal Intent
    const intent: UniversalDisbursalIntent = {
      intentId,
      primaryAccountId: params.sourceAccountId,
      vendorId: params.vendorId,
      vendorName: params.vendorName,
      amountUsdc: executedAmountUsdc,
      payoutAddress: params.cryptoDetails?.walletAddress,
      serviceUrl: params.cryptoDetails?.serviceUrl,
      declaredReason: params.declaredReason || `Manual disbursal to ${params.vendorName} via ${activeRail}`,
      invoiceId: params.invoiceId,
      poReference: params.poReference,
      category: params.category || "DISBURSAL",
      sessionKeyId: params.cryptoDetails?.sessionKeyId,
      sprsRequestId: params.sprsRequestId,
      beneficiaryBank: params.fiatDetails ? {
        accountHolderName: params.fiatDetails.accountHolderName,
        ibanOrAccountNumber: params.fiatDetails.ibanOrAccountNumber,
        routingOrSwift: params.fiatDetails.routingOrSwift || (subMethod === "PUSH_TO_CARD" ? "CARD_OCT" : "021000018"),
        bankCountry: params.fiatDetails.bankCountry || "US",
        bankName: params.fiatDetails.bankName,
        paymentSubMethod: subMethod,
        cardToken: params.fiatDetails.cardToken,
        cardLast4: params.fiatDetails.cardLast4,
        cardNetwork: params.fiatDetails.cardNetwork,
      } : undefined,
    };

    // 5. Route and execute through UniversalPaymentRouter
    const result: UniversalDisbursalExecutionResult = await this.paymentRouter.routeAndExecute({
      intent,
      adminSignature: params.adminSignature,
      overrideRail: activeRail,
      clearanceCode: params.clearanceCode,
      sprsRequestId: params.sprsRequestId,
    });

    if (result.success || result.status === "EXECUTED") {
      // Recalculate dynamic liquidity record
      await this.dynamicRecords.calculateSafeToInvest(params.sourceAccountId);

      // Audit log entry
      await AuditLogRepo.appendAuditLog({
        account_id: params.sourceAccountId,
        actor_agent: "ManualDisbursalAdmin",
        action_type: `MANUAL_PAYMENT_${activeRail}`,
        amount_usdc: params.amountUsdc,
        is_autonomous: false,
        tx_hash: result.txHash,
        counterparty_address: params.cryptoDetails?.walletAddress,
        reason: params.declaredReason,
        pre_state_snapshot: { accountId: params.sourceAccountId },
        post_state_snapshot: { status: "EXECUTED", txHash: result.txHash, rail: activeRail },
      });
    }

    return {
      success: result.success,
      intentId,
      rail: activeRail,
      subMethod: result.subMethod || subMethod,
      status: result.status,
      amountUsdc: params.amountUsdc,
      sourceAccountId: params.sourceAccountId,
      vendorId: params.vendorId,
      txHash: result.txHash,
      fiatPayoutId: result.fiatPayoutId,
      cardPayoutRef: result.cardPayoutRef,
      imadOmadTrace: result.imadOmadTrace,
      journalSequenceId: result.journalSequenceId,
      sprsRequestId: result.sprsRequestId,
      error: result.error,
      timestamp,
    };
  }
}
