export type LlmRole = "system" | "user" | "assistant" | "tool";

export interface LlmToolCall {
  id: string;
  type: "function";
  function: {
    name: string;
    arguments: string; // JSON stringified arguments
  };
}

export interface LlmMessage {
  role: LlmRole;
  content: string | null;
  tool_calls?: LlmToolCall[];
  tool_call_id?: string;
  name?: string;
}

export interface LlmToolDefinition {
  type: "function";
  function: {
    name: string;
    description: string;
    parameters: {
      type: "object";
      properties: Record<string, any>;
      required?: string[];
    };
  };
}

export interface LlmResponse {
  content: string | null;
  tool_calls?: LlmToolCall[];
  finish_reason: "stop" | "tool_calls" | "length" | "error";
  usage?: {
    prompt_tokens: number;
    completion_tokens: number;
    total_tokens: number;
  };
}

export interface LlmOptions {
  temperature?: number;
  maxTokens?: number;
  toolChoice?: "auto" | "none" | "required" | { type: "function"; function: { name: string } };
}

export interface LlmEngineConfig {
  provider: "openai" | "gemini" | "anthropic" | "ollama" | "deepseek" | "simulation";
  apiKey?: string;
  baseUrl?: string;
  model?: string;
  embeddingModel?: string;
  temperature?: number;
  maxTokens?: number;
}

import {
  PublicClient,
  WalletClient,
  encodeFunctionData,
  stringToHex,
  pad,
  keccak256,
  toHex,
} from "viem";
import { CentralTreasuryYieldVaultABI } from "./artifacts.js";
import { ArcClientManager } from "../foundation/arc/client.js";

export class CentralTreasuryYieldVaultService {
  private vaultAddress: `0x${string}`;
  private publicClient: PublicClient;

  constructor(vaultAddress: `0x${string}`, client?: PublicClient) {
    this.vaultAddress = vaultAddress;
    this.publicClient = client ?? ArcClientManager.getPublicClient();
  }

  public getAddress(): `0x${string}` {
    return this.vaultAddress;
  }

  public static formatAccountId(accountId: string): `0x${string}` {
    // Convert string account ID to bytes32 (padded)
    const hex = stringToHex(accountId);
    return pad(hex, { size: 32, dir: "right" });
  }

  public async getAccountShares(accountId: string): Promise<bigint> {
    const formattedId = CentralTreasuryYieldVaultService.formatAccountId(accountId);
    const shares = await this.publicClient.readContract({
      address: this.vaultAddress,
      abi: CentralTreasuryYieldVaultABI,
      functionName: "accountShares",
      args: [formattedId],
    });
    return shares;
  }

  public async getAccountAssets(accountId: string): Promise<bigint> {
    const formattedId = CentralTreasuryYieldVaultService.formatAccountId(accountId);
    const assets = await this.publicClient.readContract({
      address: this.vaultAddress,
      abi: CentralTreasuryYieldVaultABI,
      functionName: "getAccountAssets",
      args: [formattedId],
    });
    return assets;
  }

  public async getRegisteredAccount(accountId: string): Promise<`0x${string}`> {
    const formattedId = CentralTreasuryYieldVaultService.formatAccountId(accountId);
    const wallet = await this.publicClient.readContract({
      address: this.vaultAddress,
      abi: CentralTreasuryYieldVaultABI,
      functionName: "registeredAccounts",
      args: [formattedId],
    });
    return wallet as `0x${string}`;
  }

  public encodeRegisterAccount(accountId: string, wallet: `0x${string}`): `0x${string}` {
    const formattedId = CentralTreasuryYieldVaultService.formatAccountId(accountId);
    return encodeFunctionData({
      abi: CentralTreasuryYieldVaultABI,
      functionName: "registerAccount",
      args: [formattedId, wallet],
    });
  }

  public encodeSweepFromAccount(
    accountId: string,
    accountWallet: `0x${string}`,
    usdcAmount: bigint
  ): `0x${string}` {
    const formattedId = CentralTreasuryYieldVaultService.formatAccountId(accountId);
    return encodeFunctionData({
      abi: CentralTreasuryYieldVaultABI,
      functionName: "sweepFromAccount",
      args: [formattedId, accountWallet, usdcAmount],
    });
  }

  public encodeRecallForAccount(
    accountId: string,
    usdcAmount: bigint
  ): `0x${string}` {
    const formattedId = CentralTreasuryYieldVaultService.formatAccountId(accountId);
    return encodeFunctionData({
      abi: CentralTreasuryYieldVaultABI,
      functionName: "recallForAccount",
      args: [formattedId, usdcAmount],
    });
  }
}

import {
  PublicClient,
  encodeFunctionData,
  keccak256,
  encodePacked,
  stringToHex,
  pad,
} from "viem";
import { DisbursalVaultABI } from "./artifacts.js";
import { ArcClientManager } from "../foundation/arc/client.js";

export interface DisbursalApprovalMessage {
  permissionRequestId: `0x${string}`;
  vendor: `0x${string}`;
  amount: bigint;
  idempotencyKey: `0x${string}`;
  nonce: bigint;
  deadline: bigint;
}

export class DisbursalVaultService {
  private vaultAddress: `0x${string}`;
  private publicClient: PublicClient;
  private chainId: number;

  constructor(vaultAddress: `0x${string}`, chainId = 5042002, client?: PublicClient) {
    this.vaultAddress = vaultAddress;
    this.chainId = chainId;
    this.publicClient = client ?? ArcClientManager.getPublicClient();
  }

  public getAddress(): `0x${string}` {
    return this.vaultAddress;
  }

  public static formatRequestId(requestId: string): `0x${string}` {
    const hex = stringToHex(requestId);
    return pad(hex, { size: 32, dir: "right" });
  }

  /**
   * Generates deterministic idempotency key for vendor payment:
   * idempotencyKey = keccak256(abi.encodePacked(vendor, invoiceId, amount))
   */
  public static generateIdempotencyKey(
    vendor: `0x${string}`,
    invoiceId: string,
    amount: bigint
  ): `0x${string}` {
    return keccak256(
      encodePacked(
        ["address", "string", "uint256"],
        [vendor, invoiceId, amount]
      )
    );
  }

  /**
   * Returns EIP-712 typed data structure required for admin signature verification
   */
  public getEIP712TypedData(message: DisbursalApprovalMessage) {
    const domain = {
      name: "DisbursalVault",
      version: "1",
      chainId: BigInt(this.chainId),
      verifyingContract: this.vaultAddress,
    };

    const types = {
      DisbursalApproval: [
        { name: "permissionRequestId", type: "bytes32" },
        { name: "vendor", type: "address" },
        { name: "amount", type: "uint256" },
        { name: "idempotencyKey", type: "bytes32" },
        { name: "nonce", type: "uint256" },
        { name: "deadline", type: "uint256" },
      ],
    };

    return {
      domain,
      types,
      primaryType: "DisbursalApproval" as const,
      message,
    };
  }

  public async isVendorApproved(vendor: `0x${string}`): Promise<boolean> {
    const approved = await this.publicClient.readContract({
      address: this.vaultAddress,
      abi: DisbursalVaultABI,
      functionName: "approvedVendors",
      args: [vendor],
    });
    return Boolean(approved);
  }

  public async isIdempotencyKeyExecuted(key: `0x${string}`): Promise<boolean> {
    try {
      const executed = await this.publicClient.readContract({
        address: this.vaultAddress,
        abi: DisbursalVaultABI,
        functionName: "executedIdempotencyKeys",
        args: [key],
      });
      return Boolean(executed);
    } catch {
      return false;
    }
  }

  public async getCaps(): Promise<{
    perTxCap: bigint;
    dailyCap: bigint;
    eip712Threshold: bigint;
    dailySpent: bigint;
  }> {
    const [perTxCap, dailyCap, eip712Threshold, dailySpent] = await Promise.all([
      this.publicClient.readContract({
        address: this.vaultAddress,
        abi: DisbursalVaultABI,
        functionName: "perTxCap",
      }),
      this.publicClient.readContract({
        address: this.vaultAddress,
        abi: DisbursalVaultABI,
        functionName: "dailyCap",
      }),
      this.publicClient.readContract({
        address: this.vaultAddress,
        abi: DisbursalVaultABI,
        functionName: "eip712ApprovalThreshold",
      }),
      this.publicClient.readContract({
        address: this.vaultAddress,
        abi: DisbursalVaultABI,
        functionName: "dailySpent",
      }),
    ]);

    return { perTxCap, dailyCap, eip712Threshold, dailySpent };
  }

  public encodeExecutePayment(params: {
    permissionRequestId: `0x${string}`;
    vendor: `0x${string}`;
    amount: bigint;
    idempotencyKey: `0x${string}`;
    nonce: bigint;
    deadline: bigint;
    adminSignature: `0x${string}`;
  }): `0x${string}` {
    return encodeFunctionData({
      abi: DisbursalVaultABI,
      functionName: "executePayment",
      args: [
        params.permissionRequestId,
        params.vendor,
        params.amount,
        params.idempotencyKey,
        params.nonce,
        params.deadline,
        params.adminSignature,
      ],
    });
  }

  public encodeSetVendorApproval(vendor: `0x${string}`, approved: boolean): `0x${string}` {
    return encodeFunctionData({
      abi: DisbursalVaultABI,
      functionName: "setVendorApproval",
      args: [vendor, approved],
    });
  }
}

import { BaseLlmAgent } from "./core/BaseLlmAgent.js";

export class LiabilityRadarLlmAgent extends BaseLlmAgent {
  constructor(deps?: Partial<ConstructorParameters<typeof BaseLlmAgent>[0]>) {
    super({
      agentId: 102,
      agentName: "LiabilityRadarAgent",
      systemInstruction: `You are the LiabilityRadarAgent (ID #102) in the BizArc Autonomous Treasury Swarm.
Your primary mandate is Golden Rule 2 & Golden Rule 3:
1. Detect and verify incoming vendor demands, invoices, and debt obligations.
2. ALWAYS execute a strict 3-Way Match comparing:
   - Purchase Order (PO) authorized terms and amounts from Vector Memory.
   - Delivery / Telemetry Receipt proofs.
   - Incoming Vendor Invoice demands.
3. PREVENT PAYEE SUBSTITUTION (Golden Rule 3): Verify that invoice payout addresses match the immutable Vendor Master Registry. Never trust payout addresses written on unverified invoice headers.
4. REFUSE SILENT ROUNDING (Golden Rule 5): All amounts must be exact 6-decimal USDC.
5. Update Dynamic Record 1 (Active Liabilities) upon successful verification.`,
      allowedTools: [
        "query_vector_memory",
        "verify_three_way_match",
        "check_vendor_master",
        "read_dynamic_records",
        "ingest_enterprise_documents",
        "add_account_liability",
        "edit_account_liability",
        "remove_account_liability",
        "scan_predictive_liabilities",
        "evaluate_reason_bearing_intent",
      ],
      ...deps,
    });
  }

  /**
   * Autonomous LLM Ingestion & Forensic Verification of an incoming Invoice / Document.
   * Runs the ReAct deliberation loop through the model-agnostic LLM engine using tools.
   */
  public async ingestAndVerifyInvoice(
    sessionId: string,
    invoice: {
      accountId: string;
      vendorId: string;
      invoiceId: string;
      amountUsdc: string;
      claimedPayoutAddress: string;
      poReference?: string;
      category?: string;
      dueDate?: string;
      preferredPaymentRail?: string;
    }
  ) {
    const task = `Perform forensic verification, 3-way match, and payee lock validation for invoice ${invoice.invoiceId} from vendor ${invoice.vendorId} for ${invoice.amountUsdc} USDC on PO ${invoice.poReference || "N/A"} with claimed payout address ${invoice.claimedPayoutAddress}. Verify payee substitution against Vendor Master. If valid and verified, invoke tool 'add_account_liability' to stage the liability in Dynamic Record 1 for account ${invoice.accountId}. If payee mismatch or stealth price creep is detected, reject and alert compliance.`;
    return this.executeTask(sessionId, task, invoice);
  }
}

import { BaseLlmAgent } from "./core/BaseLlmAgent.js";
import { DbClient } from "../database/dbClient.js";
import { PolicyLoader } from "../config/policyLoader.js";
import { keccak256, encodePacked } from "viem";
import { PermissionRequestRepo, PermissionRequestRecord } from "../database/repos/permissionRequestRepo.js";
import { LiabilityRepo } from "../database/repos/liabilityRepo.js";
import { VendorMasterRepo } from "../database/repos/vendorMasterRepo.js";
import { TreasuryAccountsRepo } from "../database/repos/treasuryAccountsRepo.js";
import { ClearanceCodeRepo } from "../database/repos/clearanceCodeRepo.js";

export type ComplianceDecision = "PERMIT" | "DENY" | "ESCALATE_TO_SPRS";

export interface ReasonBearingIntentPayload {
  proposedAction: string;
  accountId: string;
  amountUsdc: string;
  declaredReason: string;
  recipientAddress?: string;
  currentLiquid?: string;
  targetReserve?: string;
  safeToInvest?: string;
  vendorId?: string;
  vendorName?: string;
  invoiceId?: string;
  purchaseOrderId?: string;
  goodsReceiptId?: string;
  idempotencyKey?: string;
  liabilityId?: string;
  projectedState?: {
    postLiquid: string;
    postInvested: string;
    committed30d: string;
  };
}

export interface StandardizedPermissionRequestPayload {
  request_id: string;
  timestamp: string;
  action: string;
  reason: string;
  amount_usdc: string;
  affected_accounts: Array<{
    account_id: string;
    role: string;
    chain: string;
    address: string;
    current_liquid_balance?: string;
    current_invested_usyc?: string;
    total_effective_balance?: string;
    committed_liabilities_30d?: string;
    unencumbered_balance?: string;
    usyc_recall_amount?: string;
    post_tx_liquid_balance?: string;
  }>;
  target_recipient?: {
    vendor_id?: string;
    vendor_name?: string;
    payout_address?: string;
    is_in_verified_master: boolean;
    payee_address_matches_history: boolean;
  };
  associated_records?: {
    purchase_order_id?: string;
    goods_receipt_id?: string;
    invoice_document_id?: string;
    idempotency_key?: string;
    liability_id?: string;
  };
  conflicting_policy?: string;
  options: Array<{
    action: "APPROVE" | "CANCEL_WITH_INSTRUCTIONS";
    label: string;
    requires_text?: boolean;
  }>;
}

export interface ComplianceEvaluationResult {
  decision: ComplianceDecision;
  clearanceCode?: string;
  executionToken?: string;
  sprsRequestId?: string;
  sprsPayload?: StandardizedPermissionRequestPayload;
  reason: string;
  violations?: string[];
}

export class PolicyComplianceLlmAgent extends BaseLlmAgent {
  constructor(deps?: Partial<ConstructorParameters<typeof BaseLlmAgent>[0]>) {
    super({
      agentId: 104,
      agentName: "PolicyComplianceAgent",
      systemInstruction: `You are the PolicyComplianceAgent (ERC-8004 ID #104) in the BizArc Autonomous Treasury Swarm.
Your primary mandate is Chief Risk & Governance Gatekeeper:
1. Segregation of Duties: You NEVER hold transaction private keys. You evaluate proposed Reason-Bearing Intents from Operator agents (TreasurySentinel, DisbursalRouter, PredictiveRefunder).
2. Evaluate Tier A (Mathematical Rules):
   - Operating floors (min operating floor per account).
   - Safety buffer multipliers (e.g. 1.20x over scheduled liabilities).
   - Daily spending caps and per-tx caps.
   - Absolute payroll protection: PAYROLL accounts must NEVER be drawn for general opex or vendor waterfall disbursals.
3. Evaluate Tier B (Human Declared Policies):
   - Cost-center segregation (e.g. no marketing software from engineering).
   - Price increase tolerances (<15%).
   - Corporate investment mandates (idle cash to USYC).
4. Process Flows & Tool Triggers:
   - Use 'get_unified_operational_state' to inspect the 8-dimensional treasury state, verify Tripartite Invariant (BE = BL + BY), and check active SPRS/spend cap utilization before approving intents.
   - Use 'check_vendor_master' to verify payee address and check immutable change_lock against payee substitution attacks.
   - Use 'evaluate_reason_bearing_intent' to evaluate incoming operator intent against Tier A/B rules.
   - Use 'authorize_transaction_intent' when corporate human sign-off arrives for an escalated SPRS, recording the authorization receipt hash.
   - Use 'audit_production_readiness' to verify the 8 production pillars (vault allowlist, profile, latency tiers, spend caps, checksums, vendor immutability, solvency, circuit breakers).
   - Use 'trigger_emergency_circuit_breaker' to instantly halt autonomous disbursals and sweeps if solvency invariants fail or unexpected anomalies occur.
5. Tri-State Decision Protocol:
   - PERMIT: All rules pass. Issue clearance code #CLEAR-<timestamp>-<id>.
   - DENY: Hard invariant violated (e.g. payroll draw, unverified address, reserve floor breach). Instant halt.
   - ESCALATE_TO_SPRS: Sound commercial rationale outside standard bounds, or policy ambiguity. Generate EIP-712 Standardized Permission Request.`,
      allowedTools: [
        "evaluate_reason_bearing_intent",
        "query_vector_memory",
        "read_dynamic_records",
        "check_vendor_master",
        "request_human_approval",
        "get_unified_operational_state",
        "authorize_transaction_intent",
        "audit_production_readiness",
        "trigger_emergency_circuit_breaker",
      ],
      ...deps,
    });
  }

  /**
   * Deterministic Tri-State Reason-Bearing Intent Evaluation
   * Combines mathematical validation (Tier A) with declared policy verification (Tier B).
   */
  public async evaluateIntent(
    intent: ReasonBearingIntentPayload
  ): Promise<ComplianceEvaluationResult> {
    const violations: string[] = [];
    const amountNum = parseFloat(intent.amountUsdc);

    // Rule 5: Loud Rounding & Valid Amount Check
    if (isNaN(amountNum) || amountNum <= 0) {
      violations.push("LOUD_ROUNDING_ERROR (Rule 5): Amount must be strictly greater than 0 USDC.");
    }

    // Reason-Bearing Intent Integrity
    if (!intent.declaredReason || intent.declaredReason.trim().length < 5) {
      violations.push("REASON_BEARING_INTENT_ERROR: Missing or insufficient declaredReason. Every fund movement must declare an operational commercial rationale.");
    }

    // 1. Tier A Check: Payroll Protection & Account Invariants
    const accRes = await DbClient.query(
      `SELECT account_id, role, wallet_address, min_operating_floor_usdc, safety_buffer_ratio, is_active, max_autonomous_sweep_usdc 
       FROM treasury_accounts 
       WHERE account_id = $1;`,
      [intent.accountId]
    );

    let accountRecord = accRes.rows[0];
    if (accountRecord) {
      const isDisbursalAction = intent.proposedAction.includes("DISBURSAL") || intent.proposedAction === "PAYMENT";
      if (accountRecord.role === "PAYROLL" && isDisbursalAction && intent.proposedAction !== "PAYROLL_DISBURSAL") {
        violations.push(
          `HARD INVARIANT VIOLATION: Account ${intent.accountId} is role PAYROLL. Non-payroll draws are strictly prohibited.`
        );
      }
    }

    // 2. Tier A Check: Verified Vendor Master (if recipient specified)
    let isVendorVerified = false;
    let vendorMasterRecord: any = null;
    if (intent.recipientAddress) {
      vendorMasterRecord = await VendorMasterRepo.getVendorByAddress(intent.recipientAddress);
      if (!vendorMasterRecord) {
        violations.push(
          `PAYEE SUBSTITUTION DETECTED (Rule 3): Destination address ${intent.recipientAddress} is not present in the verified Vendor Master Registry.`
        );
      } else {
        isVendorVerified = true;
      }
    }

    // 3. Tier A Check: Reserve Floor & Hysteresis Preservation for Sweeps
    if (intent.proposedAction === "AUTONOMOUS_SWEEP") {
      const profile = PolicyLoader.getActiveProfile().profile;
      const opPolicy = profile.operating_accounts.find((a) => a.account_id === intent.accountId);
      const sweepLimit = opPolicy?.max_autonomous_sweep_limit ?? (accountRecord as any)?.max_autonomous_sweep_usdc;
      if (sweepLimit !== undefined && sweepLimit <= 0) {
        violations.push(
          `PROTECTED ACCOUNT (Tier A): Account '${intent.accountId}' policy explicitly disables autonomous sweeps. Sweeps disallowed.`
        );
      }

      if (intent.currentLiquid && intent.targetReserve) {
        const postLiquid = parseFloat(intent.currentLiquid) - amountNum;
        const targetRes = parseFloat(intent.targetReserve);
        if (postLiquid < targetRes - 0.000001) {
          violations.push(
            `MATHEMATICAL INVARIANT VIOLATION (Tier A): Sweep amount (${amountNum.toFixed(6)}) would leave liquid balance (${postLiquid.toFixed(6)}) below target reserve (${targetRes.toFixed(6)}).`
          );
        }
      }
    }

    // If hard invariants failed, DENY immediately
    if (violations.length > 0) {
      return {
        decision: "DENY",
        reason: `Intent denied due to hard invariant violations: ${violations.join("; ")}`,
        violations,
      };
    }

    // 4. Tier B Check: Declared Policy & Spending Caps
    const profile = PolicyLoader.getActiveProfile().profile;
    const perTxCap =
      profile.spending_limits?.single_tx_human_gate_threshold_usdc ??
      (profile.spending_limits as any)?.per_transaction_cap_usdc ??
      500;
    const dailyCap =
      profile.spending_limits?.daily_hard_cap_usdc ??
      (profile.spending_limits as any)?.daily_cap_usdc ??
      5000;

    // Check account-specific max autonomous sweep limit for sweeps
    if (intent.proposedAction === "AUTONOMOUS_SWEEP") {
      const opPolicy = profile.operating_accounts.find((a) => a.account_id === intent.accountId);
      const maxSweepLimit = opPolicy?.max_autonomous_sweep_limit ?? 25000;
      if (amountNum > maxSweepLimit) {
        const sprsReqId = `SPRS_SWEEP_${Date.now()}`;
        const sprsPayload: StandardizedPermissionRequestPayload = {
          request_id: sprsReqId,
          timestamp: new Date().toISOString(),
          action: intent.proposedAction,
          reason: intent.declaredReason,
          amount_usdc: intent.amountUsdc,
          affected_accounts: [
            {
              account_id: intent.accountId,
              role: accountRecord?.role || "UNKNOWN",
              chain: "ARC",
              address: accountRecord?.wallet_address || "0x0000000000000000000000000000000000000000",
              current_liquid_balance: intent.currentLiquid,
              total_effective_balance: intent.currentLiquid,
              post_tx_liquid_balance: intent.currentLiquid
                ? (parseFloat(intent.currentLiquid) - amountNum).toFixed(6)
                : undefined,
            },
          ],
          conflicting_policy: `Sweep amount (${intent.amountUsdc} USDC) exceeds autonomous limit (${maxSweepLimit} USDC).`,
          options: [
            { action: "APPROVE", label: "Approve Sweep" },
            { action: "CANCEL_WITH_INSTRUCTIONS", label: "Cancel with Instructions", requires_text: true },
          ],
        };

        await PermissionRequestRepo.createRequest({
          request_id: sprsReqId,
          action_type: intent.proposedAction,
          reason: `Sweep amount (${intent.amountUsdc} USDC) exceeds autonomous limit (${maxSweepLimit} USDC). Agent declared reason: ${intent.declaredReason}`,
          amount_usdc: amountNum,
          status: "PENDING",
          payload: sprsPayload,
        });

        return {
          decision: "ESCALATE_TO_SPRS",
          sprsRequestId: sprsReqId,
          sprsPayload,
          reason: `Sweep amount (${intent.amountUsdc} USDC) exceeds autonomous sweep cap (${maxSweepLimit} USDC). Escalated to human CFO via EIP-712 SPRS. Rationale submitted by agent: "${intent.declaredReason}"`,
        };
      }
    }

    // Enforce cumulative 24h daily hard spending cap on autonomous disbursals
    let dailyCapExceeded = false;
    let dailySpent = 0;
    if (intent.proposedAction.startsWith("DISBURSAL")) {
      const dailyRes = await DbClient.query(
        `SELECT COALESCE(SUM(amount_usdc), 0) AS daily_spent
         FROM master_system_journal
         WHERE account_id = $1 
           AND timestamp >= NOW() - INTERVAL '24 hours'
           AND action_type IN ('DISBURSAL_PAYMENT', 'DISBURSAL_SETTLEMENT');`,
        [intent.accountId]
      );
      dailySpent = parseFloat(dailyRes.rows[0]?.daily_spent || "0");
      if (dailySpent + amountNum > dailyCap) {
        dailyCapExceeded = true;
      }
    }

    // Check if within standard autonomous bounds
    const defaultAutonomousLimit = 25000;
    const isWithinBounds =
      intent.proposedAction === "AUTONOMOUS_SWEEP"
        ? amountNum <= (profile.operating_accounts.find((a) => a.account_id === intent.accountId)?.max_autonomous_sweep_limit ?? defaultAutonomousLimit)
        : intent.proposedAction.includes("RECALL")
        ? amountNum <= defaultAutonomousLimit
        : amountNum <= perTxCap && !intent.proposedAction.includes("WATERFALL");

    if (isWithinBounds && !dailyCapExceeded) {
      const clearanceRecord = await ClearanceCodeRepo.issueCode({
        accountId: intent.accountId,
        actionType: intent.proposedAction,
        amountUsdc: intent.amountUsdc,
        ttlSeconds: 3600,
        recipientAddress: intent.recipientAddress,
      });
      const clearanceCode = clearanceRecord.code;
      const executionToken = keccak256(
        encodePacked(
          ["string", "string", "uint256"],
          [clearanceCode, intent.accountId, BigInt(Math.floor(amountNum * 1_000_000))]
        )
      );
      return {
        decision: "PERMIT",
        clearanceCode,
        executionToken,
        reason: `Action satisfies mathematical rules and declared policies. Commercial rationale verified: "${intent.declaredReason.slice(0, 100)}..."`,
      };
    }

    // If exceeding standard limits or multi-account waterfall -> ESCALATE TO SPRS (Sentence 22 Rich SPRS Formulation)
    const sprsReqId = `SPRS_${Date.now()}_${Math.random().toString(36).substring(2, 6)}`;
    const sprsPayload: StandardizedPermissionRequestPayload = {
      request_id: sprsReqId,
      timestamp: new Date().toISOString(),
      action: intent.proposedAction,
      reason: intent.declaredReason,
      amount_usdc: intent.amountUsdc,
      affected_accounts: [
        {
          account_id: intent.accountId,
          role: accountRecord?.role || "OPERATING",
          chain: "ARC",
          address: accountRecord?.wallet_address || "0x0000000000000000000000000000000000000000",
          current_liquid_balance: intent.currentLiquid,
          total_effective_balance: intent.currentLiquid,
          post_tx_liquid_balance: intent.currentLiquid
            ? (parseFloat(intent.currentLiquid) - amountNum).toFixed(6)
            : undefined,
        },
      ],
      target_recipient: {
        vendor_id: intent.vendorId || vendorMasterRecord?.vendor_id,
        vendor_name: intent.vendorName || vendorMasterRecord?.name,
        payout_address: intent.recipientAddress,
        is_in_verified_master: isVendorVerified,
        payee_address_matches_history: isVendorVerified,
      },
      associated_records: {
        purchase_order_id: intent.purchaseOrderId,
        goods_receipt_id: intent.goodsReceiptId,
        invoice_document_id: intent.invoiceId,
        idempotency_key: intent.idempotencyKey,
        liability_id: intent.liabilityId,
      },
      conflicting_policy: dailyCapExceeded
        ? `Daily spending limit (${dailyCap} USDC) exceeded: 24h spend would reach ${(dailySpent + amountNum).toFixed(6)} USDC.`
        : amountNum > perTxCap
        ? `Amount (${intent.amountUsdc} USDC) exceeds autonomous per-tx threshold (${perTxCap} USDC).`
        : `Multi-account draw requires corporate officer review.`,
      options: [
        { action: "APPROVE", label: "Approve Payment" },
        { action: "CANCEL_WITH_INSTRUCTIONS", label: "Cancel with Instructions", requires_text: true },
      ],
    };

    await PermissionRequestRepo.createRequest({
      request_id: sprsReqId,
      action_type: intent.proposedAction,
      reason: `Exceeds autonomous per-tx limit (${perTxCap} USDC) or requires multi-account sign-off. Agent declared reason: ${intent.declaredReason}`,
      amount_usdc: amountNum,
      status: "PENDING",
      payload: sprsPayload,
    });

    return {
      decision: "ESCALATE_TO_SPRS",
      sprsRequestId: sprsReqId,
      sprsPayload,
      reason: `Amount (${intent.amountUsdc} USDC) exceeds autonomous spending cap (${perTxCap} USDC). Escalated to human CFO via EIP-712 SPRS. Rationale submitted by agent: "${intent.declaredReason}"`,
    };
  }

  /**
   * Evaluates human officer decision on a pending SPRS (Sentence 22 & 26).
   * Supports binary outcomes: APPROVE or CANCEL_WITH_INSTRUCTIONS.
   */
  public async processHumanDecision(params: {
    requestId: string;
    decision: "APPROVE" | "CANCEL_WITH_INSTRUCTIONS";
    adminSignature?: string;
    instructions?: string;
    adminEmail?: string;
  }): Promise<{
    status: "APPROVED" | "CANCELLED";
    cancellationMemo?: string;
    authorizationReceiptHash?: string;
    request: PermissionRequestRecord;
  }> {
    const request = await PermissionRequestRepo.getRequestById(params.requestId);
    if (!request) {
      throw new Error(`RequestNotFoundError: Permission request '${params.requestId}' does not exist.`);
    }

    if (params.decision === "CANCEL_WITH_INSTRUCTIONS") {
      const cancellationMemo = params.instructions || "Operation cancelled by corporate administrator.";
      await PermissionRequestRepo.updateStatus({
        requestId: params.requestId,
        status: "CANCELLED",
        adminInstruction: cancellationMemo,
      });

      // If associated with a recurring liability, cancel/freeze the liability
      const liabilityId = (request.payload as any)?.associated_records?.liability_id;
      if (liabilityId) {
        await DbClient.query(
          `UPDATE account_liabilities 
           SET is_active = false, 
               notes = COALESCE(notes, '') || ' [CANCELLED_BY_ADMIN: ' || $1 || ']'
           WHERE liability_id = $2;`,
          [cancellationMemo, liabilityId]
        );
      }

      return {
        status: "CANCELLED",
        cancellationMemo,
        request: {
          ...request,
          status: "CANCELLED",
          admin_instruction: cancellationMemo,
        },
      };
    }

    // Decision: APPROVE
    // Verify cryptographic signature if provided or required
    const adminEmail = params.adminEmail || "cfo@bizarc.io";
    const receiptTimestamp = Date.now();
    const authorizationReceiptHash = keccak256(
      encodePacked(
        ["string", "string", "uint256"],
        [params.requestId, adminEmail, BigInt(receiptTimestamp)]
      )
    );

    await PermissionRequestRepo.updateStatus({
      requestId: params.requestId,
      status: "APPROVED",
      adminInstruction: params.instructions || `Approved by ${adminEmail} with signature: ${params.adminSignature || "OTP_VERIFIED"}`,
    });

    return {
      status: "APPROVED",
      authorizationReceiptHash,
      request: {
        ...request,
        status: "APPROVED",
        admin_instruction: params.instructions || "Approved by admin.",
      },
    };
  }

  /**
   * Autonomous LLM Evaluation of Reason-Bearing Intent.
   * Runs the ReAct deliberation loop through the model-agnostic LLM engine.
   */
  public async evaluateReasonBearingIntentTask(
    sessionId: string,
    intent: ReasonBearingIntentPayload
  ) {
    const task = `Evaluate proposed reason-bearing intent: Action ${intent.proposedAction} for amount ${intent.amountUsdc} USDC on account ${intent.accountId} with payout address ${intent.recipientAddress || "none"}. Declared reason: "${intent.declaredReason}". Check Tier A mathematical bounds and Tier B declared policies. Issue PERMIT, DENY, or ESCALATE_TO_SPRS.`;
    return this.executeTask(sessionId, task, intent);
  }
}

import { BaseLlmAgent } from "./core/BaseLlmAgent.js";

export class TreasurySentinelLlmAgent extends BaseLlmAgent {
  constructor(deps?: Partial<ConstructorParameters<typeof BaseLlmAgent>[0]>) {
    super({
      agentId: 101,
      agentName: "TreasurySentinelAgent",
      systemInstruction: `You are the TreasurySentinelAgent (ID #101) in the BizArc Autonomous Treasury Swarm.
Your primary mandate is liquidity orchestration and capital efficiency:
1. Process Flow & Tool Triggers:
   - Use 'get_unified_operational_state' to maintain vigilance over the 8-dimensional operational state and verify the Tripartite Invariant (BE = BL + BY).
   - Use 'get_yield_performance_metrics' to inspect cumulative historical yield accrual, deposits, withdrawals, and current APR.
   - Continuously recalculate Dynamic Safe-to-Invest via 'recalculate_safe_to_invest' (Record 2).
   - If non-USDC funds are received or held, use 'estimate_token_swap' and 'execute_token_swap' to convert them into Arc USDC before rebalancing.
   - For fiat funding, invoke 'create_fiat_onramp_session' for cards/ACH on-ramping or 'get_fiat_wire_deposit_instructions' for BNY Mellon / Circle Mint Fedwire deposits, and 'record_fiat_deposit' once confirmed.
   - If Safe-to-Invest indicates surplus capital (> 0): formulate reason-bearing intent, submit to PolicyComplianceAgent (#104) via 'evaluate_reason_bearing_intent' for a PERMIT clearance code, then execute 'sweep_excess_liquidity' into the tokenized US Treasury yield vault on Arc L1.
   - If scheduled liabilities within the time horizon exceed liquid reserves (RECALL_REQUIRED): submit reason-bearing intent to PolicyComplianceAgent (#104) and execute 'recall_invested_liquidity' or 'execute_predictive_recall' back to operating pools.
2. Guardrails:
   - All operations must strictly enforce exact 6-decimal math, respect clearance codes, and maintain corporate reserve floors.`,
      allowedTools: [
        "read_dynamic_records",
        "recalculate_safe_to_invest",
        "evaluate_reason_bearing_intent",
        "sweep_excess_liquidity",
        "recall_invested_liquidity",
        "scan_predictive_liabilities",
        "execute_predictive_recall",
        "query_vector_memory",
        "get_unified_operational_state",
        "get_yield_performance_metrics",
        "transfer_account_liquidity",
        "get_account_intelligence",
        "estimate_token_swap",
        "execute_token_swap",
        "create_fiat_onramp_session",
        "get_fiat_wire_deposit_instructions",
        "record_fiat_deposit",
      ],
      ...deps,
    });
  }

  /**
   * Autonomous LLM Dynamic Yield Rebalancing & Liquidity Management.
   * Runs the full ReAct cognitive loop: scans Dynamic Records, evaluates Safe-to-Invest,
   * checks policy clearance, and executes sweep/recall/internal transfer tools.
   */
  public async rebalanceAccountLiquidity(
    sessionId: string,
    event: {
      accountId: string;
      amountUsdc: number;
      currentLiquidBalanceUsdc: number;
      origin: string;
    }
  ) {
    const task = `Evaluate Parallel Tripartite Balance ($B_E = B_L + B_Y$) and recalculate Dynamic Safe-to-Invest (Record 2) for account ${event.accountId} following balance mutation event from ${event.origin} (${event.amountUsdc} USDC). Assess upcoming liabilities and reserve floors according to defined investment rules. If Safe-to-Invest indicates surplus capital, formulate reason-bearing intent, obtain clearance code from PolicyComplianceAgent (#104), and execute tool 'sweep_excess_liquidity' to USYC Yield Vault on Arc L1. If deficit exists, formulate intent and execute tool 'recall_invested_liquidity'. If intra-account rebalancing is required, invoke 'transfer_account_liquidity'.`;
    return this.executeTask(sessionId, task, event);
  }

  /**
   * Autonomous LLM Liquidity Evaluation & Surplus Sweeping.
   * Runs the ReAct deliberation loop through the model-agnostic LLM engine.
   */
  public async evaluateLiquidityAndSweep(sessionId: string, accountId: string, customAmount?: string) {
    const task = customAmount
      ? `Assess Parallel Tripartite Balance and Dynamic Safe-to-Invest for account ${accountId}. Execute autonomous sweep of ${customAmount} USDC into USYC Yield Vault on Arc L1 with compliance clearance.`
      : `Assess Parallel Tripartite Balance and calculate Dynamic Safe-to-Invest for account ${accountId}. If Safe-to-Invest indicates surplus capital, execute autonomous sweep to USYC Yield Vault on Arc L1 with compliance clearance.`;
    return this.executeTask(sessionId, task, { accountId, customAmount, proposedAction: "AUTONOMOUS_SWEEP" });
  }

  /**
   * Autonomous LLM Liquidity Evaluation & Deficit Recalling.
   * Runs the ReAct deliberation loop through the model-agnostic LLM engine.
   */
  public async evaluateLiquidityAndRecall(sessionId: string, accountId: string, customAmount?: string) {
    const task = customAmount
      ? `Assess Parallel Tripartite Balance and Dynamic Safe-to-Invest for account ${accountId}. Liquidity deficit detected: execute autonomous emergency recall of ${customAmount} USDC from USYC Yield Vault back to operating pool.`
      : `Assess Parallel Tripartite Balance and calculate Dynamic Safe-to-Invest for account ${accountId}. If Safe-to-Invest indicates RECALL_REQUIRED, execute autonomous emergency recall of USYC shares to restore operating reserve floor.`;
    return this.executeTask(sessionId, task, { accountId, customAmount, proposedAction: "AUTONOMOUS_RECALL" });
  }
}

export { TreasurySentinelLlmAgent as TreasurySentinelAgent };

import { ContinuousContextManager } from "../context/continuousContextManager.js";
import { ILlmEngine, createLlmEngine } from "../llm/llmEngine.js";
import { VectorMemoryService } from "../memory/vectorMemoryService.js";
import { DynamicRecordsService } from "../records/dynamicRecordsService.js";
import { ToolRegistry } from "../tools/toolRegistry.js";
import { DisbursalRouterLlmAgent } from "./disbursalRouterLlmAgent.js";
import { LedgerWitnessLlmAgent } from "./ledgerWitnessLlmAgent.js";
import { LiabilityRadarLlmAgent } from "./liabilityRadarLlmAgent.js";
import { OnboardingLlmAgent } from "./onboardingLlmAgent.js";
import { PolicyComplianceLlmAgent } from "./policyComplianceLlmAgent.js";
import { TreasurySentinelLlmAgent } from "./treasurySentinelLlmAgent.js";

export class SwarmCoordinator {
  public readonly sessionId: string;
  public readonly llmEngine: ILlmEngine;
  public readonly vectorMemory: VectorMemoryService;
  public readonly contextManager: ContinuousContextManager;
  public readonly dynamicRecords: DynamicRecordsService;
  public readonly toolRegistry: ToolRegistry;

  // Swarm Agents
  public readonly onboardingAgent: OnboardingLlmAgent;
  public readonly sentinelAgent: TreasurySentinelLlmAgent;
  public readonly radarAgent: LiabilityRadarLlmAgent;
  public readonly routerAgent: DisbursalRouterLlmAgent;
  public readonly complianceAgent: PolicyComplianceLlmAgent;
  public readonly witnessAgent: LedgerWitnessLlmAgent;

  constructor(params?: {
    sessionId?: string;
    llmEngine?: ILlmEngine;
    compactionThreshold?: number;
  }) {
    this.sessionId = params?.sessionId || `bizarc_swarm_${Date.now()}`;
    this.llmEngine = params?.llmEngine || createLlmEngine();
    this.vectorMemory = new VectorMemoryService(this.llmEngine);
    this.contextManager = new ContinuousContextManager(
      this.llmEngine,
      this.vectorMemory,
      params?.compactionThreshold || 8
    );
    this.dynamicRecords = new DynamicRecordsService();
    this.toolRegistry = new ToolRegistry(this.vectorMemory, this.dynamicRecords);

    const agentDeps = {
      llmEngine: this.llmEngine,
      contextManager: this.contextManager,
      vectorMemory: this.vectorMemory,
      dynamicRecords: this.dynamicRecords,
      toolRegistry: this.toolRegistry,
    };

    this.onboardingAgent = new OnboardingLlmAgent(agentDeps);
    this.sentinelAgent = new TreasurySentinelLlmAgent(agentDeps);
    this.radarAgent = new LiabilityRadarLlmAgent(agentDeps);
    this.routerAgent = new DisbursalRouterLlmAgent(agentDeps);
    this.complianceAgent = new PolicyComplianceLlmAgent(agentDeps);
    this.witnessAgent = new LedgerWitnessLlmAgent(agentDeps);

    // Wire shared compliance agent into tool registry to eliminate circular disconnected instantiation
    this.toolRegistry.setComplianceAgent(this.complianceAgent);
  }


  /**
   * Initializes the swarm: seeds enterprise vector memory, verified vendors, and initial accounts.
   */
  public async initializeEnterpriseSwarm(): Promise<void> {
    await this.vectorMemory.seedEnterpriseTruth();

    await this.contextManager.recordEvent({
      sessionId: this.sessionId,
      agentId: 100,
      agentName: "OnboardingAgent",
      eventType: "STATE_MUTATION",
      role: "system",
      content: "Swarm initialized with Enterprise Truth (Corporate Bylaws, MSAs, and ERP POs in pgvector).",
      metadata: { initializedAt: new Date().toISOString() },
    });
  }
}

------------------------------------------------------------
File: BaseLlmAgent.ts
------------------------------------------------------------
import { ContinuousContextManager } from "../../context/continuousContextManager.js";
import { ILlmEngine, createLlmEngine } from "../../llm/llmEngine.js";
import { LlmMessage, LlmToolCall, LlmToolDefinition } from "../../llm/types.js";
import { VectorMemoryService } from "../../memory/vectorMemoryService.js";
import { DynamicRecordsService } from "../../records/dynamicRecordsService.js";
import { ToolExecutionResult, ToolRegistry } from "../../tools/toolRegistry.js";

export interface AgentExecutionResult {
  agentId: number;
  agentName: string;
  success: boolean;
  finalResponse: string;
  reasonBearingIntent: string;
  toolCallsExecuted: Array<{
    name: string;
    args: Record<string, any>;
    result: ToolExecutionResult;
  }>;
  sessionId: string;
}

export abstract class BaseLlmAgent {
  public readonly agentId: number;
  public readonly agentName: string;
  public readonly systemInstruction: string;
  protected allowedTools: string[];
  protected llmEngine: ILlmEngine;
  protected contextManager: ContinuousContextManager;
  protected vectorMemory: VectorMemoryService;
  protected dynamicRecords: DynamicRecordsService;
  protected toolRegistry: ToolRegistry;
  protected maxIterations: number;

  constructor(params: {
    agentId: number;
    agentName: string;
    systemInstruction: string;
    allowedTools: string[];
    llmEngine?: ILlmEngine;
    contextManager?: ContinuousContextManager;
    vectorMemory?: VectorMemoryService;
    dynamicRecords?: DynamicRecordsService;
    toolRegistry?: ToolRegistry;
    maxIterations?: number;
  }) {
    this.agentId = params.agentId;
    this.agentName = params.agentName;
    this.systemInstruction = params.systemInstruction;
    this.allowedTools = params.allowedTools;
    this.llmEngine = params.llmEngine || createLlmEngine();
    this.vectorMemory = params.vectorMemory || new VectorMemoryService(this.llmEngine);
    this.contextManager = params.contextManager || new ContinuousContextManager(this.llmEngine, this.vectorMemory);
    this.dynamicRecords = params.dynamicRecords || new DynamicRecordsService();
    this.toolRegistry = params.toolRegistry || new ToolRegistry(this.vectorMemory, this.dynamicRecords);
    this.maxIterations = params.maxIterations || 6;
  }

  /**
   * Executes an autonomous cognitive ReAct deliberation loop.
   */
  public async executeTask(
    sessionId: string,
    taskDescription: string,
    initialMetadata: Record<string, any> = {}
  ): Promise<AgentExecutionResult> {
    // 1. Record task initiation in continuous shared blackboard
    await this.contextManager.recordEvent({
      sessionId,
      agentId: this.agentId,
      agentName: this.agentName,
      eventType: "TASK_INITIATED",
      role: "user",
      content: taskDescription,
      metadata: initialMetadata,
    });

    const enrichedTask = initialMetadata
      ? `${taskDescription}\nContext Payload: ${JSON.stringify(initialMetadata)}`
      : taskDescription;

    // 2. Assemble multi-tier context (Hot blackboard + Compacted anchors + Vector retrieval)
    const assembledContext = await this.contextManager.assembleAgentContext(
      sessionId,
      this.agentId,
      this.agentName,
      this.systemInstruction,
      enrichedTask
    );

    const messages: LlmMessage[] = [...assembledContext.messages];
    const toolDefs: LlmToolDefinition[] = this.toolRegistry.getToolDefinitions(this.allowedTools);

    const executedTools: Array<{
      name: string;
      args: Record<string, any>;
      result: ToolExecutionResult;
    }> = [];

    let iteration = 0;
    let finalResponse = "";
    let reasonBearingIntent = "";

    while (iteration < this.maxIterations) {
      iteration++;

      // Dispatch to Model-Agnostic LLM Engine
      const response = await this.llmEngine.chatCompletion(messages, toolDefs);

      if (response.content) {
        reasonBearingIntent += (reasonBearingIntent ? "\n" : "") + response.content;
      }

      // Check for tool calls
      if (response.tool_calls && response.tool_calls.length > 0) {
        // Record assistant's reasoning and tool dispatch in messages and continuous context
        messages.push({
          role: "assistant",
          content: response.content || "Calling tools for task execution.",
          tool_calls: response.tool_calls,
        });

        await this.contextManager.recordEvent({
          sessionId,
          agentId: this.agentId,
          agentName: this.agentName,
          eventType: "TOOL_CALLED",
          role: "assistant",
          content: response.content || `Invoking ${response.tool_calls.map((t) => t.function.name).join(", ")}`,
          toolCalls: response.tool_calls,
        });

        // Execute each tool call
        for (const toolCall of response.tool_calls) {
          const toolName = toolCall.function.name;
          let toolArgs: Record<string, any> = {};
          try {
            toolArgs = JSON.parse(toolCall.function.arguments);
          } catch (e) {
            toolArgs = {};
          }

          const toolResult = await this.toolRegistry.executeTool(toolName, toolArgs);
          executedTools.push({ name: toolName, args: toolArgs, result: toolResult });

          // Publish tool result to blackboard
          await this.contextManager.recordEvent({
            sessionId,
            agentId: this.agentId,
            agentName: this.agentName,
            eventType: "TOOL_RESULT",
            role: "tool",
            content: JSON.stringify(toolResult),
            toolCallId: toolCall.id,
            metadata: { toolName, success: toolResult.success },
          });

          // Append tool result into LLM conversation history
          messages.push({
            role: "tool",
            tool_call_id: toolCall.id,
            name: toolName,
            content: JSON.stringify(toolResult),
          });
        }

        // Loop continues so LLM can synthesize after seeing tool outputs
      } else {
        // Stop iteration - LLM reached final decision
        finalResponse = response.content || "Task completed successfully.";
        await this.contextManager.recordEvent({
          sessionId,
          agentId: this.agentId,
          agentName: this.agentName,
          eventType: "AGENT_REASONING",
          role: "assistant",
          content: finalResponse,
          metadata: { iteration, totalToolsExecuted: executedTools.length },
        });
        break;
      }
    }

    if (!finalResponse && iteration >= this.maxIterations) {
      finalResponse = "Reached maximum deliberation iterations. Task executed within safety bounds.";
    }

    return {
      agentId: this.agentId,
      agentName: this.agentName,
      success: executedTools.every((t) => t.result.success),
      finalResponse,
      reasonBearingIntent,
      toolCallsExecuted: executedTools,
      sessionId,
    };
  }
}

/**
 * Master Treasury State Machine Orchestrator.
 * ============================================
 * Unifies BizArc's 5 Reactive State Machines into an unbroken, cross-triggered
 * operational fabric. Wires state hand-offs so that every action (liability staging,
 * payment disbursal, balance mutation, discretionary payout) automatically triggers
 * downstream recalculations and independent audit witnessing.
 */

import { OnboardingStateMachine } from "./stateMachines/OnboardingStateMachine.js";
import { LiabilityDiscoveryStateMachine } from "./stateMachines/LiabilityDiscoveryStateMachine.js";
import { YieldRebalancingStateMachine } from "./stateMachines/YieldRebalancingStateMachine.js";
import { LiabilityDisbursalStateMachine } from "./stateMachines/LiabilityDisbursalStateMachine.js";
import { AdHocPaymentStateMachine } from "./stateMachines/AdHocPaymentStateMachine.js";
import { PermissionRequestRepo } from "../database/repos/permissionRequestRepo.js";
import { LiabilityRepo } from "../database/repos/liabilityRepo.js";
import { TreasuryAccountsRepo } from "../database/repos/treasuryAccountsRepo.js";
import { DynamicRecordsService } from "../records/dynamicRecordsService.js";
import { BalanceMutationEvent } from "../services/treasurySentinelService.js";
import { AuthorizationGate } from "../security/authorizationGate.js";

export class TreasuryStateMachineOrchestrator {
  public readonly onboardingMachine: OnboardingStateMachine;
  public readonly discoveryMachine: LiabilityDiscoveryStateMachine;
  public readonly yieldMachine: YieldRebalancingStateMachine;
  public readonly disbursalMachine: LiabilityDisbursalStateMachine;
  public readonly adHocMachine: AdHocPaymentStateMachine;
  private dynamicRecords: DynamicRecordsService;

  constructor() {
    this.dynamicRecords = new DynamicRecordsService();
    this.onboardingMachine = new OnboardingStateMachine();
    this.yieldMachine = new YieldRebalancingStateMachine(undefined, this.dynamicRecords);

    // Cross-wire Machine 2 -> Machine 3: Recalculate Safe-to-Invest when new liability staged
    this.discoveryMachine = new LiabilityDiscoveryStateMachine(undefined, async (accountId: string) => {
      await this.yieldMachine.recalculateForAccount(accountId);
    });

    // Cross-wire Machine 4 -> Machine 3: Recalculate Safe-to-Invest after payment disbursal
    this.disbursalMachine = new LiabilityDisbursalStateMachine({
      dynamicRecords: this.dynamicRecords,
      onDisbursalSettled: async (accountId: string) => {
        await this.yieldMachine.recalculateForAccount(accountId);
      },
    });

    // Cross-wire Machine 5 -> Machine 3: Recalculate Safe-to-Invest after ad-hoc payment
    this.adHocMachine = new AdHocPaymentStateMachine({
      dynamicRecords: this.dynamicRecords,
      onPaymentSettled: async (accountId: string) => {
        await this.yieldMachine.recalculateForAccount(accountId);
      },
    });
  }

  /**
   * Primary Inbound Trigger: Blockchain or Internal Balance Mutation
   */
  public async onBalanceMutation(event: BalanceMutationEvent) {
    return this.yieldMachine.handleBalanceMutation(event);
  }

  /**
   * Primary Inbound Trigger: External Ingestion (Connected Apps / Webhooks)
   */
  public async onInboundInvoice(invoicePayload: any) {
    return this.discoveryMachine.ingestAndProcessInvoice(invoicePayload);
  }

  /**
   * Primary Inbound Trigger: Temporal Due Liability Scan
   */
  public async onDueLiabilityDisbursal(liability: any) {
    return this.disbursalMachine.executeDueLiability(liability);
  }

  /**
   * Primary Inbound Trigger: Discretionary / Ad-hoc Outflow Request
   */
  public async onAdHocPaymentRequest(request: any) {
    return this.adHocMachine.processPayment(request);
  }

  /**
   * Resumes Halted State Machine upon Human SPRS Approval / Rejection
   */
  public async handleSprsDecision(params: {
    requestId: string;
    decision: "APPROVE" | "REJECT";
    adminSignature?: string;
  }) {
    const sprs = await PermissionRequestRepo.getRequestById(params.requestId);
    if (!sprs) {
      throw new Error(`SPRS Request '${params.requestId}' not found.`);
    }

    if (params.decision === "APPROVE") {
      if (!params.adminSignature) {
        throw new Error(`Cryptographic adminSignature is required to approve SPRS '${params.requestId}'.`);
      }

      await AuthorizationGate.authorizeTransactionIntent({
        permissionRequestId: params.requestId,
        adminSignature: params.adminSignature,
      });

      // Check if attached to a specific liability
      const liabilityId = sprs.payload?.liabilityId;
      if (liabilityId) {
        const liabilities = await LiabilityRepo.getUpcomingLiabilities(365);
        const matchedLiab = liabilities.find((l) => l.liability_id === liabilityId);
        if (matchedLiab && matchedLiab.liability_id) {
          await LiabilityRepo.updateLiabilityStatus(matchedLiab.liability_id, "SCHEDULED");
          const disbursalRes = await this.disbursalMachine.executeDueLiability(matchedLiab);
          return {
            success: disbursalRes.success,
            requestId: params.requestId,
            status: "APPROVE",
            disbursalResult: disbursalRes,
          };
        }
      }

      return { success: true, requestId: params.requestId, status: "APPROVE" };
    } else {
      await PermissionRequestRepo.updateStatus(params.requestId, "REJECTED");
      return { success: true, requestId: params.requestId, status: "REJECT" };
    }
  }

  /**
   * Returns complete real-time visibility across all accounts and dynamic records.
   */
  public async getTreasuryOverview(companyId?: string) {
    const accounts = companyId
      ? await TreasuryAccountsRepo.getAccountsByCompany(companyId)
      : await TreasuryAccountsRepo.getAllAccounts();

    const overview = [];
    for (const acc of accounts) {
      const tripartite = await this.dynamicRecords.getTripartiteBalance(acc.account_id);
      const safeToInvest = await this.dynamicRecords.calculateSafeToInvest(acc.account_id);
      const liabilities = await LiabilityRepo.getUpcomingLiabilities(365, acc.account_id, companyId);

      overview.push({
        accountId: acc.account_id,
        role: acc.role,
        walletAddress: acc.wallet_address,
        tripartiteBalance: tripartite,
        safeToInvestUsdc: safeToInvest.safeToInvestUsdc,
        timeHorizonSeconds: safeToInvest.timeHorizonSeconds,
        activeLiabilitiesCount: liabilities.length,
      });
    }

    return overview;
  }
}

/**
 * Machine 1: Onboarding & Tenant Genesis Reactive State Machine.
 * ================================================================
 * Governs the unbroken transition from initial signup / workspace OAuth
 * to full corporate activation and dashboard readiness.
 */

import { OnboardingWizardService, WizardSession } from "../../services/onboardingWizardService.js";
import { IntakeDiscoveryAgent } from "../../services/intakeDiscoveryAgent.js";
import { OnboardingLlmAgent } from "../../agents/onboardingLlmAgent.js";
import { StateMachineExecutionResult, StateMachineTransitionRecord } from "./types.js";

export type OnboardingState =
  | "UNINITIALIZED"
  | "DISCOVERY_INGESTION"
  | "DRAFT_SYNTHESIS"
  | "QA_MATH_DERIVATION"
  | "ACCOUNTS_CONFIGURED"
  | "LIABILITIES_ATTACHED"
  | "ATOMIC_ACTIVATION_PENDING"
  | "COMPLETED_OPERATIONAL"
  | "FAILED";

export interface OnboardingInitParams {
  companyId: string;
  entryPath: "MANUAL" | "CONNECTED_WORKSPACE" | "CONNECTED_ERP";
  companyName?: string;
  adminEmail?: string;
  sourceCredentials?: Record<string, any>;
}

export class OnboardingStateMachine {
  private wizardService: OnboardingWizardService;
  private onboardingAgent: OnboardingLlmAgent;
  private transitionLog: StateMachineTransitionRecord[] = [];

  constructor(wizardService?: OnboardingWizardService, onboardingAgent?: OnboardingLlmAgent) {
    this.wizardService = wizardService ?? new OnboardingWizardService();
    this.onboardingAgent = onboardingAgent ?? new OnboardingLlmAgent();
  }

  private logTransition(instanceId: string, from: string, to: string, trigger: string, details?: any) {
    this.transitionLog.push({
      machineName: "ONBOARDING_STATE_MACHINE",
      instanceId,
      fromState: from,
      toState: to,
      trigger,
      actorAgentId: 106,
      actorAgentName: "OnboardingLlmAgent",
      timestamp: new Date(),
      details,
    });
  }

  /**
   * Unbroken Chain Execution: Initializes session and synthesizes draft if connected source provided.
   */
  public async startOnboarding(params: OnboardingInitParams): Promise<StateMachineExecutionResult<WizardSession>> {
    const session = await this.wizardService.createSession({
      companyId: params.companyId,
      entryPath: params.entryPath,
      initialDraft: {
        step1_profile: {
          companyName: params.companyName || params.companyId,
          adminEmail: params.adminEmail || `admin@${params.companyId}.internal`,
        },
      },
    });

    this.logTransition(session.sessionId, "UNINITIALIZED", "DISCOVERY_INGESTION", "SIGNUP_TRIGGER", { entryPath: params.entryPath });

    if (params.entryPath === "CONNECTED_WORKSPACE" || params.entryPath === "CONNECTED_ERP") {
      try {
        const discoveryAgent = new IntakeDiscoveryAgent({ companyId: params.companyId });
        const synthesis = await discoveryAgent.synthesizeAllSources();

        this.logTransition(session.sessionId, "DISCOVERY_INGESTION", "DRAFT_SYNTHESIS", "DATA_EXTRACTED", {
          discoveredCostCenters: synthesis.discoveredCostCenters.length,
          discoveredLiabilities: synthesis.discoveredLiabilities.length,
        });

        // Agent synthesizes pre-fill draft
        const prefilledSession = await this.wizardService.prefillDraftFromConnectedSource(session.sessionId, {
          companyName: params.companyName || params.companyId,
          costCenters: synthesis.discoveredCostCenters,
          invoices: synthesis.discoveredLiabilities,
        });

        return {
          success: true,
          machineName: "ONBOARDING_STATE_MACHINE",
          instanceId: session.sessionId,
          currentState: "DRAFT_SYNTHESIS",
          data: prefilledSession,
          unbrokenChainLog: [...this.transitionLog],
        };
      } catch (err: any) {
        // Fall back to manual draft if external connector is not configured
        console.warn(`[OnboardingStateMachine] External discovery note: ${err.message}. Progressing to manual intake.`);
      }
    }

    return {
      success: true,
      machineName: "ONBOARDING_STATE_MACHINE",
      instanceId: session.sessionId,
      currentState: "QA_MATH_DERIVATION",
      data: session,
      unbrokenChainLog: [...this.transitionLog],
    };
  }

  /**
   * Transitions through Math Q&A, Account Setup, and Liability Attachment.
   */
  public async submitStep(
    sessionId: string,
    step: number,
    payload: Record<string, any>
  ): Promise<StateMachineExecutionResult<WizardSession>> {
    const updated = await this.wizardService.saveStepDraft(sessionId, step, payload);
    const stateMap: Record<number, OnboardingState> = {
      1: "DISCOVERY_INGESTION",
      2: "QA_MATH_DERIVATION",
      3: "QA_MATH_DERIVATION",
      4: "ACCOUNTS_CONFIGURED",
      5: "LIABILITIES_ATTACHED",
      6: "ATOMIC_ACTIVATION_PENDING",
    };

    const nextState = stateMap[step] || "DRAFT_SYNTHESIS";
    this.logTransition(sessionId, `STEP_${step - 1}`, nextState, `SUBMIT_STEP_${step}`, { step });

    return {
      success: true,
      machineName: "ONBOARDING_STATE_MACHINE",
      instanceId: sessionId,
      currentState: nextState,
      data: updated,
      unbrokenChainLog: [...this.transitionLog],
    };
  }

  /**
   * Final atomic commitment: provisions database tables, locks vendor master, mints Genesis block.
   */
  public async activateOrganization(
    sessionId: string
  ): Promise<StateMachineExecutionResult<{ companyId: string; dashboardUrl: string }>> {
    this.logTransition(sessionId, "ATOMIC_ACTIVATION_PENDING", "COMPLETED_OPERATIONAL", "ATOMIC_ACTIVATION_TRIGGER");
    const activation = await this.wizardService.activateOrganization(sessionId);

    return {
      success: true,
      machineName: "ONBOARDING_STATE_MACHINE",
      instanceId: sessionId,
      currentState: "COMPLETED_OPERATIONAL",
      data: activation,
      unbrokenChainLog: [...this.transitionLog],
    };
  }
}

File: YieldRebalancingStateMachine.ts

/**
 * Machine 3: Automated Treasury Yield Engine & Dynamic Records State Machine.
 * ===========================================================================
 * Governs the real-time evaluation of Dynamic Record 1 (Liabilities) and
 * Dynamic Record 2 (Safe-to-Invest), maintains the parallel tripartite balance,
 * and executes autonomous USYC sweeps and deficit recalls inside policy envelopes.
 */

import { TreasurySentinelService, BalanceMutationEvent, SentinelEvaluationResult } from "../../services/treasurySentinelService.js";
import { DynamicRecordsService } from "../../records/dynamicRecordsService.js";
import { TreasurySentinelLlmAgent } from "../../agents/treasurySentinelLlmAgent.js";
import { TokenSwapService } from "../../services/tokenSwapService.js";
import { StateMachineExecutionResult, StateMachineTransitionRecord } from "./types.js";

export type YieldRebalancingState =
  | "MUTATION_DETECTED"
  | "TOKEN_SWAP_CONVERTED"
  | "INTERNAL_FILTERED"
  | "DEBOUNCED"
  | "RECORD_2_RECALCULATED"
  | "SURPLUS_SWEEP_EXECUTED"
  | "DEFICIT_RECALL_EXECUTED"
  | "HYSTERESIS_SUPPRESSED"
  | "PROTECTED_ACCOUNT_IGNORED"
  | "FAILED";

export class YieldRebalancingStateMachine {
  private sentinelService: TreasurySentinelService;
  private dynamicRecords: DynamicRecordsService;
  private sentinelAgent: TreasurySentinelLlmAgent;
  private swapService: TokenSwapService;
  private transitionLog: StateMachineTransitionRecord[] = [];

  constructor(
    sentinelService?: TreasurySentinelService,
    dynamicRecords?: DynamicRecordsService,
    sentinelAgent?: TreasurySentinelLlmAgent,
    swapService?: TokenSwapService
  ) {
    this.sentinelService = sentinelService ?? new TreasurySentinelService();
    this.dynamicRecords = dynamicRecords ?? new DynamicRecordsService();
    this.sentinelAgent = sentinelAgent ?? new TreasurySentinelLlmAgent();
    this.swapService = swapService ?? new TokenSwapService();
  }

  private logTransition(instanceId: string, from: string, to: string, trigger: string, details?: any) {
    this.transitionLog.push({
      machineName: "YIELD_REBALANCING_STATE_MACHINE",
      instanceId,
      fromState: from,
      toState: to,
      trigger,
      actorAgentId: 101,
      actorAgentName: "TreasurySentinelAgent",
      timestamp: new Date(),
      details,
    });
  }

  /**
   * Primary Entry Point: Invoked by Arc L1 event listener or post-settlement balance changes.
   */
  public async handleBalanceMutation(
    event: BalanceMutationEvent
  ): Promise<StateMachineExecutionResult<SentinelEvaluationResult>> {
    const instanceId = `YIELD-${event.accountId}-${Date.now()}`;
    this.logTransition(instanceId, "INITIAL", "MUTATION_DETECTED", "BALANCE_MUTATION_EVENT", {
      origin: event.origin,
      amountUsdc: event.amountUsdc,
    });

    try {
      // 1. Loop Protection: Filter internal settlements
      if (this.sentinelService.isInternalSettlement(event)) {
        this.logTransition(instanceId, "MUTATION_DETECTED", "INTERNAL_FILTERED", "INTERNAL_SETTLEMENT_SUPPRESSED", {
          origin: event.origin,
        });

        return {
          success: true,
          machineName: "YIELD_REBALANCING_STATE_MACHINE",
          instanceId,
          currentState: "INTERNAL_FILTERED",
          data: {
            accountId: event.accountId,
            liquidBalanceUsdc: event.currentLiquidBalanceUsdc,
            targetReserveUsdc: 0,
            safeToInvestUsdc: 0,
            action: "NONE",
            actionAmountUsdc: 0,
            branch: "FILTERED_INTERNAL",
            reason: `Filtered internal settlement event from origin '${event.origin}' to prevent feedback loop.`,
          },
          unbrokenChainLog: [...this.transitionLog],
        };
      }

      // 1.5 Non-USDC Token Auto-Conversion: Swap non-USDC token inflows into USDC before yield sweep
      const incomingToken = (event as any).incomingToken;
      if (incomingToken && incomingToken.toUpperCase() !== "USDC" && incomingToken.toUpperCase() !== "NATIVE") {
        const swapResult = await this.swapService.executeSwap({
          accountId: event.accountId,
          fromChain: (event as any).chain || "Ethereum",
          fromToken: incomingToken,
          toChain: "Arc",
          toToken: "USDC",
          amount: ((event as any).incomingAmount || event.amountUsdc).toString(),
          declaredReason: `Auto-conversion of incoming ${incomingToken} to USDC for treasury yield optimization`,
        });

        if (swapResult.success) {
          const convertedUsdc = parseFloat(swapResult.toAmount);
          event.amountUsdc = convertedUsdc;
          event.currentLiquidBalanceUsdc += convertedUsdc;

          this.logTransition(instanceId, "MUTATION_DETECTED", "TOKEN_SWAP_CONVERTED", "TOKEN_SWAPPED_TO_USDC", {
            swapId: swapResult.swapId,
            fromToken: incomingToken,
            toAmountUsdc: convertedUsdc,
            realizedRate: swapResult.realizedRate,
          });
        }
      }

      // 2. State: Debounced & Recalculate Dynamic Record 2
      this.logTransition(instanceId, "MUTATION_DETECTED", "DEBOUNCED", "DEBOUNCE_PASSED");
      const safeToInvestCalc = await this.dynamicRecords.calculateSafeToInvest(event.accountId);

      this.logTransition(instanceId, "DEBOUNCED", "RECORD_2_RECALCULATED", "SAFE_TO_INVEST_COMPUTED", {
        safeToInvestUsdc: safeToInvestCalc.safeToInvestUsdc,
        timeHorizonSeconds: safeToInvestCalc.timeHorizonSeconds,
        targetReserveUsdc: safeToInvestCalc.targetReserveUsdc,
      });

      // 3. State: Autonomous LLM Agent Liquidity Deliberation & Tool Execution
      await this.sentinelAgent.rebalanceAccountLiquidity(instanceId, {
        accountId: event.accountId,
        amountUsdc: event.amountUsdc,
        currentLiquidBalanceUsdc: event.currentLiquidBalanceUsdc,
        origin: event.origin,
      });

      const evalResult = await this.sentinelService.onBalanceMutation(event);

      let finalState: YieldRebalancingState = "HYSTERESIS_SUPPRESSED";
      if (evalResult.action === "SWEEP") {
        finalState = "SURPLUS_SWEEP_EXECUTED";
      } else if (evalResult.action === "RECALL") {
        finalState = "DEFICIT_RECALL_EXECUTED";
      } else if (evalResult.branch === "PROTECTED_ACCOUNT") {
        finalState = "PROTECTED_ACCOUNT_IGNORED";
      }

      this.logTransition(instanceId, "RECORD_2_RECALCULATED", finalState, evalResult.action, {
        actionAmountUsdc: evalResult.actionAmountUsdc,
        clearanceCode: evalResult.clearanceCode,
        branch: evalResult.branch,
      });

      return {
        success: true,
        machineName: "YIELD_REBALANCING_STATE_MACHINE",
        instanceId,
        currentState: finalState,
        data: evalResult,
        unbrokenChainLog: [...this.transitionLog],
      };
    } catch (err: any) {
      this.logTransition(instanceId, "MUTATION_DETECTED", "FAILED", "ERROR", { error: err.message });
      return {
        success: false,
        machineName: "YIELD_REBALANCING_STATE_MACHINE",
        instanceId,
        currentState: "FAILED",
        error: err.message,
        unbrokenChainLog: [...this.transitionLog],
      };
    }
  }

  /**
   * Recalculates Safe-to-Invest explicitly when liabilities are added or edited.
   */
  public async recalculateForAccount(accountId: string): Promise<StateMachineExecutionResult<any>> {
    const tripartite = await this.dynamicRecords.getTripartiteBalance(accountId);
    return this.handleBalanceMutation({
      accountId,
      amountUsdc: 0,
      currentLiquidBalanceUsdc: parseFloat(tripartite.liquidCashUsdc),
      origin: "LIABILITY_RECALCULATION",
      forceImmediate: true,
    });
  }
}
