import {
  LedgerWitnessService as LedgerWitnessAgent,
  ReconciledReceiptError,
  LoudRoundingError,
} from "../src/services/ledgerWitnessService.js";
import { DbClient } from "../src/database/dbClient.js";
import { MasterJournalRepo } from "../src/database/repos/masterJournalRepo.js";
import { AuditLogRepo } from "../src/database/repos/auditLogRepo.js";
import { TreasuryAccountsRepo } from "../src/database/repos/treasuryAccountsRepo.js";
import { VendorMasterRepo } from "../src/database/repos/vendorMasterRepo.js";
import { PolicyLoader } from "../src/config/policyLoader.js";
import { encodeEventTopics, parseAbiItem, toHex } from "viem";

/**
 * INDEPENDENT REAL-WORLD AUDIT SUITE FOR D6 -> D7:
 * LedgerWitnessAgent & Tamper-Evident System Journal
 *
 * Verifies Segregation of Duties (zero keys), Double-Entry Accounting Vouchers,
 * Independent RPC Receipt Witnessing, Rule 3 Payee Substitution Protection,
 * Rule 5 Loud Repair on micro-rounding, Cryptographic Hash Chaining, and
 * Attack Simulation on Database Tampering.
 *
 * Executed against live PostgreSQL 'bizarc' database.
 */
async function runIndependentD7Audit() {
  console.log("================================================================================");
  console.log("    INDEPENDENT REAL-WORLD AUDIT: D6 -> D7 LEDGER WITNESS & MASTER JOURNAL      ");
  console.log("================================================================================");

  let pass = 0;
  let fail = 0;
  const failures: string[] = [];

  function assert(condition: boolean, label: string) {
    if (condition) {
      console.log(`  ✓ ${label}`);
      pass++;
    } else {
      console.error(`  ✗ FAIL: ${label}`);
      fail++;
      failures.push(label);
    }
  }

  function assertEqual<T>(actual: T, expected: T, label: string) {
    if (actual === expected) {
      console.log(`  ✓ ${label}`);
      pass++;
    } else {
      console.error(`  ✗ FAIL: ${label} -> expected ${JSON.stringify(expected)}, got ${JSON.stringify(actual)}`);
      fail++;
      failures.push(label);
    }
  }

  // ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  // 1. SETUP & REAL DATABASE CLEANUP
  // ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  console.log("\n[Setup] Cleaning database tables for independent D7 audit...");
  await DbClient.query("TRUNCATE TABLE master_system_journal CASCADE");
  await DbClient.query("TRUNCATE TABLE account_agent_audit_log CASCADE");
  await DbClient.query("TRUNCATE TABLE permission_requests CASCADE");
  await DbClient.query("TRUNCATE TABLE account_liabilities CASCADE");
  await DbClient.query("TRUNCATE TABLE vendor_master_registry CASCADE");
  await DbClient.query("TRUNCATE TABLE treasury_accounts CASCADE");

  const { profile } = PolicyLoader.getActiveProfile();
  for (const acc of profile.operating_accounts) {
    await TreasuryAccountsRepo.upsertAccount({
      account_id: acc.account_id,
      name: acc.name,
      role: acc.role,
      wallet_address: `0x${acc.account_id.length.toString().padStart(40, "7")}` as `0x${string}`,
      chain_id: 5042002,
      min_operating_floor_usdc: acc.min_floor_usdc,
      safety_buffer_ratio: acc.safety_multiplier,
      is_active: true,
    });
  }

  // Seed verified vendor
  const VENDOR_AWS = "vnd_aws_cloud";
  const VENDOR_AWS_ADDR = "0x7777777777777777777777777777777777777777" as `0x${string}`;
  await VendorMasterRepo.registerVendor({
    vendor_id: VENDOR_AWS,
    name: "Amazon Web Services Inc.",
    verified_payout_address: VENDOR_AWS_ADDR,
    verified_by_admin: "admin_secops",
    last_verified_at: new Date(),
    change_lock: true,
  });

  const witnessAgent = new LedgerWitnessAgent();

  // ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  // 2. AUDIT: SEGREGATION OF DUTIES (ZERO-SIGNING MODEL)
  // ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  console.log("\n[Audit 1] Segregation of Duties: LedgerWitness has Zero Private Keys");
  assertEqual(witnessAgent.persona, "LedgerWitnessAgent", "Persona confirmed as LedgerWitnessAgent");
  assertEqual(witnessAgent.canSignTransactions, false, "canSignTransactions is STRICTLY FALSE (no private keys)");
  assertEqual(witnessAgent.canWriteLedger, true, "canWriteLedger is TRUE (authoritative ledger writes)");
  assertEqual(witnessAgent.erc8004Id, 105, "ERC-8004 Identity registered as Agent 105");

  // ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  // 3. AUDIT: DOUBLE-ENTRY ACCOUNTING VOUCHERS (DEBITS = CREDITS)
  // ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  console.log("\n[Audit 2] Double-Entry Accounting Voucher Classification");

  const sweepAccounts = witnessAgent.getDoubleEntryAccounts("AUTONOMOUS_SWEEP", "acc_engineering");
  assertEqual(sweepAccounts.debitAccount, "Asset:Investments:USYC:acc_engineering", "SWEEP Debits USYC Investment asset");
  assertEqual(sweepAccounts.creditAccount, "Asset:Cash:USDC:acc_engineering", "SWEEP Credits liquid USDC asset");

  const recallAccounts = witnessAgent.getDoubleEntryAccounts("AUTONOMOUS_RECALL", "acc_engineering");
  assertEqual(recallAccounts.debitAccount, "Asset:Cash:USDC:acc_engineering", "RECALL Debits liquid USDC asset");
  assertEqual(recallAccounts.creditAccount, "Asset:Investments:USYC:acc_engineering", "RECALL Credits USYC Investment asset");

  const disbursalAccounts = witnessAgent.getDoubleEntryAccounts("DISBURSAL_PAYMENT", "acc_engineering", "vnd_aws_cloud", "INFRASTRUCTURE");
  assertEqual(disbursalAccounts.debitAccount, "Expense:INFRASTRUCTURE:vnd_aws_cloud", "DISBURSAL Debits vendor expense account");
  assertEqual(disbursalAccounts.creditAccount, "Asset:Cash:USDC:acc_engineering", "DISBURSAL Credits liquid cash asset");

  // ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  // 4. AUDIT: INDEPENDENT RPC RECEIPT RECONCILIATION
  // ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  console.log("\n[Audit 3] Independent RPC Receipt Verification & Event Decoding");

  const TX_RECONCILE = "0xabcdef1234567890abcdef1234567890abcdef1234567890abcdef1234567890" as `0x${string}`;
  const mockPublicClient = {
    getTransactionReceipt: async ({ hash }: { hash: `0x${string}` }) => {
      const transferEventAbi = parseAbiItem("event Transfer(address indexed from, address indexed to, uint256 value)");
      const topics = encodeEventTopics({
        abi: [transferEventAbi],
        eventName: "Transfer",
        args: {
          from: "0x1111111111111111111111111111111111111111",
          to: "0x2222222222222222222222222222222222222222",
        },
      });

      return {
        status: "success",
        blockNumber: 492010n,
        transactionHash: hash,
        from: "0x1111111111111111111111111111111111111111" as `0x${string}`,
        to: "0x2222222222222222222222222222222222222222" as `0x${string}`,
        logs: [
          {
            address: "0x3600000000000000000000000000000000000000",
            topics,
            data: toHex(500000000n, { size: 32 }), // 500.000000 USDC (6 decimals)
          },
        ],
      };
    },
  } as any;

  const witnessWithClient = new LedgerWitnessAgent(mockPublicClient);
  const reconciled = await witnessWithClient.reconcileTransactionReceipt(TX_RECONCILE);

  assertEqual(reconciled.status, "success", "Receipt status reconciled as success");
  assertEqual(reconciled.transferredAmountUsdc, 500.0, "Decoded amount is exactly 500.000000 USDC");
  assertEqual(reconciled.blockNumber, 492010n, "Block number verified independently");

  // ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  // 5. AUDIT: RULE 3 PAYEE SUBSTITUTION CHECK IN WITNESS
  // ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  console.log("\n[Audit 4] Rule 3: Payee Substitution Enforcement by LedgerWitness");
  const ATTACKER_ADDR = "0xdead00000000000000000000000000000000dead" as `0x${string}`;

  let caughtPayeeViolation = false;
  try {
    await witnessWithClient.reconcileTransactionReceipt(TX_RECONCILE, {
      to: ATTACKER_ADDR, // Expected attacker, but receipt sent to actual recipient
    });
  } catch (err: any) {
    caughtPayeeViolation = err instanceof ReconciledReceiptError && err.message.includes("Payee Substitution");
  }
  assert(caughtPayeeViolation, "Witness aborted write due to Payee Substitution Detection (Rule 3)");

  // ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  // 6. AUDIT: RULE 5 LOUD REPAIR (MICRO-ROUNDING SHORTFALL RESISTANCE)
  // ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  console.log("\n[Audit 5] Rule 5: Refusal of Silent Rounding (Loud Repair)");
  let caughtRoundingError = false;
  try {
    await witnessWithClient.reconcileTransactionReceipt(TX_RECONCILE, {
      amountUsdc: 500.000001, // 1 micro-unit discrepancy!
    });
  } catch (err: any) {
    caughtRoundingError = err instanceof LoudRoundingError;
  }
  assert(caughtRoundingError, "Witness rejected micro-unit difference of 0.000001 USDC (Rule 5)");

  // ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  // 7. AUDIT: RULE 1 DOCUMENT LINKING ENFORCEMENT
  // ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  console.log("\n[Audit 6] Rule 1: Document-Linked Ledger Only");
  let caughtRule1 = false;
  try {
    await witnessWithClient.recordJournalVoucher({
      accountId: "acc_engineering",
      actionType: "AUTONOMOUS_SWEEP",
      amountUsdc: 500.0,
      documentRef: "", // Empty document reference!
    });
  } catch (err: any) {
    caughtRule1 = err.message.includes("Rule 1 violation");
  }
  assert(caughtRule1, "Witness rejected transaction without verifiable document reference (Rule 1)");

  // ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  // 8. AUDIT: END-TO-END WITNESSING, AUDIT LOG & MASTER JOURNAL PERSISTENCE
  // ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  console.log("\n[Audit 7] End-to-End Transaction Witnessing & Chained Recording");
  const witnessRes = await witnessWithClient.witnessTransaction({
    txHash: "0x4444444444444444444444444444444444444444444444444444444444444444",
    accountId: "acc_engineering",
    actionType: "AUTONOMOUS_SWEEP",
    amountUsdc: 500.0,
    documentRef: "doc_sweep_verified_plan_771",
  });

  assertEqual(witnessRes.receipt.status, "success", "Transaction witnessed and reconciled");
  assertEqual(witnessRes.journalEntry.amount_usdc, 500.0, "Master journal amount matches exactly 500.0 USDC");
  assertEqual(witnessRes.journalEntry.document_ref, "doc_sweep_verified_plan_771", "Journal record links to verified document");

  // Verify PostgreSQL audit log record
  const auditLogs = await AuditLogRepo.getAuditLogsByAccount("acc_engineering");
  const loggedSweep = auditLogs.find((l) => l.action_type === "AUTONOMOUS_SWEEP");
  assert(Boolean(loggedSweep), "Audit log entry created in account_agent_audit_log");
  assertEqual(loggedSweep?.actor_agent, "LedgerWitnessAgent", "Audit log records actor as LedgerWitnessAgent");
  assertEqual(loggedSweep?.amount_usdc, 500.0, "Audit log amount matches 500.0 USDC");

  // ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  // 9. AUDIT: CRYPTOGRAPHIC MASTER JOURNAL HASH CHAINING & INTEGRITY AUDITING
  // ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  console.log("\n[Audit 8] Cryptographic Master System Journal Hash Chaining");

  // Add two more chained journal entries
  await witnessWithClient.witnessTransaction({
    txHash: "0x5555555555555555555555555555555555555555555555555555555555555555",
    accountId: "acc_engineering",
    actionType: "AUTONOMOUS_SWEEP",
    amountUsdc: 500.0,
    documentRef: "doc_sweep_chain_entry_2",
  });

  await witnessWithClient.witnessTransaction({
    txHash: "0x6666666666666666666666666666666666666666666666666666666666666666",
    accountId: "acc_engineering",
    actionType: "AUTONOMOUS_SWEEP",
    amountUsdc: 500.0,
    documentRef: "doc_sweep_chain_entry_3",
  });

  const chainAudit = await witnessWithClient.verifyLedgerIntegrity();
  assertEqual(chainAudit.valid, true, "Master journal hash chain is cryptographically VALID");
  assertEqual(chainAudit.totalEntries, 3, "Master journal verified all 3 sequential entries");

  // ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  // 10. AUDIT: TAMPER DETECTION (MALICIOUS ATTACK ON POSTGRESQL JOURNAL)
  // ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  console.log("\n[Audit 9] Database Attack Simulation: Malicious Direct SQL Tampering");

  const journalEntries = await MasterJournalRepo.getAllEntries();
  const targetEntry = journalEntries[1]; // Tamper entry #2

  // Attacker covertly changes amount from 500 to 999 via raw SQL
  await DbClient.query("UPDATE master_system_journal SET amount_usdc = 999.0 WHERE sequence_id = $1", [targetEntry.sequence_id]);

  const tamperedAudit = await witnessWithClient.verifyLedgerIntegrity();
  assertEqual(tamperedAudit.valid, false, "Tampered journal entry is INSTANTLY DETECTED as INVALID");
  assertEqual(tamperedAudit.brokenAtSequence, String(targetEntry.sequence_id), "Integrity check correctly isolated broken sequence ID");

  // Restore the record to keep state clean
  await DbClient.query("UPDATE master_system_journal SET amount_usdc = 500.0 WHERE sequence_id = $1", [targetEntry.sequence_id]);
  const restoredAudit = await witnessWithClient.verifyLedgerIntegrity();
  assertEqual(restoredAudit.valid, true, "Ledger integrity confirmed valid after restoring tampered record");

  // ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  // 11. AUDIT: CIRCLE WEBHOOK INGESTION & INDEPENDENT RECONCILIATION
  // ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  console.log("\n[Audit 10] Independent Circle Webhook Reconciliation");
  const webhookBody = JSON.stringify({
    notificationId: "notif_audit_circle_9918",
    type: "transactions.inbound",
    data: {
      id: "tx_inbound_circle_001",
      state: "CONFIRMED",
      txHash: TX_RECONCILE,
      amount: "500.00",
    },
    timestamp: new Date().toISOString(),
  });

  const webhookResult = await witnessWithClient.reconcileCircleWebhook({
    rawBody: webhookBody,
  });

  assertEqual(webhookResult.verified, true, "Circle webhook payload verified and ingested");
  assertEqual(webhookResult.payload.data.state, "CONFIRMED", "Webhook state is CONFIRMED");
  assert(Boolean(webhookResult.reconciledReceipt), "Webhook automatically reconciled independent RPC receipt");

  // ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  // SUMMARY
  // ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  console.log("\n" + "=".repeat(80));
  console.log(`  INDEPENDENT D7 AUDIT COMPLETE: ${pass} passed, ${fail} failed`);
  if (failures.length > 0) {
    console.error("  FAILURES:");
    failures.forEach((f) => console.error(`    ✗ ${f}`));
  } else {
    console.log("  >>> ALL D6->D7 LEDGER WITNESS AUDIT SCENARIOS CONFIRMED PASSING <<<");
  }
  console.log("=".repeat(80));

  process.exit(fail > 0 ? 1 : 0);
}

runIndependentD7Audit().catch((err) => {

  process.exit(1);

    const unauthedCompany = "cmp_unauthenticated_tenant_999";
    const awsConn = new AwsBillingConnector(unauthedCompany);
    const ghConn = new GithubBillingConnector(unauthedCompany);
    const openAiConn = new OpenAiBillingConnector(unauthedCompany);

    await assert.rejects(
      async () => await awsConn.fetchBillingData(),
      (err: any) => {
        assert.ok(err instanceof MissingVendorCredentialsError);
        assert.equal(err.vendorName, "AWS");
        return true;

    );

    await assert.rejects(
      async () => await ghConn.fetchBillingData(),
      (err: any) => {
        assert.ok(err instanceof MissingVendorCredentialsError);
        assert.equal(err.vendorName, "GitHub Enterprise");
        return true;

    );

    await assert.rejects(
      async () => await openAiConn.fetchBillingData(),
      (err: any) => {
        assert.ok(err instanceof MissingVendorCredentialsError);
        assert.equal(err.vendorName, "OpenAI");
        return true;
      }
    );
  });

  it("12. VendorBillingAggregator successfully aggregates all 10 major vendor connectors simultaneously", async () => {
    const aggregator = new VendorBillingAggregator(companyId, {
      AWS: awsTransport,
      GITHUB: githubTransport,
      DATADOG: datadogTransport,
      GCP: gcpTransport,
      AZURE: azureTransport,
      OPENAI: openAiTransport,
      STRIPE: stripeTransport,
      SNOWFLAKE: snowflakeTransport,
      TWILIO: twilioTransport,
      FIGMA: figmaTransport,

    assert.equal(summary.companyId, companyId);
    assert.equal(summary.vendors.length, 10);
    assert.equal(summary.aggregatedInvoices.length, 10);
    assert.ok(summary.aggregatedCostCenters.length >= 10);

    // Verify sum of monthly spend across all 10
    // 14850 + 2385 + 4250.5 + 8950 + 7450 + 3120 + 2150 + 7500 + 1450 + 180 = 52285.50
    assert.equal(summary.totalMonthlySpendUsdc, 52285.5);
    assert.ok(summary.totalForecastedMonthlySpendUsdc > summary.totalMonthlySpendUsdc);

    // Verify payment rail distribution covers all 4 rails across the 10 vendors
    assert.ok(summary.railDistribution["DISBURSAL_VAULT"] >= 4); // AWS, GCP, Azure, Snowflake
    assert.ok(summary.railDistribution["MODULAR_SESSION_KEY"] >= 4); // GitHub, Datadog, Twilio, Figma
    assert.ok(summary.railDistribution["GATEWAY_X402"] >= 1); // OpenAI
    assert.ok(summary.railDistribution["ERC3009_AUTHORIZATION"] >= 1); // Stripe
  });
});

/**
 * D23: Production Readiness Path Test Suite
 * ==========================================
 * Comprehensive verification of the 8 Core Pillars of Enterprise Production Readiness
 * on Arc Layer-1 blockchain as specified in project_dag.md and AUTONOMOUS_TREASURY_PLAN.md:
 *
 * 1. Pillar 1: Replace mock USYC with allowlisted production Hashnote institutional contract
 * 2. Pillar 2: Enterprise policy profile activation ($500 OPEX / $10k Payroll floors, 30-day evaluation windows)
 * 3. Pillar 3: Parameterized production redemption latency (Tier A 900s, Tier B 28.8ks, Tier C 86.4ks)
 * 4. Pillar 4: Enterprise spending limits ($25k daily hard cap, $5k single-tx human gate threshold)
 * 5. Pillar 5: Production wallet configuration (EVM checksum validation, 20 Gwei gas floor, 18-decimal scaling)
 * 6. Pillar 6: Production vendor registry (Immutable change_lock, admin verification, anti-substitution)
 * 7. Pillar 7: Monitoring & Solvency (Tripartite BE = BL + BY invariant, SHA-256 hash chain verification)
 * 8. Pillar 8: Operational controls & Circuit Breakers (Instant disbursal halt, admin clearance disarm)
 *
 * ZERO STUBS. ZERO MOCKS. Real PostgreSQL, real cryptographic hash chaining, and real ToolRegistry dispatch.
 */

import { describe, it, before, after } from "node:test";
import assert from "node:assert/strict";
import crypto from "crypto";
import { getAddress, isAddress } from "viem";
import { DbClient } from "../src/database/dbClient.js";
import { PolicyLoader } from "../src/config/policyLoader.js";
import { ARC_CONSTANTS } from "../src/foundation/arc/constants.js";
import { TreasuryAccountsRepo } from "../src/database/repos/treasuryAccountsRepo.js";
import { VendorMasterRepo } from "../src/database/repos/vendorMasterRepo.js";
import { MasterJournalRepo } from "../src/database/repos/masterJournalRepo.js";
import { AuditLogRepo } from "../src/database/repos/auditLogRepo.js";
import { ProductionReadinessService } from "../src/services/productionReadinessService.js";
import { ToolRegistry } from "../src/tools/toolRegistry.js";
import { DynamicRecordsService } from "../src/records/dynamicRecordsService.js";

describe("D23: Enterprise Production Readiness Path (Arc L1)", () => {
  const ts = Date.now();
  const testCompanyId = `comp_prod_${ts}`;
  const prodOpexId = `acc_prod_opex_${ts}`;
  const prodPayrollId = `acc_prod_payroll_${ts}`;
  const prodVendorId = `vend_prod_${ts}`;
  const prodOpexWallet = getAddress(`0x${crypto.randomBytes(20).toString("hex")}`);
  const prodPayrollWallet = getAddress(`0x${crypto.randomBytes(20).toString("hex")}`);
  const prodPayoutAddress = getAddress(`0x${crypto.randomBytes(20).toString("hex")}`);
  const institutionalUsycVault = "0x4444444444444444444444444444444444444444" as `0x${string}`;

  let service: ProductionReadinessService;
  let toolRegistry: ToolRegistry;

  before(async () => {
    service = new ProductionReadinessService();
    toolRegistry = new ToolRegistry();

    // 1. Seed Production Operating & Payroll Accounts
    await TreasuryAccountsRepo.upsertAccount({
      account_id: prodOpexId,
      company_id: testCompanyId,
      name: "Corporate Primary OPEX (Prod)",
      role: "OPERATING_EXPENSES",
      wallet_address: prodOpexWallet,
      chain_id: 5042,
      min_operating_floor_usdc: 500.0,
      safety_buffer_ratio: 0.2,
      is_active: true,
    });

    await TreasuryAccountsRepo.upsertAccount({
      account_id: prodPayrollId,
      company_id: testCompanyId,
      name: "Corporate Payroll Reserve (Prod)",
      role: "PAYROLL",
      wallet_address: prodPayrollWallet,
      chain_id: 5042,
      min_operating_floor_usdc: 10000.0,
      safety_buffer_ratio: 0.1,
      is_active: true,
      exclude_from_waterfall: true,
    });

    // 2. Seed Vendor Master Registry with immutable change_lock
    await VendorMasterRepo.registerVendor({
      vendor_id: prodVendorId,
      name: "AWS Cloud Infrastructure Corp",
      verified_payout_address: prodPayoutAddress,
      verified_by_admin: "admin@enterprise.io",
      last_verified_at: new Date(),
      change_lock: true,
    });
  });

  after(async () => {
    // Cleanup seeded records
    try {
      await DbClient.query("DELETE FROM treasury_accounts WHERE account_id IN ($1, $2);", [
        prodOpexId,
        prodPayrollId,
      ]);
      await DbClient.query("DELETE FROM vendor_master_registry WHERE vendor_id = $1;", [
        prodVendorId,
      ]);
    } catch {
      // Ignored in test cleanup
    }
  });

  // ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  // Pillar 1: Replace mock USYC with allowlisted production integration
  // ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  it("Pillar 1: Should replace mock USYC vault with allowlisted production contract", async () => {
    const migration = await service.replaceYieldVaultIntegration(institutionalUsycVault, true);

    assert.equal(migration.success, true);
    assert.equal(migration.newVault, getAddress(institutionalUsycVault));
    assert.ok(migration.migrationHash.length === 64, "Expected 64-char SHA-256 migration voucher");

    // Verify Master System Journal voucher
    const latestEntry = await MasterJournalRepo.getLatestEntry();
    assert.ok(latestEntry);
    assert.equal(latestEntry.action_type, "YIELD_VAULT_CONTRACT_MIGRATED");
    assert.equal(latestEntry.account_id, "CENTRAL_YIELD_VAULT");

    // Verify Audit via Service
    const audit = await service.auditProductionReadiness();
    assert.equal(audit.pillars.yieldVault.isReady, true);
    assert.equal(audit.pillars.yieldVault.score, 100);
    assert.ok(audit.pillars.yieldVault.details.includes(getAddress(institutionalUsycVault)));
  });

  // ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  // Pillar 2: Production Policy Profile Configuration
  // ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  it("Pillar 2: Should promote active policy to PRODUCTION with strict account floors", async () => {
    const activation = await service.activateProductionProfile({
      adminEmail: "cfo@enterprise.io",
      vaultAddress: institutionalUsycVault,
      accountId: prodOpexId,
      reason: "Formal Go-Live Signoff for Arc L1 Autonomous Treasury",
    });

    assert.equal(activation.success, true);
    assert.equal(activation.activatedProfile, "PRODUCTION");
    assert.ok(activation.journalHash.length === 64);

    // Verify Active Profile parameters
    const active = PolicyLoader.getActiveProfile();
    assert.equal(active.profileName, "PRODUCTION");
    const opexDev = active.profile.operating_accounts.find((a) => a.role === "OPEX_DEV");
    const payroll = active.profile.operating_accounts.find((a) => a.role === "PAYROLL");
    assert.ok(opexDev, "Expected OPEX_DEV account in PRODUCTION profile");
    assert.ok(payroll, "Expected PAYROLL account in PRODUCTION profile");
    assert.equal(opexDev.min_floor_usdc, 500.0);
    assert.equal(payroll.min_floor_usdc, 10000.0);
    assert.equal(payroll.exclude_from_waterfall_draws, true);
    assert.equal(opexDev.evaluation_window_days, 30);

    // Verify audit log entry
    const auditLogs = await AuditLogRepo.getAuditLogsByAccount(prodOpexId, 5);
    const activationLog = auditLogs.find((l) => l.action_type === "PRODUCTION_PROFILE_ACTIVATED");
    assert.ok(activationLog);
    assert.equal(activationLog.actor_agent, "PolicyComplianceAgent");
    assert.equal(activationLog.is_autonomous, false);
  });

  // ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  // Pillar 3: Parameterized Production Redemption Latency
  // ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  it("Pillar 3: Should enforce production redemption latency tiers (Tier A, Tier B, Tier C)", async () => {
    const audit = await service.auditProductionReadiness();
    const latencyPillar = audit.pillars.redemptionLatency;

    assert.equal(latencyPillar.isReady, true);
    assert.equal(latencyPillar.score, 100);
    assert.equal(latencyPillar.metadata?.tier, "TIER_C_BATCH_T1");
    assert.equal(latencyPillar.metadata?.latencySeconds, 86400);

    // Verify metadata contains all three defined tiers
    assert.equal(latencyPillar.metadata?.allTiers.TIER_A_INSTANT, 900);
    assert.equal(latencyPillar.metadata?.allTiers.TIER_B_BATCH_T0, 28800);
    assert.equal(latencyPillar.metadata?.allTiers.TIER_C_BATCH_T1, 86400);
  });

  // ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  // Pillar 4: Production Spending Limits & Human Gate
  // ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  it("Pillar 4: Should enforce production spending limits ($25k daily cap, $5k human gate threshold)", async () => {
    const audit = await service.auditProductionReadiness();
    const limitsPillar = audit.pillars.spendingLimits;

    assert.equal(limitsPillar.isReady, true);
    assert.equal(limitsPillar.score, 100);
    assert.equal(limitsPillar.metadata?.dailyHardCapUsdc, 25000.0);
    assert.equal(limitsPillar.metadata?.singleTxHumanGateThresholdUsdc, 5000.0);

    // Ensure hackathon thresholds ($10) are no longer active
    assert.notEqual(limitsPillar.metadata?.singleTxHumanGateThresholdUsdc, 10.0);
  });

  // ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  // Pillar 5: Production Wallet Configuration & Arc L1 Protocol Standards
  // ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  it("Pillar 5: Should validate EVM checksums, Arc Chain ID 5042, and 20 Gwei gas floor", async () => {
    const audit = await service.auditProductionReadiness();
    const walletPillar = audit.pillars.walletConfiguration;

    assert.equal(walletPillar.isReady, true);
    assert.ok(walletPillar.score >= 90);
    assert.equal(walletPillar.metadata?.chainId, ARC_CONSTANTS.MAINNET.chainId);
    assert.equal(walletPillar.metadata?.testnetChainId, ARC_CONSTANTS.TESTNET.chainId);

    // Verify protocol gas floor & decimal factor
    assert.equal(ARC_CONSTANTS.MIN_GAS_FLOOR_GWEI, 20n);
    assert.equal(ARC_CONSTANTS.DECIMAL_CONVERSION_FACTOR, 10n ** 12n);
  });

  // ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  // Pillar 6: Production Vendor Registry Immutability
  // ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  it("Pillar 6: Should enforce immutable change_lock and verified payout address in Vendor Master", async () => {
    const audit = await service.auditProductionReadiness();
    const vendorPillar = audit.pillars.vendorRegistry;

    assert.equal(vendorPillar.isReady, true);
    assert.ok(vendorPillar.score >= 80);

    // Verify Anti-Payee Substitution verification
    const vendor = await VendorMasterRepo.getVendorById(prodVendorId);
    assert.ok(vendor);
    assert.equal(vendor.change_lock, true);
    assert.equal(vendor.verified_payout_address.toLowerCase(), prodPayoutAddress.toLowerCase());

    // Verify tool registry check_vendor_master
    const toolCheck = await toolRegistry.executeTool("check_vendor_master", {
      vendorId: prodVendorId,
      payoutAddress: prodPayoutAddress,
    });
    assert.equal(toolCheck.success, true);
    assert.equal(toolCheck.data.isMatch, true);

    // Verify unauthorized substitution is detected
    const spoofCheck = await toolRegistry.executeTool("check_vendor_master", {
      vendorId: prodVendorId,
      payoutAddress: "0x000000000000000000000000000000000000dEaD",
    });
    assert.equal(spoofCheck.success, false);
    assert.ok(spoofCheck.error?.includes("Possible payee substitution"));
  });

  // ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  // Pillar 7: Monitoring & Solvency Invariant (BE = BL + BY & SHA-256 Hash Chain)
  // ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  it("Pillar 7: Should verify cryptographic hash chain integrity and Tripartite Solvency Invariant", async () => {
    // 1. Verify Hash Chain Integrity
    const chainVerification = await MasterJournalRepo.verifyChainIntegrity();
    assert.equal(chainVerification.valid, true, `Hash chain broken: ${chainVerification.details}`);
    assert.ok(chainVerification.totalEntries > 0);

    // 2. Verify Tripartite Invariant on seeded accounts
    const dynamicRecords = new DynamicRecordsService();
    const opexTripartite = await dynamicRecords.getTripartiteBalance(prodOpexId);
    assert.equal(opexTripartite.invariantSatisfied, true);

    const audit = await service.auditProductionReadiness();
    const monitoringPillar = audit.pillars.monitoringAndSolvency;
    assert.equal(monitoringPillar.isReady, true);
    assert.equal(monitoringPillar.score, 100);
  });

  // ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  // Pillar 8: Operational Controls & Emergency Circuit Breaker
  // ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  it("Pillar 8: Should trip emergency circuit breaker and require clearance code to disarm", async () => {
    // 1. Trip Emergency Circuit Breaker
    const tripResult = await service.triggerEmergencyCircuitBreaker(
      "Unusual cross-chain slippage detected in external DEX",
      "cfo@enterprise.io"
    );
    assert.equal(tripResult.circuitBreakerActive, true);
    assert.equal(tripResult.emergencyReason, "Unusual cross-chain slippage detected in external DEX");

    // Audit should report Pillar 8 as not ready / score penalized
    const auditTripped = await service.auditProductionReadiness();
    assert.equal(auditTripped.pillars.operationalControls.isReady, false);
    assert.equal(auditTripped.pillars.operationalControls.score, 0);

    // 2. Attempt Reset without valid clearance code -> Should Throw
    await assert.rejects(
      async () => {
        await service.resetCircuitBreaker("cfo@enterprise.io", "short_code");
      },
      /Valid administrative clearance code required/
    );

    // 3. Reset with valid 16+ character clearance code
    const resetResult = await service.resetCircuitBreaker(
      "cfo@enterprise.io",
      "CLEARANCE-OVERRIDE-SEC-AUTH-2026-X88"
    );
    assert.equal(resetResult.circuitBreakerActive, false);
    assert.equal(resetResult.status, "NORMAL_OPERATIONS_RESTORED");

    // Audit should restore Pillar 8 score
    const auditRestored = await service.auditProductionReadiness();
    assert.equal(auditRestored.pillars.operationalControls.isReady, true);
    assert.equal(auditRestored.pillars.operationalControls.score, 100);
  });

  // ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  // Pillar 9: ToolRegistry D23 Function Invocations
  // ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  it("ToolRegistry: Should execute audit_production_readiness, activate_production_profile, and emergency circuit breaker", async () => {
    // 1. Audit production readiness via ToolRegistry
    const auditToolResult = await toolRegistry.executeTool("audit_production_readiness", {
      companyId: testCompanyId,
    });
    assert.equal(auditToolResult.success, true);
    assert.ok(auditToolResult.data.overallScore >= 80);
    assert.equal(auditToolResult.data.activeProfile, "PRODUCTION");

    // 2. Circuit breaker trip via ToolRegistry
    const tripToolResult = await toolRegistry.executeTool("trigger_emergency_circuit_breaker", {
      action: "TRIP",
      reason: "Automated regression testing freeze",
      adminEmail: "security@bizarc.io",
    });
    assert.equal(tripToolResult.success, true);
    assert.equal(tripToolResult.data.circuitBreakerActive, true);

    // 3. Circuit breaker reset via ToolRegistry
    const resetToolResult = await toolRegistry.executeTool("trigger_emergency_circuit_breaker", {
      action: "RESET",
      reason: "Testing complete, resume operations",
      adminEmail: "cfo@bizarc.io",
      clearanceCode: "CLEARANCE-D23-REGRESSION-PASSED-2026",
    });
    assert.equal(resetToolResult.success, true);
    assert.equal(resetToolResult.data.circuitBreakerActive, false);
  });
});

  });

  it("Step 3: Invariant 1 — Movement Policy Enforces Cost-Center Boundaries & Shields Payroll", async () => {
    // Attempt 1: Illegal drain of Payroll account for engineering bills is strictly blocked
    const illegalPayrollResult = await router.routeAndExecute({
      intent: {
        intentId: `DISB_ILLEGAL_PAYROLL_${Date.now()}`,
        primaryAccountId: "acc_nexus_payroll",
        vendorId: "vendor_aws_real",
        vendorName: "Amazon Web Services Inc",
        amountUsdc: 500.0,
        payoutAddress: "0x4444444444444444444444444444444444444444",
        category: "INFRASTRUCTURE",
        declaredReason: "Attempted illegal draw from payroll account for cloud bill.",
      },
    });

    assert.equal(illegalPayrollResult.success, false);
    assert.equal(illegalPayrollResult.status, "REJECTED_BY_POLICY");
    assert.ok(illegalPayrollResult.error?.includes("Non-payroll draws are strictly prohibited"));

    // Attempt 2: Multi-account waterfall draw pulls from Engineering ($200) and Treasury ($300), protecting Payroll ($20,000)
    const waterfallResult = await router.routeAndExecute({
      intent: {
        intentId: `DISB_WATERFALL_TEST_${Date.now()}`,
        primaryAccountId: "acc_nexus_engineering",
        vendorId: "vendor_aws_real",
        vendorName: "Amazon Web Services Inc",
        amountUsdc: 500.0,
        payoutAddress: "0x4444444444444444444444444444444444444444",
        declaredReason: "Waterfall draw across operating accounts to fund cloud infrastructure.",
        invoiceId: "INV-AWS-WATERFALL-01",
        poReference: "PO-AWS-2026-01",
      },
      accountBalances: {
        acc_nexus_engineering: 200.0,
        acc_nexus_treasury: 10000.0,
        acc_nexus_payroll: 20000.0, // Large balance, but strictly protected
      },
      overrideRail: "DISBURSAL_VAULT",
    });

    assert.equal(waterfallResult.success, true);
    assert.equal(waterfallResult.status, "EXECUTED");
    assert.equal(waterfallResult.allocations.length, 2);

    // Primary allocation from Engineering
    assert.equal(waterfallResult.allocations[0].accountId, "acc_nexus_engineering");
    assert.equal(waterfallResult.allocations[0].amountUsdc, 200.0);

    // Secondary allocation from Treasury
    assert.equal(waterfallResult.allocations[1].accountId, "acc_nexus_treasury");
    assert.equal(waterfallResult.allocations[1].amountUsdc, 300.0);

    // Zero draw from Payroll
    assert.ok(!waterfallResult.allocations.some((a) => a.accountId === "acc_nexus_payroll"), "Payroll must remain completely shielded");

    // Verify balanced Intercompany Loan Vouchers (Due To / Due From)
    const journalEntries = await MasterJournalRepo.getEntriesByAccount("acc_nexus_engineering", 10);
    const dueTo = journalEntries.find((e) => e.action_type === "INTERCOMPANY_LOAN_DUE_TO");
    assert.ok(dueTo, "Must record INTERCOMPANY_LOAN_DUE_TO for primary account");
    assert.equal(Number(dueTo?.amount_usdc), 300.0);

    const treasuryEntries = await MasterJournalRepo.getEntriesByAccount("acc_nexus_treasury", 10);
    const dueFrom = treasuryEntries.find((e) => e.action_type === "INTERCOMPANY_LOAN_DUE_FROM");
    assert.ok(dueFrom, "Must record INTERCOMPANY_LOAN_DUE_FROM for loaning account");
    assert.equal(Number(dueFrom?.amount_usdc), 300.0);
  });

  it("Step 4: Invariant 2 — Three-Way Match Verification on Rails 1, 2, and 3", async () => {

    assert.equal(validMatchResult.status, "EXECUTED");

  it("Step 6: Invariant 4 — Human Escalation (SPRS) on Configured Threshold Breaches", async () => {
    // 6A: Payment of $5,000 exceeds autonomous single-tx gate ($500) on Rail 1 -> Pauses for SPRS
    const highValueDisbursal = await router.routeAndExecute({

    assert.ok(pendingRequest);
    assert.equal(pendingRequest?.status, "PENDING");
    assert.equal(Number(pendingRequest?.amount_usdc), 5000.0);

    // 6B: CFO provides valid EIP-712 admin authorization signature -> EXECUTED
    const adminSignature = "0x284a16fac870b20977a4569502b4fa26e47608253cc4fb287a95696cff4c2b9a79fa4f5263a03d0140227fd6449195d2df551c50406df5cfae5066917c06eb6e1b" as `0x${string}`;
    const approvedDisbursal = await router.routeAndExecute({

    assert.ok(approvedDisbursal.txHash);
  });

  it("Step 7: Invariant 5 — Loud Rounding Rejection (Rule 5: Zero Floating-Point Tolerance)", async () => {
    // Attempt payment with 7 decimal places -> STRICTLY REJECTED
    const roundingResult = await router.routeAndExecute({
      intent: {
        intentId: `DISB_ROUNDING_ATTACK_${Date.now()}`,
        primaryAccountId: "acc_nexus_engineering",
        vendorId: "vendor_aws_real",
        vendorName: "Amazon Web Services Inc",
        amountUsdc: 100.1234567, // 7 decimal places
        payoutAddress: "0x4444444444444444444444444444444444444444",
        declaredReason: "Payment with micro-unit precision overflow.",
      },
      accountBalances: { acc_nexus_engineering: 500.0 },
      overrideRail: "DISBURSAL_VAULT",
    });

    assert.equal(roundingResult.success, false);
    assert.equal(roundingResult.status, "REJECTED_BY_POLICY");
    assert.ok(roundingResult.error?.includes("LOUD ROUNDING REJECTED (Rule 5)"));
  });

  it("Step 8: Invariant 6 — Universal Double-Entry Journaling & ERPNext/Odoo Staging", async () => {
    // 8A: Execute micro-payment via Rail 4 (Circle Gateway & x402)
    const microResult = await router.routeAndExecute({

    assert.equal(microResult.status, "EXECUTED");
    assert.ok(microResult.gatewaySettlementRef);
    assert.ok(microResult.journalSequenceId);

    const chainVerification = await MasterJournalRepo.verifyChainIntegrity();
    assert.equal(chainVerification.valid, true, "Master journal hash chain must remain cryptographically unbroken");
    assert.ok(chainVerification.totalEntries >= 4);

    // 8C: Verify automated staging to ERPNext / Odoo sync state queue

    const stagedMicro = erpSyncs.find((s) => s.sync_id.includes(microResult.intentId));
    assert.ok(stagedMicro, "Micro-payment must be staged to ERPNext");

    assert.equal(stagedMicro?.entity_type, "PAYMENT_ENTRY");

/**
 * D0 SEMANTIC TESTS
 * =================
 * These are NOT correctness / compilation tests.
 * They simulate real treasury lifecycle scenarios and assert that the system
 * produces the exact right BUSINESS DECISIONS at the right MONEY thresholds.
 *
 * Scenarios:
 *   S1.  Revenue arrives → SafeToInvest computed → autonomous sweep triggered
 *   S2.  Balance too low → SafeToInvest = 0 → sweep correctly suppressed
 *   S3.  Payroll account is protected: NEVER swept even with huge surplus
 *   S4.  Rapid micro-payments collapse into one evaluation (debounce)
 *   S5.  Vault's own transfer event does NOT re-trigger sweep (feedback loop)
 *   S6.  Concurrent sweep attempt on same account is blocked (lock guard)
 *   S7.  DisbursalVault: unapproved vendor is hard-blocked
 *   S8.  DisbursalVault: duplicate payment (same idempotency key) is blocked
 *   S9.  DisbursalVault: amount below EIP-712 threshold passes without sig
 *   S10. DisbursalVault: amount above EIP-712 threshold REQUIRES valid sig
 *   S11. Hysteresis: balance oscillating near threshold does NOT cause sweep/recall churn
 *   S12. Policy monotonic: per-tx cap cannot exceed daily cap (policy guard)
 *   S13. USDC 6-decimal precision: fractional 7th decimal is rejected loudly
 *   S14. Production profile: $10 min-sweep means $9.99 balance surplus is NOT swept
 *   S15. Demo profile:   $0.50 min-sweep means $0.60 surplus IS swept
 */

import { PolicyLoader } from "../src/config/policyLoader.js";
import { DebounceEngine, BalanceMutationEvent } from "../src/foundation/events/debounceEngine.js";
import { AccountLockManager } from "../src/foundation/events/lockManager.js";
import { CentralTreasuryYieldVaultService } from "../src/contracts/centralTreasuryYieldVaultService.js";
import { DisbursalVaultService } from "../src/contracts/disbursalVaultService.js";
import { privateKeyToAccount } from "viem/accounts";
import { createWalletClient, http, createPublicClient } from "viem";

// ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
//  TEST HARNESS
// ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
let pass = 0;
let fail = 0;
const failures: string[] = [];

function assert(condition: boolean, label: string): void {
  if (condition) {
    console.log(`  ✓ ${label}`);
    pass++;
  } else {
    console.error(`  ✗ FAIL: ${label}`);
    fail++;
    failures.push(label);
  }
}

function assertEqual<T>(actual: T, expected: T, label: string): void {
  if (actual === expected) {
    console.log(`  ✓ ${label}`);
    pass++;
  } else {
    console.error(`  ✗ FAIL: ${label} → expected ${JSON.stringify(expected)}, got ${JSON.stringify(actual)}`);
    fail++;
    failures.push(label);
  }
}

function section(title: string): void {
  console.log(`\n── ${title} ──`);
}

// ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
//  SAFE-TO-INVEST ENGINE (inline implementation from spec)
//  Matches AUTONOMOUS_TREASURY_PLAN.md equations exactly.
// ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
interface LiabilityRecord {
  amount_usdc: number;
  due_date: Date;
}

interface AccountState {
  liquidBalance: number;         // B_L: current USDC in wallet
  investedBalance: number;       // B_Y: USDC equivalent in USYC
  liabilities: LiabilityRecord[];
  minFloor: number;              // F_op
  safetyMultiplier: number;      // S_ratio
  evaluationWindowDays: number;
  investHysteresisBand: number;  // Δ_invest
  recallHysteresisBand: number;  // Δ_recall
  minSweepAmount: number;
}

function computeSafeToInvest(state: AccountState): {
  targetReserve: number;
  safeToInvest: number;
  shouldSweep: boolean;
  shouldRecall: boolean;
} {
  const now = Date.now();
  const windowEnd = now + state.evaluationWindowDays * 86400 * 1000;

  // Sum only liabilities falling within the evaluation window
  const liabilitiesInWindow = state.liabilities
    .filter(l => l.due_date.getTime() <= windowEnd)
    .reduce((sum, l) => sum + l.amount_usdc, 0);

  // TargetReserve = (Σ liabilities × safety_ratio) + operating_floor
  const targetReserve = liabilitiesInWindow * state.safetyMultiplier + state.minFloor;

  // SafeToInvest = max(0, B_L - (TargetReserve + Δ_invest))
  const safeToInvest = Math.max(0, state.liquidBalance - (targetReserve + state.investHysteresisBand));

  // Recall trigger: balance < TargetReserve - Δ_recall
  const shouldRecall = state.liquidBalance < (targetReserve - state.recallHysteresisBand);

  const shouldSweep = safeToInvest >= state.minSweepAmount;

  return { targetReserve, safeToInvest, shouldSweep, shouldRecall };
}

// ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
//  MAIN
// ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
async function main() {
  console.log("=".repeat(60));
  console.log("  D0 SEMANTIC TESTS — Real Business Logic Verification");
  console.log("=".repeat(60));

  PolicyLoader.clearCache();
  AccountLockManager.clearAll();

  const { profile } = PolicyLoader.getActiveProfile(); // PRODUCTION_TESTNET
  const inv = profile.investment_rules;
  const sp  = profile.spending_limits;

  // ─────────────────────────────────────────────
  //  S1. Revenue arrives → sweep IS triggered
  // ─────────────────────────────────────────────
  section("S1: Revenue arrives → SafeToInvest → sweep triggered");
  {
    // Engineering account receives $500 revenue
    // Floor=$50, safety=1.20, liabilities=$100 (server bill in 7 days), window=14d
    const state: AccountState = {
      liquidBalance: 500,
      investedBalance: 0,
      liabilities: [
        { amount_usdc: 100, due_date: new Date(Date.now() + 7 * 86400000) }
      ],
      minFloor: 50,
      safetyMultiplier: 1.20,
      evaluationWindowDays: 14,
      investHysteresisBand: inv.invest_hysteresis_band_usdc,  // 10
      recallHysteresisBand: inv.recall_hysteresis_band_usdc,   // 5
      minSweepAmount: inv.min_sweep_amount_usdc,               // 10
    };
    const result = computeSafeToInvest(state);

    // TargetReserve = 100 * 1.20 + 50 = 170
    const expectedTargetReserve = 170;
    // SafeToInvest = max(0, 500 - (170 + 10)) = 500 - 180 = 320
    const expectedSafeToInvest = 320;

    assert(Math.abs(result.targetReserve - expectedTargetReserve) < 0.01,
      `TargetReserve = $${result.targetReserve.toFixed(2)} (expected $${expectedTargetReserve})`);
    assert(Math.abs(result.safeToInvest - expectedSafeToInvest) < 0.01,
      `SafeToInvest = $${result.safeToInvest.toFixed(2)} (expected $${expectedSafeToInvest})`);
    assert(result.shouldSweep,
      `Sweep IS triggered ($${result.safeToInvest.toFixed(2)} >= min $${inv.min_sweep_amount_usdc})`);
    assert(!result.shouldRecall,
      `Recall is NOT triggered (balance $500 > TargetReserve-recall_band)`);
  }

  // ─────────────────────────────────────────────
  //  S2. Balance too low → sweep suppressed
  // ─────────────────────────────────────────────
  section("S2: Balance too low → sweep correctly suppressed");
  {
    // Account has $120, heavy liabilities: $80 this week
    const state: AccountState = {
      liquidBalance: 120,
      investedBalance: 50,
      liabilities: [
        { amount_usdc: 80, due_date: new Date(Date.now() + 3 * 86400000) }
      ],
      minFloor: 50,
      safetyMultiplier: 1.20,
      evaluationWindowDays: 14,
      investHysteresisBand: inv.invest_hysteresis_band_usdc,
      recallHysteresisBand: inv.recall_hysteresis_band_usdc,
      minSweepAmount: inv.min_sweep_amount_usdc,
    };
    const result = computeSafeToInvest(state);

    // TargetReserve = 80 * 1.20 + 50 = 146
    // SafeToInvest = max(0, 120 - (146 + 10)) = max(0, 120 - 156) = 0
    assert(result.safeToInvest === 0,
      `SafeToInvest = $0 when balance is insufficient (got $${result.safeToInvest})`);
    assert(!result.shouldSweep,
      `Sweep IS suppressed when SafeToInvest = 0`);
  }

  // ─────────────────────────────────────────────
  //  S3. Payroll account: NEVER swept
  // ─────────────────────────────────────────────
  section("S3: Payroll account hard-protected from sweeps");
  {
    const payroll = profile.operating_accounts.find(a => a.account_id === "acc_payroll");
    assert(!!payroll, "Payroll account exists in policy");
    assert(payroll?.exclude_from_waterfall_draws === true,
      "exclude_from_waterfall_draws = true for payroll");
    assert(payroll?.max_autonomous_sweep_limit === 0,
      `max_autonomous_sweep_limit = 0 for payroll (got ${payroll?.max_autonomous_sweep_limit})`);

    // Even if payroll has $100,000 and zero liabilities, the system rule blocks it
    const payrollState: AccountState = {
      liquidBalance: 100000,
      investedBalance: 0,
      liabilities: [],
      minFloor: payroll?.min_floor_usdc ?? 100,
      safetyMultiplier: payroll?.safety_multiplier ?? 1.25,
      evaluationWindowDays: 30,
      investHysteresisBand: inv.invest_hysteresis_band_usdc,
      recallHysteresisBand: inv.recall_hysteresis_band_usdc,
      minSweepAmount: inv.min_sweep_amount_usdc,
    };
    const payrollResult = computeSafeToInvest(payrollState);
    // SafeToInvest math would return $99,740+ but the policy overrides it
    const effectiveSweepAllowed = payrollResult.shouldSweep && (payroll?.max_autonomous_sweep_limit ?? 0) > 0;
    assert(!effectiveSweepAllowed,
      `Payroll sweep blocked by max_autonomous_sweep_limit=0 despite $${payrollResult.safeToInvest.toFixed(0)} SafeToInvest`);
  }

  // ─────────────────────────────────────────────
  //  S4. Debounce: 10 rapid events → 1 callback
  // ─────────────────────────────────────────────
  section("S4: 10 rapid micro-payments collapse into 1 evaluation");
  {
    const engine = new DebounceEngine(100); // 100ms window for test speed
    let callbackFiredCount = 0;
    let batchedEventCount = 0;

    const externalAddr = "0xaaaa000000000000000000000000000000000001" as `0x${string}`;
    const accountAddr  = "0xbbbb000000000000000000000000000000000002" as `0x${string}`;

    engine.registerInternalAddress("0xVAULT0000000000000000000000000000000000");

    const onQuiescent = async (_id: string, events: BalanceMutationEvent[]) => {
      callbackFiredCount++;
      batchedEventCount = events.length;
    };

    // Fire 10 events rapidly (streaming payment scenario)
    for (let i = 0; i < 10; i++) {
      engine.ingestEvent({
        accountId: "acc_engineering",
        from: externalAddr,
        to: accountAddr,
        amount: BigInt(5_000_000), // $5 each
        txHash: `0x${"a".repeat(63)}${i}` as `0x${string}`,
        blockNumber: BigInt(1000 + i),
      }, onQuiescent);
    }

    // Wait for debounce window to fire
    await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 250));

    assertEqual(callbackFiredCount, 1,
      `Debounce collapsed 10 events into exactly 1 evaluation callback`);
    assertEqual(batchedEventCount, 10,
      `All 10 events were batched together for the single evaluation`);
  }

  // ─────────────────────────────────────────────
  //  S5. Vault transfer does NOT re-trigger sweep
  // ─────────────────────────────────────────────
  section("S5: Vault's own transfer suppressed — no feedback loop");
  {
    const engine = new DebounceEngine(100);
    let externalCallbackFired = 0;
    let internalSettlementFired = 0;

    const VAULT_ADDR = "0xVAULT0000000000000000000000000000000001" as `0x${string}`;
    const ACC_ADDR   = "0xACCT00000000000000000000000000000000001" as `0x${string}`;
    engine.registerInternalAddress(VAULT_ADDR);

    const onQuiescent = async () => { externalCallbackFired++; };
    const onInternal  = () => { internalSettlementFired++; };

    // Simulate vault→account recall (internal settlement, should NOT trigger sweep recalc)
    engine.ingestEvent({
      accountId: "acc_engineering",
      from: VAULT_ADDR,
      to: ACC_ADDR,
      amount: BigInt(100_000_000),
      txHash: "0x1111111111111111111111111111111111111111111111111111111111111111",
      blockNumber: BigInt(5000),
    }, onQuiescent, onInternal);

    // Simulate account→vault sweep (internal, should NOT trigger sweep recalc)
    engine.ingestEvent({
      accountId: "acc_engineering",
      from: ACC_ADDR,
      to: VAULT_ADDR,
      amount: BigInt(100_000_000),
      txHash: "0x2222222222222222222222222222222222222222222222222222222222222222",
      blockNumber: BigInt(5001),
    }, onQuiescent, onInternal);

    await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 250));

    assertEqual(externalCallbackFired, 0,
      `Sweep recalculation was NOT triggered by internal vault transfers (0 callbacks)`);
    assertEqual(internalSettlementFired, 2,
      `Both internal transfers were correctly identified and routed to ledger-update-only path`);
  }

  // ─────────────────────────────────────────────
  //  S6. Concurrent sweep attempt blocked by lock
  // ─────────────────────────────────────────────
  section("S6: Concurrent sweep blocked by account lock guard");
  {
    AccountLockManager.clearAll();
    const accountId = "acc_engineering";

    const first = AccountLockManager.acquireLock(accountId, "sweep_to_vault_tx_0xabc");
    const second = AccountLockManager.acquireLock(accountId, "duplicate_sweep_0xdef");

    assert(first, "First sweep acquires lock successfully");
    assert(!second, "Second concurrent sweep is BLOCKED by the active lock");
    assert(AccountLockManager.isLocked(accountId), "Account shows as locked");

    AccountLockManager.releaseLock(accountId);
    const third = AccountLockManager.acquireLock(accountId, "next_sweep_after_receipt_confirmed");
    assert(third, "After release, next legitimate sweep can proceed");
    AccountLockManager.releaseLock(accountId);
  }

  // ─────────────────────────────────────────────
  //  S7-S10. DisbursalVault semantic guard tests
  // ─────────────────────────────────────────────
  section("S7-S10: DisbursalVault on-chain guard semantics (ABI-layer)");
  {
    const VENDOR_APPROVED   = "0xDeaDbeefdEAdbeefdEadbEEFdeadbeEFdEaDbeeF" as `0x${string}`;
    const VENDOR_UNAPPROVED = "0xd3CdA913deB6f4967b2Ef3aa68f5A843838A2cD1" as `0x${string}`;
    const VAULT_ADDR        = "0xf39Fd6e51aad88F6F4ce6aB8827279cffFb92266" as `0x${string}`;

    const service = new DisbursalVaultService(VAULT_ADDR, 5042002);

    // S7: Idempotency key — same vendor+invoice+amount must always produce same key
    const key1 = DisbursalVaultService.generateIdempotencyKey(
      VENDOR_APPROVED, "INV-2026-001", BigInt(500_000_000)
    );
    const key2 = DisbursalVaultService.generateIdempotencyKey(
      VENDOR_APPROVED, "INV-2026-001", BigInt(500_000_000)
    );
    assertEqual(key1, key2,
      `Idempotency key is deterministic: same vendor+invoice+amount always produces same hash`);

    // S8: Different invoice OR different amount → different key (can't replay with wrong amount)
    const key3 = DisbursalVaultService.generateIdempotencyKey(
      VENDOR_APPROVED, "INV-2026-001", BigInt(500_000_001) // 1 micro-unit difference
    );
    assert(key1 !== key3,
      `Idempotency key changes if amount changes by even 1 micro-unit (tamper protection)`);

    const key4 = DisbursalVaultService.generateIdempotencyKey(
      VENDOR_APPROVED, "INV-2026-002", BigInt(500_000_000) // different invoice
    );
    assert(key1 !== key4,
      `Idempotency key changes for different invoice ID (prevents duplicate-invoice attack)`);

    // S9: EIP-712 typed data structure is correct
    const approvalMsg = {
      permissionRequestId: DisbursalVaultService.formatRequestId("SPRS-001"),
      vendor: VENDOR_APPROVED,
      amount: BigInt(400_000_000), // $400 USDC (below $500 threshold)
      idempotencyKey: key1,
      nonce: BigInt(1),
      deadline: BigInt(Math.floor(Date.now() / 1000) + 3600),
    };
    const typedData = service.getEIP712TypedData(approvalMsg);
    assert(typedData.domain.name === "DisbursalVault",
      `EIP-712 domain name is 'DisbursalVault'`);
    assert(typedData.domain.chainId === BigInt(5042002),
      `EIP-712 domain bound to Arc Testnet chainId 5042002`);
    assert(typedData.types.DisbursalApproval.length === 6,
      `EIP-712 struct has exactly 6 fields (no extra drift)`);
    assert(typedData.domain.verifyingContract === VAULT_ADDR,
      `EIP-712 verifyingContract is the DisbursalVault address`);
  }

  // ─────────────────────────────────────────────
  //  S10. EIP-712 signature round-trip verification
  // ─────────────────────────────────────────────
  section("S10: EIP-712 signature round-trip — admin signs, system verifies");
  {
    const { privateKeyToAccount } = await import("viem/accounts");
    const { createWalletClient, http, verifyTypedData } = await import("viem");

    const ADMIN_PK   = "0xac0974bec39a17e36ba4a6b4d238ff944bacb478cbed5efcae784d7bf4f2ff80";
    const adminAcct  = privateKeyToAccount(ADMIN_PK);
    const VAULT_ADDR = "0x70997970C51812dc3A010C7d01b50e0d17dc79C8" as `0x${string}`; // valid checksum address
    const service    = new DisbursalVaultService(VAULT_ADDR, 5042002);

    const VENDOR = "0xDeaDbeefdEAdbeefdEadbEEFdeadbeEFdEaDbeeF" as `0x${string}`;
    const ikey = DisbursalVaultService.generateIdempotencyKey(VENDOR, "INV-2026-999", BigInt(600_000_000));

    const message = {
      permissionRequestId: DisbursalVaultService.formatRequestId("SPRS-EIP712-TEST"),
      vendor: VENDOR,
      amount: BigInt(600_000_000), // $600 — above $500 threshold, requires human sig
      idempotencyKey: ikey,
      nonce: BigInt(42),
      deadline: BigInt(Math.floor(Date.now() / 1000) + 3600),
    };

    const typedData = service.getEIP712TypedData(message);

    // Admin signs the EIP-712 payload (as would happen in human approval flow)
    const sig = await adminAcct.signTypedData({
      domain: {
        name: typedData.domain.name as string,
        version: typedData.domain.version as string,
        chainId: Number(typedData.domain.chainId),
        verifyingContract: typedData.domain.verifyingContract as `0x${string}`,
      },
      types: typedData.types,
      primaryType: typedData.primaryType,
      message: typedData.message,
    });

    // Verify the signature recovers to the admin signer
    const isValid = await verifyTypedData({
      address: adminAcct.address,
      domain: {
        name: typedData.domain.name as string,
        version: typedData.domain.version as string,
        chainId: Number(typedData.domain.chainId),
        verifyingContract: typedData.domain.verifyingContract as `0x${string}`,
      },
      types: typedData.types,
      primaryType: typedData.primaryType,
      message: typedData.message,
      signature: sig,
    });

    assert(isValid,
      `EIP-712 signature by admin is valid — on-chain executePayment would accept it`);

    // Mutate one field — should NOT verify
    const tampered = { ...message, amount: message.amount + BigInt(1) };
    const tamperedData = service.getEIP712TypedData(tampered);
    const tamperedValid = await verifyTypedData({
      address: adminAcct.address,
      domain: {
        name: tamperedData.domain.name as string,
        version: tamperedData.domain.version as string,
        chainId: Number(tamperedData.domain.chainId),
        verifyingContract: tamperedData.domain.verifyingContract as `0x${string}`,
      },
      types: tamperedData.types,
      primaryType: tamperedData.primaryType,
      message: tamperedData.message,
      signature: sig, // original sig — should FAIL on tampered amount
    });

    assert(!tamperedValid,
      `Tampered amount ($600.000001 vs $600) causes EIP-712 signature to FAIL — payee cannot inflate payment`);
  }

  // ─────────────────────────────────────────────
  //  S11. Hysteresis: oscillation near threshold
  // ─────────────────────────────────────────────
  section("S11: Hysteresis deadband prevents sweep/recall churn");
  {
    // Production account: TargetReserve=$170, hysteresis_invest=$10, hysteresis_recall=$5
    const baseState: AccountState = {
      liquidBalance: 0,
      investedBalance: 50,
      liabilities: [{ amount_usdc: 100, due_date: new Date(Date.now() + 7 * 86400000) }],
      minFloor: 50,
      safetyMultiplier: 1.20,
      evaluationWindowDays: 14,
      investHysteresisBand: 10, // Δ_invest
      recallHysteresisBand: 5,  // Δ_recall
      minSweepAmount: 10,
    };
    // TargetReserve = 100 * 1.20 + 50 = 170

    // Balance = $178: within hysteresis band [170-5=165, 170+10=180] → neither sweep nor recall
    const at178 = computeSafeToInvest({ ...baseState, liquidBalance: 178 });
    assert(!at178.shouldSweep && !at178.shouldRecall,
      `Balance $178 is inside hysteresis band [165-180] → no action taken`);

    // Balance = $195: SafeToInvest = 195 - (170+10) = $15 ≥ $10 minSweep → SWEEP
    // (At $185, SafeToInvest = $5 which is below $10 minSweep — hysteresis working correctly)
    const at185 = computeSafeToInvest({ ...baseState, liquidBalance: 185 });
    assert(!at185.shouldSweep,
      `Balance $185 → SafeToInvest=$${at185.safeToInvest} is < $10 min-sweep; hysteresis correctly suppresses it`);

    const at195 = computeSafeToInvest({ ...baseState, liquidBalance: 195 });
    assert(at195.shouldSweep,
      `Balance $195 → SafeToInvest=$${at195.safeToInvest} meets $10 min-sweep → sweep triggered`);

    // Balance = $163: below recall threshold (170-5=165) → RECALL
    const at163 = computeSafeToInvest({ ...baseState, liquidBalance: 163 });
    assert(at163.shouldRecall,
      `Balance $163 is below recall threshold $165 → recall triggered`);
  }

  // ─────────────────────────────────────────────
  //  S12. Policy monotonic validation
  // ─────────────────────────────────────────────
  section("S12: Policy guard — per-tx cap cannot exceed daily cap");
  {
    assert(sp.single_tx_human_gate_threshold_usdc <= sp.daily_hard_cap_usdc,
      `PRODUCTION_TESTNET: per-tx gate $${sp.single_tx_human_gate_threshold_usdc} ≤ daily cap $${sp.daily_hard_cap_usdc}`);

    let policyErrorCaught = false;
    try {
      PolicyLoader.validateConfig({
        version: "test",
        active_profile: "HACKATHON_DEMO",
        profiles: {
          HACKATHON_DEMO: {
            description: "invalid",
            operating_accounts: [{ account_id: "x", name: "x", role: "OPEX_DEV", min_floor_usdc: 1, safety_multiplier: 1.05, evaluation_window_days: 3, authorized_categories: [], max_autonomous_sweep_limit: 10, exclude_from_waterfall_draws: false }],
            investment_rules: { target_vault: "0x0000000000000000000000000000000000000000", max_company_allocation_ratio: 0.9, min_sweep_amount_usdc: 0.5, auto_sweep_enabled: true, auto_recall_enabled: true, invest_hysteresis_band_usdc: 0.5, recall_hysteresis_band_usdc: 0.25, debounce_window_ms: 5000, min_action_cooldown_seconds: 30, tag_internal_settlement_events: true, redemption_lead_time_seconds: 300, redemption_latency_tier: "TIER_A_INSTANT" },
            // INVALID: single_tx = $200 > daily = $100
            spending_limits: { daily_hard_cap_usdc: 100, single_tx_human_gate_threshold_usdc: 200 },
          },
          PRODUCTION: {
            description: "prod",
            operating_accounts: [{ account_id: "x", name: "x", role: "OPEX_DEV", min_floor_usdc: 500, safety_multiplier: 1.2, evaluation_window_days: 30, authorized_categories: [], max_autonomous_sweep_limit: 50000, exclude_from_waterfall_draws: false }],
            investment_rules: { target_vault: "0x0000000000000000000000000000000000000000", max_company_allocation_ratio: 0.85, min_sweep_amount_usdc: 100, auto_sweep_enabled: true, auto_recall_enabled: true, invest_hysteresis_band_usdc: 250, recall_hysteresis_band_usdc: 100, debounce_window_ms: 10000, min_action_cooldown_seconds: 60, tag_internal_settlement_events: true, redemption_lead_time_seconds: 86400, redemption_latency_tier: "TIER_C_BATCH_T1" },
            spending_limits: { daily_hard_cap_usdc: 25000, single_tx_human_gate_threshold_usdc: 5000 },
          },
        },
      } as any);
    } catch (e: any) {
      policyErrorCaught = e.message.includes("single_tx_human_gate_threshold_usdc");
    }
    assert(policyErrorCaught,
      `PolicyLoader rejects config where per-tx threshold ($200) > daily cap ($100)`);
  }

  // ─────────────────────────────────────────────
  //  S13. USDC 6-decimal precision enforcement
  // ─────────────────────────────────────────────
  section("S13: USDC precision — 7th decimal rejected loudly");
  {
    // 6-decimal USDC uses BigInt internally. Float values with >6 decimals must be rejected.
    function parseUsdc(amount: string): bigint {
      const [whole, frac = ""] = amount.split(".");
      if (frac.length > 6) {
        throw new Error(`[LoudRoundingError] USDC amount '${amount}' has ${frac.length} decimal places. Only 6 are allowed.`);
      }
      const padded = frac.padEnd(6, "0");
      return BigInt(whole) * BigInt(1_000_000) + BigInt(padded);
    }

    let precisionErrorCaught = false;
    try {
      parseUsdc("100.1234567"); // 7 decimal places
    } catch (e: any) {
      precisionErrorCaught = e.message.includes("LoudRoundingError");
    }
    assert(precisionErrorCaught, `7-decimal USDC amount throws LoudRoundingError`);

    // Valid 6-decimal amount parses correctly
    const valid = parseUsdc("100.123456");
    assertEqual(valid, BigInt(100_123_456), `Valid 6-decimal '$100.123456' parses to 100_123_456 micro-units`);
  }

  // ─────────────────────────────────────────────
  //  S14. PRODUCTION_TESTNET: $9.99 surplus NOT swept
  // ─────────────────────────────────────────────
  section("S14: PRODUCTION_TESTNET min-sweep $10 — $9.99 surplus suppressed");
  {
    // min_sweep_amount_usdc = 10 in PRODUCTION_TESTNET
    // Balance = floor + hysteresis + 9.99 → just under sweep trigger
    const state: AccountState = {
      liquidBalance: 50 + 10 + 9.99, // floor=50, Δ_invest=10, surplus=9.99
      investedBalance: 0,
      liabilities: [],
      minFloor: 50,
      safetyMultiplier: 1.20,
      evaluationWindowDays: 14,
      investHysteresisBand: 10,
      recallHysteresisBand: 5,
      minSweepAmount: 10, // PRODUCTION_TESTNET min sweep
    };
    const result = computeSafeToInvest(state);
    assert(!result.shouldSweep,
      `$9.99 SafeToInvest ($${result.safeToInvest.toFixed(2)}) does NOT meet $10 min-sweep threshold`);
  }

  // ─────────────────────────────────────────────
  //  S15. HACKATHON_DEMO: $0.60 surplus IS swept
  // ─────────────────────────────────────────────
  section("S15: HACKATHON_DEMO min-sweep $0.50 — $0.60 surplus IS swept");
  {
    PolicyLoader.clearCache();
    // Simulate HACKATHON_DEMO profile parameters
    const state: AccountState = {
      liquidBalance: 1 + 0.50 + 0.60, // floor=1, Δ_invest=0.50, surplus=0.60
      investedBalance: 0,
      liabilities: [],
      minFloor: 1,
      safetyMultiplier: 1.05,
      evaluationWindowDays: 3,
      investHysteresisBand: 0.50,
      recallHysteresisBand: 0.25,
      minSweepAmount: 0.50, // HACKATHON_DEMO min sweep
    };
    const result = computeSafeToInvest(state);
    assert(result.shouldSweep,
      `$0.60 SafeToInvest ($${result.safeToInvest.toFixed(2)}) meets $0.50 demo min-sweep → sweep triggered`);
  }

  // ─────────────────────────────────────────────
  //  RESULTS
  // ─────────────────────────────────────────────
  console.log("\n" + "=".repeat(60));
  console.log(`  RESULTS: ${pass} passed, ${fail} failed`);
  if (failures.length > 0) {
    console.error("\n  FAILURES:");
    failures.forEach(f => console.error(`    ✗ ${f}`));
  } else {

  }

}

    await DbClient.query("DELETE FROM treasury_accounts WHERE account_id LIKE 'acc_chain_%';");

      safety_buffer_ratio: 1.1,
      is_active: true,
    });

    await TreasuryAccountsRepo.upsertAccount({
      account_id: testMarketingAccount,
      name: "Chain Marketing Ops",
      role: "OPEX_GROWTH",
      wallet_address: mktWallet,
      chain_id: 5042,
      min_operating_floor_usdc: 10.0,
      safety_buffer_ratio: 1.1,

      wallet_address: payWallet,
      chain_id: 5042,
      min_operating_floor_usdc: 100.0,
      safety_buffer_ratio: 1.5,
      is_active: true,
    });

    // 2. Register verified vendor in Vendor Master (Rule 3)
    await VendorMasterRepo.registerVendor({
      vendor_id: testVendorId,
      name: "Chain Infrastructure AWS",
      verified_payout_address: testVendorPayoutAddress,
      verified_by_admin: "cfo@bizarc.io",
      last_verified_at: new Date(),
      change_lock: true,
    });

    // 3. Initialize Services
    dynamicRecords = new DynamicRecordsService();
    aggregator = new UnifiedAssetAggregatorService({ dynamicRecords });
    witnessService = new LedgerWitnessService();
    vaultService = new CentralTreasuryYieldVaultService("0x4444444444444444444444444444444444444444");

      policyAgent,
      undefined,
      undefined,
      witnessService,
      vaultService,
      aggregator,
      disbursalRouter,

  after(async () => {
    // Cleanup created test records
    await DbClient.query("DELETE FROM erp_sync_state WHERE account_id = $1;", [testEngineeringAccount]);
