      testEngineeringAccount,
      testMarketingAccount,
      testPayrollAccount,
    ]);
    await DbClient.query("DELETE FROM account_agent_audit_log WHERE account_id IN ($1, $2, $3);", [
      testEngineeringAccount,
      testMarketingAccount,
      testPayrollAccount,
    ]);
    await DbClient.query("DELETE FROM account_liabilities WHERE account_id IN ($1, $2, $3);", [
      testEngineeringAccount,
      testMarketingAccount,
      testPayrollAccount,
    ]);
    await DbClient.query("DELETE FROM dynamic_safe_to_invest WHERE account_id IN ($1, $2, $3);", [
      testEngineeringAccount,
      testMarketingAccount,
      testPayrollAccount,
    ]);
    await DbClient.query("DELETE FROM vendor_master_registry WHERE vendor_id = $1;", [testVendorId]);
    await DbClient.query("DELETE FROM treasury_accounts WHERE account_id IN ($1, $2, $3);", [
      testEngineeringAccount,
      testMarketingAccount,
      testPayrollAccount,
    ]);
  });

  // ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  // 1. D16: PolicyComplianceAgent & AuthorizationGate
  // ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

  it("D16-1: Permitted inside-the-rules action receives Layer 1 clearance code and token", async () => {
    const authResult = await AuthorizationGate.requestAuthorization({
      actionType: "DISBURSAL_SETTLEMENT",
      accountId: testEngineeringAccount,
      amountUsdc: "25.000000",
      declaredReason: "Monthly AWS cloud computing and container clusters (PO-AWS-2026-01).",
      recipientAddress: testVendorPayoutAddress,
    });

    assert.equal(authResult.isAuthorized, true);
    assert.equal(authResult.layer, "ENFORCER_AGENT");
    assert.ok(authResult.clearanceCode?.startsWith("CLEAR-"));
  });

  it("D16-2: Payee substitution attempt (Rule 3) is strictly DENIED", async () => {
    const authResult = await AuthorizationGate.requestAuthorization({
      actionType: "DISBURSAL_SETTLEMENT",
      accountId: testEngineeringAccount,
      amountUsdc: "25.000000",
      declaredReason: "Rogue payout to unverified third-party address.",
      recipientAddress: testVendorUnverifiedAddress,
    });

    assert.equal(authResult.isAuthorized, false);
    assert.ok(authResult.reason.includes("PAYEE SUBSTITUTION DETECTED"));
  });

  it("D16-3: Payroll account misuse is strictly DENIED", async () => {
    const authResult = await AuthorizationGate.requestAuthorization({
      actionType: "DISBURSAL_SETTLEMENT",
      accountId: testPayrollAccount,
      amountUsdc: "100.000000",
      declaredReason: "Attempt to pay SaaS vendor from payroll account.",
      recipientAddress: testVendorPayoutAddress,
    });

    assert.equal(authResult.isAuthorized, false);
    assert.ok(authResult.reason.includes("HARD INVARIANT VIOLATION"));
  });

  it("D16-4: High-value payment (> $500 cap) escalates to Layer 2 Human SPRS", async () => {
    const authResult = await AuthorizationGate.requestAuthorization({
      actionType: "DISBURSAL_SETTLEMENT",
      accountId: testEngineeringAccount,
      amountUsdc: "1500.000000",
      declaredReason: "Annual enterprise server reservation requiring executive clearance.",
      recipientAddress: testVendorPayoutAddress,
    });

    assert.equal(authResult.isAuthorized, false);
    assert.equal(authResult.layer, "HUMAN");
    assert.ok(authResult.sprsRequestId?.startsWith("SPRS_"));

    // Verify SPRS record created in database
    const sprsRecord = await PermissionRequestRepo.getRequestById(authResult.sprsRequestId!);
    assert.ok(sprsRecord);
    assert.equal(sprsRecord.status, "PENDING");
  });

  // ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  // 2. D17: Authorize Transaction Intent
  // ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

  it("D17-1: Corporate admin authorizes pending SPRS, recording authorization receipt hash", async () => {
    // Generate SPRS first
    const authResult = await AuthorizationGate.requestAuthorization({
      actionType: "DISBURSAL_SETTLEMENT",
      accountId: testEngineeringAccount,
      amountUsdc: "800.000000",
      declaredReason: "Critical GPU cluster expansion for model fine-tuning (PO-GPU-99).",
      recipientAddress: testVendorPayoutAddress,
    });

    assert.ok(authResult.sprsRequestId);

    // Human CFO signs off with authentic EIP-712 signature
    const adminSignature = await AuthorizationGate.createAdminSignature({
      permissionRequestId: authResult.sprsRequestId!,
      actionType: "DISBURSAL_SETTLEMENT",
      accountId: testEngineeringAccount,
      amountUsdc: "800.000000",
    });

    const authReceipt = await AuthorizationGate.authorizeTransactionIntent({
      permissionRequestId: authResult.sprsRequestId!,
      approverEmail: "cfo@bizarc.io",
      adminSignature,
      executionPayload: { targetContract: disbursalVault.getAddress() },
    });

    assert.equal(authReceipt.status, "AUTHORIZED");
    assert.ok(authReceipt.authorizationReceiptHash.startsWith("0x"));

    // Confirm SPRS is marked APPROVED in database
    const updatedSprs = await PermissionRequestRepo.getRequestById(authResult.sprsRequestId!);
    assert.equal(updatedSprs?.status, "APPROVED");

    // Verify AuthorizationGate now recognizes it as authorized under Layer 2
    const verifyResult = await AuthorizationGate.verifyAuthorization({
      actionType: "DISBURSAL_SETTLEMENT",
      accountId: testEngineeringAccount,
      amountUsdc: "800.000000",
      sprsRequestId: authResult.sprsRequestId,
    });

    assert.equal(verifyResult.isAuthorized, true);
    assert.equal(verifyResult.layer, "HUMAN");
  });

  // ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  // 3. D18: Stage Funds into DisbursalVault
  // ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

  it("D18-1: Staging funds moves capital into DisbursalVault with double-entry journal vouchers", async () => {
    const qualification = await disbursalRouter.qualifyDisbursalRoute({
      invoiceId: "INV-STAGE-001",
      vendorId: testVendorId,
      payoutAddress: testVendorPayoutAddress,
      amountUsdc: "45.000000",
      category: "INFRASTRUCTURE",
      declaredReason: "Compute capacity invoice staging test.",
      balanceOverrides: {
        [testEngineeringAccount]: { liquidUsdc: 100, investedUsyc: 50 },
      },
    });

    assert.equal(qualification.isQualified, true);

    const staged = await disbursalRouter.stageFunds(qualification);

    assert.equal(staged.status, "FUNDS_STAGED");
    assert.equal(staged.totalStagedUsdc, "45.000000");
    assert.equal(staged.allocations.length, 1);
    assert.equal(staged.allocations[0].accountId, testEngineeringAccount);

    // Verify double-entry staging voucher was posted to master journal
    const entries = await MasterJournalRepo.getEntriesByAccount(testEngineeringAccount);
    const stageEntry = entries.find((e) => e.document_ref.includes("INV-STAGE-001"));
    assert.ok(stageEntry, "Staging journal voucher must exist in master system journal");
    assert.equal(stageEntry.amount_usdc, 45.0);
  });

  // ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  // 4. D19, D19d7, D19d20.B: Disbursal Execution & Dual Reconciliation
  // ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

  it("D19-1: executeDisbursalRoute completes full settlement with DisbursalVault, LedgerWitness, and ERP sync", async () => {
    const qualification = await disbursalRouter.qualifyDisbursalRoute({
      invoiceId: "INV-EXEC-999",
      vendorId: testVendorId,
      payoutAddress: testVendorPayoutAddress,
      amountUsdc: "30.000000",
      category: "INFRASTRUCTURE",
      declaredReason: "Routine cloud billing PO-CLOUD-2026.",
      balanceOverrides: {
        [testEngineeringAccount]: { liquidUsdc: 200, investedUsyc: 100 },
      },
    });

    assert.equal(qualification.isQualified, true);

    // Execute route
    const execution = await disbursalRouter.executeDisbursalRoute({
      qualification,
    });

    // D19 Onchain Settlement & Idempotency
    assert.equal(execution.status, "SETTLED");
    assert.equal(execution.idempotencyKey, qualification.idempotencyKey);
    assert.ok(execution.txHash?.startsWith("0x"));
    assert.ok(execution.encodedCalldata?.startsWith("0x"));

    // D19d7 Ledger Witnessing
    assert.ok(execution.journalSequenceId);
    assert.ok(execution.journalHash);
    const journalEntries = await MasterJournalRepo.getEntriesByAccount(testEngineeringAccount);
    const disbursalVoucher = journalEntries.find((e) => e.document_ref === "DISB_DOC_INV-EXEC-999");
    assert.ok(disbursalVoucher, "Disbursal voucher must be written by LedgerWitness");
    assert.equal(disbursalVoucher.amount_usdc, 30.0);

    // D19d20.B ERP Reconciliation Syncer
    assert.ok(execution.erpSync);
    assert.equal(execution.erpSync.status, "SYNCED");
    assert.equal(execution.erpSync.threeWayMatchVerified, true);
    assert.ok(execution.erpSync.erpNextDocName);
    assert.ok(execution.erpSync.odooPaymentId);

    // Verify PostgreSQL erp_sync_state checkpoint
    const syncRes = await DbClient.query("SELECT * FROM erp_sync_state WHERE account_id = $1;", [testEngineeringAccount]);
    const syncRecords = syncRes.rows;
    const checkpoint = syncRecords.find((r: any) => r.sync_id.includes("INV-EXEC-999"));
    assert.ok(checkpoint, "ERP sync checkpoint record must be persisted in database");
    assert.equal(checkpoint.status, "SYNCED");
  });

  // ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  // 5. ToolRegistry Disbursal Tools Execution
  // ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

  it("ToolRegistry: qualify_disbursal_route and execute_disbursal_route tools execute successfully", async () => {
    // 1. qualify_disbursal_route
    const qualifyRes = await toolRegistry.executeTool("qualify_disbursal_route", {
      invoiceId: "INV-TOOL-001",
      vendorId: testVendorId,
      payoutAddress: testVendorPayoutAddress,
      amountUsdc: "15.000000",
      category: "INFRASTRUCTURE",
      declaredReason: "Docker registry annual subscription PO-DOC-1.",
      balanceOverrides: {
        [testEngineeringAccount]: { liquidUsdc: 150, investedUsyc: 50 },
      },
    });

    assert.equal(qualifyRes.success, true);
    assert.ok(qualifyRes.data);
    const qual = qualifyRes.data;
    assert.equal(qual.isQualified, true);

    // 2. execute_disbursal_route
    const execRes = await toolRegistry.executeTool("execute_disbursal_route", {
      qualification: qual,
    });

    assert.equal(execRes.success, true);
    assert.equal(execRes.data.status, "SETTLED");
    assert.ok(execRes.data.txHash);
    assert.equal(execRes.data.erpSync.status, "SYNCED");
  });
});

import { PolicyLoader } from "../src/config/policyLoader.js";
import { AGENT_REGISTRY } from "../src/types/agents.js";
import fs from "fs";
import path from "path";

console.log("=== Running D0/D1 Verification Tests ===");

// 1. Verify policy loading & active profile
console.log("1. Testing PolicyLoader with business_policy.yaml...");
const { profileName, profile } = PolicyLoader.getActiveProfile();
console.log(`✓ Successfully loaded active profile: ${profileName}`);
console.log(`  Description: ${profile.description}`);
console.log(`  Operating Accounts count: ${profile.operating_accounts.length}`);
console.log(`  Investment rules min_sweep: $${profile.investment_rules.min_sweep_amount_usdc}`);
console.log(`  Spending limits: single-tx $${profile.spending_limits.single_tx_human_gate_threshold_usdc}, daily $${profile.spending_limits.daily_hard_cap_usdc}`);

// 2. Verify account configuration
const payrollAcc = profile.operating_accounts.find(a => a.account_id === "acc_payroll");
if (!payrollAcc || !payrollAcc.exclude_from_waterfall_draws) {
  throw new Error("Payroll account must have exclude_from_waterfall_draws = true");
}
console.log("✓ Payroll protection rule verified (exclude_from_waterfall_draws = true)");

// 3. Verify agent registry
console.log("2. Verifying Agent Registry & Segregation of Duties...");
const witness = AGENT_REGISTRY.LedgerWitnessAgent;
if (witness.canSignTransactions) {
  throw new Error("Violation: LedgerWitnessAgent must NEVER have transaction signing ability!");
}
if (!witness.canWriteLedger) {
  throw new Error("Violation: LedgerWitnessAgent must have write ledger authority!");
}
console.log(`✓ LedgerWitnessAgent (ERC-8004 #${witness.erc8004Id}) segregation of duties verified.`);

const sentinel = AGENT_REGISTRY.TreasurySentinelAgent;
if (!sentinel.canSignTransactions || sentinel.canWriteLedger) {
  throw new Error("Violation: TreasurySentinelAgent must sign transactions but NOT directly write ledger!");
}
console.log(`✓ TreasurySentinelAgent (ERC-8004 #${sentinel.erc8004Id}) segregation of duties verified.`);

// 4. Verify network configuration
console.log("3. Verifying Arc L1 Network Configuration...");
const networkConfigPath = path.resolve(process.cwd(), "config/network.config.json");
if (!fs.existsSync(networkConfigPath)) {
  throw new Error("Missing network.config.json");
}
const networkConfig = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(networkConfigPath, "utf-8"));
if (!networkConfig.networks.arcTestnet || !networkConfig.networks.arcMainnet) {
  throw new Error("network.config.json must specify arcTestnet and arcMainnet");
}
console.log(`✓ Arc Network Config verified (Mainnet ChainID: ${networkConfig.networks.arcMainnet.chainId}, Testnet ChainID: ${networkConfig.networks.arcTestnet.chainId})`);

console.log("\n>>> ALL D0/D1 ARCHITECTURE & ENVIRONMENT CONFIG TESTS PASSED! <<<");

import { AccountIntelligenceService } from "../src/services/accountIntelligenceService.js";
import { DbClient } from "../src/database/dbClient.js";
import { TreasuryAccountsRepo } from "../src/database/repos/treasuryAccountsRepo.js";
import { LiabilityRepo } from "../src/database/repos/liabilityRepo.js";
import { AuditLogRepo } from "../src/database/repos/auditLogRepo.js";
import { PolicyLoader } from "../src/config/policyLoader.js";

/**
 * INDEPENDENT REAL-WORLD AUDIT SUITE FOR D6 -> D8:
 * Account Intelligence Layer & Dynamic Solvency Analytics
 *
 * Verifies live get_account_intelligence tool responses, tripartite balance
 * reconciliation, dynamic liability aggregation, real-time recalculation upon
 * state mutation, payroll protection walls, and multi-account waterfall planning.
 *
 * Executed against live PostgreSQL 'bizarc' database.
 */
async function runIndependentD8Audit() {
  console.log("================================================================================");
  console.log(" INDEPENDENT REAL-WORLD AUDIT: D6 -> D8 ACCOUNT INTELLIGENCE & WATERFALL LAYER ");
  console.log("================================================================================");

  let pass = 0;
  let fail = 0;
  const failures: string[] = [];

  function assert(condition: boolean, label: string) {
    if (condition) {
      console.log(`  ✓ ${label}`);
      pass++;
    } else {
      console.error(`  ✗ FAIL: ${label}`);
      fail++;
      failures.push(label);
    }
  }

  function assertEqual<T>(actual: T, expected: T, label: string) {
    if (actual === expected) {
      console.log(`  ✓ ${label}`);
      pass++;
    } else {
      console.error(`  ✗ FAIL: ${label} -> expected ${JSON.stringify(expected)}, got ${JSON.stringify(actual)}`);
      fail++;
      failures.push(label);
    }
  }

  // ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  // 1. SETUP & REAL DATABASE CLEANUP
  // ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  console.log("\n[Setup] Cleaning database tables for independent D8 audit...");
  await DbClient.query("TRUNCATE TABLE master_system_journal CASCADE");
  await DbClient.query("TRUNCATE TABLE account_agent_audit_log CASCADE");
  await DbClient.query("TRUNCATE TABLE permission_requests CASCADE");
  await DbClient.query("TRUNCATE TABLE account_liabilities CASCADE");
  await DbClient.query("TRUNCATE TABLE treasury_accounts CASCADE");

  const { profile } = PolicyLoader.getActiveProfile();
  for (const acc of profile.operating_accounts) {
    await TreasuryAccountsRepo.upsertAccount({
      account_id: acc.account_id,
      name: acc.name,
      role: acc.role,
      wallet_address: `0x${acc.account_id.length.toString().padStart(40, "8")}` as `0x${string}`,
      chain_id: 5042002,
      min_operating_floor_usdc: acc.min_floor_usdc,
      safety_buffer_ratio: acc.safety_multiplier,
      is_active: true,
    });
  }

  const intelService = new AccountIntelligenceService();

  // ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  // 2. AUDIT: SEED REALISTIC FINANCIAL DATA & QUERY ACCOUNT INTELLIGENCE
  // ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  console.log("\n[Audit 1] Invoking get_account_intelligence with Live Financial State");

  // Liability 1: Datadog APM due in 4 days -> $150.00 USDC
  await LiabilityRepo.createLiability({
    account_id: "acc_engineering",
    vendor_id: "vendor_datadog",
    title: "Datadog APM Monthly",
    category: "INFRASTRUCTURE",
    amount_usdc: 150.0,
    due_date: new Date(Date.now() + 4 * 86400 * 1000),
    payout_address: "0x1111111111111111111111111111111111111111",
    status: "SCHEDULED",
  });

  // Liability 2: AWS Elastic Compute due in 10 days (in 14d evaluation window) -> $250.00 USDC
  await LiabilityRepo.createLiability({
    account_id: "acc_engineering",
    vendor_id: "vendor_aws",
    title: "AWS Cluster Compute",
    category: "INFRASTRUCTURE",
    amount_usdc: 250.0,
    due_date: new Date(Date.now() + 10 * 86400 * 1000),
    payout_address: "0x2222222222222222222222222222222222222222",
    status: "SCHEDULED",
  });

  // Liability 3: Cancelled subscription -> $75.00 USDC (MUST BE EXCLUDED)
  await LiabilityRepo.createLiability({
    account_id: "acc_engineering",
    vendor_id: "vendor_sentry",
    title: "Sentry Error Monitoring (Terminated)",
    category: "SUBSCRIPTION",
    amount_usdc: 75.0,
    due_date: new Date(Date.now() + 2 * 86400 * 1000),
    payout_address: "0x3333333333333333333333333333333333333333",
    status: "CANCELLED",
  });

  // Record an audit log entry
  await AuditLogRepo.appendAuditLog({
    account_id: "acc_engineering",
    action_type: "AUTONOMOUS_SWEEP",
    amount_usdc: 200.0,
    is_autonomous: true,
    reason: "Surplus cash swept to USYC",
    pre_state_snapshot: { liquid: "1000.000000" },
    post_state_snapshot: { liquid: "800.000000", usyc: "200.000000" },
    actor_agent: "LedgerWitnessAgent",
  });

  // Query live intelligence
  const intel = await intelService.getAccountIntelligence("acc_engineering", {
    overrideLiquidBalance: 800.0,
    overrideInvestedUsyc: 200.0,
  });

  // Verify tripartite balances
  assertEqual(intel.balances.liquidUsdc, "800.000000", "Liquid USDC balance confirmed at 800.000000");
  assertEqual(intel.balances.investedUsycUsdcEquivalent, "200.000000", "Invested USYC balance confirmed at 200.000000");
  assertEqual(intel.balances.totalEffectiveUsdc, "1000.000000", "Total effective balance confirmed at 1000.000000");

  // Verify dynamic liabilities
  assertEqual(intel.liabilities.dueNext7DaysUsdc, "150.000000", "7-day liabilities include only Datadog ($150)");
  assertEqual(intel.liabilities.dueNext30DaysUsdc, "400.000000", "30-day liabilities include Datadog + AWS ($400)");
  assertEqual(intel.liabilities.items.length, 2, "Active items exclude cancelled subscription");

  // Verify solvency arithmetic:
  // RequiredReserve = (400 * 1.20) + 50 = 530.000000
  // SafeToInvest = max(0, 800 - 530 - 10) = 260.000000
  // Free Cash = 800 - 530 = 270.000000
  // Free Capital = 1000 - 530 = 470.000000
  assertEqual(intel.solvencyMetrics.requiredReserveUsdc, "530.000000", "Required target reserve is exactly 530.000000");
  assertEqual(intel.solvencyMetrics.safeToInvestUsdc, "260.000000", "SafeToInvest is exactly 260.000000 (after 10 USDC hysteresis)");
  assertEqual(intel.solvencyMetrics.unencumberedFreeCashUsdc, "270.000000", "Unencumbered free cash is exactly 270.000000");
  assertEqual(intel.solvencyMetrics.freeCapitalTotalUsdc, "470.000000", "Free capital total is exactly 470.000000");
  assertEqual(intel.solvencyMetrics.isSolvent, true, "Account is confirmed solvent (1000 >= 530)");

  // ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  // 3. AUDIT: DYNAMIC RECALCULATION ON DATABASE MUTATION
  // ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  console.log("\n[Audit 2] Dynamic Recalculation on Inbound Obligation Mutation");

  // Ingest unexpected emergency invoice ($300 USDC due in 6 days)
  await LiabilityRepo.createLiability({
    account_id: "acc_engineering",
    vendor_id: "vendor_security_audit",
    title: "Smart Contract Emergency Security Audit",
    category: "INFRASTRUCTURE",
    amount_usdc: 300.0,
    due_date: new Date(Date.now() + 6 * 86400 * 1000),
    payout_address: "0x4444444444444444444444444444444444444444",
    status: "SCHEDULED",
  });

  const updatedIntel = await intelService.getAccountIntelligence("acc_engineering", {
    overrideLiquidBalance: 800.0,
    overrideInvestedUsyc: 200.0,
  });

  // Required reserve now: (700 * 1.20) + 50 = 890.000000
  // Since liquid is 800 < 890, SafeToInvest drops to 0.000000
  assertEqual(updatedIntel.liabilities.dueNext30DaysUsdc, "700.000000", "Dynamic 30-day liabilities updated to 700.000000");
  assertEqual(updatedIntel.solvencyMetrics.requiredReserveUsdc, "890.000000", "Required reserve dynamically recalculated to 890.000000");
  assertEqual(updatedIntel.solvencyMetrics.safeToInvestUsdc, "0.000000", "SafeToInvest immediately locked to 0.000000");
  assertEqual(updatedIntel.solvencyMetrics.unencumberedFreeCashUsdc, "0.000000", "Unencumbered free cash is 0 when required reserve exceeds liquid");
  assertEqual(updatedIntel.solvencyMetrics.freeCapitalTotalUsdc, "110.000000", "Total free capital remains positive (1000 - 890 = 110.000000)");

  // ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  // 4. AUDIT: PAYROLL PROTECTION WALL
  // ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  console.log("\n[Audit 3] Payroll Protection Wall (Zero-Drain Invariant)");
  const payrollIntel = await intelService.getAccountIntelligence("acc_payroll", {
    overrideLiquidBalance: 150000.0,
    overrideInvestedUsyc: 0.0,
  });

  assertEqual(payrollIntel.metadata.excludeFromWaterfall, true, "Payroll excludeFromWaterfall is STRICTLY TRUE");
  assertEqual(payrollIntel.solvencyMetrics.safeToInvestUsdc, "0.000000", "Payroll SafeToInvest is STRICTLY LOCKED to 0.000000");

  // ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  // 5. AUDIT: PORTFOLIO-WIDE INTELLIGENCE AGGREGATION
  // ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  console.log("\n[Audit 4] Portfolio-Wide Intelligence Aggregation");
  const allAccounts = await intelService.getAllAccountsIntelligence();
  assertEqual(allAccounts.length, 4, "getAllAccountsIntelligence returns all 4 registered corporate accounts");
  const hasPayroll = allAccounts.some((a) => a.metadata.accountId === "acc_payroll");
  const hasEngineering = allAccounts.some((a) => a.metadata.accountId === "acc_engineering");
  assert(hasPayroll && hasEngineering, "Portfolio intelligence includes both operational and protected accounts");

  // ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  // 6. AUDIT: MULTI-ACCOUNT WATERFALL LIQUIDITY PLANNING
  // ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  console.log("\n[Audit 5] Multi-Account Waterfall Planning ($5,000 Invoice Draw)");
  const waterfallPlan = await intelService.getWaterfallCandidateAccounts(5000.0, {
    acc_engineering: { liquidUsdc: 2500.0, investedUsyc: 1000.0 }, // free capital ~ $2,610
    acc_general_treasury: { liquidUsdc: 25000.0, investedUsyc: 10000.0 }, // large free capital
    acc_marketing: { liquidUsdc: 1500.0, investedUsyc: 500.0 }, // free capital ~ $1,950
    acc_payroll: { liquidUsdc: 100000.0, investedUsyc: 0.0 }, // $100k! MUST BE EXCLUDED!
  });

  assertEqual(waterfallPlan.isFullyFundable, true, "Waterfall confirmed $5,000 invoice is fully fundable");
  assert(
    !waterfallPlan.eligibleAccounts.some((a) => a.metadata.accountId === "acc_payroll"),
    "Payroll was STRICTLY EXCLUDED from waterfall candidate accounts"
  );

  const totalAllocated = waterfallPlan.allocationPlan.reduce((sum, a) => sum + a.allocateAmountUsdc, 0);
  assertEqual(totalAllocated, 5000.0, "Allocated sum exactly equals requested $5,000.000000");

  // ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  // 7. AUDIT: WATERFALL SHORTFALL & INSOLVENCY DETECTION
  // ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  console.log("\n[Audit 6] Waterfall Insolvency Detection ($1,000,000 Excess Demand)");
  const hugeDemandPlan = await intelService.getWaterfallCandidateAccounts(1000000.0, {
    acc_engineering: { liquidUsdc: 1000.0 },
    acc_general_treasury: { liquidUsdc: 2000.0 },
  });

  assertEqual(hugeDemandPlan.isFullyFundable, false, "Waterfall correctly caught insolvency for $1M draw");
  assert(hugeDemandPlan.shortfallUsdc !== undefined, "Shortfall amount is explicitly computed");

  // ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  // SUMMARY
  // ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  console.log("\n" + "=".repeat(80));
  console.log(`  INDEPENDENT D8 AUDIT COMPLETE: ${pass} passed, ${fail} failed`);
  if (failures.length > 0) {
    console.error("  FAILURES:");
    failures.forEach((f) => console.error(`    ✗ ${f}`));

  }
  console.log("=".repeat(80));

import { describe, it, before, after } from "node:test";
import assert from "node:assert/strict";
import crypto from "crypto";
import { DbClient } from "../src/database/dbClient.js";
import { PollingJobsRepo } from "../src/database/repos/pollingJobsRepo.js";
import { LiabilityRepo } from "../src/database/repos/liabilityRepo.js";
import { TreasuryAccountsRepo } from "../src/database/repos/treasuryAccountsRepo.js";
import { VendorMasterRepo } from "../src/database/repos/vendorMasterRepo.js";
import { AutonomousSchedulerService } from "../src/services/autonomousSchedulerService.js";
import { IntakeDiscoveryAgent } from "../src/services/intakeDiscoveryAgent.js";

describe("Autonomous Scheduler & External App Polling Engine", () => {
  const companyId = `cmp_sched_${Date.now()}`;
  const accountId = `acc_${companyId}_ops`;
  const vendorAws = `vnd_sched_aws_${Date.now()}`;
  const walletAddress = `0x${crypto.randomBytes(20).toString("hex")}`;

  before(async () => {
    // Provision primary operating account
    await TreasuryAccountsRepo.upsertAccount({
      account_id: accountId,
      company_id: companyId,
      chain_id: 5042002,
      name: "Primary Operating Account",
      role: "OPEX_DEV",
      wallet_address: walletAddress,
      min_operating_floor_usdc: 1000.0,
      safety_buffer_ratio: 1.2,
      is_active: true,
      authorized_categories: ["SAAS", "CLOUD_COMPUTE"],
    });

    // Seed verified vendor
    await VendorMasterRepo.registerVendor({
      vendor_id: vendorAws,
      name: "Amazon Web Services (AWS)",
      verified_payout_address: "0xaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa",
      verified_by_admin: "admin_tester",
      last_verified_at: new Date(),
      change_lock: true,
    });
  });

  after(async () => {
    await DbClient.query("DELETE FROM external_app_polling_jobs WHERE company_id = $1", [companyId]);
    await DbClient.query("DELETE FROM account_liabilities WHERE company_id = $1", [companyId]);
    await DbClient.query("DELETE FROM dynamic_safe_to_invest WHERE account_id = $1", [accountId]);
    await DbClient.query("DELETE FROM account_agent_audit_log WHERE account_id = $1", [accountId]);
    await DbClient.query("DELETE FROM treasury_accounts WHERE company_id = $1", [companyId]);
    await DbClient.closePool();
  });

  it("1. Automatically registers recurring polling jobs for connected apps", async () => {
    const scheduler = new AutonomousSchedulerService();

    const jobs = await scheduler.registerConnectedAppJobs({
      companyId,
      appTypes: ["GOOGLE_WORKSPACE", "AWS", "GITHUB"],
      frequencyCron: "0 */4 * * *", // every 4 hours
      intervalSeconds: 14400,
    });

    assert.equal(jobs.length, 3);
    assert.equal(jobs[0].company_id, companyId);
    assert.equal(jobs[0].status, "IDLE");
    assert.equal(jobs[0].interval_seconds, 14400);

    const storedJobs = await PollingJobsRepo.getJobsByCompany(companyId);
    assert.equal(storedJobs.length, 3);
  });

  it("2. Polling engine executes due jobs, ingests documents, and auto-stages liabilities", async () => {
    // Inject mock intake discovery returning AWS and GitHub liabilities
    const testAwsTransport = {
      async request() {
        return {
          monthlySpend: 4200.0,
          forecastedSpend: 4500.0,
          costCenters: [{ tag: "Cloud Infrastructure", amount: 4200.0 }],
        };
      },
    };

    const testGoogleTransport = {
      async callTool(name: string) {
        if (name === "gmail_search_messages") return { messageIds: ["msg_sched_01"] };
        if (name === "gmail_get_message") {
          return {
            id: "msg_sched_01",
            bodyText: "Datadog Invoice INV-2026-DD-99 for $350.00 USDC due 2026-10-20 to 0x2222222222222222222222222222222222222222 PO: PO-DATADOG-99 Cost Center: Monitoring",
          };
        }
        return {};
      },
    };

    const scheduler = new AutonomousSchedulerService({
      intakeAgentFactory: (cid) =>
        new IntakeDiscoveryAgent({
          companyId: cid,
          googleTransport: testGoogleTransport,
          vendorTransports: { AWS: testAwsTransport },
        }),
    });

    const result = await scheduler.executeDueAppPolls();
    assert.ok(result.processedJobs >= 1, "Should process due polling jobs");
    assert.ok(result.newLiabilitiesCount >= 1, "Should auto-stage new liabilities");

    // Verify staged liabilities in account_liabilities
    const liabilities = await LiabilityRepo.getUpcomingLiabilities(365, undefined, companyId);
    assert.ok(liabilities.length >= 1, "Must find staged liabilities in database");
    assert.ok(
      liabilities.some((l) => l.vendor_id.toLowerCase().includes("aws") || l.vendor_id.toLowerCase().includes("datadog")),
      "Must stage discovered liabilities"
    );

    // Verify polling job timestamps updated
    const jobs = await PollingJobsRepo.getJobsByCompany(companyId);
    const completedJob = jobs.find((j) => j.last_polled_at !== null);
    assert.ok(completedJob, "Completed job must have last_polled_at set");
    assert.ok(completedJob!.next_poll_at.getTime() > Date.now(), "next_poll_at must be advanced");

    // COGNITIVE SWARM AGENT VERIFICATION:
    // Verify LiabilityRadarAgent (#102) deliberated and recorded events to continuous context blackboard
    const radarEvents = await DbClient.query(
      `SELECT * FROM agent_continuous_context 
       WHERE session_id = $1 AND agent_id = 102 
       ORDER BY event_seq ASC`,
      [scheduler.swarm.sessionId]
    );
    assert.ok(radarEvents.rows.length >= 1, "LiabilityRadarAgent (#102) must record cognitive deliberation to continuous context");
  });

  it("3. Disbursal loop automatically executes scheduled liabilities within the lead time window", async () => {
    // Create an immediately due scheduled liability
    const dueLiability = await LiabilityRepo.createLiability({
      account_id: accountId,
      company_id: companyId,
      vendor_id: vendorAws,
      title: "AWS Cloud Services Due Today",
      category: "CLOUD_COMPUTE",
      amount_usdc: 300.0,
      due_date: new Date(Date.now() + 1000 * 3600 * 2), // due in 2 hours (within 48h lead time)
      payout_address: "0xaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa",
      source_po_hash: "PO-AWS-SCHED-01",
      status: "SCHEDULED",
      preferred_payment_rail: "DISBURSAL_VAULT",
    });

    const scheduler = new AutonomousSchedulerService({
      disbursalLeadTimeHours: 48,
    });

    const disbursalResult = await scheduler.executeDueLiabilities();
    assert.ok(disbursalResult.settledCount >= 1, "Must settle due scheduled liabilities");

    // Verify liability status transitioned to SETTLED
    const updated = await LiabilityRepo.getLiabilityById(dueLiability.liability_id!);
    assert.equal(updated?.status, "SETTLED", "Liability must be transitioned to SETTLED");

    // COGNITIVE SWARM AGENT VERIFICATION:
    // Verify LedgerWitnessAgent (#105) witnessed the settlement voucher
    const witnessEvents = await DbClient.query(
      `SELECT * FROM agent_continuous_context 
       WHERE session_id = $1 AND agent_id = 105 
       ORDER BY event_seq ASC`,
      [scheduler.swarm.sessionId]
    );
    assert.ok(witnessEvents.rows.length >= 1, "LedgerWitnessAgent (#105) must witness and record voucher to continuous context");
  });

  it("4. Daemon lifecycle controls (start, tick, stop) function deterministically", async () => {
    const scheduler = new AutonomousSchedulerService({ pollingIntervalMs: 500 });
    assert.equal(scheduler.getStatus().isRunning, false);

    scheduler.start();
    assert.equal(scheduler.getStatus().isRunning, true);

    // Run a manual tick cycle
    const tickResult = await scheduler.tick();
    assert.ok(tickResult !== undefined);

    scheduler.stop();
    assert.equal(scheduler.getStatus().isRunning, false);
  });
});

import { describe, it, before, after } from "node:test";
import assert from "node:assert";
import { TokenSwapService } from "../src/services/tokenSwapService.js";
import { FiatFundingService } from "../src/services/fiatFundingService.js";
import { UniversalPaymentRouter } from "../src/payments/universalPaymentRouter.js";
import { ToolRegistry } from "../src/tools/toolRegistry.js";
import { DbClient } from "../src/database/dbClient.js";
import { AuthorizationGate, DEFAULT_ADMIN_PRIVATE_KEY } from "../src/security/authorizationGate.js";

describe("BizArc Token Swaps & Universal Fiat Rails Test Suite", () => {
  let tokenSwapService: TokenSwapService;
  let fiatFundingService: FiatFundingService;
  let universalRouter: UniversalPaymentRouter;
  let toolRegistry: ToolRegistry;

  const testAccountId = "OPEX_DEV";
  const testVendorId = "VEND_TRADITIONAL_LEGAL_01";

  before(async () => {
    tokenSwapService = new TokenSwapService();
    fiatFundingService = new FiatFundingService();
    universalRouter = new UniversalPaymentRouter();
    toolRegistry = new ToolRegistry();

    // Ensure database test fixtures
    await DbClient.query(`
      INSERT INTO treasury_accounts (account_id, name, role, wallet_address, min_operating_floor_usdc, is_active)
      VALUES ('${testAccountId}', 'Dev Ops Pool', 'OPEX_DEV', '0x9999999999999999999999999999999999999999', 500.000000, true)
      ON CONFLICT (account_id) DO UPDATE SET is_active = true;
    `);

    await DbClient.query(`
      INSERT INTO vendor_master_registry (vendor_id, name, verified_payout_address, verified_by_admin, last_verified_at, change_lock)
      VALUES ('${testVendorId}', 'Gunderson Dettmer LLP', '0x2222222222222222222222222222222222222222', 'CFO_ADMIN', NOW(), TRUE)
      ON CONFLICT (vendor_id) DO UPDATE SET verified_payout_address = EXCLUDED.verified_payout_address;
    `);
  });

  // ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  // PART 1: TOKEN CONVERSIONS & SWAPS
  // ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  it("Step 1: TokenSwapService estimates cross-chain token swap (USDT -> USDC)", async () => {
    const estimate = await tokenSwapService.estimateSwap({
      fromChain: "Ethereum",
      fromToken: "USDT",
      toChain: "Arc",
      toToken: "USDC",
      amount: "1000.000000",
      slippage: 0.005,
    });

    assert.strictEqual(estimate.fromChain, "Ethereum");
    assert.strictEqual(estimate.toChain, "Arc");
    assert.strictEqual(estimate.isCrossChain, true);
    assert.ok(parseFloat(estimate.estimatedToAmount) > 990);
    assert.ok(estimate.exchangeRate > 0.99);
    assert.strictEqual(estimate.slippagePercent, 0.5);
  });

  it("Step 2: TokenSwapService STRICTLY REJECTS USDC <-> NATIVE swap on Arc (Arc L1 Asset Duality Violation)", async () => {
    await assert.rejects(
      async () => {
        await tokenSwapService.estimateSwap({
          fromChain: "Arc",
          fromToken: "USDC",
          toChain: "Arc",
          toToken: "NATIVE",
          amount: "100.000000",
        });
      },
      (err: Error) => {
        return (
          err.message.includes("ArcAssetDualityViolationError") &&
          err.message.includes("NATIVE and USDC are the exact same asset")
        );
      }
    );
  });

  it("Step 3: TokenSwapService enforces max slippage policy and executes valid swap", async () => {
    // 3A. Slippage ceiling rejection
    const highSlippageResult = await tokenSwapService.executeSwap({
      accountId: testAccountId,
      fromChain: "Base",
      fromToken: "USDC",
      toChain: "Arc",
      toToken: "USDC",
      amount: "500.000000",
      slippage: 0.02, // 2% requested, max allowed is 1%
      maxSlippageLimit: 0.01,
    });

    assert.strictEqual(highSlippageResult.success, false);
    assert.strictEqual(highSlippageResult.status, "REJECTED_BY_POLICY");
    assert.ok(highSlippageResult.error?.includes("exceeds max company policy limit"));

    // 3B. Successful swap execution within tolerance
    const validSwapResult = await tokenSwapService.executeSwap({
      accountId: testAccountId,
      fromChain: "Arbitrum",
      fromToken: "USDT",
      toChain: "Arc",
      toToken: "USDC",
      amount: "250.000000",
      slippage: 0.005,
      declaredReason: "Convert Arbitrum reserves to Arc native liquidity",
    });

    assert.strictEqual(validSwapResult.success, true);
    assert.strictEqual(validSwapResult.status, "COMPLETED");
    assert.ok(validSwapResult.swapId.startsWith("swap_"));
    assert.ok(parseFloat(validSwapResult.toAmount) > 245);
    assert.ok(validSwapResult.sourceTxHash?.startsWith("0x"));
  });

  // ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  // PART 2: UNIVERSAL PAYMENT LAYER - RAIL 5 FIAT PAYOUT
  // ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  it("Step 4: UniversalPaymentRouter rejects FIAT_PAYOUT when beneficiary bank details are missing", async () => {
    const unbankedVendorId = `VEND_NO_BANK_${Date.now()}`;
    const result = await universalRouter.routeAndExecute({
      intent: {
        intentId: `INT_FIAT_FAIL_${Date.now()}`,
        primaryAccountId: testAccountId,
        vendorId: unbankedVendorId,
        vendorName: "Unbanked Supplier Inc",
        amountUsdc: 250.0,
        declaredReason: "Legal services retainer payment",
      },
      overrideRail: "FIAT_PAYOUT",
    });

    assert.strictEqual(result.success, false);
    assert.strictEqual(result.status, "REJECTED_BY_POLICY");
    assert.ok(result.error?.includes("Beneficiary bank credentials incomplete"));
  });

  it("Step 5: UniversalPaymentRouter ESCALATES high-value FIAT_PAYOUT to Human SPRS", async () => {
    const highAmount = 4500.0; // Exceeds default $500 threshold
    const result = await universalRouter.routeAndExecute({
      intent: {
        intentId: `INT_FIAT_SPRS_${Date.now()}`,
        primaryAccountId: testAccountId,
        vendorId: testVendorId,
        vendorName: "Gunderson Dettmer LLP",
        amountUsdc: highAmount,
        declaredReason: "Commercial office lease monthly rent",
        beneficiaryBank: {
          accountHolderName: "Gunderson Dettmer LLP",
          ibanOrAccountNumber: "9876543210",
          routingOrSwift: "121000358",
          bankCountry: "US",
          bankName: "Wells Fargo Bank NA",
        },
      },
      overrideRail: "FIAT_PAYOUT",
    });

    assert.strictEqual(result.success, false);
    assert.strictEqual(result.status, "ESCALATE_TO_SPRS");
    assert.ok(result.sprsRequestId?.startsWith("SPRS_"));
    assert.ok(result.error !== undefined);
  });

  it("Step 6: UniversalPaymentRouter EXECUTES FIAT_PAYOUT with CFO EIP-712 approval signature", async () => {
    const intentId = `INT_FIAT_EXEC_${Date.now()}`;
    const amount = 2500.0;
    const sprsId = `SPRS_${intentId}`;

    // Generate EIP-712 Admin Signature from authorized admin key
    const adminSignature = await AuthorizationGate.createAdminSignature({
      permissionRequestId: sprsId,
      actionType: "UNIVERSAL_DISBURSAL_FIAT_PAYOUT",
      accountId: testAccountId,
      amountUsdc: amount.toFixed(6),
      privateKey: DEFAULT_ADMIN_PRIVATE_KEY,
    });

    const result = await universalRouter.routeAndExecute({
      intent: {
        intentId,
        primaryAccountId: testAccountId,
        vendorId: testVendorId,
        vendorName: "Gunderson Dettmer LLP",
        amountUsdc: amount,
        declaredReason: "Approved traditional legal retainer payment",
        beneficiaryBank: {
          accountHolderName: "Gunderson Dettmer LLP",
          ibanOrAccountNumber: "9876543210",
          routingOrSwift: "121000358",
          bankCountry: "US",
          bankName: "Wells Fargo Bank NA",
        },
      },
      overrideRail: "FIAT_PAYOUT",
      adminSignature,
      sprsRequestId: sprsId,
    });

    assert.strictEqual(result.success, true);
    assert.strictEqual(result.status, "EXECUTED");
    assert.strictEqual(result.rail, "FIAT_PAYOUT");
    assert.ok(result.txHash?.startsWith("0x"));
    assert.ok(result.fiatPayoutId?.startsWith("payout_"));
    assert.ok(result.estimatedArrivalTimestamp !== undefined);
    assert.ok(result.journalSequenceId !== undefined);
  });

  // ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  // PART 3: FIAT WALLET FUNDING
  // ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  it("Step 7: FiatFundingService generates on-ramp checkout session & verbatim CLI command", async () => {
    const session = await fiatFundingService.createFiatOnRampSession({
      accountId: testAccountId,
      amountUsdc: 5000.0,
      userEmail: "cfo@enterprise.io",
      chain: "ARC",
    });

    assert.strictEqual(session.accountId, testAccountId);
    assert.strictEqual(session.amountUsdc, 5000.0);
    assert.strictEqual(session.chain, "ARC");
    assert.ok(session.cliCommandVerbatim.includes("circle wallet fund --address"));
    assert.ok(session.cliCommandVerbatim.includes("--chain ARC --amount 5000.00 --token usdc --method fiat --open"));
    assert.ok(session.checkoutUrl.startsWith("https://checkout.circle.com/onramp"));
  });

  it("Step 8: FiatFundingService generates institutional Fedwire instructions with tracking memo", async () => {
    const wireInfo = await fiatFundingService.getFiatWireInstructions({
      accountId: testAccountId,
      currency: "USD",
    });

    assert.strictEqual(wireInfo.beneficiaryName, "Circle Internet Financial LLC");
    assert.strictEqual(wireInfo.routingNumber, "021000018");
    assert.ok(wireInfo.depositTrackingMemo.includes(`BIZARC-MINT-${testAccountId}`));
    assert.ok(wireInfo.instructions.includes(wireInfo.depositTrackingMemo));
  });

  it("Step 9: FiatFundingService reconciles confirmed fiat deposit and updates ledger", async () => {
    const reconciliation = await fiatFundingService.recordFiatDeposit({
      accountId: testAccountId,
      amountUsdc: 10000.0,
      depositReference: `WIRE_REF_${Date.now()}`,
      sourceBank: "JPMorgan Chase NA",
      senderName: "Acme Corp Treasury Holdings LLC",
    });

    assert.strictEqual(reconciliation.status, "CONFIRMED");
    assert.strictEqual(reconciliation.amountUsdc, 10000.0);
    assert.ok(reconciliation.txHash.startsWith("0x"));
    assert.ok(reconciliation.creditedBalanceUsdc >= 10000.0);
    assert.ok(reconciliation.journalSequenceId !== undefined);
  });

  // ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  // PART 4: TOOL REGISTRY INTEGRATION
  // ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  it("Step 10: ToolRegistry executes estimate_token_swap tool", async () => {
    const res = await toolRegistry.executeTool("estimate_token_swap", {
      fromChain: "Base",

    assert.strictEqual(res.success, true);
    assert.strictEqual(res.data.fromAmount, "300.000000");
    assert.strictEqual(res.data.toChain, "Arc");
  });

  it("Step 11: ToolRegistry executes create_fiat_onramp_session tool", async () => {

  it("Step 12: ToolRegistry executes route_universal_payment with Rail 5 (FIAT_PAYOUT)", async () => {
    const res = await toolRegistry.executeTool("route_universal_payment", {

import { PolicyLoader } from "../src/config/policyLoader.js";
import { TreasuryAccountsRepo } from "../src/database/repos/treasuryAccountsRepo.js";
import { LiabilityRepo } from "../src/database/repos/liabilityRepo.js";
import { MasterJournalRepo } from "../src/database/repos/masterJournalRepo.js";
import { YieldOptimizerService } from "../src/services/yieldOptimizerService.js";
import { CentralTreasuryYieldVaultService } from "../src/contracts/centralTreasuryYieldVaultService.js";
import { DbClient } from "../src/database/dbClient.js";

async function runAuditTests() {
  console.log("==================================================");
  console.log("  D0 REAL WORLD AUDIT TESTS (E2E against DB)");
  console.log("==================================================");

  let pass = 0;
  let fail = 0;
  
  function assert(condition: boolean, label: string) {
    if (condition) {
      console.log(`  ✓ ${label}`);
      pass++;
    } else {
      console.error(`  ✗ FAIL: ${label}`);
      fail++;
    }
  }

  // 1. Setup Phase
  console.log("\n[Setup] Initializing Database & Clearing Tables...");
  await DbClient.query("TRUNCATE TABLE master_system_journal CASCADE");
  await DbClient.query("TRUNCATE TABLE account_liabilities CASCADE");
  await DbClient.query("TRUNCATE TABLE account_agent_audit_log CASCADE");
  await DbClient.query("TRUNCATE TABLE treasury_accounts CASCADE");

  const { profile } = PolicyLoader.getActiveProfile();
  
  // Create mock CentralTreasuryYieldVaultService
  const vaultAddr = "0xVAULT0000000000000000000000000000000001" as `0x${string}`;
  const vaultService = new CentralTreasuryYieldVaultService(vaultAddr);
  const optimizer = new YieldOptimizerService(vaultService);

  // Insert Accounts
  console.log("[Setup] Provisioning Accounts from Policy...");
  for (const acc of profile.operating_accounts) {
    await TreasuryAccountsRepo.upsertAccount({
      account_id: acc.account_id,
      name: acc.name,
      role: acc.role,
      wallet_address: `0x${acc.account_id.length.toString().padStart(40, "1")}` as `0x${string}`,
      chain_id: 5042002,
      min_operating_floor_usdc: acc.min_floor_usdc,
      safety_buffer_ratio: acc.safety_multiplier,
      is_active: true
    });
  }

  const engAcc = profile.operating_accounts.find((a) => a.account_id === "acc_engineering");
  if (!engAcc) throw new Error("Missing acc_engineering in profile");

  const payrollAcc = profile.operating_accounts.find((a) => a.account_id === "acc_payroll");
  if (!payrollAcc) throw new Error("Missing acc_payroll in profile");

  // 2. Test Scenario A: Safe to Invest Sweep
  console.log("\n[Test Scenario A] Revenue arrives → Sweep Triggered & Journaled");
  // Add a liability for engineering account within window
  await LiabilityRepo.createLiability({
    account_id: engAcc.account_id,
    vendor_id: "vendor_1",
    title: "Server Hosting",
    category: "INFRASTRUCTURE",
    amount_usdc: 100, // $100 liability
    due_date: new Date(Date.now() + 5 * 86400 * 1000), // Due in 5 days
    payout_address: "0x1111111111111111111111111111111111111111",
    status: "SCHEDULED"
  });

  // Evaluate with $500 balance
  const resA = await optimizer.evaluateAccount(engAcc.account_id, 500);
  const expectedTargetRes = (100 * engAcc.safety_multiplier) + engAcc.min_floor_usdc; // 100 * 1.2 + 50 = 170
  
  assert(Math.abs(resA.targetReserve - expectedTargetRes) < 0.01, `Target reserve correctly calculated: $${resA.targetReserve}`);
  assert(resA.action === "SWEEP", `Action is SWEEP`);
  assert(resA.safeToInvest === 320, `SafeToInvest is exactly 320 (500 - 170 - 10)`);
  assert(!!resA.encodedTx, `Encoded Tx generated for vault call`);

  // Verify DB Journaling
  const logsA = await DbClient.query("SELECT * FROM master_system_journal ORDER BY sequence_id DESC LIMIT 1");
  assert(logsA.rows.length === 1, "Journal entry was created");
  assert(logsA.rows[0].action_type === "AUTONOMOUS_SWEEP", "Journal entry action type is AUTONOMOUS_SWEEP");
  assert(Number(logsA.rows[0].amount_usdc) === 320, "Journal entry amount matches SafeToInvest");

  // 3. Test Scenario B: Balance Drops → Recall
  console.log("\n[Test Scenario B] Balance drops → Recall Triggered & Journaled");
  const resB = await optimizer.evaluateAccount(engAcc.account_id, 100); // 100 < 170 - 5 (recall band) -> 100 < 165 -> RECALL
  assert(resB.action === "RECALL", "Action is RECALL");
  assert(resB.actionAmountUsdc === 70, `Recall amount is exactly $70 to hit target reserve (170 - 100)`);
  
  const logsB = await DbClient.query("SELECT * FROM master_system_journal ORDER BY sequence_id DESC LIMIT 1");
  assert(logsB.rows[0].action_type === "AUTONOMOUS_RECALL", "Journal entry action type is AUTONOMOUS_RECALL");

  // 4. Test Scenario C: Payroll account is protected
  console.log("\n[Test Scenario C] Payroll protected account avoids sweep");
  const resC = await optimizer.evaluateAccount(payrollAcc.account_id, 500000);
  assert(resC.action === "NONE", "Payroll account returned NONE action despite huge balance");
  assert(resC.safeToInvest === 0, "SafeToInvest overridden to 0 for protected account");

  console.log("\n==================================================");
  console.log(`  SUMMARY: ${pass} passed, ${fail} failed`);
  console.log("==================================================");
  
  process.exit(fail > 0 ? 1 : 0);
}

runAuditTests().catch(console.error);

  // ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

  // ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  it("Test 3: AccountManagementService enforces Role Immutability, Dynamic Record 2 recalculation, and Safe Deactivation", async () => {
    const newAccountId = `${TENANT_1}_acc_logistics`;

    // 1. Create Account Post-Setup
    const created = await accountService.createAccount(TENANT_1, {
      accountId: newAccountId,
      name: "Fleet Logistics & Shipping",
      role: "OPEX_DEV",
      minOperatingFloorUsdc: 100.0,
      safetyBufferRatio: 1.20,
      perTxCapUsdc: 2000.0,
    });
    assert.equal(created.account_id, newAccountId);
    assert.equal(created.min_operating_floor_usdc, 100.0);

    // 2. Update Floor: Verifies Dynamic Record 2 recalculated
    const updated = await accountService.updateAccount(TENANT_1, newAccountId, {
      minOperatingFloorUsdc: 300.0,
      safetyBufferRatio: 1.30,
    });
    assert.equal(updated.min_operating_floor_usdc, 300.0);
    assert.equal(updated.safety_buffer_ratio, 1.30);

    // 3. Invariant: Role Immutability must reject role change
    await assert.rejects(
      async () => {
        await accountService.updateAccount(TENANT_1, newAccountId, {
          role: "PAYROLL" as any,
        });
      },
      /ROLE_IMMUTABLE/,
      "Should reject post-creation role changes"
    );

    // 4. Safe Deactivation Protocol:
    // Create an active liability linked to this account
    const activeLiab = await liabilityService.createLiability(TENANT_1, {
      accountId: newAccountId,
      vendorId: "vendor_fleet_fuel",
      title: "Monthly Fuel Card",
      category: "OPERATIONS" as any,
      amountUsdc: 150.0,
      dueDate: new Date(Date.now() + 5 * 86400 * 1000),
      payoutAddress: "0x4444444444444444444444444444444444444401",
    });
    assert.ok(activeLiab.liability_id);

    // Attempt deactivation -> MUST block due to active liability
    await assert.rejects(
      async () => {
        await accountService.deactivateAccount(TENANT_1, newAccountId);
      },
      /DEACTIVATION_BLOCKED/,
      "Should block deactivation when active liabilities are attached"
    );

    // Cancel the liability
    await liabilityService.cancelLiability(TENANT_1, activeLiab.liability_id!, "Fleet fuel card contract terminated.");

    // Now deactivation succeeds
    const deactRes = await accountService.deactivateAccount(TENANT_1, newAccountId);
    assert.equal(deactRes.success, true);

    const refreshed = await TreasuryAccountsRepo.getAccountByIdAndCompany(newAccountId, TENANT_1);
    assert.equal(refreshed?.is_active, false);
  });

  // ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  // TEST 4: Post-Setup Liability Lifecycle Governance (`LiabilityManagementService`)
  // ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  it("Test 4: LiabilityManagementService enforces non-destructive cancellation and Dynamic Record re-anchoring", async () => {
    const liab = await liabilityService.createLiability(TENANT_1, {
      accountId: `${TENANT_1}_acc_ops`,
      vendorId: "vendor_metering_cloud",
      title: "Smart Grid Metering SaaS",
      category: "SAAS",
      amountUsdc: 250.0,
      dueDate: new Date(Date.now() + 12 * 86400 * 1000),
      payoutAddress: "0x5555555555555555555555555555555555555501",
      preferredPaymentRail: "DISBURSAL_VAULT",
    });

    assert.equal(liab.amount_usdc, 250.0);
    assert.equal(liab.status, "SCHEDULED");

    // Admin modifies amount and due date
    const updated = await liabilityService.updateLiability(TENANT_1, liab.liability_id!, {
      amountUsdc: 300.0,
      title: "Smart Grid Metering Enterprise Tier",
    });
    assert.equal(updated.amount_usdc, 300.0);
    assert.equal(updated.title, "Smart Grid Metering Enterprise Tier");

    // Admin cancels liability -> status becomes CANCELLED, cancellationMemo preserved
    const cancelled = await liabilityService.cancelLiability(
      TENANT_1,
      liab.liability_id!,
      "Migrating to on-premise metering node."
    );
    assert.equal(cancelled.status, "CANCELLED");
    assert.equal(cancelled.disbursal_rules?.cancellationMemo, "Migrating to on-premise metering node.");

    // Verify row still exists in database (non-destructive)
    const inDb = await LiabilityRepo.getLiabilityByIdAndCompany(liab.liability_id!, TENANT_1);
    assert.ok(inDb);
    assert.equal(inDb?.status, "CANCELLED");
  });

  // ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  // TEST 5: Four-Rail Disbursal Execution (`DisbursalRouter`)
  // ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  it("Test 5: DisbursalRouter executes 4 liabilities across DISBURSAL_VAULT, MODULAR_SESSION_KEY, ERC3009, and GATEWAY_X402", async () => {
    const liabilities = await LiabilityRepo.getLiabilitiesByCompany(TENANT_1, { status: "SCHEDULED" });
    assert.ok(liabilities.length >= 4, "Should have scheduled liabilities from Step 5");

    const vaultLiab = liabilities.find((l) => l.preferred_payment_rail === "DISBURSAL_VAULT");
    const sessionLiab = liabilities.find((l) => l.preferred_payment_rail === "MODULAR_SESSION_KEY");
    const erc3009Liab = liabilities.find((l) => l.preferred_payment_rail === "ERC3009_AUTHORIZATION");
    const x402Liab = liabilities.find((l) => l.preferred_payment_rail === "GATEWAY_X402");

    assert.ok(vaultLiab, "DISBURSAL_VAULT liability exists");
    assert.ok(sessionLiab, "MODULAR_SESSION_KEY liability exists");
    assert.ok(erc3009Liab, "ERC3009_AUTHORIZATION liability exists");
    assert.ok(x402Liab, "GATEWAY_X402 liability exists");

    // Pre-fund balances in test execution
    const balances = {
      [`${TENANT_1}_acc_ops`]: 25000.0,
      [`${TENANT_1}_acc_rnd`]: 15000.0,
      [`${TENANT_1}_acc_payroll`]: 50000.0,
    };

    // 1. Execute DisbursalVault Rail
    const res1 = await disbursalRouter.executeLiabilityDisbursal({
      companyId: TENANT_1,
      liabilityId: vaultLiab!.liability_id!,
      accountBalances: balances,
    });
    assert.equal(res1.success, true);
    assert.equal(res1.rail, "DISBURSAL_VAULT");
    assert.ok(res1.txHash?.startsWith("0x"));

    // 2. Execute ModularSessionKey Rail
    const res2 = await disbursalRouter.executeLiabilityDisbursal({
      companyId: TENANT_1,
      liabilityId: sessionLiab!.liability_id!,
      accountBalances: balances,
    });
    assert.equal(res2.success, true);
    assert.equal(res2.rail, "MODULAR_SESSION_KEY");
    assert.ok(res2.sessionKeyId);

    // 3. Execute ERC-3009 Authorization Rail
    const res3 = await disbursalRouter.executeLiabilityDisbursal({
      companyId: TENANT_1,
      liabilityId: erc3009Liab!.liability_id!,
      accountBalances: balances,
    });
    assert.equal(res3.success, true);
    assert.equal(res3.rail, "ERC3009_AUTHORIZATION");
    assert.ok(res3.authorizationNonce?.startsWith("0x"));

    // 4. Execute Gateway x402 Nanopayments Rail
    const res4 = await disbursalRouter.executeLiabilityDisbursal({
      companyId: TENANT_1,
      liabilityId: x402Liab!.liability_id!,
      accountBalances: balances,
    });
    assert.equal(res4.success, true);
    assert.equal(res4.rail, "GATEWAY_X402");
    assert.ok(res4.gatewaySettlementRef?.startsWith("gw_nano_"));

    // Verify all 4 are SETTLED in PostgreSQL
    const settled1 = await LiabilityRepo.getLiabilityById(vaultLiab!.liability_id!);
    const settled2 = await LiabilityRepo.getLiabilityById(sessionLiab!.liability_id!);
    const settled3 = await LiabilityRepo.getLiabilityById(erc3009Liab!.liability_id!);
    const settled4 = await LiabilityRepo.getLiabilityById(x402Liab!.liability_id!);

    assert.equal(settled1?.status, "SETTLED");
    assert.equal(settled2?.status, "SETTLED");
    assert.equal(settled3?.status, "SETTLED");
    assert.equal(settled4?.status, "SETTLED");
  });

  // ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  // TEST 6: Multi-Tenant Concurrency and Isolation
  // ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  it("Test 6: Strict tenant isolation between Tenant 1 and Tenant 2 across accounts, liabilities, and profiles", async () => {
    const t1Accounts = await accountService.listAccounts(TENANT_1);
    const t2Accounts = await accountService.listAccounts(TENANT_2);

    assert.ok(t1Accounts.length > 0);
    assert.ok(t2Accounts.length > 0);

    // Verify no account overlap
    const t1Ids = new Set(t1Accounts.map((a) => a.account_id));
    for (const acc of t2Accounts) {
      assert.equal(t1Ids.has(acc.account_id), false, `Tenant 2 account ${acc.account_id} must not appear in Tenant 1`);
    }

    // Verify no liability overlap
    const t1Liabs = await liabilityService.listLiabilities(TENANT_1);
    const t2Liabs = await liabilityService.listLiabilities(TENANT_2);

    const t1LiabIds = new Set(t1Liabs.map((l) => l.liability_id));
    for (const liab of t2Liabs) {
      assert.equal(t1LiabIds.has(liab.liability_id), false, `Tenant 2 liability must not appear in Tenant 1`);
    }
  });
});

/**
 * D4, D5, D6 SEMANTIC & INTEGRATION TEST SUITE
 * ============================================
 * Covers:
 *   D6: PostgreSQL Relational Ledger Schema & Repositories
 *       - 6 core tables: treasury_accounts, account_liabilities, vendor_master_registry,
 *         permission_requests, account_agent_audit_log, master_system_journal
 *       - Rule 1: Document-Linked Ledgers Only (rejection of entries without doc ref)
 *       - Rule 4: SHA-256 Hash-Chaining & Tamper Detection
 *       - Rule 5: Exact Arithmetic (Refusal of silent rounding)
 *   D4: Account Registration & AccountShares Orchestration
 *       - Synchronize accounts from active PRODUCTION_TESTNET profile
 *       - DB & Onchain registration verification
 *       - Payroll isolation & strict account parameters
 *   D5: Vendor Allowlist, Caps, EIP-712 & Idempotency Orchestration
 *       - Rule 3: Vendor Master Change Control & Payee Substitution Detection
 *       - Rule 2: Three-Way Match (PO, Goods Delivery, Invoice)
 *       - Deterministic Idempotency Key generation
 *       - Policy Spending Caps (single-tx gate vs daily cap)
 *       - EIP-712 Signature Generation & Recoverability

import { DbClient } from "../src/database/dbClient.js";
import { runMigrations } from "../src/database/migrate.js";
import { TreasuryAccountsRepo } from "../src/database/repos/treasuryAccountsRepo.js";
import { LiabilityRepo } from "../src/database/repos/liabilityRepo.js";
