import {
  LedgerWitnessService as LedgerWitnessAgent,
  ReconciledReceiptError,
  LoudRoundingError,
} from "../src/services/ledgerWitnessService.js";
import { DbClient } from "../src/database/dbClient.js";
import { MasterJournalRepo } from "../src/database/repos/masterJournalRepo.js";
import { AuditLogRepo } from "../src/database/repos/auditLogRepo.js";
import { TreasuryAccountsRepo } from "../src/database/repos/treasuryAccountsRepo.js";
import { PolicyLoader } from "../src/config/policyLoader.js";
import { PublicClient, encodeEventTopics, parseAbiItem, toHex } from "viem";

async function runD7Tests() {
  console.log("==================================================");
  console.log("  D6 -> D7: LedgerWitnessAgent Comprehensive Audit");
  console.log("==================================================");

  let pass = 0;
  let fail = 0;
  const failures: string[] = [];

  function assert(condition: boolean, label: string) {
    if (condition) {
      console.log(`  ✓ ${label}`);
      pass++;
    } else {
      console.error(`  ✗ FAIL: ${label}`);
      fail++;
      failures.push(label);
    }
  }

  function assertEqual<T>(actual: T, expected: T, label: string) {
    if (actual === expected) {
      console.log(`  ✓ ${label}`);
      pass++;
    } else {
      console.error(`  ✗ FAIL: ${label} -> expected ${JSON.stringify(expected)}, got ${JSON.stringify(actual)}`);
      fail++;
      failures.push(label);
    }
  }

  // ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  // 1. SETUP & DB RESET
  // ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  console.log("\n[Setup] Cleaning DB tables for fresh witness audit...");
  await DbClient.query("TRUNCATE TABLE master_system_journal CASCADE");
  await DbClient.query("TRUNCATE TABLE account_agent_audit_log CASCADE");
  await DbClient.query("TRUNCATE TABLE account_liabilities CASCADE");
  await DbClient.query("TRUNCATE TABLE treasury_accounts CASCADE");

  const { profile } = PolicyLoader.getActiveProfile();
  for (const acc of profile.operating_accounts) {
    await TreasuryAccountsRepo.upsertAccount({
      account_id: acc.account_id,
      name: acc.name,
      role: acc.role,
      wallet_address: `0x${acc.account_id.length.toString().padStart(40, "2")}` as `0x${string}`,
      chain_id: 5042002,
      min_operating_floor_usdc: acc.min_floor_usdc,
      safety_buffer_ratio: acc.safety_multiplier,
      is_active: true,
    });
  }

  // ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  // 2. SEGREGATION OF DUTIES (Rule 4)
  // ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  console.log("\n[Test 1] Segregation of Duties: LedgerWitness has zero signing capability");
  const agent = new LedgerWitnessAgent();
  assertEqual(agent.persona, "LedgerWitnessAgent", "Persona is LedgerWitnessAgent");
  assertEqual(agent.canSignTransactions, false, "canSignTransactions is FALSE (zero private keys)");
  assertEqual(agent.canWriteLedger, true, "canWriteLedger is TRUE (auditor write permissions)");
  assertEqual(agent.erc8004Id, 105, "ERC-8004 Agent ID is 105");

  // ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  // 3. DOUBLE-ENTRY VOUCHER STANDARD
  // ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  console.log("\n[Test 2] Double-Entry Accounting Vouchers");
  const sweepVoucher = agent.getDoubleEntryAccounts("AUTONOMOUS_SWEEP", "acc_engineering");
  assertEqual(
    sweepVoucher.debitAccount,
    "Asset:Investments:USYC:acc_engineering",
    "SWEEP Debit is Asset:Investments:USYC:acc_engineering"
  );
  assertEqual(
    sweepVoucher.creditAccount,
    "Asset:Cash:USDC:acc_engineering",
    "SWEEP Credit is Asset:Cash:USDC:acc_engineering"
  );

  const recallVoucher = agent.getDoubleEntryAccounts("AUTONOMOUS_RECALL", "acc_engineering");
  assertEqual(
    recallVoucher.debitAccount,
    "Asset:Cash:USDC:acc_engineering",
    "RECALL Debit is Asset:Cash:USDC:acc_engineering"
  );
  assertEqual(
    recallVoucher.creditAccount,
    "Asset:Investments:USYC:acc_engineering",
    "RECALL Credit is Asset:Investments:USYC:acc_engineering"
  );

  const disbursalVoucher = agent.getDoubleEntryAccounts(
    "DISBURSAL_PAYMENT",
    "acc_engineering",
    "vendor_aws",
    "INFRASTRUCTURE"
  );
  assertEqual(
    disbursalVoucher.debitAccount,
    "Expense:INFRASTRUCTURE:vendor_aws",
    "DISBURSAL Debit is Expense:INFRASTRUCTURE:vendor_aws"
  );
  assertEqual(
    disbursalVoucher.creditAccount,
    "Asset:Cash:USDC:acc_engineering",
    "DISBURSAL Credit is Asset:Cash:USDC:acc_engineering"
  );

  // ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  // 4. INDEPENDENT RPC RECEIPT RECONCILIATION
  // ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  console.log("\n[Test 3] Independent RPC Receipt Reconciliation & Event Decoding");

  const SENDER = "0x2222222222222222222222222222222222222222" as `0x${string}`;
  const VAULT = "0x3333333333333333333333333333333333333333" as `0x${string}`;
  const TX_HASH = "0xaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa" as `0x${string}`;

  // Build a realistic simulated ERC-20 Transfer log for $320 USDC (320_000_000 micro-units)
  const transferAbi = parseAbiItem("event Transfer(address indexed from, address indexed to, uint256 value)");
  const topics = encodeEventTopics({
    abi: [transferAbi],
    eventName: "Transfer",
    args: {
      from: SENDER,
      to: VAULT,
    },
  });

  const mockReceipt = {
    transactionHash: TX_HASH,
    blockNumber: 123456n,
    blockHash: "0xbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbb" as `0x${string}`,
    status: "success" as const,
    gasUsed: 42000n,
    from: SENDER,
    to: VAULT,
    logs: [
      {
        address: "0x1c7D4B196Cb0C7B01d743Fbc6116a902379C7238" as `0x${string}`, // USDC
        topics,
        data: toHex(BigInt(320_000_000), { size: 32 }), // 320 USDC
      },
    ],
  };

  const mockClient = {
    getTransactionReceipt: async ({ hash }: { hash: `0x${string}` }) => {
      if (hash === TX_HASH) return mockReceipt;
      if (hash === "0xreverted00000000000000000000000000000000000000000000000000000000") {
        return { ...mockReceipt, status: "reverted" as const, transactionHash: hash };
      }
      return null;
    },
  } as unknown as PublicClient;

  const witnessWithMockRpc = new LedgerWitnessAgent(mockClient);

  // S1: Successful reconciliation with exact amount match
  const rec = await witnessWithMockRpc.reconcileTransactionReceipt(TX_HASH, {
    from: SENDER,
    to: VAULT,
    amountUsdc: 320.0,
  });
  assert(rec.status === "success", "Receipt status reconciled as 'success'");
  assertEqual(rec.transferredAmountUsdc, 320.0, "Decoded transferred amount is exactly 320.000000 USDC");
  assertEqual(rec.blockNumber, 123456n, "Block number confirmed at 123456");

  // S2: Reverted transaction throws ReconciledReceiptError
  let revertedCaught = false;
  try {
    await witnessWithMockRpc.reconcileTransactionReceipt(
      "0xreverted00000000000000000000000000000000000000000000000000000000"
    );
  } catch (err) {
    revertedCaught = err instanceof ReconciledReceiptError;
  }
  assert(revertedCaught, "Reverted transaction receipt throws ReconciledReceiptError");

  // ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  // 5. FINANCIAL GUARDRAIL AUDITS (Rules 1, 3, 5)
  // ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  console.log("\n[Test 4] Rule 3: Payee Substitution Protection");
  let payeeSubCaught = false;
  try {
    const ATTACKER_ADDR = "0x9999999999999999999999999999999999999999" as `0x${string}`;
    await witnessWithMockRpc.reconcileTransactionReceipt(TX_HASH, {
      to: ATTACKER_ADDR, // Expected attacker, but receipt sent to VAULT
      amountUsdc: 320.0,
    });
  } catch (err) {
    payeeSubCaught = err instanceof ReconciledReceiptError && (err as Error).message.includes("Payee Substitution Detected");
  }
  assert(payeeSubCaught, "Payee mismatch triggers Payee Substitution violation error");

  console.log("\n[Test 5] Rule 5: Refuse Silent Rounding (Loud Repair)");
  let roundingErrorCaught = false;
  try {
    // Expected 320.000001, but onchain is 320.000000
    await witnessWithMockRpc.reconcileTransactionReceipt(TX_HASH, {
      amountUsdc: 320.000001,
    });
  } catch (err) {
    roundingErrorCaught = err instanceof LoudRoundingError;
  }
  assert(roundingErrorCaught, "Micro-unit difference (0.000001 USDC) throws LoudRoundingError");

  console.log("\n[Test 6] Rule 1: Document-Linked Ledger Only");
  let docRefErrorCaught = false;
  try {
    await witnessWithMockRpc.recordJournalVoucher({
      accountId: "acc_engineering",
      actionType: "AUTONOMOUS_SWEEP",
      amountUsdc: 320,
      documentRef: "", // Violation: empty document reference
    });
  } catch (err) {
    docRefErrorCaught = (err as Error).message.includes("Rule 1 violation");
  }
  assert(docRefErrorCaught, "Empty documentRef throws Rule 1 violation error");

  // ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  // 6. END-TO-END WITNESS TRANSACTION FLOW
  // ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  console.log("\n[Test 7] End-to-End witnessTransaction: Receipt + Audit Log + Master Journal");
  const witnessRes = await witnessWithMockRpc.witnessTransaction({
    accountId: "acc_engineering",
    actionType: "AUTONOMOUS_SWEEP",
    txHash: TX_HASH,
    amountUsdc: 320.0,
    documentRef: "SWEEP_PO_2026_001",
    counterpartyAddress: VAULT,
    isAutonomous: true,
    preState: { liquidUsdc: 500, investedUsyc: 0 },
    postState: { liquidUsdc: 180, investedUsyc: 320 },
    reason: "Autonomous surplus yield sweep to USYC vault",
  });

  assert(witnessRes.reconciled, "Transaction witnessed and reconciled");
  assertEqual(witnessRes.journalEntry.amount_usdc, 320.0, "Journal entry amount matches 320.0 USDC");
  assertEqual(witnessRes.journalEntry.document_ref, "SWEEP_PO_2026_001", "Journal entry has verifiable documentRef");
  assertEqual(witnessRes.auditLog.actor_agent, "LedgerWitnessAgent", "Audit log actor_agent is LedgerWitnessAgent");
  assertEqual(witnessRes.auditLog.action_type, "AUTONOMOUS_SWEEP", "Audit log action_type is AUTONOMOUS_SWEEP");

  // ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  // 7. SEQUENTIAL HASH CHAIN INTEGRITY & TAMPER DETECTION (Rule 4)
  // ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  console.log("\n[Test 8] Cryptographic Master System Journal Hash Chaining & Tamper Detection");
  
  // Append 2 more vouchers to form a chain
  await witnessWithMockRpc.recordJournalVoucher({
    accountId: "acc_engineering",
    actionType: "CUSTOMER_FUNDING",
    amountUsdc: 1000.0,
    documentRef: "INV-CUST-9001",
  });

  await witnessWithMockRpc.recordJournalVoucher({
    accountId: "acc_engineering",
    actionType: "DISBURSAL_PAYMENT",
    amountUsdc: 150.0,
    documentRef: "PO-DATADOG-2026",
    vendorId: "vendor_datadog",
    category: "SAAS",
  });

  // Verify chain integrity
  const integrityInitial = await witnessWithMockRpc.verifyLedgerIntegrity();
  assert(integrityInitial.valid, "Master journal hash chain is cryptographically VALID");
  assertEqual(integrityInitial.totalEntries, 3, "Master journal contains exactly 3 chained entries");

  // Tamper test: Alter entry #2 in the database directly
  console.log("\n[Test 9] Tamper Detection: Malicious edit in sequence #2");
  const secondEntryRes = await DbClient.query(
    "SELECT sequence_id, amount_usdc FROM master_system_journal ORDER BY sequence_id ASC OFFSET 1 LIMIT 1"
  );
  const secondEntry = secondEntryRes.rows[0];
  const origAmount = Number(secondEntry.amount_usdc);

  await DbClient.query(
    "UPDATE master_system_journal SET amount_usdc = 999.000000 WHERE sequence_id = $1",
    [secondEntry.sequence_id]
  );

  const integrityTampered = await witnessWithMockRpc.verifyLedgerIntegrity();
  assert(!integrityTampered.valid, "Tampered journal entry is DETECTED as INVALID");
  assert(
    !!integrityTampered.brokenAtSequence,
    `Integrity check pinpointed broken sequence ID: ${integrityTampered.brokenAtSequence}`
  );

  // Restore entry so DB integrity is preserved
  await DbClient.query(
    "UPDATE master_system_journal SET amount_usdc = $1 WHERE sequence_id = $2",
    [origAmount, secondEntry.sequence_id]
  );
  const integrityRestored = await witnessWithMockRpc.verifyLedgerIntegrity();
  assert(integrityRestored.valid, "Ledger integrity restored to 100% valid state after correction");

  // ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  // 8. CIRCLE WEBHOOK AUDITING
  // ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  console.log("\n[Test 10] Circle Webhook Ingestion & Reconciliation");
  const webhookBody = JSON.stringify({
    notificationId: "notif_12345",
    type: "transactions.inbound",
    data: {
      id: "tx_inbound_99",
      state: "CONFIRMED",
      txHash: TX_HASH,
      amount: "320.00",
    },
    timestamp: new Date().toISOString(),
  });

  const webhookResult = await witnessWithMockRpc.reconcileCircleWebhook({
    rawBody: webhookBody,
  });
  assert(webhookResult.verified, "Circle webhook payload verified and ingested");
  assertEqual(webhookResult.payload.data.state, "CONFIRMED", "Webhook state is CONFIRMED");
  assert(!!webhookResult.reconciledReceipt, "Webhook automatically reconciled onchain transaction receipt");

  // ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  // SUMMARY
  // ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  console.log("\n" + "=".repeat(50));
  console.log(`  RESULTS: ${pass} passed, ${fail} failed`);
  if (failures.length > 0) {
    console.error("  FAILURES:");
    failures.forEach((f) => console.error(`    ✗ ${f}`));
  } else {
    console.log("  >>> ALL D6->D7 LEDGER WITNESS AUDIT TESTS PASSED <<<");
  }
  console.log("=".repeat(50));

  process.exit(fail > 0 ? 1 : 0);
}

runD7Tests().catch((err) => {
  console.error("[FATAL]", err);
  process.exit(1);

import { describe, it, before, after } from "node:test";
import assert from "node:assert/strict";
import { DbClient } from "../src/database/dbClient.js";
import { McpClientManager } from "../src/connectors/mcpClientManager.js";
import { MissingVendorCredentialsError } from "../src/connectors/vendorBillingTypes.js";
import { IntakeDiscoveryAgent } from "../src/services/intakeDiscoveryAgent.js";
import { VendorMasterRepo } from "../src/database/repos/vendorMasterRepo.js";
import { OnboardingWizardService } from "../src/services/onboardingWizardService.js";

describe("IntakeDiscoveryAgent & McpClientManager Architecture Verification", () => {
  const companyId = `cmp_intake_test_${Date.now()}`;
  let sessionId: string;

  before(async () => {
    // Seed verified vendor in VendorMasterRepo (Rule 3 Payee Verification)
    await VendorMasterRepo.registerVendor({
      vendor_id: "vnd_datadog",
      name: "Datadog, Inc.",
      verified_payout_address: "0x2222222222222222222222222222222222222222",
      verified_by_admin: "admin_tester",
      last_verified_at: new Date(),
      change_lock: true,
    });

    const wizardService = new OnboardingWizardService();
    const session = await wizardService.createSession({
      companyId,
      entryPath: "GOOGLE_WORKSPACE",
    });
    sessionId = session.sessionId;
  });

  after(async () => {
    await DbClient.closePool();
  });

  it("1. McpClientManager loudly throws MissingVendorCredentialsError when credentials missing (Rule 5)", async () => {
    await assert.rejects(
      async () => await McpClientManager.getClientSession("cmp_unauthed_999", "GOOGLE_WORKSPACE"),
      (err: any) => {
        assert.ok(err instanceof MissingVendorCredentialsError);
        assert.equal(err.vendorName, "Google Workspace MCP");
        return true;
      }
    );

    await assert.rejects(
      async () => await McpClientManager.getClientSession("cmp_unauthed_999", "MICROSOFT_365"),
      (err: any) => {
        assert.ok(err instanceof MissingVendorCredentialsError);
        assert.equal(err.vendorName, "Microsoft 365 MCP");
        return true;
      }
    );
  });

  it("2. IntakeDiscoveryAgent synthesizes across Workspace MCP and Top 10 Vendor Connectors", async () => {
    const testGoogleTransport = {
      async callTool(name: string, args: Record<string, any>) {
        if (name === "gmail_search_messages") return { messageIds: ["msg_dd_01"] };
        if (name === "gmail_get_message") {
          return {
            id: "msg_dd_01",
            bodyText: "Datadog Invoice INV-2026-DD-9812 for $1,250.00 USDC due 2026-10-15 to 0x2222222222222222222222222222222222222222 PO: PO-2026-DATADOG-01 Cost Center: Engineering Cloud Infrastructure",
          };
        }
        if (name === "gdrive_search_files") {
          return {
            files: [
              {
                id: "doc_dd_contract",
                name: "Datadog_Enterprise_Agreement.pdf",
                textContent: "Master Services Agreement Datadog Committed Monthly Spend $1,000.00 USDC. Terms: Vendor must provide 30-day prior written notice for price increases exceeding 5%. Department: Engineering Cloud Infrastructure",
              },
            ],
          };
        }
        return {};
      },
    };

    const testMicrosoftTransport = {
      async callTool(name: string, args: Record<string, any>) {
        if (name === "onedrive_search_files") {
          return {
            files: [
              { id: "wb_budget", name: "Budget_Schedule.xlsx", mimeType: "application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet" },
            ],
          };
        }
        if (name === "excel_read_range") {
          return {
            values: [
              ["Vendor Name", "Monthly Cost (USDC)", "Due Date", "Department Tag", "PO Number", "Payout Wallet"],
              ["GitHub, Inc.", "$500.00", "2026-10-25", "Developer Tooling & CI/CD", "PO-2026-GH-01", "0x3333333333333333333333333333333333333333"],
            ],
          };
        }
        return {};
      },
    };

    const testAwsTransport = {
      async request() {
        return {
          monthlySpend: 9200.0,
          forecastedSpend: 9500.0,
          costCenters: [{ tag: "Core Cloud Compute", amount: 9200.0 }],
        };
      },
    };

    const agent = new IntakeDiscoveryAgent({
      companyId,
      googleTransport: testGoogleTransport,
      microsoftTransport: testMicrosoftTransport,
      vendorTransports: { AWS: testAwsTransport },
    });

    const synthesis = await agent.synthesizeAllSources();

    assert.equal(synthesis.companyId, companyId);
    assert.ok(synthesis.discoveredCostCenters.length >= 2, "Must discover normalized cost centers");
    assert.ok(synthesis.discoveredLiabilities.length >= 2, "Must discover liabilities from workspace & AWS");
    assert.ok(synthesis.totalCommittedMonthlySpendUsdc > 0);

    // Rule 3 Payee Verification
    const datadogLiab = synthesis.discoveredLiabilities.find((l) => l.vendorName.includes("Datadog"));
    assert.ok(datadogLiab);
    assert.equal(datadogLiab?.payeeVerified, true, "Datadog payout address must be verified against VendorMasterRepo");

    // Stealth Price Creep Detection (Datadog billed $1,250 vs $1,000 baseline)
    assert.ok(synthesis.stealthCreepAlerts.length >= 1, "Must trigger Stealth Price Creep alert");
    assert.equal(synthesis.stealthCreepAlerts[0].vendorName, "Datadog, Inc.");
    assert.ok(synthesis.stealthCreepAlerts[0].clause.includes("30-day prior written notice"));
  });

  it("3. IntakeDiscoveryAgent pre-fills wizard draft session successfully", async () => {
    const testAwsTransport = {
      async request() {
        return {
          monthlySpend: 5000.0,
          forecastedSpend: 5200.0,
          costCenters: [{ tag: "Cloud Infrastructure", amount: 5000.0 }],
        };
      },
    };

    const agent = new IntakeDiscoveryAgent({
      companyId,
      vendorTransports: { AWS: testAwsTransport },
    });

    const updatedSession = await agent.prefillWizardSession(sessionId);
    assert.equal(updatedSession.sessionId, sessionId);
    assert.equal(updatedSession.status, "DRAFT_READY");
    assert.ok(updatedSession.draftPayload.step4_accounts.length >= 1);
    assert.ok(updatedSession.draftPayload.step5_liabilities.length >= 1);
  });
});

        ('${testTaxAccountId}', '${testCompanyId}', 'Tax Reserve', 'TAX_RESERVE', '0x3333333333333333333333333333333333333333', 2000.000000, true),
        ('${testYieldAccountId}', '${testCompanyId}', 'Yield Vault', 'YIELD_VAULT', '0x4444444444444444444444444444444444444444', 0.000000, true)
      ON CONFLICT (account_id) DO UPDATE SET is_active = true;
    `);

/**
 * D20: Unified Operational State Integration Test Suite
 * =======================================================
 * Validates DAG Node D20 synthesizing the 8 foundational dimensions:
 * 1. Liquid Balances (BL)
 * 2. Tokenized USYC Invested Balances (BY)
 * 3. Total Effective Purchasing Power & Tripartite Invariant (BE = BL + BY)
 * 4. Liabilities Dynamic Record 1 (Upcoming 30d, overdue, category breakdown)
 * 5. Safe-to-Invest Dynamic Record 2 (Evaluation horizon, reserve floors, hysteresis)
 * 6. ERP Sync Status (ERPNext, Odoo, Three-Way Match integrity)
 * 7. Master Journal & Audit State (SHA-256 hash-chain verification, autonomous vs human)
 * 8. Transaction & Policy Governance State (24h spend cap, SPRS, authorized intents, locks)
 *
 * Plus ToolRegistry integration: executeTool("get_unified_operational_state")
 *
 * Zero stubs. Zero mocks. Real PostgreSQL & viem cryptographic verification.
 */

import { describe, it, before, after } from "node:test";
import assert from "node:assert/strict";
import crypto from "crypto";
import { DbClient } from "../src/database/dbClient.js";
import { TreasuryAccountsRepo } from "../src/database/repos/treasuryAccountsRepo.js";
import { VendorMasterRepo } from "../src/database/repos/vendorMasterRepo.js";
import { LiabilityRepo } from "../src/database/repos/liabilityRepo.js";
import { PermissionRequestRepo } from "../src/database/repos/permissionRequestRepo.js";
import { MasterJournalRepo } from "../src/database/repos/masterJournalRepo.js";
import { ErpSyncRepo } from "../src/database/repos/erpSyncRepo.js";
import { AuditLogRepo } from "../src/database/repos/auditLogRepo.js";
import { AccountLockManager } from "../src/foundation/events/lockManager.js";
import { UnifiedOperationalStateService } from "../src/services/unifiedOperationalStateService.js";
import { ToolRegistry } from "../src/tools/toolRegistry.js";

describe("D20: Unified Operational State Real-World Integration", () => {
  const ts = Date.now();
  const testAcc1 = `acc_d20_ops_${ts}`;
  const testAcc2 = `acc_d20_rsv_${ts}`;
  const wallet1 = `0x${crypto.randomBytes(20).toString("hex")}`;
  const wallet2 = `0x${crypto.randomBytes(20).toString("hex")}`;
  const vendorId = `vnd_d20_${ts}`;
  const vendorPayoutAddr = `0x${crypto.randomBytes(20).toString("hex")}`;
  let liabilityId1: string;
  let liabilityId2: string;
  let sprsRequestId: string;

  let stateService: UnifiedOperationalStateService;
  let toolRegistry: ToolRegistry;

  before(async () => {
    stateService = new UnifiedOperationalStateService();
    toolRegistry = new ToolRegistry();

    // 0. Pre-clean
    await DbClient.query("DELETE FROM dynamic_safe_to_invest WHERE account_id LIKE 'acc_d20_%';");
    await DbClient.query("DELETE FROM master_system_journal WHERE account_id LIKE 'acc_d20_%';");
    await DbClient.query("DELETE FROM account_agent_audit_log WHERE account_id LIKE 'acc_d20_%';");
    await DbClient.query("DELETE FROM account_liabilities WHERE account_id LIKE 'acc_d20_%';");
    await DbClient.query("DELETE FROM erp_sync_state WHERE account_id LIKE 'acc_d20_%';");
    await DbClient.query("DELETE FROM treasury_accounts WHERE account_id LIKE 'acc_d20_%';");

    // 1. Seed Treasury Accounts
    await TreasuryAccountsRepo.upsertAccount({
      account_id: testAcc1,
      name: "D20 Operations Account",
      role: "OPERATING" as any,
      wallet_address: wallet1 as `0x${string}`,
      chain_id: 5042,
      min_operating_floor_usdc: 1000,
      safety_buffer_ratio: 0.2,
      is_active: true,
    });

    await TreasuryAccountsRepo.upsertAccount({
      account_id: testAcc2,
      name: "D20 Reserve Account",
      role: "RESERVE" as any,
      wallet_address: wallet2 as `0x${string}`,
      chain_id: 5042,
      min_operating_floor_usdc: 2500,
      safety_buffer_ratio: 0.15,
      is_active: true,
    });

    // 2. Seed Vendor Master
    await VendorMasterRepo.registerVendor({
      vendor_id: vendorId,
      name: "D20 Cloud Infrastructure Corp",
      verified_payout_address: vendorPayoutAddr as `0x${string}`,
      verified_by_admin: "admin@bizarc.io",
      last_verified_at: new Date(),
      change_lock: true,
    });

    // 3. Seed Liabilities (Record 1)
    const dueSoon = new Date(Date.now() + 5 * 86400 * 1000);
    const overdue = new Date(Date.now() - 2 * 86400 * 1000);

    const liab1 = await LiabilityRepo.createLiability({
      account_id: testAcc1,
      vendor_id: vendorId,
      title: "Monthly Dedicated Servers",
      category: "INFRASTRUCTURE",
      amount_usdc: 750.0,
      due_date: dueSoon,
      status: "SCHEDULED",
      payout_address: vendorPayoutAddr,
    });
    liabilityId1 = liab1.liability_id;

    const liab2 = await LiabilityRepo.createLiability({
      account_id: testAcc1,
      vendor_id: vendorId,
      title: "Past Due Fiber Transit",
      category: "TELECOM",
      amount_usdc: 200.0,
      due_date: overdue,
      status: "SCHEDULED",
      payout_address: vendorPayoutAddr,
    });
    liabilityId2 = liab2.liability_id;

    // 4. Seed ERP Sync Records (D20.B)
    await ErpSyncRepo.upsertSyncState({
      sync_id: `sync_erpnext_${ts}`,
      system_type: "ERPNEXT",
      account_id: testAcc1,
      entity_type: "PAYMENT_ENTRY",
      last_sync_timestamp: new Date(),
      last_synced_document_id: `PE-ERPNEXT-${ts}`,
      status: "SYNCED",
      sync_checkpoint_data: {
        invoiceId: `INV-ERPNEXT-${ts}`,
        txHash: `0x${crypto.randomBytes(32).toString("hex")}`,
        threeWayMatchVerified: true,
      },
    });

    await ErpSyncRepo.upsertSyncState({
      sync_id: `sync_odoo_${ts}`,
      system_type: "ODOO",
      account_id: testAcc1,
      entity_type: "PAYMENT_ENTRY",
      last_sync_timestamp: new Date(),
      last_synced_document_id: `PAY-ODOO-${ts}`,
      status: "SYNCED",
      sync_checkpoint_data: {
        invoiceId: `INV-ODOO-${ts}`,
        odooPaymentId: 8842,
        threeWayMatchVerified: true,
      },
    });

    // 5. Seed Master System Journal vouchers & Hash Chaining
    const voucherHash1 = `0x${crypto.randomBytes(32).toString("hex")}`;
    const voucherHash2 = `0x${crypto.randomBytes(32).toString("hex")}`;

    await MasterJournalRepo.appendEntry({
      account_id: testAcc1,
      action_type: "SWEEP_TO_YIELD",
      debit_account: "USYC_VAULT",
      credit_account: testAcc1,
      amount_usdc: 3000.0,
      document_ref: `rcpt_swp_${ts}`,
    });

    await MasterJournalRepo.appendEntry({
      account_id: testAcc1,
      action_type: "DISBURSAL_PAYMENT",
      debit_account: "DISBURSAL_VAULT",
      credit_account: testAcc1,
      amount_usdc: 750.0,
      document_ref: `rcpt_disb_${ts}`,
    });

    // 6. Seed Account Agent Audit Log entries
    await AuditLogRepo.appendAuditLog({
      account_id: testAcc1,
      action_type: "YIELD_SWEEP",
      amount_usdc: 3000.0,
      is_autonomous: true,
      tx_hash: voucherHash1,
      reason: "Autonomous yield sweep executed inside policy",
      pre_state_snapshot: { liquidUsdc: "10000.000000" },
      post_state_snapshot: { liquidUsdc: "7000.000000", investedUsyc: "3000.000000" },
      actor_agent: "TreasurySentinel",
    });

    await AuditLogRepo.appendAuditLog({
      account_id: testAcc1,
      action_type: "DISBURSAL_EXECUTION",
      amount_usdc: 750.0,
      is_autonomous: false,
      tx_hash: voucherHash2,
      reason: "Human-approved server payment",
      pre_state_snapshot: { liquidUsdc: "7000.000000" },
      post_state_snapshot: { liquidUsdc: "6250.000000" },
      actor_agent: "DisbursalRouter",
    });

    // 7. Seed Pending SPRS
    sprsRequestId = `sprs_${ts}`;
    await PermissionRequestRepo.createRequest({
      request_id: sprsRequestId,
      action_type: "VENDOR_PAYMENT",
      amount_usdc: 1500.0,
      status: "PENDING",
      reason: "Quarterly security penetration testing",
      payload: {
        vendor_id: vendorId,
        conflicting_policy: "Single-transaction limit threshold exceeded ($1500 > $500)",
      },
    });
  });

  after(async () => {
    // Cleanup seeded test fixtures
    await DbClient.query(`DELETE FROM account_liabilities WHERE account_id IN ($1, $2);`, [testAcc1, testAcc2]);
    await DbClient.query(`DELETE FROM erp_sync_state WHERE account_id IN ($1, $2);`, [testAcc1, testAcc2]);
    await DbClient.query(`DELETE FROM account_agent_audit_log WHERE account_id IN ($1, $2);`, [testAcc1, testAcc2]);
    await DbClient.query(`DELETE FROM master_system_journal WHERE account_id IN ($1, $2);`, [testAcc1, testAcc2]);
    await DbClient.query(`DELETE FROM dynamic_safe_to_invest WHERE account_id IN ($1, $2);`, [testAcc1, testAcc2]);
    await DbClient.query(`DELETE FROM permission_requests WHERE request_id = $1;`, [sprsRequestId]);
    await DbClient.query(`DELETE FROM vendor_master_registry WHERE vendor_id = $1;`, [vendorId]);
    await DbClient.query(`DELETE FROM treasury_accounts WHERE account_id IN ($1, $2);`, [testAcc1, testAcc2]);
  });

  it("1. should compute balance dimensions and verify the Tripartite Invariant (BL + BY = BE)", async () => {
    const balanceOverrides = {
      [testAcc1]: { liquidUsdc: "5000.000000", investedUsyc: "10000.000000" },
      [testAcc2]: { liquidUsdc: "2500.000000", investedUsyc: "5000.000000" },
    };

    const state = await stateService.getUnifiedOperationalState({ balanceOverrides });

    assert.ok(state.timestamp, "State must have an ISO timestamp");
    assert.strictEqual(state.currency, "USDC");
    assert.ok(state.activeProfile, "Active profile should be defined");

    // Tripartite Invariant check
    assert.strictEqual(state.balances.tripartiteInvariantVerified, true, "Tripartite invariant must hold");
    const sum = state.balances.totalLiquidRaw + state.balances.totalInvestedRaw;
    assert.strictEqual(sum, state.balances.totalEffectiveRaw, "Liquid + Invested must equal Effective raw");

    // Solvency Health
    assert.strictEqual(state.balances.solvencyHealth.isSolvent, true, "Company should be solvent");
    assert.ok(state.balances.solvencyHealth.healthRatio >= 1.0, "Health ratio must be >= 1.0");

    // Verify account inclusion
    const acc1State = state.balances.accounts.find((a) => a.accountId === testAcc1);
    assert.ok(acc1State, "Test Account 1 must be present in accounts breakdown");
    assert.strictEqual(acc1State.liquidUsdc, "5000.000000");
    assert.strictEqual(acc1State.investedUsyc, "10000.000000");
    assert.strictEqual(acc1State.totalEffectiveUsdc, "15000.000000");
  });

  const defaultOverrides = {
    [testAcc1]: { liquidUsdc: 5000, investedUsyc: 10000 },
    [testAcc2]: { liquidUsdc: 2500, investedUsyc: 5000 },
  };

  it("2. should correctly evaluate Liabilities (Dynamic Record 1) with overdue flags and category breakdown", async () => {
    const state = await stateService.getUnifiedOperationalState({
      accountId: testAcc1,
      balanceOverrides: defaultOverrides,
      horizonDays: 30,
    });

    const liabilities = state.liabilities;
    assert.ok(liabilities.totalLiabilitiesCount >= 2, "Must include the 2 seeded liabilities");
    assert.ok(liabilities.activeScheduledCount >= 2, "Active scheduled liabilities count should match");

    // Category breakdown should contain INFRASTRUCTURE and TELECOM
    assert.ok("INFRASTRUCTURE" in liabilities.categoryBreakdown, "INFRASTRUCTURE category must be present");
    assert.strictEqual(liabilities.categoryBreakdown["INFRASTRUCTURE"], "750.000000");

    assert.ok("TELECOM" in liabilities.categoryBreakdown, "TELECOM category must be present");
    assert.strictEqual(liabilities.categoryBreakdown["TELECOM"], "200.000000");

    // Overdue liability verification
    const overdueItem = liabilities.upcomingItems.find((item) => item.liabilityId === liabilityId2);
    assert.ok(overdueItem, "Overdue liability must be in upcoming items");
    assert.strictEqual(overdueItem.isOverdue, true, "Overdue flag must be true");
    assert.strictEqual(overdueItem.amountUsdc, "200.000000");

    const upcomingItem = liabilities.upcomingItems.find((item) => item.liabilityId === liabilityId1);
    assert.ok(upcomingItem, "Upcoming liability must be in upcoming items");
    assert.strictEqual(upcomingItem.isOverdue, false, "Upcoming liability must not be marked overdue");
  });

  it("3. should calculate Safe-to-Invest Horizon (Dynamic Record 2) with hysteresis bands", async () => {
    const balanceOverrides = {
      [testAcc1]: { liquidUsdc: 8000, investedUsyc: 12000 },
    };

    const state = await stateService.getUnifiedOperationalState({
      accountId: testAcc1,
      balanceOverrides,
      horizonDays: 30,
    });

    const horizon = state.safeToInvestHorizon;
    assert.strictEqual(horizon.evaluationHorizonDays, 30);
    assert.ok(horizon.hysteresis.investHysteresisBandUsdc >= 0, "Invest hysteresis band must be non-negative");
    assert.ok(horizon.hysteresis.recallHysteresisBandUsdc >= 0, "Recall hysteresis band must be non-negative");
    assert.ok(horizon.hysteresis.minSweepAmountUsdc >= 0, "Min sweep amount must be non-negative");

    const accRecord = horizon.accountRecords.find((r) => r.accountId === testAcc1);
    assert.ok(accRecord, "Account record must exist in safeToInvest horizon");
    assert.strictEqual(accRecord.status, "SAFE_TO_INVEST", "Excess liquid funds should yield SAFE_TO_INVEST");
    assert.ok(accRecord.safeToInvestRaw > 0n, "Safe to invest raw must be greater than zero");
  });

  it("4. should report ERP Sync Status (D20.B) and Three-Way Match integrity", async () => {
    const state = await stateService.getUnifiedOperationalState({
      accountId: testAcc1,
      balanceOverrides: defaultOverrides,
    });

    const erp = state.erpSyncStatus;
    assert.strictEqual(erp.overallStatus, "SYNCED");
    assert.strictEqual(erp.threeWayMatchIntegrity, true, "Three-way match integrity must be true");
    assert.strictEqual(erp.unreconciledCount, 0, "No unreconciled checkpoints should exist");

    assert.strictEqual(erp.erpNext.status, "CONNECTED");
    assert.ok(erp.erpNext.lastDocName?.startsWith("PE-ERPNEXT-"), "Last synced doc name should match ERPNext seed");

    assert.strictEqual(erp.odoo.status, "CONNECTED");
    assert.strictEqual(erp.odoo.lastPaymentId, 8842, "Odoo last payment ID should match 8842");

    assert.ok(erp.recentCheckpoints.length >= 2, "Checkpoints list must contain both ERP systems");
  });

  it("5. should verify Master System Journal SHA-256 hash chain and audit state (D7 / D19d7)", async () => {
    const state = await stateService.getUnifiedOperationalState({
      accountId: testAcc1,
      balanceOverrides: defaultOverrides,
      includeAuditHistoryLimit: 10,
    });

    const audit = state.auditState;
    // Master System Journal
    assert.ok(audit.masterJournal.totalVouchersCount >= 2, "Should have at least 2 vouchers");
    assert.strictEqual(audit.masterJournal.chainIntegrityVerified, true, "Hash chain integrity must be verified");
    assert.ok(audit.masterJournal.headBlockHash.length === 64, "Head block hash should be a 64-char SHA256 hex");

    // Audit Log
    assert.ok(audit.auditLog.totalAuditEntries >= 2, "Should have at least 2 audit entries");
    assert.ok(audit.auditLog.autonomousActionsCount >= 1, "Should record autonomous action");
    assert.ok(audit.auditLog.humanSupervisedActionsCount >= 1, "Should record human supervised action");

    const autonomousEvent = audit.auditLog.recentAuditEvents.find((e) => e.isAutonomous);
    assert.ok(autonomousEvent, "Autonomous event must be recorded");
    assert.strictEqual(autonomousEvent.actionType, "YIELD_SWEEP");
  });

  it("6. should report Transaction State with spending limits, SPRS, and account locks (D16 / D17 / D19)", async () => {
    // Acquire a temporary concurrency lock on testAcc1
    const lockAcquired = AccountLockManager.acquireLock(testAcc1, "D20 testing concurrency state");
    assert.strictEqual(lockAcquired, true, "Should acquire lock");

    try {
      const state = await stateService.getUnifiedOperationalState({
        balanceOverrides: defaultOverrides,
      });

      const tx = state.transactionState;
      assert.ok(parseFloat(tx.spendingLimits.dailyHardCapUsdc) > 0, "Daily hard cap should be positive");
      assert.ok(parseFloat(tx.spendingLimits.dailyRemainingUsdc) <= parseFloat(tx.spendingLimits.dailyHardCapUsdc));

      // Pending SPRS
      assert.ok(tx.pendingSprs.count >= 1, "Should have at least 1 pending SPRS");
      const foundSprs = tx.pendingSprs.requests.find((r) => r.requestId === sprsRequestId);
      assert.ok(foundSprs, "Seeded SPRS must be present");
      assert.strictEqual(foundSprs.amountUsdc, 1500.0);
      assert.ok(foundSprs.conflictingPolicy?.includes("Single-transaction limit threshold exceeded"));

      // Concurrency Locks
      assert.ok(tx.activeAccountLocks.includes(testAcc1), "testAcc1 should be listed in active account locks");
    } finally {
      AccountLockManager.releaseLock(testAcc1);
    }
  });

  it("7. should execute get_unified_operational_state via ToolRegistry tool call", async () => {
    const result = await toolRegistry.executeTool("get_unified_operational_state", {
      accountId: testAcc1,
      horizonDays: 14,
      balanceOverrides: {
        [testAcc1]: { liquidUsdc: "12000.000000", investedUsyc: "6000.000000" },
      },
    });

    assert.strictEqual(result.success, true, "ToolRegistry tool call must succeed");
    assert.ok(result.data, "Tool result must contain data payload");

    const state = result.data;
    assert.strictEqual(state.currency, "USDC");
    assert.strictEqual(state.safeToInvestHorizon.evaluationHorizonDays, 14);
    assert.strictEqual(state.balances.accounts.length, 1);
    assert.strictEqual(state.balances.accounts[0].accountId, testAcc1);
    assert.strictEqual(state.balances.accounts[0].totalEffectiveUsdc, "18000.000000");
    assert.strictEqual(state.erpSyncStatus.overallStatus, "SYNCED");
    assert.strictEqual(state.auditState.masterJournal.chainIntegrityVerified, true);
  });

  after(async () => {
    await DbClient.closePool();
  });
});

import { TreasurySentinelService as TreasurySentinelAgent, BalanceMutationEvent } from "../src/services/treasurySentinelService.js";
import { LedgerWitnessService as LedgerWitnessAgent } from "../src/services/ledgerWitnessService.js";
import { AccountIntelligenceService } from "../src/services/accountIntelligenceService.js";
import { CentralTreasuryYieldVaultService } from "../src/contracts/centralTreasuryYieldVaultService.js";
import { DbClient } from "../src/database/dbClient.js";
import { TreasuryAccountsRepo } from "../src/database/repos/treasuryAccountsRepo.js";
import { LiabilityRepo } from "../src/database/repos/liabilityRepo.js";
import { PermissionRequestRepo } from "../src/database/repos/permissionRequestRepo.js";
import { AuditLogRepo } from "../src/database/repos/auditLogRepo.js";
import { MasterJournalRepo } from "../src/database/repos/masterJournalRepo.js";
import { PolicyLoader } from "../src/config/policyLoader.js";

/**
 * COMPREHENSIVE REAL-WORLD TEST SUITE FOR D10:
 * TreasurySentinelAgent (Yield Optimizer & Dynamic Liquidity Operator)
 *
 * Verifies D10.1 (Event Ingestion), D10.2 (Debouncing), D10.3 (Internal Filtering),
 * D10.4 (Account Locking), D10.5 (Liquidity Horizon), D10.6 (TargetReserve),
 * D10.7 (SafeToInvest), D10.8 (Hysteresis), and D10.9 (Policy Compliance: Inside vs Outside Rules).
 *
 * Executed against live PostgreSQL 'bizarc' database.
 */
async function runD10Tests() {
  console.log("================================================================================");
  console.log("   D10 REAL-WORLD AUDIT: TreasurySentinelAgent (Autonomous Yield & Liquidity)   ");
  console.log("================================================================================");

  let pass = 0;
  let fail = 0;
  const failures: string[] = [];

  function assert(condition: boolean, label: string) {
    if (condition) {
      console.log(`  ✓ ${label}`);
      pass++;
    } else {
      console.error(`  ✗ FAIL: ${label}`);
      fail++;
      failures.push(label);
    }
  }

  function assertEqual<T>(actual: T, expected: T, label: string) {
    if (actual === expected) {
      console.log(`  ✓ ${label}`);
      pass++;
    } else {
      console.error(`  ✗ FAIL: ${label} -> expected ${JSON.stringify(expected)}, got ${JSON.stringify(actual)}`);
      fail++;
      failures.push(label);
    }
  }

  // ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  // 1. SETUP & REAL DATABASE CLEANUP
  // ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  console.log("\n[Setup] Cleaning database tables for fresh D10 Sentinel audit...");
  await DbClient.query("TRUNCATE TABLE master_system_journal CASCADE");
  await DbClient.query("TRUNCATE TABLE account_agent_audit_log CASCADE");
  await DbClient.query("TRUNCATE TABLE permission_requests CASCADE");
  await DbClient.query("TRUNCATE TABLE account_liabilities CASCADE");
  await DbClient.query("TRUNCATE TABLE treasury_accounts CASCADE");

  const { profile } = PolicyLoader.getActiveProfile();
  for (const acc of profile.operating_accounts) {
    await TreasuryAccountsRepo.upsertAccount({
      account_id: acc.account_id,
      name: acc.name,
      role: acc.role,
      wallet_address: `0x${acc.account_id.length.toString().padStart(40, "5")}` as `0x${string}`,
      chain_id: 5042002,
      min_operating_floor_usdc: acc.min_floor_usdc,
      safety_buffer_ratio: acc.safety_multiplier,
      is_active: true,
    });
  }

  const VAULT_ADDRESS = "0x5555555555555555555555555555555555555555" as `0x${string}`;
  const vaultService = new CentralTreasuryYieldVaultService(VAULT_ADDRESS);
  const witnessAgent = new LedgerWitnessAgent();
  const intelService = new AccountIntelligenceService(undefined, vaultService);

  const sentinelAgent = new TreasurySentinelAgent({
    intelService,
    vaultService,
    witnessAgent,
    debounceMs: 50, // fast debounce for tests
    vaultAddress: VAULT_ADDRESS,
  });

  // ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  // 2. AUDIT: AGENT PERSONA & CAPABILITIES (ERC-8004)
  // ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  console.log("\n[Test 1] TreasurySentinelAgent Persona & Segregation of Duties");
  assertEqual(sentinelAgent.persona, "TreasurySentinelAgent", "Persona confirmed as TreasurySentinelAgent");
  assertEqual(sentinelAgent.erc8004Id, 101, "ERC-8004 Onchain Agent Identity is registered as ID 101");
  assertEqual(sentinelAgent.canSignTransactions, true, "canSignTransactions is TRUE (signs/executes sweep & recall calls)");
  assertEqual(sentinelAgent.canWriteLedger, false, "canWriteLedger is FALSE (strictly defers ledger writes to LedgerWitness)");

  // ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  // 3. AUDIT: D10.3 INTERNAL SETTLEMENT FILTERING (FEEDBACK LOOP PROTECTION)
  // ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  console.log("\n[Test 2] D10.3 Internal Settlement Filtering (Infinite Loop Prevention)");

  // Scenario A: Recall from USYC back to operating wallet
  const internalRecallEvent: BalanceMutationEvent = {
    accountId: "acc_engineering",
    amountUsdc: 250.0,
    currentLiquidBalanceUsdc: 600.0,
    origin: "USYC_RECALL",
    from: VAULT_ADDRESS,
  };
  const recallRes = await sentinelAgent.onBalanceMutation(internalRecallEvent);
  assertEqual(recallRes.action, "NONE", "Internal USYC recall ignored from triggering sweep");
  assertEqual(recallRes.branch, "FILTERED_INTERNAL", "Branch tagged as FILTERED_INTERNAL");

  // Scenario B: Internal settlement transfer
  const internalSettlementEvent: BalanceMutationEvent = {
    accountId: "acc_engineering",
    amountUsdc: 100.0,
    currentLiquidBalanceUsdc: 700.0,
    origin: "INTERNAL_SETTLEMENT",
  };
  const settleRes = await sentinelAgent.onBalanceMutation(internalSettlementEvent);
  assertEqual(settleRes.action, "NONE", "Internal settlement ignored");
  assertEqual(settleRes.branch, "FILTERED_INTERNAL", "Branch tagged as FILTERED_INTERNAL");

  // ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  // 4. AUDIT: D10.4 CONCURRENCY ACCOUNT LOCK MANAGER
  // ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  console.log("\n[Test 3] D10.4 Concurrency Account Lock Manager");
  const lockAcquired = sentinelAgent.acquireAccountLock("acc_engineering");
  assert(lockAcquired, "Acquired lock on acc_engineering");
  assertEqual(sentinelAgent.isAccountLocked("acc_engineering"), true, "Account reports locked");

  // Second acquisition attempt MUST fail
  const secondAttempt = sentinelAgent.acquireAccountLock("acc_engineering");
  assertEqual(secondAttempt, false, "Concurrent lock acquisition on locked account is rejected");

  sentinelAgent.releaseAccountLock("acc_engineering");
  assertEqual(sentinelAgent.isAccountLocked("acc_engineering"), false, "Account lock released");

  // ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  // 5. AUDIT: PAYROLL PROTECTION LOCK
  // ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  console.log("\n[Test 4] Corporate Payroll Protection Lock");
  const payrollEvent: BalanceMutationEvent = {
    accountId: "acc_payroll",
    amountUsdc: 50000.0,
    currentLiquidBalanceUsdc: 150000.0,
    origin: "EXTERNAL_REVENUE",
    forceImmediate: true,
  };
  const payrollRes = await sentinelAgent.onBalanceMutation(payrollEvent);
  assertEqual(payrollRes.action, "NONE", "Payroll account returned action NONE");
  assertEqual(payrollRes.safeToInvestUsdc, 0, "SafeToInvest is strictly locked to 0 on payroll account");
  assertEqual(payrollRes.branch, "PROTECTED_ACCOUNT", "Branch tagged as PROTECTED_ACCOUNT");

  // ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  // 6. AUDIT: D10.5 - D10.8 LIQUIDITY HORIZON, TARGET RESERVE, HYSTERESIS & SWEEP
  // ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  console.log("\n[Test 5] Dynamic Liquidity Horizon, TargetReserve & Autonomous Sweep (Inside Rules)");

  // Seed liabilities for acc_engineering in PostgreSQL:
  // Liability 1: Datadog ($150 USDC due in 3 days)
  await LiabilityRepo.createLiability({
    account_id: "acc_engineering",
    vendor_id: "vendor_datadog",
    title: "Datadog APM Monthly",
    category: "INFRASTRUCTURE",
    amount_usdc: 150.0,
    due_date: new Date(Date.now() + 3 * 86400 * 1000),
    payout_address: "0x1111111111111111111111111111111111111111",
    status: "SCHEDULED",
  });

  // TargetReserve calculation:
  // Horizon = 14 days (opPolicy). Sum liabilities = 150.0.
  // Safety multiplier = 1.20, min operating floor = 50.0 USDC.
  // TargetReserve = (150 * 1.20) + 50 = 180 + 50 = 230.000000 USDC.
  // Hysteresis band = 10 USDC. Min sweep = 10 USDC.
  // Liquid balance = 800.000000 USDC.
  // SafeToInvest = max(0, 800 - (230 + 10)) = 560.000000 USDC.

  const revenueEvent: BalanceMutationEvent = {
    accountId: "acc_engineering",
    amountUsdc: 400.0,
    currentLiquidBalanceUsdc: 800.0,
    origin: "EXTERNAL_REVENUE",
    forceImmediate: true,
  };

  const sweepRes = await sentinelAgent.onBalanceMutation(revenueEvent);

  assertEqual(sweepRes.action, "SWEEP", "Sentinel triggered autonomous SWEEP");
  assertEqual(sweepRes.branch, "INSIDE_RULES", "Branch is INSIDE_RULES");
  assertEqual(sweepRes.targetReserveUsdc, 230.0, "TargetReserve calculated as exactly 230.000000 USDC");
  assertEqual(sweepRes.safeToInvestUsdc, 560.0, "SafeToInvest calculated as exactly 560.000000 USDC");
  assertEqual(sweepRes.actionAmountUsdc, 560.0, "Action amount matches SafeToInvest");
  assert(Boolean(sweepRes.encodedTx), "Encoded smart contract transaction generated for sweep");
  assertEqual(sweepRes.witnessed, true, "Sweep witnessed by LedgerWitnessAgent");

  // Verify that LedgerWitnessAgent recorded to master journal & audit log
  const journalEntries = await MasterJournalRepo.getEntriesByAccount("acc_engineering");
  const sweepJournal = journalEntries.find((j) => j.action_type === "AUTONOMOUS_SWEEP");
  assert(Boolean(sweepJournal), "Master journal voucher created for autonomous sweep");
  assertEqual(sweepJournal?.amount_usdc, 560.0, "Master journal amount matches 560.0 USDC");

  const auditLogs = await AuditLogRepo.getAuditLogsByAccount("acc_engineering");
  const sweepLog = auditLogs.find((l) => l.action_type === "AUTONOMOUS_SWEEP");
  assert(Boolean(sweepLog), "Audit log entry created for autonomous sweep");

  // ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  // 7. AUDIT: D10.8 HYSTERESIS BAND SUPPRESSION (MICRO-SWEEP SUPPRESSION)
  // ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  console.log("\n[Test 6] D10.8 Hysteresis Band: Micro-Sweep Suppression");

  // Liquid balance is $235 USDC (TargetReserve is $230).
  // SafeToInvest = max(0, 235 - (230 + 10)) = 0 < min_sweep ($10)
  const smallBalanceEvent: BalanceMutationEvent = {
    accountId: "acc_engineering",
    amountUsdc: 5.0,
    currentLiquidBalanceUsdc: 235.0,
    origin: "EXTERNAL_REVENUE",
    forceImmediate: true,
  };
  const microRes = await sentinelAgent.onBalanceMutation(smallBalanceEvent);
  assertEqual(microRes.action, "NONE", "Micro-sweep suppressed by hysteresis band");
  assertEqual(microRes.branch, "BELOW_HYSTERESIS", "Branch tagged as BELOW_HYSTERESIS");

  // ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  // 8. AUDIT: DEFICIT RECALL DETECTION
  // ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  console.log("\n[Test 7] Deficit Recall Detection (Balance Drops Below Target Reserve)");

  // Liquid balance drops to $150 USDC (TargetReserve is $230, recall hysteresis is $10 -> threshold $220)
  // Deficit = 230 - 150 = 80 USDC
  const dropEvent: BalanceMutationEvent = {
    accountId: "acc_engineering",
    amountUsdc: 85.0,
    currentLiquidBalanceUsdc: 150.0,
    origin: "DISBURSAL",
    forceImmediate: true,
  };
  const recallDetectRes = await sentinelAgent.onBalanceMutation(dropEvent);
  assertEqual(recallDetectRes.action, "RECALL", "Sentinel detected liquidity deficit and triggered RECALL");
  assertEqual(recallDetectRes.actionAmountUsdc, 80.0, "Recall amount is exactly 80.000000 USDC (230 - 150)");
  assert(Boolean(recallDetectRes.encodedTx), "Encoded recall transaction generated for Vault");

  // ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  // 9. AUDIT: D10.9 POLICY COMPLIANCE - OUTSIDE RULES & HUMAN GATE (SPRS)
  // ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  console.log("\n[Test 8] D10.9 Policy Compliance: Outside Rules (High-Value Sweep Human Gate)");

  // Massive revenue inflow ($25,000 USDC)
  // Liquid balance = $25,000. TargetReserve = $230.
  // SafeToInvest = $25,000 - 240 = $24,760 USDC.
  // Policy single-tx limit is $5,000. $24,760 > $5,000 -> OUTSIDE RULES!
  const highRevenueEvent: BalanceMutationEvent = {
    accountId: "acc_engineering",
    amountUsdc: 25000.0,
    currentLiquidBalanceUsdc: 25000.0,
    origin: "EXTERNAL_REVENUE",
    forceImmediate: true,
  };

  const highSweepRes = await sentinelAgent.onBalanceMutation(highRevenueEvent);

  assertEqual(highSweepRes.action, "SPRS_REQUIRED", "High-value sweep halted for SPRS Human Gate");
  assertEqual(highSweepRes.branch, "OUTSIDE_RULES", "Branch tagged as OUTSIDE_RULES");
  assert(Boolean(highSweepRes.sprs), "Standardized Permission Request generated");
  assertEqual(highSweepRes.sprs?.action, "HIGH_VALUE_SWEEP_EXEMPTION", "SPRS action is HIGH_VALUE_SWEEP_EXEMPTION");
  assertEqual(highSweepRes.sprs?.options.length, 2, "Binary options: APPROVE and REJECT");

  // Verify SPRS record in PostgreSQL
  const sprsInDb = await PermissionRequestRepo.getRequestById(highSweepRes.sprs!.requestId);
  assert(Boolean(sprsInDb), "SPRS successfully persisted to PostgreSQL permission_requests table");
  assertEqual(sprsInDb?.status, "PENDING", "SPRS status is PENDING");

  // ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  // 10. AUDIT: HUMAN GATE APPROVAL FLOW FOR HIGH-VALUE SWEEP
  // ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  console.log("\n[Test 9] Human Gate Approval Flow (Admin Approves High-Value Sweep)");

  const approveRes = await sentinelAgent.resolveSweepDecision({
    requestId: highSweepRes.sprs!.requestId,
    decision: "APPROVE",
    adminInstructions: "Treasury Committee approved high-value surplus allocation to USYC.",
  });

  assertEqual(approveRes.status, "APPROVED", "SPRS decision recorded as APPROVED");
  assertEqual(approveRes.actionExecuted, true, "Sweep action executed post-approval");
  assert(Boolean(approveRes.encodedTx), "Encoded sweep transaction generated");

  // Verify DB state updated
  const updatedSprs = await PermissionRequestRepo.getRequestById(highSweepRes.sprs!.requestId);
  assertEqual(updatedSprs?.status, "APPROVED", "PostgreSQL SPRS status confirmed APPROVED");

  const approvedVoucher = await MasterJournalRepo.getEntriesByAccount("acc_engineering");
  const hasApprovedSweep = approvedVoucher.some((j) => j.document_ref.includes(highSweepRes.sprs!.requestId));
  assert(hasApprovedSweep, "Approved sweep recorded into Master System Journal");

  // ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  // 11. AUDIT: HUMAN GATE REJECTION FLOW (ADMIN REJECTS SWEEP)
  // ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  console.log("\n[Test 10] Human Gate Rejection Flow (Admin Rejects Sweep)");

  // Another high revenue event
  const rejectCandidateEvent: BalanceMutationEvent = {
    accountId: "acc_engineering",
    amountUsdc: 15000.0,
    currentLiquidBalanceUsdc: 15000.0,
    origin: "EXTERNAL_REVENUE",
    forceImmediate: true,
  };
  const rejectCandidateRes = await sentinelAgent.onBalanceMutation(rejectCandidateEvent);
  const rejectRequestId = rejectCandidateRes.sprs!.requestId;

  const rejectRes = await sentinelAgent.resolveSweepDecision({
    requestId: rejectRequestId,
    decision: "REJECT",
    adminInstructions: "Anticipating large tax liability tomorrow. Keep cash liquid.",
  });

  assertEqual(rejectRes.status, "REJECTED", "SPRS decision recorded as REJECTED");
  assertEqual(rejectRes.actionExecuted, false, "Sweep action NOT executed (retained in liquid wallet)");

  const rejectedSprsDb = await PermissionRequestRepo.getRequestById(rejectRequestId);
  assertEqual(rejectedSprsDb?.status, "REJECTED", "PostgreSQL SPRS status confirmed REJECTED");

  // ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  // 12. AUDIT: D10.2 DEBOUNCING OF RAPID SUCCESSIVE EVENTS
  // ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  console.log("\n[Test 11] D10.2 Debounce Engine: Multiple Rapid Consecutive Events");

  const fastSentinel = new TreasurySentinelAgent({
    intelService,
    vaultService,
    witnessAgent,
    debounceMs: 150, // 150ms debounce
    vaultAddress: VAULT_ADDRESS,
  });

  // Fire 3 rapid consecutive events for acc_engineering
  fastSentinel.onBalanceMutation({
    accountId: "acc_engineering",
    amountUsdc: 50.0,
    currentLiquidBalanceUsdc: 500.0,
    origin: "EXTERNAL_REVENUE",
  });

  fastSentinel.onBalanceMutation({
    accountId: "acc_engineering",
    amountUsdc: 50.0,
    currentLiquidBalanceUsdc: 550.0,
    origin: "EXTERNAL_REVENUE",
  });

  const finalDebouncedPromise = fastSentinel.onBalanceMutation({
    accountId: "acc_engineering",
    amountUsdc: 50.0,
    currentLiquidBalanceUsdc: 600.0, // Final settled balance
    origin: "EXTERNAL_REVENUE",
  });

  const debouncedResult = await finalDebouncedPromise;
  assertEqual(debouncedResult.liquidBalanceUsdc, 600.0, "Debounced result evaluated final settled balance ($600 USDC)");
  assertEqual(debouncedResult.action, "SWEEP", "Debounced evaluation triggered single consolidated sweep");

  // ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  // SUMMARY
  // ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  console.log("\n" + "=".repeat(80));
  console.log(`  D10 REAL-WORLD AUDIT COMPLETE: ${pass} passed, ${fail} failed`);
  if (failures.length > 0) {
    console.error("  FAILURES:");
    failures.forEach((f) => console.error(`    ✗ ${f}`));
  } else {
    console.log("  >>> ALL D10 TREASURY SENTINEL AGENT AUDIT SCENARIOS CONFIRMED PASSING <<<");
  }
  console.log("=".repeat(80));

  process.exit(fail > 0 ? 1 : 0);
}

runD10Tests().catch((err) => {
  console.error("[FATAL D10 AUDIT ERROR]", err);
  process.exit(1);
});

  const testOdooTransport = {
    async callJsonRpc<T>(service: string, method: string, args: any[]): Promise<T> {
      if (service === "common" && method === "authenticate") return 1 as any;
      if (service === "object" && method === "execute_kw") {
        const model = args[3];
        if (model === "purchase.order") {
          return [{ id: 101, name: "PO-2026-AWS-01", partner_id: [42, "AWS EMEA"], amount_total: 12500.0, state: "purchase", order_line: [1001] }] as any;
        }
        if (model === "stock.picking") {

        }
        if (model === "account.move") {
          return [{ id: 901, name: "BILL/2026/05/0001", partner_id: [42, "AWS EMEA"], move_type: "in_invoice", amount_total: 12500.0, amount_residual: 12500.0, invoice_date_due: new Date(Date.now() + 86400000 * 5).toISOString(), payment_state: "not_paid", invoice_line_ids: [2001] }] as any;
        }
      }
      return {} as any;
    },
  };

  const testErpNextTransport = {
    async get<T>(path: string, params?: Record<string, any>): Promise<T> {

        return [{ name: "PO-2026-AWS-01", supplier: "vnd_aws", grand_total: 12500.0, currency: "USD", status: "To Receive and Bill", items: [] }] as any;

      }

    async post<T>(path: string, body: any): Promise<T> {

  assert.strictEqual(erpnextAudit.status, "SYNCED");

import { describe, it, before, after } from "node:test";
import assert from "node:assert/strict";
import { UniversalPaymentRouter } from "../src/payments/universalPaymentRouter.js";
import { MovementPolicyRepo } from "../src/database/repos/movementPolicyRepo.js";
import { RecurringProposalRepo } from "../src/database/repos/recurringProposalRepo.js";
import { MasterJournalRepo } from "../src/database/repos/masterJournalRepo.js";
import { TreasuryAccountsRepo } from "../src/database/repos/treasuryAccountsRepo.js";
import { VendorMasterRepo } from "../src/database/repos/vendorMasterRepo.js";
import { DynamicRecordsService } from "../src/records/dynamicRecordsService.js";
import { DbClient } from "../src/database/dbClient.js";

describe("Universal Payment Router: Movement Policy, 4 Payment Rails & Recurring Governance", () => {
  const router = new UniversalPaymentRouter();
  const dynamicRecords = new DynamicRecordsService();

  before(async () => {
    // Clean previous test records
    await DbClient.query("DELETE FROM recurring_liability_proposals WHERE account_id = 'acc_engineering';");
    await DbClient.query("DELETE FROM account_liabilities WHERE account_id = 'acc_engineering';");
    await DbClient.query("DELETE FROM vendor_master_registry WHERE vendor_id IN ('vendor_cloud_aws', 'vendor_github', 'vendor_market_data');");

    // Seed accounts
    await TreasuryAccountsRepo.upsertAccount({
      account_id: "acc_engineering",
      name: "Engineering Operations",
      role: "OPEX_DEV",
      wallet_address: "0x1111111111111111111111111111111111111101",
      chain_id: 5042002,
      min_operating_floor_usdc: 50.0,
      safety_buffer_ratio: 1.2,
      is_active: true,
    });

    await TreasuryAccountsRepo.upsertAccount({
      account_id: "acc_general_treasury",
      name: "Central Treasury Reserve",
      role: "TREASURY_RESERVE",
      wallet_address: "0x3333333333333333333333333333333333333303",
      chain_id: 5042002,
      min_operating_floor_usdc: 250.0,
      safety_buffer_ratio: 1.2,
      is_active: true,
    });

    await TreasuryAccountsRepo.upsertAccount({
      account_id: "acc_payroll",
      name: "Corporate Payroll Escrow",
      role: "PAYROLL",
      wallet_address: "0x2222222222222222222222222222222222222202",
      chain_id: 5042002,
      min_operating_floor_usdc: 100.0,
      safety_buffer_ratio: 1.25,
      is_active: true,
    });

    // Seed Movement Policy
    await MovementPolicyRepo.upsertPolicy({
      policy_id: "default_movement_policy",
      name: "Standard Corporate Inter-Account Movement Policy",
      priority_order: ["acc_engineering", "acc_general_treasury"],
      protected_accounts: ["acc_payroll"],
      cross_account_borrowing_enabled: true,
      max_borrowing_ratio: 0.50,
      human_approval_threshold_usdc: 1000.0,
    });

    // Seed Verified Vendor Master
    await VendorMasterRepo.registerVendor({
      vendor_id: "vendor_cloud_aws",
      name: "Amazon Web Services",
      verified_payout_address: "0x4444444444444444444444444444444444444444",
      verified_by_admin: "CHIEF_RISK_OFFICER",
      last_verified_at: new Date(),
      change_lock: true,
    });

    await VendorMasterRepo.registerVendor({
      vendor_id: "vendor_github",
      name: "GitHub Enterprise",
      verified_payout_address: "0x5555555555555555555555555555555555555555",
      verified_by_admin: "CHIEF_RISK_OFFICER",
      last_verified_at: new Date(),
      change_lock: true,
    });
  });

  after(async () => {
    await DbClient.closePool();
  });

  it("Test 1: Multi-Account Funding strictly consults Movement Policy and protects Payroll", async () => {
    // Primary account has only $40, total bill is $100.
    // Movement policy should pull $40 from acc_engineering and $60 from acc_general_treasury.
    // acc_payroll ($5,000) must NEVER be touched.
    const allocation = await MovementPolicyRepo.computeMultiAccountFunding({
      primaryAccountId: "acc_engineering",
      totalAmountUsdc: 100.0,
      accountBalances: {
        acc_engineering: 40.0,
        acc_general_treasury: 500.0,
        acc_payroll: 5000.0, // Large balance, but strictly protected
      },
    });

    assert.equal(allocation.totalAllocatedUsdc, 100.0);
    assert.equal(allocation.unmetShortfallUsdc, 0);
    assert.equal(allocation.allocations.length, 2);

    // Primary allocation
    assert.equal(allocation.allocations[0].accountId, "acc_engineering");
    assert.equal(allocation.allocations[0].amountUsdc, 40.0);
    assert.equal(allocation.allocations[0].isPrimary, true);

    // Secondary waterfall allocation
    assert.equal(allocation.allocations[1].accountId, "acc_general_treasury");
    assert.equal(allocation.allocations[1].amountUsdc, 60.0);
    assert.equal(allocation.allocations[1].isPrimary, false);

    // Verify Payroll was NEVER allocated
    assert.ok(
      !allocation.allocations.some((a) => a.accountId === "acc_payroll"),
      "Payroll account must be strictly protected from waterfall draws"
    );
  });

  it("Test 2: Recurring Liabilities Lifecycle — Agent Proposals require Human Approval Gate", async () => {
    // 1. Agent detects a new recurring SaaS subscription ($250/mo) and submits proposal
    const agentProposal = await RecurringProposalRepo.submitProposal({
      actionType: "ADD",
      accountId: "acc_engineering",
      vendorId: "vendor_github",
      proposedBy: "LiabilityRadarAgent",
      details: {
        title: "GitHub Copilot Enterprise Seats",
        category: "SUBSCRIPTION",
        amountUsdc: "250.000000",
        payoutAddress: "0x5555555555555555555555555555555555555555",
        frequencyCron: "0 0 1 * *", // Monthly on the 1st
        dueDateIso: new Date(Date.now() + 86400 * 14 * 1000).toISOString(),
        rationale: "Detected new invoice with recurring 30-day terms from GitHub.",
      },
    });

    assert.equal(agentProposal.status, "PENDING_HUMAN_APPROVAL");
    assert.ok(agentProposal.sprs_request_id?.startsWith("SPRS_"));

    // Verify it is NOT yet active in Dynamic Record 1
    const pendingLiabilities = await dynamicRecords.getLiabilities("acc_engineering");
    assert.ok(
      !pendingLiabilities.some((l) => l.vendorTitle === "GitHub Copilot Enterprise Seats"),
      "Agent proposal must NOT be active before human approval"
    );

    // 2. Human CFO reviews and approves the proposal
    const approvedProposal = await RecurringProposalRepo.approveProposal(
      agentProposal.proposal_id,
      "Approved by CFO for engineering team."
    );
    assert.equal(approvedProposal.status, "APPROVED");

    // 3. Verify it is NOW enacted and active in Dynamic Record 1
    const activeLiabilities = await dynamicRecords.getLiabilities("acc_engineering");
    const found = activeLiabilities.find((l) => l.vendorTitle === "GitHub Copilot Enterprise Seats");
    assert.ok(found);
    assert.equal(found?.amountUsdc, "250.000000");

    // 4. Human directly adds a recurring liability (auto-committed)

        vendorId: "vendor_cloud_aws",

    assert.equal(result.status, "EXECUTED");
    assert.equal(result.allocations?.length, 2);

    // Verify Master System Journal recorded Due-To and Due-From entries
    const journalEntries = await MasterJournalRepo.getEntriesByAccount("acc_engineering", 10);
    const dueToEntry = journalEntries.find((e) => e.action_type === "INTERCOMPANY_LOAN_DUE_TO");

    const dueFromEntry = treasuryEntries.find((e) => e.action_type === "INTERCOMPANY_LOAN_DUE_FROM");
    assert.ok(dueFromEntry, "Secondary account must have an INTERCOMPANY_LOAN_DUE_FROM journal entry");
    assert.equal(Number(dueFromEntry?.amount_usdc), 50.0);
  });

  it("Test 11: Persistent PostgreSQL ERC-3009 Nonce Replay Prevention", async () => {
    const fixedNonce = "0xaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa" as `0x${string}`;
    const result1 = await router.routeAndExecute({
      intent: {
        intentId: `DISB_REPLAY_1_${Date.now()}`,
        primaryAccountId: "acc_engineering",
        vendorId: "vendor_cloud_aws",
        vendorName: "Amazon Web Services",
        amountUsdc: 25.0,
        payoutAddress: "0x4444444444444444444444444444444444444444",
        declaredReason: "First execution with fixed nonce.",
      },
      accountBalances: { acc_engineering: 100.0 },
      overrideRail: "ERC3009_AUTHORIZATION",
    });
    assert.equal(result1.success, true);

    // Now attempt replay attack using the exact same nonce
    const { Erc3009AuthorizationRail } = await import("../src/payments/rails/erc3009AuthorizationRail.js");
    const freshRailInstance = new Erc3009AuthorizationRail();
    const replayResult = await freshRailInstance.execute(
      {
        intentId: `DISB_REPLAY_ATTACK_${Date.now()}`,
        primaryAccountId: "acc_engineering",
        vendorId: "vendor_cloud_aws",
        vendorName: "Amazon Web Services",
        amountUsdc: 25.0,
        payoutAddress: "0x4444444444444444444444444444444444444444",
        declaredReason: "Replay attack with previously executed nonce.",
      },
      [{ accountId: "acc_engineering", amountUsdc: 25.0, isPrimary: true }],
      { nonce: result1.authorizationNonce }
    );

    assert.equal(replayResult.success, false);
    assert.equal(replayResult.status, "REJECTED_BY_POLICY");
    assert.ok(replayResult.error?.includes("already been executed"));
  });
});
