import { AccountIntelligenceService } from "../src/services/accountIntelligenceService.js";
import { DbClient } from "../src/database/dbClient.js";
import { TreasuryAccountsRepo } from "../src/database/repos/treasuryAccountsRepo.js";
import { LiabilityRepo } from "../src/database/repos/liabilityRepo.js";
import { AuditLogRepo } from "../src/database/repos/auditLogRepo.js";
import { PolicyLoader } from "../src/config/policyLoader.js";

async function runD8Tests() {
  console.log("==================================================");
  console.log("  D6 -> D8: Account Intelligence Layer Audit");
  console.log("==================================================");

  let pass = 0;
  let fail = 0;
  const failures: string[] = [];

  function assert(condition: boolean, label: string) {
    if (condition) {
      console.log(`  ✓ ${label}`);
      pass++;
    } else {
      console.error(`  ✗ FAIL: ${label}`);
      fail++;
      failures.push(label);
    }
  }

  function assertEqual<T>(actual: T, expected: T, label: string) {
    if (actual === expected) {
      console.log(`  ✓ ${label}`);
      pass++;
    } else {
      console.error(`  ✗ FAIL: ${label} -> expected ${JSON.stringify(expected)}, got ${JSON.stringify(actual)}`);
      fail++;
      failures.push(label);
    }
  }

  // ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  // 1. SETUP & DB RESET
  // ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  console.log("\n[Setup] Cleaning DB tables for fresh account intelligence audit...");
  await DbClient.query("TRUNCATE TABLE master_system_journal CASCADE");
  await DbClient.query("TRUNCATE TABLE account_agent_audit_log CASCADE");
  await DbClient.query("TRUNCATE TABLE account_liabilities CASCADE");
  await DbClient.query("TRUNCATE TABLE treasury_accounts CASCADE");

  const { profile } = PolicyLoader.getActiveProfile();
  for (const acc of profile.operating_accounts) {
    await TreasuryAccountsRepo.upsertAccount({
      account_id: acc.account_id,
      name: acc.name,
      role: acc.role,
      wallet_address: `0x${acc.account_id.length.toString().padStart(40, "3")}` as `0x${string}`,
      chain_id: 5042002,
      min_operating_floor_usdc: acc.min_floor_usdc,
      safety_buffer_ratio: acc.safety_multiplier,
      is_active: true,
    });
  }

  const intelService = new AccountIntelligenceService();

  // ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  // 2. SEED REALISTIC OPERATIONAL DATA FOR acc_engineering
  // ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  console.log("\n[Setup] Seeding liabilities and audit logs for acc_engineering...");

  // Liability 1: Due in 3 days (in 7d and 30d window) -> $150 USDC
  await LiabilityRepo.createLiability({
    account_id: "acc_engineering",
    vendor_id: "vendor_datadog",
    title: "Datadog APM & Logs Monitoring",
    category: "INFRASTRUCTURE",
    amount_usdc: 150.0,
    due_date: new Date(Date.now() + 3 * 86400 * 1000),
    payout_address: "0x1111111111111111111111111111111111111111",
    status: "SCHEDULED",
  });

  // Liability 2: Due in 12 days (in 30d window, not in 7d window) -> $250 USDC
  await LiabilityRepo.createLiability({
    account_id: "acc_engineering",
    vendor_id: "vendor_aws",
    title: "AWS Elastic Kubernetes Service",
    category: "INFRASTRUCTURE",
    amount_usdc: 250.0,
    due_date: new Date(Date.now() + 12 * 86400 * 1000),
    payout_address: "0x2222222222222222222222222222222222222222",
    status: "SCHEDULED",
  });

  // Liability 3: Cancelled subscription -> $50 USDC (should NOT be included in active liability calculations)
  await LiabilityRepo.createLiability({
    account_id: "acc_engineering",
    vendor_id: "vendor_sentry",
    title: "Sentry Error Tracking (Cancelled)",
    category: "SUBSCRIPTION",
    amount_usdc: 50.0,
    due_date: new Date(Date.now() + 5 * 86400 * 1000),
    payout_address: "0x3333333333333333333333333333333333333333",
    status: "CANCELLED",
  });

  // Audit Log Entry
  await AuditLogRepo.appendAuditLog({
    account_id: "acc_engineering",
    action_type: "AUTONOMOUS_SWEEP",
    amount_usdc: 120.0,
    is_autonomous: true,
    reason: "Surplus yield sweep to central USYC vault",
    pre_state_snapshot: { liquid: 400.0 },
    post_state_snapshot: { liquid: 280.0, invested: 120.0 },
    actor_agent: "LedgerWitnessAgent",
    tx_hash: "0xdeadbeef11111111111111111111111111111111111111111111111111111111",
  });

  // ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  // 3. TEST: get_account_intelligence SCHEMA & METRICS
  // ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  console.log("\n[Test 1] Invoking get_account_intelligence for acc_engineering");

  // acc_engineering: minFloor=50, safetyMultiplier=1.20, evaluationWindow=14d
  // Active liabilities within 14d: 150 + 250 = 400
  // TargetReserve = (400 * 1.20) + 50 = 480 + 50 = 530 USDC
  // Assume balances: liquid = 800 USDC, invested = 200 USYC -> total effective = 1000 USDC
  // SafeToInvest = max(0, 800 - (530 + 10 invest_hysteresis)) = 800 - 540 = 260 USDC
  // UnencumberedFreeCash = max(0, 800 - 530) = 270 USDC
  // FreeCapitalTotal = max(0, 1000 - 530) = 470 USDC
  const intel = await intelService.getAccountIntelligence("acc_engineering", {
    overrideLiquidBalance: 800.0,
    overrideInvestedUsyc: 200.0,
  });

  // Metadata assertions
  assertEqual(intel.metadata.accountId, "acc_engineering", "Metadata: accountId matches");
  assertEqual(intel.metadata.role, "OPEX_DEV", "Metadata: role matches OPEX_DEV");
  assertEqual(intel.metadata.minOperatingFloorUsdc, 50, "Metadata: min operating floor is 50 USDC");
  assertEqual(intel.metadata.safetyBufferRatio, 1.2, "Metadata: safety buffer ratio is 1.20");
  assertEqual(intel.metadata.excludeFromWaterfall, false, "Metadata: excludeFromWaterfall is false");

  // Balances assertions
  assertEqual(intel.balances.liquidUsdc, "800.000000", "Balances: liquidUsdc is 800.000000");
  assertEqual(intel.balances.investedUsycUsdcEquivalent, "200.000000", "Balances: investedUsyc is 200.000000");
  assertEqual(intel.balances.totalEffectiveUsdc, "1000.000000", "Balances: totalEffectiveUsdc is 1000.000000");

  // Liabilities assertions
  assertEqual(intel.liabilities.dueNext7DaysUsdc, "150.000000", "Liabilities: dueNext7Days is 150.000000 (Datadog)");
  assertEqual(intel.liabilities.dueNext30DaysUsdc, "400.000000", "Liabilities: dueNext30Days is 400.000000 (Datadog + AWS)");
  assertEqual(intel.liabilities.items.length, 2, "Liabilities: exactly 2 active items (cancelled excluded)");

  // Solvency & Reserve assertions
  assertEqual(intel.solvencyMetrics.requiredReserveUsdc, "530.000000", "Solvency: requiredReserve is exactly 530.000000");
  assertEqual(intel.solvencyMetrics.safeToInvestUsdc, "260.000000", "Solvency: safeToInvest is exactly 260.000000 (800 - 540)");
  assertEqual(intel.solvencyMetrics.unencumberedFreeCashUsdc, "270.000000", "Solvency: unencumberedFreeCash is exactly 270.000000 (800 - 530)");
  assertEqual(intel.solvencyMetrics.freeCapitalTotalUsdc, "470.000000", "Solvency: freeCapitalTotal is exactly 470.000000 (1000 - 530)");
  assert(intel.solvencyMetrics.isSolvent, "Solvency: isSolvent is TRUE (1000 >= 530)");
  assert(intel.solvencyMetrics.timeHorizonSeconds > 0 && intel.solvencyMetrics.timeHorizonSeconds <= 3 * 86400, "Solvency: timeHorizonSeconds accurately reflects 3-day earliest deadline");

  // Audit History assertions
  assertEqual(intel.recentAuditHistory.length, 1, "Audit: exactly 1 recent audit log record");
  assertEqual(intel.recentAuditHistory[0].action, "AUTONOMOUS_SWEEP", "Audit: action matches AUTONOMOUS_SWEEP");
  assertEqual(intel.recentAuditHistory[0].actorAgent, "LedgerWitnessAgent", "Audit: actor matches LedgerWitnessAgent");

  // ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  // 4. TEST: PAYROLL ACCOUNT PROTECTION
  // ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  console.log("\n[Test 2] Payroll Account Protection in Account Intelligence");

  const payrollIntel = await intelService.getAccountIntelligence("acc_payroll", {
    overrideLiquidBalance: 50000.0,
    overrideInvestedUsyc: 0.0,
  });

  assertEqual(payrollIntel.metadata.excludeFromWaterfall, true, "Payroll: excludeFromWaterfall is TRUE");
  assertEqual(payrollIntel.solvencyMetrics.safeToInvestUsdc, "0.000000", "Payroll: safeToInvest is strictly suppressed to 0.000000");

  // ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  // 5. TEST: ALL ACCOUNTS PORTFOLIO AGGREGATION
  // ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  console.log("\n[Test 3] Portfolio-Wide Intelligence Aggregation");

  const allAccounts = await intelService.getAllAccountsIntelligence({
    acc_engineering: { liquidUsdc: 800.0, investedUsyc: 200.0 },
    acc_payroll: { liquidUsdc: 50000.0, investedUsyc: 0.0 },
    acc_marketing: { liquidUsdc: 1500.0, investedUsyc: 500.0 },
    acc_general_treasury: { liquidUsdc: 25000.0, investedUsyc: 10000.0 },
  });

  assertEqual(allAccounts.length, 4, "getAllAccountsIntelligence returns all 4 registered corporate accounts");
  const foundPayroll = allAccounts.find((a) => a.metadata.accountId === "acc_payroll");
  assert(!!foundPayroll && foundPayroll.metadata.excludeFromWaterfall, "Portfolio includes protected payroll account");

  // ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  // 6. TEST: WATERFALL CANDIDATE PLANNING (For Disbursals)
  // ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  console.log("\n[Test 4] Multi-Account Waterfall Planning for AWS Invoice ($5,000)");

  // acc_engineering: total effective = 1000, requiredReserve = 530 -> free capital = 470 USDC
  // acc_growth: minFloor = 50, safetyMultiplier = 1.15, liabilities = 0 -> requiredReserve = 50 -> free capital = 2000 - 50 = 1950 USDC
  // acc_general_treasury: minFloor = 500, safetyMultiplier = 1.10, liabilities = 0 -> requiredReserve = 500 -> free capital = 35000 - 500 = 34500 USDC
  // acc_payroll: excluded!
  const waterfallPlan = await intelService.getWaterfallCandidateAccounts(5000.0, {
    acc_engineering: { liquidUsdc: 800.0, investedUsyc: 200.0 },
    acc_payroll: { liquidUsdc: 50000.0, investedUsyc: 0.0 },
    acc_marketing: { liquidUsdc: 1500.0, investedUsyc: 500.0 },
    acc_general_treasury: { liquidUsdc: 25000.0, investedUsyc: 10000.0 },
  });

  assert(waterfallPlan.isFullyFundable, "Waterfall: $5,000 invoice is fully fundable");
  assertEqual(waterfallPlan.eligibleAccounts.length, 3, "Waterfall: exactly 3 accounts eligible (payroll correctly excluded)");
  assert(
    !waterfallPlan.eligibleAccounts.some((a) => a.metadata.accountId === "acc_payroll"),
    "Waterfall: payroll is STRICTLY excluded from candidate pool"
  );

  // Check allocation plan: primary largest free capital funds first
  const allocatedSum = waterfallPlan.allocationPlan.reduce((acc, p) => acc + p.allocateAmountUsdc, 0);
  assertEqual(allocatedSum, 5000.0, "Waterfall: allocated sum exactly equals requested $5,000");

  console.log("\n[Test 5] Waterfall Shortfall Detection");
  const impossibleDemand = await intelService.getWaterfallCandidateAccounts(1000000.0, {
    acc_engineering: { liquidUsdc: 800.0, investedUsyc: 200.0 },
    acc_payroll: { liquidUsdc: 50000.0, investedUsyc: 0.0 },
    acc_marketing: { liquidUsdc: 1500.0, investedUsyc: 500.0 },
    acc_general_treasury: { liquidUsdc: 25000.0, investedUsyc: 10000.0 },
  });

  assert(!impossibleDemand.isFullyFundable, "Waterfall: $1,000,000 exceeds available free capital and reports isFullyFundable = false");

  // ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  // SUMMARY
  // ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  console.log("\n" + "=".repeat(50));
  console.log(`  RESULTS: ${pass} passed, ${fail} failed`);
  if (failures.length > 0) {
    console.error("  FAILURES:");
    failures.forEach((f) => console.error(`    ✗ ${f}`));
  } else {
    console.log("  >>> ALL D6->D8 ACCOUNT INTELLIGENCE TESTS PASSED <<<");
  }
  console.log("=".repeat(50));

  process.exit(fail > 0 ? 1 : 0);
}

runD8Tests().catch((err) => {
  console.error("[FATAL]", err);
  process.exit(1);
});

import { describe, it, before, after } from "node:test";
import assert from "node:assert";
import { SwarmCoordinator } from "../src/agents/swarmCoordinator.js";
import { DbClient } from "../src/database/dbClient.js";

describe("BizArc Swarm E2E Real-World Multi-Agent Audit", () => {
  let swarm: SwarmCoordinator;
  const testSessionId = `audit_session_${Date.now()}`;

  before(async () => {
    swarm = new SwarmCoordinator({
      sessionId: testSessionId,
      compactionThreshold: 6,
    });

    // Clean up test tables for clean reproducible run
    await DbClient.query(`DELETE FROM account_liabilities WHERE account_id LIKE 'OPEX_%' OR account_id = 'PAYROLL';`);
    await DbClient.query(`DELETE FROM master_system_journal WHERE account_id LIKE 'OPEX_%';`);

    // Seed test accounts in database across multiple cost centers
    await DbClient.query(`
      INSERT INTO treasury_accounts (account_id, name, role, wallet_address, min_operating_floor_usdc, is_active)
      VALUES 
        ('OPEX_DEV', 'Dev Ops Pool', 'OPEX_DEV', '0x9999999999999999999999999999999999999999', 500.000000, true),
        ('OPEX_GROWTH', 'Marketing Pool', 'OPEX_GROWTH', '0x8888888888888888888888888888888888888888', 500.000000, true),
        ('PAYROLL', 'Employee Payroll Reserve', 'PAYROLL', '0x7777777777777777777777777777777777777777', 10000.000000, true)
      ON CONFLICT (account_id) DO UPDATE SET is_active = true;
    `);

    // Seed verified vendor master registry (Golden Rule 3)
    await DbClient.query(`
      INSERT INTO vendor_master_registry (vendor_id, name, verified_payout_address, verified_by_admin, last_verified_at, change_lock)
      VALUES ('VEND-AWS-01', 'Amazon Web Services Inc.', '0x1111111111111111111111111111111111111111', 'CFO_ADMIN', NOW(), TRUE)
      ON CONFLICT (vendor_id) DO UPDATE SET verified_payout_address = EXCLUDED.verified_payout_address;
    `);
  });

  after(async () => {
    await DbClient.closePool();

import { describe, it, before, after } from "node:test";
import assert from "node:assert/strict";
import { ErpNextConnector, IErpNextTransport } from "../src/connectors/erpNextConnector.js";
import { OdooConnector, IOdooTransport } from "../src/connectors/odooConnector.js";
import { ErpSyncRepo } from "../src/database/repos/erpSyncRepo.js";
import { EnterpriseOnboardingService } from "../src/services/enterpriseOnboardingService.js";
import { LiabilityRadarService } from "../src/services/liabilityRadarService.js";
import { MasterJournalRepo } from "../src/database/repos/masterJournalRepo.js";
import { AuditLogRepo } from "../src/database/repos/auditLogRepo.js";
import { TreasuryAccountsRepo } from "../src/database/repos/treasuryAccountsRepo.js";
import { DbClient } from "../src/database/dbClient.js";
import { LoudRoundingError } from "../src/foundation/usdc/usdcService.js";

const testErpNextTransport: IErpNextTransport = {
  async get<T>(path: string, params?: Record<string, any>): Promise<T> {
    if (path === "/api/resource/Purchase Order") {
      return [
        {
          name: "PO-2026-AWS-01",
          supplier: "vnd_aws",
          grand_total: 12500.0,
          currency: "USD",
          status: "To Receive and Bill",
          items: [{ item_code: "AWS-CLOUD-SRV", qty: 1, rate: 12500.0, amount: 12500.0 }],
        },
      ] as any;
    }
    if (path === "/api/resource/Purchase Receipt") {
      return [
        {
          name: "GRN-2026-AWS-01",
          purchase_order: params?.poNumber || "PO-2026-AWS-01",
          supplier: "vnd_aws",
          status: "Completed",
          items: [{ item_code: "AWS-CLOUD-SRV", qty: 1, received_qty: 1 }],
        },
      ] as any;
    }
    if (path === "/api/resource/Purchase Invoice") {
      return [
        {
          name: "PINV-2026-AWS-01",
          supplier: "vnd_aws",
          grand_total: 12500.0,
          outstanding_amount: 12500.0,
          due_date: new Date(Date.now() + 86400000 * 5).toISOString(),
          status: "Unpaid",
          items: [{ item_code: "AWS-CLOUD-SRV", qty: 1, rate: 12500.0, amount: 12500.0 }],
        },
      ] as any;
    }
    return [] as any;
  },
  async post<T>(path: string, body: any): Promise<T> {
    return { success: true, docName: "PE-2026-AWS-01" } as any;
  },
};

const testOdooTransport: IOdooTransport = {
  async callJsonRpc<T>(service: string, method: string, args: any[]): Promise<T> {
    if (service === "common" && method === "authenticate") {
      return 1 as any;
    }
    if (service === "object" && method === "execute_kw") {
      const model = args[3];
      const modelMethod = args[4];
      if (model === "purchase.order" && modelMethod === "search_read") {
        return [
          {
            id: 101,
            name: "PO-2026-AWS-01",
            partner_id: [42, "AWS EMEA"],
            amount_total: 12500.0,
            state: "purchase",
            order_line: [1001],
          },
        ] as any;
      }
      if (model === "stock.picking" && modelMethod === "search_read") {
        return [
          {
            id: 501,
            name: "GRN-2026-AWS-01",
            origin: "PO-2026-AWS-01",
            state: "done",
            date_done: new Date().toISOString(),
          },
        ] as any;
      }
      if (model === "account.move" && modelMethod === "search_read") {
        return [
          {
            id: 901,
            name: "BILL/2026/05/0001",
            partner_id: [42, "AWS EMEA"],
            move_type: "in_invoice",
            amount_total: 12500.0,
            amount_residual: 12500.0,
            invoice_date_due: new Date(Date.now() + 86400000 * 5).toISOString(),
            payment_state: "not_paid",
            invoice_line_ids: [2001],
          },
        ] as any;
      }
      if (model === "account.payment.register" && modelMethod === "create") {
        return 777 as any;
      }
    }
    return {} as any;
  },
};

describe("D6-D9 Real-World ERP Connectors & Enterprise Onboarding Audit", () => {
  const erpNext = new ErpNextConnector(undefined, testErpNextTransport);
  const odoo = new OdooConnector(undefined, testOdooTransport);
  const onboarding = new EnterpriseOnboardingService();
  const radar = new LiabilityRadarService();

  before(async () => {
    // Seed standard test accounts for ERP linkage
    await TreasuryAccountsRepo.upsertAccount({
      account_id: "acc_engineering",
      name: "Engineering Operations",
      role: "OPEX_DEV",
      wallet_address: "0x1111111111111111111111111111111111111101",
      chain_id: 5042002,
      min_operating_floor_usdc: 50.0,
      safety_buffer_ratio: 1.2,
      is_active: true,
    });
  });

  after(async () => {
    await DbClient.closePool();
  });

  it("Test 1: ERPNext Connector fetches Purchase Orders, GRNs, and Invoices", async () => {
    const pos = await erpNext.getPurchaseOrders();
    assert.ok(pos.length >= 1, "Should fetch at least 1 PO from ERPNext");
    assert.equal(pos[0].supplier, "vnd_aws");
    assert.equal(pos[0].grand_total, 12500.0);

    const receipts = await erpNext.getPurchaseReceipts(pos[0].name);
    assert.ok(receipts.length >= 1, "Should fetch Goods Receipt Note (GRN) for PO");
    assert.equal(receipts[0].purchase_order, pos[0].name);
    assert.equal(receipts[0].status, "Completed");

    const invoices = await erpNext.getPurchaseInvoices();
    assert.ok(invoices.length >= 1, "Should fetch Purchase Invoices from ERPNext");
    assert.equal(invoices[0].supplier, "vnd_aws");
    assert.equal(invoices[0].outstanding_amount, 12500.0);
  });

  it("Test 2: Rule 5 Loud Repair: Refusal of ERPNext 0.5 round-off sweeps", async () => {
    const cleanInvoice = {
      name: "PINV-CLEAN",
      supplier: "vnd_aws",
      grand_total: 100.0,
      outstanding_amount: 100.0,
      due_date: new Date().toISOString(),
      status: "Unpaid",
      items: [],
      round_off: 0,
    };
    const cleanCheck = erpNext.verifyNoSilentRoundOff(cleanInvoice);
    assert.equal(cleanCheck.hasSilentRoundOff, false);

    const silentRoundOffInvoice = {
      name: "PINV-DIRTY",
      supplier: "vnd_aws",
      grand_total: 100.0,
      rounded_total: 100.45,
      round_off: 0.45, // Silent ERPNext round-off sweep
      outstanding_amount: 100.45,
      due_date: new Date().toISOString(),
      status: "Unpaid",
      items: [],
    };
    const dirtyCheck = erpNext.verifyNoSilentRoundOff(silentRoundOffInvoice);
    assert.equal(dirtyCheck.hasSilentRoundOff, true);
    assert.equal(dirtyCheck.roundOffAmount, 0.45);

    // Verify LiabilityRadarService loudly throws LoudRoundingError
    await assert.rejects(
      async () => {
        await radar.ingestLiabilityDocument({
          accountId: "acc_engineering",
          vendorId: "vnd_aws",
          title: "Dirty ERPNext Round-off Invoice",
          category: "INFRASTRUCTURE",
          amountUsdc: 100.45,
          dueDate: new Date(Date.now() + 86400000),
          claimedPayoutAddress: "0x1111111111111111111111111111111111111111",
          roundOffSweepDetected: true,
          erpRoundOffAmount: 0.45,
        });
      },
      (err: any) => {
        assert.ok(err instanceof LoudRoundingError);
        assert.ok(err.message.includes("LOUD REPAIR REFUSAL: ERPNext 0.5 round-off sweep detected"));
        return true;
      }
    );
  });

  it("Test 3: Rule 1 Document Linkage: Post onchain-linked Payment Entry to ERPNext", async () => {
    const payment = await erpNext.postPaymentEntry({
      payment_type: "Pay",
      party_type: "Supplier",
      party: "vnd_aws",
      paid_amount: 12500.0,
      reference_no: "0xarc_tx_payment_hash_12345",
      reference_date: new Date().toISOString().split("T")[0],
      purchase_invoice_id: "PINV-2026-AWS-01",
      cost_center: "acc_engineering",
    });

    assert.equal(payment.success, true);
    assert.ok(payment.docName.startsWith("PE-"));
  });

  it("Test 4: Odoo Connector executes JSON-RPC authentication and fetches POs, pickings, and bills", async () => {
    const uid = await odoo.authenticate();
    assert.ok(uid > 0, "Odoo authentication must return a valid integer UID");

    const orders = await odoo.getPurchaseOrders();
    assert.ok(orders.length >= 1);
    assert.equal(orders[0].amount_total, 12500.0);

    const pickings = await odoo.getStockPickings(orders[0].name);
    assert.ok(pickings.length >= 1);
    assert.equal(pickings[0].state, "done");

    const bills = await odoo.getVendorBills();
    assert.ok(bills.length >= 1);
    assert.equal(bills[0].move_type, "in_invoice");

    const paymentRes = await odoo.registerPayment(bills[0].id, 12500.0, "0xarc_odoo_settled_tx");
    assert.equal(paymentRes.success, true);
    assert.ok(paymentRes.paymentId > 0);
  });

      account_id: "acc_engineering",

      status: "SYNCED",
    });

    assert.equal(syncCheckpoint.sync_id, "sync_erpnext_acc_engineering_01");
    assert.equal(syncCheckpoint.system_type, "ERPNEXT");
    assert.equal(syncCheckpoint.last_synced_document_id, "PINV-2026-AWS-01");

    const retrieved = await ErpSyncRepo.getSyncState("sync_erpnext_acc_engineering_01");
    assert.ok(retrieved);
    assert.equal(retrieved?.status, "SYNCED");

    const updated = await ErpSyncRepo.updateCheckpoint(

      "PINV-2026-AWS-02",
      { batch_size: 50, latest_modified: "2026-10-01T21:00:00Z" }
    );
    assert.equal(updated?.last_synced_document_id, "PINV-2026-AWS-02");
  });

    assert.equal(vaultConfig.accountId, "acc_engineering");

  it("Test 7: D0.B Phase 7: Activation deposit ingestion & ledger genesis", async () => {
    const activation = await onboarding.ingestActivationDeposit(

    assert.equal(activation.journalEntryHash.length, 64);

    // Verify journal has document-linked entry (Rule 1)
    const journalEntries = await MasterJournalRepo.getEntriesByAccount("acc_engineering");
    const activationEntry = journalEntries.find((e) => e.action_type === "ACTIVATION_DEPOSIT_INGESTED");
    assert.ok(activationEntry);
    assert.equal(activationEntry?.amount_usdc, 5000.0);
    assert.equal(activationEntry?.document_ref, "ARC:TX:0xarc_activation_deposit_tx_hash_112233");

    // Verify audit log
    const auditLogs = await AuditLogRepo.getAuditLogsByAccount("acc_engineering");
    const activationLog = auditLogs.find((l) => l.action_type === "ACCOUNT_ACTIVATED");
    assert.ok(activationLog);
    assert.equal(activationLog?.actor_agent, "OnboardingAgent");
  });
});

/**

 * 1. Multi-Tenancy Isolation Test: Concurrent onboarding and mutations across separate tenants.

 * 4. Per-Liability 4-Rail Execution Test: DisbursalVault, ModularSessionKey, ERC-3009, Gateway x402.

describe("Phase 4: Platform Verification, Invariant Enforcement, & Multi-Tenant Audit", () => {
  const wizardService = new OnboardingWizardService();
  const accountService = new AccountManagementService();
  const liabilityService = new LiabilityManagementService();
  const disbursalRouter = new DisbursalRouter();
  const mathEngine = new MathRulesQAEngine();
  const policyManager = TenantPolicyManager.getInstance();
  const dynamicRecords = new DynamicRecordsService();
  const mcpAggregator = new McpAppConnector();

  const TENANT_ALPHA = `audit_alpha_${Date.now()}`;
  const TENANT_BETA = `audit_beta_${Date.now()}`;

  before(async () => {
    await DbClient.query("DELETE FROM onboarding_wizard_sessions WHERE company_id IN ($1, $2)", [TENANT_ALPHA, TENANT_BETA]);
    await DbClient.query("DELETE FROM account_liabilities WHERE company_id IN ($1, $2)", [TENANT_ALPHA, TENANT_BETA]);
    await DbClient.query("DELETE FROM treasury_accounts WHERE company_id IN ($1, $2)", [TENANT_ALPHA, TENANT_BETA]);
    await DbClient.query("DELETE FROM company_profiles WHERE company_id IN ($1, $2)", [TENANT_ALPHA, TENANT_BETA]);
    await DbClient.query("DELETE FROM session_key_registry");
    await DbClient.query("DELETE FROM master_system_journal");
  });

  after(async () => {
    await DbClient.closePool();
  });

  // ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  // 1. MULTI-TENANCY ISOLATION TEST (Section 13.1 #1)
  // ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  it("Audit 1: Multi-Tenancy Isolation — Concurrent Onboarding & Zero Cross-Tenant Data Leakage", async () => {
    // Run two simultaneous tenant onboarding flows (Tenant A and Tenant B) on separate worker processes
    const runWorker = (companyId: string, otherCompanyId: string, floor: number, amount: number, rail: string) => {
      return execAsync(
        `npx tsx tests/helpers/tenantOnboardingWorker.ts --companyId ${companyId} --otherCompanyId ${otherCompanyId} --floor ${floor} --amount ${amount} --rail ${rail}`,
        { cwd: "/home/gifted/BizArc" }
      );
    };

    const [outA, outB] = await Promise.all([
      runWorker(TENANT_ALPHA, TENANT_BETA, 500, 250, "DISBURSAL_VAULT"),
      runWorker(TENANT_BETA, TENANT_ALPHA, 1500, 1200, "MODULAR_SESSION_KEY"),
    ]);

    const resA = JSON.parse(outA.stdout.trim());
    const resB = JSON.parse(outB.stdout.trim());

    assert.equal(resA.success, true, "Worker process A must succeed");
    assert.equal(resB.success, true, "Worker process B must succeed");
    assert.notEqual(resA.pid, resB.pid, "Tenant A and Tenant B must execute on separate OS worker processes");
    assert.equal(resA.crossTenantPollutionDetected, false, "Tenant A process detected zero cross-tenant pollution");
    assert.equal(resB.crossTenantPollutionDetected, false, "Tenant B process detected zero cross-tenant pollution");

    // Verify Storage Isolation directly in PostgreSQL
    const alphaAccounts = await accountService.listAccounts(TENANT_ALPHA);
    const betaAccounts = await accountService.listAccounts(TENANT_BETA);

    assert.equal(alphaAccounts.length, 1);
    assert.equal(betaAccounts.length, 1);
    assert.equal(alphaAccounts.every((a) => a.company_id === TENANT_ALPHA), true);
    assert.equal(betaAccounts.every((a) => a.company_id === TENANT_BETA), true);
    assert.notEqual(alphaAccounts[0].account_id, betaAccounts[0].account_id);

    // Cross-tenant liability queries must return 0 results
    const alphaLiabs = await liabilityService.listLiabilities(TENANT_ALPHA);
    const betaLiabs = await liabilityService.listLiabilities(TENANT_BETA);

    assert.equal(alphaLiabs.length, 1);
    assert.equal(betaLiabs.length, 1);
    assert.equal(alphaLiabs.every((l) => l.company_id === TENANT_ALPHA), true);
    assert.equal(betaLiabs.every((l) => l.company_id === TENANT_BETA), true);

    // Master Journal isolation
    const alphaJournals = await MasterJournalRepo.getEntriesByCompany(TENANT_ALPHA);
    const betaJournals = await MasterJournalRepo.getEntriesByCompany(TENANT_BETA);
    assert.equal(alphaJournals.length >= 1, true);
    assert.equal(betaJournals.length >= 1, true);
    assert.equal(alphaJournals.every((j) => j.company_id === TENANT_ALPHA), true);
    assert.equal(betaJournals.every((j) => j.company_id === TENANT_BETA), true);
  });

  // ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  // 2. Q&A MATHEMATICAL DETERMINISM TEST (Section 13.1 #2 & Agents and Ledgers Rule 5)
  // ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  it("Audit 2: Q&A Mathematical Determinism — Exact 6-Decimal USDC & Loud Failure on Non-Conforming Input", async () => {
    const answers = [
      { questionId: "GM_RUNWAY_MONTHS", answer: 12 },
      { questionId: "GM_MONTHLY_BURN", answer: 45000 },
      { questionId: "GM_REVENUE_VOLATILITY", answer: "MEDIUM" },
      { questionId: "GM_BUFFER_MULTIPLIER", answer: "CONSERVATIVE" },
      { questionId: "IM_USYC_SWEEP_RATIO", answer: 85 },
      { questionId: "IM_MIN_SWEEP_BATCH_USDC", answer: 250 },
      { questionId: "IM_RECALL_HYSTERESIS_BAND", answer: 50 },
    ];

    const results = mathEngine.evaluateAnswers(answers);
    assert.equal(results.length, 7);

    // Verify 6-decimal string formatting with zero rounding errors
    const burnResult = results.find((r) => r.questionId === "GM_MONTHLY_BURN");
    assert.equal(burnResult?.derivedValue, 45000);
    assert.equal(burnResult?.formattedUsdc, "45000.000000 USDC");

    const ratioResult = results.find((r) => r.questionId === "IM_USYC_SWEEP_RATIO");
    assert.equal(ratioResult?.derivedValue, 0.85);

    // Verify Loud Rounding Exception (Rule 5: Refuse silent rounding or invalid bounds)
    assert.throws(
      () => {
        mathEngine.evaluateAnswers([{ questionId: "GM_RUNWAY_MONTHS", answer: 999 }]); // > 24 months max
      },
      /Validation error/,
      "Must throw loud validation error for non-conforming inputs"
    );
  });

  // 3. LIVE MCP INTEGRATION TEST (Section 13.1 #3 & Rule 1 Document-Linked Ledgers)

  it("Audit 3: Live MCP Integration — Document Extraction, Vendor Dimension Normalization & Candidate Mapping", async () => {

    // 2. Google Workspace MCP Client (Drive & Gmail live tool execution)
    const testGoogleTransport = {

        if (name === "gmail_get_message") {
          return {
            id: "msg_audit_01",

          };

        if (name === "gdrive_search_files") {
          return {
            files: [
              {
                id: "doc_audit_contract",
                name: "Datadog_Enterprise_Agreement.pdf",

    const googleClient = new GoogleWorkspaceMcpClient("audit_tenant_mcp", testGoogleTransport);

    assert.ok(googleData.invoices[0].amountUsdc > 0);
    assert.ok(googleData.invoices[0].payoutAddress.startsWith("0x"));

    // 3. Microsoft 365 MCP Client (Excel & OneDrive live tool execution)
    const testMicrosoftTransport = {
      async callTool(name: string, args: Record<string, any>) {

          return {
            files: [
              { id: "wb_budget", name: "Budget_Schedule.xlsx", mimeType: "application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet" },

            ],

  it("Audit 4: Per-Liability 4-Rail Settlement — DisbursalVault, SessionKey, ERC-3009, Gateway x402", async () => {
    const TENANT_RAILS = `audit_rails_${Date.now()}`;
    const VENDOR_AWS = `vnd_audit_aws_${Date.now()}`;

      verified_payout_address: "0x2222222222222222222222222222222222222202",
      verified_by_admin: "admin_auditor",
      last_verified_at: new Date(),
      change_lock: true,
    });
    await VendorMasterRepo.registerVendor({
      vendor_id: VENDOR_ARC,
      name: "Arc Developer Tools",
      verified_payout_address: "0x3333333333333333333333333333333333333303",
      verified_by_admin: "admin_auditor",
      last_verified_at: new Date(),
      change_lock: true,
    });
    await VendorMasterRepo.registerVendor({
      vendor_id: VENDOR_WEATHER,
      name: "Circle Gateway Weather Query",
      verified_payout_address: "0x4444444444444444444444444444444444444404",
      payment_endpoint_url: "https://api.marketdata.arc/v1/weather",
      verified_by_admin: "admin_auditor",

    await wizardService.saveStepDraft(session.sessionId, 5, {

        {
          title: "SaaS Database Monitoring",
          accountId: `${TENANT_RAILS}_ops`,

  // ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  // 5. POST-SETUP EDITABILITY & INVARIANT RE-ANCHORING (Section 13.1 #5)
  // ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  it("Audit 5: Post-Setup Editability — Re-anchoring Dynamic Records 1 & 2 without Human Intervention", async () => {
    const TENANT_EDIT = `audit_edit_${Date.now()}`;
    const accountId = `${TENANT_EDIT}_acc_growth`;

    // Provision initial state
    await accountService.createAccount(TENANT_EDIT, {
      accountId,
      name: "Growth Operations",
      role: "OPEX_GROWTH",
      minOperatingFloorUsdc: 200.0,
      safetyBufferRatio: 1.20,
    });

    const initialRecord2 = await dynamicRecords.calculateSafeToInvest(accountId);
    assert.ok(initialRecord2.safeToInvestUsdc);

    // Admin schedules liability
    const liab = await liabilityService.createLiability(TENANT_EDIT, {
      accountId,
      vendorId: "vnd_billboard",
      title: "Highway Digital Billboard",
      category: "MARKETING" as any,
      amountUsdc: 1500.0,
      dueDate: new Date(Date.now() + 5 * 86400 * 1000),
      payoutAddress: "0x4444444444444444444444444444444444444401",
    });

    // Verify Dynamic Record 2 immediately re-anchored after liability addition
    const postLiabRecord2 = await dynamicRecords.calculateSafeToInvest(accountId);
    assert.ok(postLiabRecord2.upcomingLiabilitiesTotalUsdc.startsWith("1500"));

    // Admin updates account floor from $200 to $600 (Section 13.1 #5)
    await accountService.updateAccount(TENANT_EDIT, accountId, {
      minOperatingFloorUsdc: 600.0,
    });

    // Verify Dynamic Record 2 reflects the raised floor
    const postFloorRecord2 = await dynamicRecords.calculateSafeToInvest(accountId);
    assert.equal(postFloorRecord2.targetReserveUsdc, "600.000000"); // $600 floor
    assert.ok(postFloorRecord2.upcomingLiabilitiesTotalUsdc.startsWith("1500")); // $1500 liability

    // Modify liability's due date and amount (Section 13.1 #5)
    const newDueDate = new Date(Date.now() + 4 * 86400 * 1000);
    const updatedLiab = await liabilityService.updateLiability(TENANT_EDIT, liab.liability_id!, {
      amountUsdc: 3200.0,
      dueDate: newDueDate,
    });
    assert.equal(updatedLiab.amount_usdc, 3200.0);

    // Verify Dynamic Record 1 & 2 immediately rebalance and reconcile without human intervention
    const postModifyRecord2 = await dynamicRecords.calculateSafeToInvest(accountId);
    assert.equal(postModifyRecord2.upcomingLiabilitiesTotalUsdc, "3200.000000");
    assert.equal(postModifyRecord2.targetReserveUsdc, "600.000000");

    // Dynamic Record 1 (parallel tripartite balance) invariant verified
    const tripartite = await dynamicRecords.getTripartiteBalance(accountId);
    assert.equal(tripartite.invariantSatisfied, true, "Liquid + Invested must strictly equal Available");

    // Admin cancels liability -> reserve immediately freed
    await liabilityService.cancelLiability(TENANT_EDIT, liab.liability_id!, "Billboard campaign ended early.");
    const postCancelRecord2 = await dynamicRecords.calculateSafeToInvest(accountId);

  });

  // ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

    // 1. Verify Live Arc Testnet RPC Connection
    const publicClient = ArcClientManager.getPublicClient();

    assert.equal(ARC_CONSTANTS.MIN_GAS_FLOOR_GWEI, 20n, "Arc L1 enforces 20 Gwei gas floor");

    // 3. Verify Master Journal Cryptographic SHA-256 Hash Chain Integrity (Agents and Ledgers Rule 1 & 4)
    const verification = await MasterJournalRepo.verifyChainIntegrity();

      console.error("[Audit 6] Chain integrity failure details:", verification);

  });

import {

  throw new Error("Failed to encode sweepFromAccount calldata");

console.log("✓ CentralTreasuryYieldVault calldata encoding verified");

// 5. Test DisbursalVaultService Idempotency & EIP-712 Signing
console.log("5. Testing DisbursalVaultService EIP-712 Signatures & Idempotency Key...");
const mockDisbursalAddr = "0x3333333333333333333333333333333333333333" as `0x${string}`;
const disbursalService = new DisbursalVaultService(mockDisbursalAddr, 5042002);

const testVendor = "0x4444444444444444444444444444444444444444" as `0x${string}`;
const invoiceId = "INV-AWS-OCT-2026";
const amount = 100_000_000n; // $100.00 USDC

const idempotencyKey1 = DisbursalVaultService.generateIdempotencyKey(testVendor, invoiceId, amount);
const idempotencyKey2 = DisbursalVaultService.generateIdempotencyKey(testVendor, invoiceId, amount);
if (idempotencyKey1 !== idempotencyKey2) {
  throw new Error("Idempotency keys for identical parameters must match deterministically");
}
console.log(`✓ Deterministic Idempotency Key generated: ${idempotencyKey1}`);

// Construct EIP-712 Typed Message
const message = {
  permissionRequestId: DisbursalVaultService.formatRequestId("pr_req_001"),
  vendor: testVendor,
  amount,
  idempotencyKey: idempotencyKey1,
  nonce: 1n,
  deadline: BigInt(Math.floor(Date.now() / 1000) + 3600), // 1 hour expiry
};

const typedData = disbursalService.getEIP712TypedData(message);

// Sign with ViemWalletAdapter (Admin Approver)
const adminPrivateKey = "0xac0974bec39a17e36ba4a6b4d238ff944bacb478cbed5efcae784d7bf4f2ff80" as `0x${string}`;
const adminWallet = new ViemWalletAdapter(adminPrivateKey, "arcTestnet");
const adminAddress = adminWallet.getAddress();

async function runSignatureTest() {
  const signature = await adminWallet.signTypedData(typedData);
  console.log(`✓ Generated EIP-712 admin authorization signature: ${signature.slice(0, 20)}...`);

  // Recover signer using Viem cryptographic verification
  const recoveredSigner = await recoverTypedDataAddress({
    domain: typedData.domain,
    types: typedData.types,
    primaryType: typedData.primaryType,
    message: typedData.message,
    signature,
  });

  if (recoveredSigner.toLowerCase() !== adminAddress.toLowerCase()) {
    throw new Error(
      `Recovered signer (${recoveredSigner}) does not match admin approver (${adminAddress})!`
    );
  }
  console.log(`✓ Cryptographic EIP-712 signature verification successful: matches admin approver (${adminAddress})`);

  // Encode executePayment calldata with the verified signature
  const executeCalldata = disbursalService.encodeExecutePayment({
    permissionRequestId: message.permissionRequestId,
    vendor: message.vendor,
    amount: message.amount,
    idempotencyKey: message.idempotencyKey,
    nonce: message.nonce,
    deadline: message.deadline,
    adminSignature: signature,
  });
  if (!executeCalldata.startsWith("0x")) {
    throw new Error("Failed to encode executePayment calldata");
  }
  console.log("✓ DisbursalVault executePayment calldata encoded with verified EIP-712 signature");

  console.log("\n>>> ALL D0/D3 SMART CONTRACT FOUNDATION TESTS PASSED! <<<");
}

runSignatureTest().catch((err) => {
  console.error(err);
  process.exit(1);
});

  function assert(condition: boolean, label: string) {
    if (condition) {
      console.log(`  ✓ ${label}`);
      pass++;
    } else {
      console.error(`  ✗ FAIL: ${label}`);
      fail++;
      failures.push(label);
    }
  }

  function assertEqual<T>(actual: T, expected: T, label: string) {
    if (actual === expected) {
      console.log(`  ✓ ${label}`);
      pass++;
    } else {
      console.error(`  ✗ FAIL: ${label} -> expected ${JSON.stringify(expected)}, got ${JSON.stringify(actual)}`);
      fail++;
      failures.push(label);
    }
  }

  const found36h = preFlightSprs.find((s) => s.requestId === `SPRS-LIAB-${liab36h.liability.liability_id}`);
  const found72h = preFlightSprs.find((s) => s.requestId === `SPRS-LIAB-${liab72h.liability.liability_id}`);

  assert(Boolean(found12h), "Liability due in 12h generated pre-flight SPRS");
  assert(Boolean(found36h), "Liability due in 36h generated pre-flight SPRS");
  assert(!found72h, "Liability due in 72h did NOT generate pre-flight SPRS (correctly excluded from 48h horizon)");

  // Inspect SPRS structure and financial intelligence completeness
  assertEqual(found12h?.action, "DISBURSEMENT_PAYMENT", "SPRS action is DISBURSEMENT_PAYMENT");
  assertEqual(found12h?.amountUsdc, "300.000000", "SPRS amount has exact 6-decimal formatting");
  assertEqual(found12h?.targetRecipient.vendorId, VENDOR_DATADOG, "SPRS targetRecipient vendorId verified");
  assertEqual(found12h?.targetRecipient.isInVerifiedMaster, true, "SPRS confirms recipient is in Verified Vendor Master");
  assertEqual(found12h?.targetRecipient.payeeAddressMatchesHistory, true, "SPRS confirms address matches verified history");
  assertEqual(found12h?.affectedAccounts[0].currentLiquidBalance, "5000.000000", "SPRS incorporates live liquid balance");
  assertEqual(found12h?.affectedAccounts[0].totalEffectiveBalance, "7500.000000", "SPRS incorporates total effective balance ($5k liquid + $2.5k USYC)");

  // ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  // 10. AUDIT: HUMAN OPERATOR APPROVAL WORKFLOW
  // ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  console.log("\n[Audit 9] Human Gate Resolution Flow: APPROVE");
  const approveResult = await radarAgent.resolveAdminDecision({
    requestId: found12h!.requestId,
    decision: "APPROVE",
    adminInstructions: "Approved by VP of Engineering. Settle within 12h window.",
  });

  assertEqual(approveResult.status, "APPROVED", "Decision recorded as APPROVED");
  const approvedLiab = await LiabilityRepo.getLiabilityById(approveResult.liabilityId);
  assertEqual(approvedLiab?.status, "SCHEDULED", "Liability returned to SCHEDULED state ready for DisbursalVault");

  const approvedSprsRecord = await PermissionRequestRepo.getRequestById(found12h!.requestId);
  assertEqual(approvedSprsRecord?.status, "APPROVED", "SPRS status persisted in DB as APPROVED");

  // ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  // 11. AUDIT: HUMAN OPERATOR CANCELLATION WORKFLOW (KILL SWITCH)
  // ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  console.log("\n[Audit 10] Human Gate Resolution Flow: CANCEL_WITH_INSTRUCTIONS");
  const cancelResult = await radarAgent.resolveAdminDecision({
    requestId: found36h!.requestId,
    decision: "CANCEL_WITH_INSTRUCTIONS",
    adminInstructions: "Decommissioning legacy Datadog logs ingestion. Do not pay. Cancel contract.",
  });

  assertEqual(cancelResult.status, "CANCELLED", "Decision recorded as CANCELLED");
  const cancelledLiab = await LiabilityRepo.getLiabilityById(cancelResult.liabilityId);
  assertEqual(cancelledLiab?.status, "CANCELLED", "Liability status locked to CANCELLED in PostgreSQL");

  const cancelledSprsRecord = await PermissionRequestRepo.getRequestById(found36h!.requestId);
  assertEqual(cancelledSprsRecord?.status, "REJECTED", "SPRS status recorded as REJECTED in PostgreSQL");

  assert(
    Boolean(cancelResult.cancellationMemo?.includes("Decommissioning legacy Datadog logs ingestion")),
    "Formal Vendor Cancellation Memo drafted with exact admin instructions"
  );

  // ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  // 12. AUDIT: MULTI-ACCOUNT OBLIGATION SEGREGATION
  // ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  console.log("\n[Audit 11] Multi-Account Segregation: Ensure Zero Cost-Center Pollution");

  // Ingest liability for Marketing Account
  const mktLiab = await radarAgent.ingestLiabilityDocument({
    accountId: "acc_marketing",
    vendorId: VENDOR_DATADOG,
    title: "Marketing Campaign Tracking Sub",
    category: "SUBSCRIPTION",
    amountUsdc: 400.0,
    dueDate: new Date(Date.now() + 5 * 86400 * 1000),
    claimedPayoutAddress: VENDOR_DATADOG_ADDR,
  });

  const engLiabilities = await LiabilityRepo.getLiabilitiesByAccount("acc_engineering");
  const mktLiabilities = await LiabilityRepo.getLiabilitiesByAccount("acc_marketing");

  assert(
    engLiabilities.every((l) => l.account_id === "acc_engineering"),
    "All Engineering liabilities strictly belong to acc_engineering"
  );
  assert(
    mktLiabilities.every((l) => l.account_id === "acc_marketing"),
    "All Marketing liabilities strictly belong to acc_marketing"
  );
  assert(
    !engLiabilities.some((l) => l.liability_id === mktLiab.liability.liability_id),
    "Engineering account is NOT contaminated with Marketing liabilities"
  );

  // ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  // 13. AUDIT: POSTGRESQL IMMUTABLE AUDIT LOG VERIFICATION
  // ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  console.log("\n[Audit 12] PostgreSQL Audit Trail: Verify Complete Event Logging");
  const logsRes = await DbClient.query("SELECT * FROM account_agent_audit_log WHERE actor_agent = 'LiabilityRadarAgent' ORDER BY log_id ASC;");
  const auditLogs = logsRes.rows;

  assert(auditLogs.length >= 8, `Audit log captured all agent lifecycle events (${auditLogs.length} entries)`);

  const hasIngested = auditLogs.some((l) => l.action_type === "LIABILITY_INGESTED");
  const hasApproved = auditLogs.some((l) => l.action_type === "LIABILITY_APPROVED");
  const hasCancelled = auditLogs.some((l) => l.action_type === "LIABILITY_CANCELLED");

  assert(hasIngested, "Audit log verified LIABILITY_INGESTED records");
  assert(hasApproved, "Audit log verified LIABILITY_APPROVED records");
  assert(hasCancelled, "Audit log verified LIABILITY_CANCELLED records");

  // ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  // AUDIT SUMMARY
  // ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  console.log("\n" + "=".repeat(80));
  console.log(`  INDEPENDENT REAL-WORLD AUDIT COMPLETE: ${pass} passed, ${fail} failed`);
  if (failures.length > 0) {
    console.error("  FAILURES DETECTED IN REAL-WORLD AUDIT:");
    failures.forEach((f) => console.error(`    ✗ ${f}`));
  } else {
    console.log("  >>> INDEPENDENT VERIFICATION CONFIRMED: D6->D9 IS ROBUST & REAL-WORLD READY <<<");
  }
  console.log("=".repeat(80));

  process.exit(fail > 0 ? 1 : 0);
}

runIndependentD9Audit().catch((err) => {

------------------------------------------------------------

import { OnboardingWizardService } from "../../src/services/onboardingWizardService.js";
import { AccountManagementService } from "../../src/services/accountManagementService.js";
import { LiabilityManagementService } from "../../src/services/liabilityManagementService.js";
import { MasterJournalRepo } from "../../src/database/repos/masterJournalRepo.js";
import { WizardSessionRepo } from "../../src/database/repos/wizardSessionRepo.js";
import { DbClient } from "../../src/database/dbClient.js";

async function main() {
  const args = process.argv.slice(2);
  const getArg = (flag: string) => {
    const idx = args.indexOf(flag);
    return idx !== -1 && args[idx + 1] ? args[idx + 1] : undefined;
  };

  const companyId = getArg("--companyId");
  const otherCompanyId = getArg("--otherCompanyId");
  const accountId = getArg("--accountId") || `${companyId}_ops`;
  const accountName = getArg("--accountName") || "Operations";
  const floorUsdc = parseFloat(getArg("--floor") || "500.0");
  const liabilityTitle = getArg("--liabilityTitle") || "Cloud Computing";
  const amountUsdc = parseFloat(getArg("--amount") || "250.0");
  const preferredPaymentRail = getArg("--rail") || "DISBURSAL_VAULT";

  if (!companyId) {
    console.error(JSON.stringify({ success: false, error: "Missing --companyId" }));
    process.exit(1);
  }

  try {
    const wizardService = new OnboardingWizardService();
    const accountService = new AccountManagementService();
    const liabilityService = new LiabilityManagementService();

    // 1. Create Session
    const session = await wizardService.createSession({ companyId, entryPath: "MANUAL" });

    // 2. Step 1 Draft
    await wizardService.saveStepDraft(session.sessionId, 1, {
      companyName: `${companyId} Enterprise`,
      jurisdiction: "US-DE",
    });

    // 3. Step 4 Draft (Accounts)
    await wizardService.saveStepDraft(session.sessionId, 4, {
      accounts: [
        {
          accountId,
          name: accountName,
          role: "OPEX_DEV",
          minOperatingFloorUsdc: floorUsdc,
        },
      ],
    });

    // 4. Step 5 Draft (Liabilities)
    await wizardService.saveStepDraft(session.sessionId, 5, {
      liabilities: [
        {
          title: liabilityTitle,
          accountId,
          vendorId: `vnd_${companyId}`,
          amountUsdc,
          payoutAddress: "0x1111111111111111111111111111111111111111",
          preferredPaymentRail: preferredPaymentRail as any,
        },
      ],
    });

    // 5. Activate Organization
    await wizardService.activateOrganization(session.sessionId);

    // 6. Post a tenant-scoped ledger entry
    await MasterJournalRepo.appendEntry({
      company_id: companyId,
      account_id: accountId,
      action_type: "ONBOARDING_INITIALIZATION",
      debit_account: accountId,
      credit_account: "0xTREASURY_RESERVE",
      amount_usdc: floorUsdc,
      document_ref: `0xhash_${companyId}`,
    });

    // 7. Verify Isolation against otherCompanyId
    let crossTenantPollutionDetected = false;
    let foreignDraftAccessed = false;

    if (otherCompanyId) {
      // Check if this tenant can access otherCompanyId's session
      const otherSessions = await DbClient.query(
        "SELECT session_id FROM onboarding_wizard_sessions WHERE company_id = $1;",
        [otherCompanyId]
      );
      // If we attempt to read otherCompany's session using wizardService or verify isolation
      const myAccounts = await accountService.listAccounts(companyId);
      const containsOtherAccounts = myAccounts.some((a) => a.company_id === otherCompanyId);

      const myLiabilities = await liabilityService.listLiabilities(companyId);
      const containsOtherLiabilities = myLiabilities.some((l) => l.company_id === otherCompanyId);

      const myJournals = await MasterJournalRepo.getEntriesByCompany(companyId);
      const containsOtherJournals = myJournals.some((j) => j.company_id === otherCompanyId);

      if (containsOtherAccounts || containsOtherLiabilities || containsOtherJournals) {
        crossTenantPollutionDetected = true;
      }
    }

    const accounts = await accountService.listAccounts(companyId);
    const liabilities = await liabilityService.listLiabilities(companyId);
    const journals = await MasterJournalRepo.getEntriesByCompany(companyId);

    const result = {
      success: true,
      pid: process.pid,
      companyId,
      accountsCount: accounts.length,
      liabilitiesCount: liabilities.length,
      journalsCount: journals.length,
      crossTenantPollutionDetected,
      accountIds: accounts.map((a) => a.account_id),
      liabilityTitles: liabilities.map((l) => l.title),
    };

    console.log(JSON.stringify(result));
    await DbClient.closePool();
    process.exit(0);
  } catch (err: any) {
    console.error(JSON.stringify({ success: false, pid: process.pid, error: err.message, stack: err.stack }));
    await DbClient.closePool();
    process.exit(1);
  }
}

main();

import { DynamicRecordsService } from "../src/records/dynamicRecordsService.js";
import { DbClient } from "../src/database/dbClient.js";

async function main() {
  console.log("[Test] Testing DynamicRecordsService...");
  const records = new DynamicRecordsService();

  // Seed test operating account in treasury_accounts
  await DbClient.query(`
    INSERT INTO treasury_accounts (account_id, name, role, wallet_address, min_operating_floor_usdc)
    VALUES ('OPEX_DEV', 'Dev Ops Pool', 'OPEX_DEV', '0x9999999999999999999999999999999999999999', 500.000000)
    ON CONFLICT (account_id) DO NOTHING;
  `);

  // 1. Add Dynamic Liability (Record 1)
  const lia = await records.upsertLiability({
    accountId: "OPEX_DEV",
    vendorId: "VEND-AWS-01",
    title: "AWS Cloud Services Bill - October 2026",
    amountUsdc: "12500.000000",
    payoutAddress: "0x1111111111111111111111111111111111111111",
    dueDate: new Date(Date.now() + 3 * 86400 * 1000), // Due in 3 days
    frequency: "MONTHLY",
    documentHash: "0x7fa26a310c812d87e0ef6b7bfa9c3e981f211320ef2294101e1dc59c4059a4bb",
    poReference: "PO-2026-AWS-01",
    status: "SCHEDULED",
  });
  console.log(`[Test] Upserted Liability: ${lia.liabilityId}, ${lia.title}, Amount: ${lia.amountUsdc} USDC`);

  // 2. Fetch Tripartite Balance
  const tripartite = await records.getTripartiteBalance("OPEX_DEV", 100000000000n, 50000000000n);
  console.log(`[Test] Tripartite Balance:`);
  console.log(` - Liquid: ${tripartite.liquidCashUsdc} USDC`);
  console.log(` - Invested: ${tripartite.investedYieldUsdc} USDC`);
  console.log(` - Available: ${tripartite.availableBalanceUsdc} USDC`);
  console.log(` - Invariant check: ${tripartite.invariantSatisfied}`);

  // 3. Calculate Safe-to-Invest (Record 2)
  const sti = await records.calculateSafeToInvest("OPEX_DEV", 7 * 86400, "20000.000000", 100000000000n, 50000000000n);
  console.log(`[Test] Dynamic Safe-to-Invest (Record 2):`);
  console.log(` - Upcoming Liabilities (within 7d): ${sti.upcomingLiabilitiesTotalUsdc} USDC`);
  console.log(` - Target Reserve: ${sti.targetReserveUsdc} USDC`);
  console.log(` - Safe-to-Invest: ${sti.safeToInvestUsdc} USDC`);
  console.log(` - Status: ${sti.status}`);

  // 100,000 Liquid - (12,500 AWS + 20,000 Reserve) = 67,500.000000 USDC Safe to Invest
  if (sti.safeToInvestUsdc !== "67500.000000") {
    throw new Error(`Expected safe to invest 67500.000000, got ${sti.safeToInvestUsdc}`);
  }

  console.log("[Test] Dynamic Records & Invariants verified successfully!");
  await DbClient.closePool();
}

main().catch(async (err) => {
  console.error("[Test] Error:", err);
  await DbClient.closePool();
  process.exit(1);
});

import { ContinuousContextManager } from "../src/context/continuousContextManager.js";
import { DbClient } from "../src/database/dbClient.js";

async function main() {
  console.log("[Test] Testing ContinuousContextManager & Dual-Stream Compaction...");
  const sessionId = `test_session_${Date.now()}`;
  const manager = new ContinuousContextManager(undefined, undefined, 5); // threshold 5 for rapid test

  // Record 6 events across different agents
  for (let i = 1; i <= 6; i++) {
    const seq = await manager.recordEvent({
      sessionId,
      agentId: 101,
      agentName: "TreasurySentinelAgent",
      eventType: i === 1 ? "TASK_INITIATED" : "STATE_MUTATION",
      role: "assistant",
      content: `Cycle #${i}: Liquidity evaluated. Idle cash $50,000 swept to USYC Yield Vault. Tx: 0xabc${i}`,
      metadata: { txHash: `0xabc${i}`, cycle: i },
    });
    console.log(` - Recorded Event Seq: ${seq}`);
  }

  // Check if compaction occurred automatically
  const episode = await manager.getLatestCompactedEpisode(sessionId);
  if (!episode) {
    throw new Error("Compaction episode was not created after exceeding threshold!");
  }

  console.log(`[Test] Compaction Succeeded! Episode #${episode.episodeIndex}:`);
  console.log(` - Narrative Summary: ${episode.narrativeSummary}`);
  console.log(` - Invariant Check Passed: ${episode.deterministicAnchors.invariantCheckPassed}`);
  console.log(` - Liquid: ${episode.deterministicAnchors.liquidCashUsdc} USDC`);
  console.log(` - Invested: ${episode.deterministicAnchors.investedYieldUsdc} USDC`);
  console.log(` - Available: ${episode.deterministicAnchors.availableBalanceUsdc} USDC`);

  // Assemble context for an agent
  const assembled = await manager.assembleAgentContext(
    sessionId,
    102,
    "LiabilityRadarAgent",
    "You are the Liability Radar Agent.",
    "Verify AWS invoice INV-2026-901 for 12,500 USDC"
  );

  console.log(`[Test] Assembled prompt context:`);
  console.log(` - Messages count: ${assembled.messages.length}`);
  console.log(` - Relevant Memory count: ${assembled.relevantMemorySnippets.length}`);

  console.log("[Test] Continuous Context & Multi-Tier Management verified successfully!");
  await DbClient.closePool();
}

  await DbClient.closePool();

import { createWalletClient, http, publicActions, encodeDeployData } from "viem";
import { privateKeyToAccount } from "viem/accounts";
import { arcTestnet } from "viem/chains";
import fs from "fs";
import path from "path";
import dotenv from "dotenv";
import {
  CentralTreasuryYieldVaultABI,
  CentralTreasuryYieldVaultBytecode,
  DisbursalVaultABI,
  DisbursalVaultBytecode,
  MockUSYCVaultABI,
  MockUSYCVaultBytecode,
} from "../src/contracts/artifacts.js";
import { ARC_CONSTANTS } from "../src/foundation/arc/constants.js";

dotenv.config();

async function main() {
  console.log("=== Deploying BizArc Smart Contracts to Arc Testnet ===");

  const privateKey =
    (process.env.BIZARC_EXECUTOR_PRIVATE_KEY as `0x${string}` | undefined) ||
    (process.env.TEST_ADMIN_PRIVATE_KEY as `0x${string}` | undefined) ||
    "0xac0974bec39a17e36ba4a6b4d238ff944bacb478cbed5efcae784d7bf4f2ff80";

  const account = privateKeyToAccount(privateKey);
  const client = createWalletClient({
    account,
    chain: arcTestnet,
    transport: http(ARC_CONSTANTS.TESTNET.rpcUrl, { timeout: 30000 }),
  }).extend(publicActions);

  console.log(`Deployer Address: ${account.address}`);
  const balance = await client.getBalance({ address: account.address });
  console.log(`Native USDC Balance: ${balance.toString()} wei (${Number(balance) / 1e18} USDC)`);

  const gasPrice = ARC_CONSTANTS.MIN_GAS_FLOOR_WEI; // 20 Gwei floor

  // 1. Deploy or resolve MockUSYCVault if needed
  let usycAddress = process.env.USYC_CONTRACT_ADDRESS as `0x${string}` | undefined;
  if (!usycAddress || !usycAddress.startsWith("0x") || usycAddress.length !== 42) {
    console.log("\n1. Deploying MockUSYCVault...");
    const usycDeployData = encodeDeployData({
      abi: MockUSYCVaultABI,
      bytecode: MockUSYCVaultBytecode,
      args: [ARC_CONSTANTS.USDC_PREDEPLOY],
    });

    const usycHash = await client.sendTransaction({
      account,
      data: usycDeployData,
      maxFeePerGas: gasPrice,
      maxPriorityFeePerGas: gasPrice,
    });
    console.log(`Transaction submitted: ${usycHash}`);
    const usycReceipt = await client.waitForTransactionReceipt({ hash: usycHash });
    usycAddress = usycReceipt.contractAddress!;
    console.log(`✓ MockUSYCVault deployed at: ${usycAddress}`);
  } else {
    console.log(`Using existing USYC address: ${usycAddress}`);
  }

  // 2. Deploy CentralTreasuryYieldVault
  let centralVaultAddress = process.env.CENTRAL_TREASURY_VAULT_ADDRESS as `0x${string}` | undefined;
  if (!centralVaultAddress || !centralVaultAddress.startsWith("0x") || centralVaultAddress.length !== 42) {
    console.log("\n2. Deploying CentralTreasuryYieldVault...");
    const centralDeployData = encodeDeployData({
      abi: CentralTreasuryYieldVaultABI,
      bytecode: CentralTreasuryYieldVaultBytecode,
      args: [ARC_CONSTANTS.USDC_PREDEPLOY, usycAddress, account.address],
    });

    const centralHash = await client.sendTransaction({
      account,
      data: centralDeployData,
      maxFeePerGas: gasPrice,
      maxPriorityFeePerGas: gasPrice,
    });
    console.log(`Transaction submitted: ${centralHash}`);
    const centralReceipt = await client.waitForTransactionReceipt({ hash: centralHash });
    centralVaultAddress = centralReceipt.contractAddress!;
    console.log(`✓ CentralTreasuryYieldVault deployed at: ${centralVaultAddress}`);
  } else {
    console.log(`Using existing CentralTreasuryYieldVault: ${centralVaultAddress}`);
  }

  // 3. Deploy DisbursalVault
  let disbursalVaultAddress = process.env.DISBURSAL_VAULT_ADDRESS as `0x${string}` | undefined;
  if (!disbursalVaultAddress || !disbursalVaultAddress.startsWith("0x") || disbursalVaultAddress.length !== 42) {
    console.log("\n3. Deploying DisbursalVault...");
    const perTxCap = 500_000_000n; // 500 USDC
    const dailyCap = 5_000_000_000n; // 5,000 USDC
    const eip712Threshold = 500_000_000n; // 500 USDC

    const disbursalDeployData = encodeDeployData({
      abi: DisbursalVaultABI,
      bytecode: DisbursalVaultBytecode,
      args: [ARC_CONSTANTS.USDC_PREDEPLOY, account.address, perTxCap, dailyCap, eip712Threshold],
    });

    const disbursalHash = await client.sendTransaction({
      account,
      data: disbursalDeployData,
      maxFeePerGas: gasPrice,
      maxPriorityFeePerGas: gasPrice,
    });
    console.log(`Transaction submitted: ${disbursalHash}`);
    const disbursalReceipt = await client.waitForTransactionReceipt({ hash: disbursalHash });
    disbursalVaultAddress = disbursalReceipt.contractAddress!;
    console.log(`✓ DisbursalVault deployed at: ${disbursalVaultAddress}`);
  } else {
    console.log(`Using existing DisbursalVault: ${disbursalVaultAddress}`);
  }

  // Update .env file
  const envPath = path.resolve(process.cwd(), ".env");
  let envContent = fs.readFileSync(envPath, "utf-8");
  envContent = envContent.replace(/^CENTRAL_TREASURY_VAULT_ADDRESS=.*$/m, `CENTRAL_TREASURY_VAULT_ADDRESS=${centralVaultAddress}`);
  envContent = envContent.replace(/^DISBURSAL_VAULT_ADDRESS=.*$/m, `DISBURSAL_VAULT_ADDRESS=${disbursalVaultAddress}`);
  envContent = envContent.replace(/^USYC_CONTRACT_ADDRESS=.*$/m, `USYC_CONTRACT_ADDRESS=${usycAddress}`);
  envContent = envContent.replace(/^ADMIN_APPROVER_ADDRESS=.*$/m, `ADMIN_APPROVER_ADDRESS=${account.address}`);
  fs.writeFileSync(envPath, envContent);

  console.log(`  CENTRAL_TREASURY_VAULT_ADDRESS=${centralVaultAddress}`);
  console.log(`  DISBURSAL_VAULT_ADDRESS=${disbursalVaultAddress}`);
  console.log(`  USYC_CONTRACT_ADDRESS=${usycAddress}`);

File: compileContracts.ts

import fs from "fs";
import path from "path";
// @ts-ignore
import solc from "solc";

function findImports(importPath: string) {
  if (importPath.startsWith("@openzeppelin/")) {
    const fullPath = path.resolve(process.cwd(), "node_modules", importPath);
    if (fs.existsSync(fullPath)) {
      return { contents: fs.readFileSync(fullPath, "utf-8") };
    }
  }

  const localPath = path.resolve(process.cwd(), "contracts", importPath);
  if (fs.existsSync(localPath)) {
    return { contents: fs.readFileSync(localPath, "utf-8") };
  }

  return { error: `File not found: ${importPath}` };
}

export function compileContracts() {
  console.log("Compiling BizArc Solidity smart contracts...");

  const contractsDir = path.resolve(process.cwd(), "contracts");
  const sources: Record<string, { content: string }> = {};

  const files = [
    "interfaces/IERC4626Yield.sol",
    "CentralTreasuryYieldVault.sol",
    "DisbursalVault.sol",
    "MockUSYCVault.sol",
  ];

  for (const file of files) {
    const filePath = path.join(contractsDir, file);
    sources[file] = { content: fs.readFileSync(filePath, "utf-8") };
  }

  const input = {
    language: "Solidity",
    sources,
    settings: {
      optimizer: {
        enabled: true,
        runs: 200,
      },
      outputSelection: {
        "*": {
          "*": ["abi", "evm.bytecode.object"],
        },
      },
    },
  };

  const output = JSON.parse(solc.compile(JSON.stringify(input), { import: findImports }));

  if (output.errors) {
    let hasFatal = false;
    for (const error of output.errors) {
      if (error.severity === "error") {
        console.error("COMPILE ERROR:", error.formattedMessage);
        hasFatal = true;
      } else {
        console.warn("COMPILE WARNING:", error.formattedMessage);
      }
    }
    if (hasFatal) {
      throw new Error("Solidity compilation failed.");
    }
  }

  const artifactsDir = path.resolve(process.cwd(), "artifacts/contracts");
  fs.mkdirSync(artifactsDir, { recursive: true });

  const compiledArtifacts: Record<string, { abi: unknown[]; bytecode: string }> = {};

  for (const [file, contractObj] of Object.entries(output.contracts as Record<string, any>)) {
    for (const [name, data] of Object.entries(contractObj)) {
      const artifact = {
        contractName: name,
        sourceName: file,
        abi: data.abi,
        bytecode: "0x" + data.evm.bytecode.object,
      };

      compiledArtifacts[name] = artifact;
      fs.writeFileSync(
        path.join(artifactsDir, `${name}.json`),
        JSON.stringify(artifact, null, 2)
      );
      console.log(`✓ Compiled: ${name} -> artifacts/contracts/${name}.json`);
    }
  }

  // Also write generated ABI TypeScript file in src/contracts/
  const contractsSrcDir = path.resolve(process.cwd(), "src/contracts");
  fs.mkdirSync(contractsSrcDir, { recursive: true });

  const tsExportContent = `// Auto-generated ABI exports
export const CentralTreasuryYieldVaultABI = ${JSON.stringify(compiledArtifacts["CentralTreasuryYieldVault"]?.abi, null, 2)} as const;
export const CentralTreasuryYieldVaultBytecode = "${compiledArtifacts["CentralTreasuryYieldVault"]?.bytecode}" as const;

export const DisbursalVaultABI = ${JSON.stringify(compiledArtifacts["DisbursalVault"]?.abi, null, 2)} as const;
export const DisbursalVaultBytecode = "${compiledArtifacts["DisbursalVault"]?.bytecode}" as const;

export const MockUSYCVaultABI = ${JSON.stringify(compiledArtifacts["MockUSYCVault"]?.abi, null, 2)} as const;
export const MockUSYCVaultBytecode = "${compiledArtifacts["MockUSYCVault"]?.bytecode}" as const;
`;

  fs.writeFileSync(path.join(contractsSrcDir, "artifacts.ts"), tsExportContent);
  console.log(`✓ Generated TypeScript ABI exports -> src/contracts/artifacts.ts`);

  return compiledArtifacts;
}

if (process.argv[1]?.endsWith("compileContracts.ts")) {
  compileContracts();
}
